The strategy groups these needs around anchor points that offer accessibility and attraction.
captions: Social research: activity needs of the two groups and the space demand.
Strategy: anchor points serving elderly people who live alone and with family.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 2021 年 11 月的現地調查與問卷，比較獨居高齡者與和子女同住者的需求，從再就業、文化活動到醫療、餐飲與購物。策略將這些需求組織在提供可及性與吸引力的錨點周圍。
captions: 社會調查：兩類高齡者的活動需求與空間需求。
策略：服務獨居與同住高齡者的錨點。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The elderly who live alone want to socialise and take 250 metres as their five-minute life circle; those who live with family have a smaller range and take 200 metres. Anchor points are placed so that each serves both kinds of community, a slow walking path connects them all, and functions for higher-level needs sit inside the life circle, while old factories are converted into a teahouse, library, canteen, theatre, museum and gardening space.
captions: Design process: functional partition, traffic design, anchor points and other points.
Master plan of the renewed community along the river.
Stakeholders map linking the elderly, the neighbourhood committee, young residents and visitors.
Space renovation for residential and public space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 獨居高齡者希望社交，以 250 公尺作為五分鐘生活圈；與家人同住者活動範圍較小，以 200 公尺為生活圈。錨點的配置讓每一處都能服務兩類社區，並以慢行步道串連，高層次需求的機能則安排在生活圈內，老工廠則改造為茶館、圖書館、食堂、劇場、博物館與園藝空間。
captions: 設計過程：機能分區、交通設計、錨點與其他節點。
沿河更新社區的總平面圖。
利害關係人圖：串連高齡者、居委會、年輕居民與訪客。
居住空間與公共空間的改造。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Anchor points at the hospital and the kindergarten, and active points for gardening, an elderly barber, a park and a riverside path, turn the old factory site into a walkable community. Elderly residents can rest, exercise and meet there.
captions: Anchor point vignettes and the axonometric drawing of the community.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 醫院與幼兒園的錨點，加上園藝、長者理髮、公園與河岸步道等活動點，讓老工廠基地成為一個可步行的社區。高齡居民能在這裡休憩、運動與相聚。
captions: 錨點場景與社區軸測圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Survey the people the site serves.
2. Measure needs as walking distance.
3. Place anchor points to serve both groups.
4. Reuse old buildings for daily life.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 調查基地所服務的人。
2. 以步行距離衡量需求。
3. 配置能同時服務兩類人群的錨點。
4. 將舊建築轉作日常生活之用。

pins.title: Low Carbon Urban New Area
pins.description:
A central wetland park and two ventilation corridors shape a carbon-neutral new urban area in Changsha.

Changsha, China | Low-carbon urban planning | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 低碳城市新區
zh-Hant.description:
以中央濕地公園與兩條通風廊道，塑造長沙一座碳中和的城市新區。

中國長沙｜低碳城市規劃｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The new area gathered around a central wetland park on the river.
圍繞河畔中央濕地公園展開的新區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project is located in the Changsha New Development Zone and is designed on the theory of carbon neutrality. The question is how a new urban area can grow while its own landscape helps to offset its carbon emissions.
captions: Site analysis: elevation, slope, landscape and traffic scores combined into a land suitability evaluation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於長沙新開發區，設計以碳中和理論為基礎。核心問題是：一個新城區如何在發展的同時，讓自身的地景協助抵消碳排放。
captions: 基地分析：高程、坡度、景觀與交通評分疊合為土地適宜性評估。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Physical geography, landscape and traffic radiation scores were overlaid to evaluate land suitability, and block density studies tested small blocks and small streets. The results guided a land use plan that balances residential, business, educational and green land.
captions: Land use planning with the share of each land type.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 團隊疊合自然地理、景觀與交通輻射評分來評估土地適宜性，並以街廓密度研究測試小街廓、密路網的配置。研究結果導出一份平衡居住、商業、教育與綠地的土地使用計畫。
captions: 土地使用規劃與各類用地比例。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A central wetland park connects the whole area, and the wetlands help to neutralise its carbon emissions. Two green ventilation corridors reduce the urban heat island effect, one passing through the wetland park and one through a new energy research university, supported by distributed energy and passive energy conservation.
captions: Master plan with the wetland park, campuses, industrial parks and riverside facilities.
Design analysis: road network, planning structure and industry structure.
Sustainable strategy: ventilation gallery, energy distribution and passive energy conservation.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 中央濕地公園串連整個區域，濕地也協助中和區域的碳排放。兩條綠色通風廊道降低都市熱島效應，一條穿過濕地公園，一條穿過新能源研究大學，並搭配分散式能源與被動式節能設計。
captions: 總平面圖：濕地公園、校園、產業園區與河岸設施。
設計分析：路網、規劃結構與產業結構。
永續策略：通風廊道、能源分布與被動式節能。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The renderings show the central wetland park as a waterfront public landscape and the research universities set among green roofs and open fields. This was a teamwork project, and the student's contribution covered site analysis, land use planning, the master plan, design analysis drawings and renderings.
captions: Rendering of the central wetland park.
Rendering of the scientific research universities.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 渲染圖呈現中央濕地公園作為水岸公共地景，研究大學則坐落在綠屋頂與開放草地之間。這是一個團隊作業，學生負責基地分析、土地使用規劃、總平面圖、設計分析圖與渲染。
captions: 中央濕地公園渲染圖。
科學研究大學渲染圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Score the land before drawing on it.
2. Let the landscape carry the carbon goal.
3. Shape corridors for wind and water.
4. Test the plan through the renderings.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先為土地評分，再開始規劃。
2. 讓地景承擔減碳目標。
3. 為風與水塑造廊道。
4. 用渲染檢驗規劃。

pins.title: Phuket Turtle Rescue Operation
pins.description:
A sea turtle rescue centre on Mai Khao Beach links emergency care, recovery and public education along one route.

Phuket, Thailand | Wildlife rescue centre | 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 普吉島海龜救援行動
zh-Hant.description:
位於麥考海灘的海龜救援中心，以一條路線串連急救、復健與公眾教育。

泰國普吉島｜野生動物救援中心｜2022｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The turtle centre drawn as a single route from the sea to the shore.
海龜中心被畫成一條從海面到岸上的連續路徑。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project is set on Mai Khao Beach in Phuket, Thailand, where sea turtles come ashore in large numbers. Injured turtles need a fast route from the sea to treatment, while plastic garbage keeps threatening their life cycle.
captions: Sea turtle analysis: the life cycle and the threats of global warming, bycatch, marine garbage and habitat destruction.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於泰國普吉島的麥考海灘，是海龜大量上岸的地方。受傷的海龜需要一條從海上快速送往治療的路線，而塑膠垃圾也持續威脅牠們的生命週期。
captions: 海龜分析：生命週期，以及全球暖化、誤捕、海洋垃圾與棲地破壞等威脅。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Studying the turtle's life and two existing conservation centres showed that design can protect hatching and reduce the swallowing of plastic garbage. The cases suggested keeping an undisturbed spawning beach, adding shading and creating more interaction between visitors and turtles.
captions: Case analysis: advantages, disadvantages, learning points and improvement points.
Strategy: tourists support the rescue centre through visits, a coffee shop, recycled goods and a youth education base.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 透過研究海龜的生命歷程與兩個既有保育中心，發現設計可以保護孵化並減少海龜誤食塑膠垃圾。案例建議保留不受干擾的產卵海灘、增加遮蔭，並創造更多遊客與海龜之間的互動。
captions: 案例分析：優點、缺點、可學習之處與改進方向。
策略：遊客透過參觀、咖啡店、回收商品與青少年教育基地支持救援中心。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The strategy works in four steps: rescue, protection, recycling and popularisation. Injured turtles are first treated at the marine emergency station, the serious cases travel along a corridor to the onshore operating room, and the plan, shaped by the hexagon of a turtle shell, connects the turtle village with an enclosed spawning beach.
captions: Strategy sketches: rescue, protection, recycling and popularisation.
Design process: connecting the turtle village, functional partition and the turtle-shell hexagon.
Master plan from the rescue wharf to the recovery pools and science exhibition.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 策略分為四個步驟：救援、保護、回收與科普。受傷的海龜先在海上急救站接受治療，重傷者沿著廊道送往岸上的手術室，而以龜殼六角形為設計元素的配置，則串連海龜村與封閉的產卵海灘。
captions: 策略草圖：救援、保護、回收與科普。
設計過程：串連海龜村、機能分區與龜殼六角形。
總平面圖：從救援碼頭到復健池與科普展覽。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The section runs from the water rescue centre through turtle surgery and recovery to a youth science base and a popular science museum. After surgery, the turtles recover in the pool before they are released back to the sea.
captions: Section through the rescue centre, surgery and recovery, science base and museum.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖面從海上救援中心，經過海龜手術與復健，延伸到青少年科普基地與科普博物館。手術後的海龜在水池中復原，之後再放回大海。
captions: 穿過救援中心、手術與復健區、科普基地與博物館的剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the animal's life cycle.
2. Learn from existing cases.
3. Draw the rescue as one route.
4. Let visitors fund the care.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從動物的生命週期出發。
2. 向既有案例學習。
3. 把救援畫成一條路線。
4. 讓遊客支持照護。

pins.title: Riverside Urban Renewal
pins.description:
Three small public spaces on Riverside Road in Guangzhou are renewed for young people, children and the elderly.

Guangzhou, China | Urban renewal | 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 沿江路都市更新
zh-Hant.description:
廣州沿江路上的三處小型公共空間，分別為年輕人、兒童與長者進行更新。

中國廣州｜都市更新｜2022｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The hydrophilic platform opens the riverside to children and families.
親水平台讓河岸向孩子與家庭開放。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Along Riverside Road on the Pearl River in Guangzhou, buildings are uneven, there is a gap between new and old housing, and the public space between buildings is losing its appeal. The design aims to restore the vitality of the whole block while keeping its cultural memory.
captions: Mapping of the site between the Yuexiu and Haizhu districts, with the three chosen sites.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在廣州珠江沿岸的沿江路一帶，建築高低不一，新舊住宅之間存在落差，建築之間的公共空間也逐漸失去吸引力。設計希望在保留文化記憶的同時，恢復整個街區的活力。
captions: 越秀區與海珠區之間的基地調查圖，標示三處選定的基地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site analysis picked three public spaces that serve three groups: a square outside the community market for young people, an underused cruise terminal for children, and a simple corner park for the elderly. Each one is given a theme: novel experience, hydrophilic space and street eye.
captions: Strategy for the youth entertainment zone, the hydrophilic platform and the Cantonese opera stage.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地分析挑選了三處服務不同族群的公共空間：社區市場外的廣場服務年輕人，使用率低的遊船碼頭服務兒童，簡單的街角公園則服務長者。每一處各有主題：新奇體驗、親水空間與街道之眼。
captions: 青年娛樂區、親水平台與粵劇舞台的策略圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In the youth entertainment zone, the canopy of the site is extracted as a design element and deformed, arranged and combined, and the shape of the fishing boat forms a three-tier market complex with a coffee shop, staircase cinema, board games and an escape room. The wharf becomes a platform for rainwater collection and tidal play, and the corner park gains an opera stage beside the road.
captions: Master plan of the youth entertainment zone.
Design process: the site, the old and new residences, and the combined deformation of eaves.
Rendering of the market extension under the new canopy.
Section perspective of the three-tier market complex.
Hydrophilic platform: design analysis sketch and renderings.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在青年娛樂區，基地的雨棚被提取為設計元素，經過變形、排列與組合，再參考漁船的造型形成三層的市場綜合體，容納咖啡店、樓梯電影院、桌遊與密室逃脫。碼頭轉變為雨水收集與潮汐遊戲的平台，街角公園則在路旁增設一座戲台。
captions: 青年娛樂區總平面圖。
設計過程：基地、新舊住宅與屋簷的組合變形。
新雨棚下延伸市場的渲染圖。
三層市場綜合體的剖透視圖。
親水平台：設計分析草圖與渲染圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The stage beside the road draws people to stop and serves as a cultural performance space for the nearby post station, while elderly people in the teahouse can enjoy Cantonese opera as they drink tea. Together the three spaces renew Riverside Road for young people, children and the elderly.
captions: Renderings of the opera stage beside the road and the raised stage in the park.
Plan of the Cantonese opera stage and the teahouse.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 路旁的戲台吸引行人駐足，也作為鄰近文化驛站的表演空間，茶館裡的長者則能一邊喝茶一邊欣賞粵劇。三處空間共同為年輕人、兒童與長者更新沿江路。
captions: 路旁戲台與公園中抬高舞台的渲染圖。
粵劇舞台與茶館平面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick small sites for different people.
2. Give each site one clear theme.
3. Borrow forms from local memory.
4. Design for staying, not passing.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 為不同族群挑選小基地。
2. 為每處基地設定清楚的主題。
3. 從在地記憶借用形式。
4. 設計讓人停留，而非只是經過。

pins.title: Folding Nanshan
pins.description:
A speculative model of how Shenzhen's Nanshan District could fold apart along class lines.

Shenzhen, China | Speculative urban design | 2021–2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 摺疊南山
zh-Hant.description:
以假想模型推演深圳南山區如何沿著階層界線摺疊分離。

中國深圳｜思辨性城市設計｜2021–2022｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The dynamic physical model: servo-driven units fold the city between gated and open communities.
動態實體模型：以伺服馬達驅動的單元，讓城市在封閉社區與開放社區之間摺疊。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Shenzhen draws tens of thousands of newcomers every day, yet an invisible barrier between classes has been hardening since the city opened up and is becoming visible in urban space. Inspired by a novel about residential segregation in Beijing, the project takes Nanshan District as a hypothetical test of what the city would look like if the gap between rich and poor kept growing.
captions: Demographic and activity area analysis of social classes in Nanshan.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳每天吸引數以萬計的新移民，但自城市開放以來，階層之間一道無形的屏障逐漸固化，並開始在城市空間中顯現。受一部描寫北京居住隔離的小說啟發，本案以南山區作為假想實驗，探問若貧富差距持續擴大，城市將呈現什麼樣貌。
captions: 南山各社會階層的人口與活動範圍分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Land use, house prices, school admission policy for non-registered children and entrepreneurship grants were mapped across the district. The analysis shows that high-priced housing comes with the best educational resources and that talents with higher education receive more policy support, which leads to class solidification and residential segregation.
captions: Land-use analysis on a grid of the district.
House prices, admission policy and grant policy maps.
Conclusion: map of population density.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究將土地使用、房價、非戶籍子女入學政策與創業補助逐一對應到整個行政區。分析顯示高房價住宅伴隨最好的教育資源，高學歷人才也更容易獲得政策支持，最終導致階層固化與居住隔離。
captions: 以網格呈現的行政區土地使用分析。
房價、入學政策與補助政策地圖。
結論：人口密度地圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The master plan is reorganised into residential, commercial, civic and public space layers, and a program analysis assigns them to the grid. A design language of folding forms is developed for each area, from civic facilities to commercial and residential zones.
captions: Master plan reorganisation by residential, public, industrial and civic land.
Program analysis of the reorganised district.
Design language for civic, commercial and residential areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 總體規劃被重組為居住、商業、公共設施與公共空間等圖層，並透過機能分析配置到網格之上。針對每一區發展出摺疊形態的設計語彙，涵蓋公共設施、商業區與住宅區。
captions: 依住宅、公共、工業與公共設施用地進行的總體規劃重組。
重組後行政區的機能分析。
公共設施、商業與住宅區的設計語彙。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A dynamic physical model links economic growth, school enrolment and start-up subsidies to servo angles, so each unit opens or closes as conditions change and is also stretched by the units around it. When the economic difference between areas is large, public space closes into gated communities, and when it is small, it opens to everyone.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 動態實體模型將經濟成長、名校入學率與創業補助連結到伺服馬達角度，讓每個單元隨條件改變而開啟或關閉，同時也受到周圍單元的拉伸與擠壓。當區域之間的經濟差距很大時，公共空間便收合為封閉社區；差距縮小時，則向所有人開放。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a question about the city's future.
2. Map the policies that sort people.
3. Translate data into a moving model.
4. Test the model under changing conditions.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個關於城市未來的問題出發。
2. 繪製將人群分類的政策地圖。
3. 將數據轉化為會動的模型。
4. 在不同條件下測試模型。

pins.title: Arcades Project in the 21st Century
pins.description:
Spaces of consumption in the Liuyun community are turned back into shared public space.

Liuyun community | Consumer space and public space | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 21 世紀的拱廊街計畫
zh-Hant.description:
將 Liuyun 社區的消費空間重新轉化為共享的公共空間。

Liuyun 社區｜消費空間與公共空間｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Four outcomes: a playground, a city hall, a marketplace and outdoor stairs.
四種成果：遊戲場、市民廳、市集與戶外樓梯。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the 19th century consumer space was built to host commercial activity, but in the 21st century space itself has become a product to be consumed. In the Liuyun community the confrontation between consumer space and public space has always existed, so the project asks what the community's space should become in the future.
captions: The phantasmagoria of the site and the alienation it produces: switch, fake, expansion, coverage and combine.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 19 世紀的消費空間是為了容納商業活動而建，到了 21 世紀，空間本身卻成為被消費的商品。在 Liuyun 社區，消費空間與公共空間的對立始終存在，因此本案探問社區的空間未來應發展成什麼樣子。
captions: 基地的幻象及其造成的異化：切換、偽裝、擴張、覆蓋與組合。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Building on the Arcades Project, the project describes the phantasmagoria of the site through words such as attractive, enforced and tease, and turns them into five operations of alienation. Shopfronts and streets in the community were then characterised through sketches of enclosure, hiding, decoration, fuzzy boundaries and no intersection.
captions: Site characterisation sketches of the community's streets and shopfronts.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案延續《拱廊街計畫》的思考，以吸引、強制、挑逗等字詞描述基地的幻象，並將其轉化為五種異化操作。接著以手繪草圖歸納社區店面與街道的特徵，包括圍合、隱藏、裝飾、模糊邊界與不相交。
captions: 社區街道與店面的基地特徵草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each operation of alienation is combined with a site characteristic to produce spaces of consumption that have been removed from consumer behaviour, such as an observation tower, a city chamber, a maze and outdoor stairs. These spaces are placed on sites around the school and along the street.
captions: Spaces of consumption removed from consumer behaviour, each a pair of operations.
Site plan of the playground near the school.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每一種異化操作都與一項基地特徵結合，產生脫離消費行為的消費空間，例如瞭望塔、市民廳、迷宮與戶外樓梯。這些空間被配置在學校周邊與街道沿線的基地上。
captions: 脫離消費行為的消費空間，每一個都由兩種操作組成。
學校旁遊戲場的基地配置圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The playground is a place of consumption or free respite at different times of the day, and the city hall hosts community events and can be hired out. The marketplace serves daily shopping and creative fairs with neighbouring businesses, while outdoor stairs let commercial tenants maintain the vertical circulation they share with residents.
captions: Site plan of the marketplace.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 遊戲場在一天不同時段可以是消費場所，也可以是免費的休憩空間；市民廳則舉辦社區活動，也可以出租使用。市集服務日常採買，並與鄰近商家合辦創意市集，戶外樓梯則讓商業租戶負責維護與居民共用的垂直動線。
captions: 市集的基地配置圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name the feelings a place produces.
2. Turn them into spatial operations.
3. Pair each operation with a site trait.
4. Test the result at different times of day.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 為場所帶來的感受命名。
2. 將感受轉化為空間操作。
3. 讓每個操作對應一項基地特徵。
4. 在一天中的不同時段檢驗成果。

pins.title: Experience in Pingshan
pins.description:
A wetland park reconnects the banks of the polluted Pingshan River in Shenzhen.

Shenzhen, China | Wetland park | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 坪山體驗
zh-Hant.description:
以濕地公園重新串連深圳受污染的坪山河兩岸。

中國深圳｜濕地公園｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the waterfront promenade along the Pingshan River.
坪山河濱水步道鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site on the Pingshan River is cut by an urban road, its water is severely polluted by the industrial area upstream, and the dense plants along the banks make the river inaccessible for people. As Shenzhen develops, the river is expected to change from a suburban factory-side river into a major recreational green space for the surrounding city.
captions: Design strategy: meeting in the space, in the memories and in the Pingshan River.
Design analysis: slow traffic, theme areas, riparian zone, roads, activities and green space.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 坪山河畔的基地被一條城市道路切開，河水受到上游工業區的嚴重污染，沿岸茂密的植物也讓人無法親近河流。隨著深圳的發展，這條河預期將從郊區工廠旁的河流，轉變為服務周邊城市的重要休憩綠地。
captions: 設計策略：相遇於空間、相遇於記憶、相遇於坪山河。
設計分析：慢行系統、主題區、河岸帶、道路、活動與綠地類型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Analysis of the location, site structure and regional history traced the area's change from agriculture to industry and its links to the city's urban, ecological and coastal axes. The strategy creates a wetland park with regional characteristics, with diverse outdoor spaces, distinctive urban spots that recall the industrial context, and water purification by plants.
captions: Master plan: places to meet in space, in memory, at events and in nature.
Bank analysis: wetlands, waterfront walkway, wooden platform, green space and trestle.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究分析了區位、基地結構與區域歷史，追溯此地從農業轉向工業的過程，以及它與城市軸線、生態軸線與濱海軸線的關係。策略是打造具有地域特色的濕地公園，提供多樣的戶外空間、呼應工業脈絡的城市特色節點，並以植物淨化水質。
captions: 總平面圖：相遇於空間、記憶、活動與自然的場所。
河岸分析：濕地、濱水步道、木平台、綠地與木棧道。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The Swirl, a red gateway to the park, reconnects the three banks divided by the river and the road and gives the site a strong new urban memory. In the water purification section, different wetland plants reduce nitrogen and phosphorus in the water from the factory outflow before it reaches the river.
captions: The Swirl: entrance, installation and activities.
Water treatment of the banks, before and after.
Water purification process from factory to rain garden, wetland island and river.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 紅色的「漩渦」是公園的門戶，重新串連被河流與道路分隔的三處河岸，也為基地留下強烈的新城市記憶。在水質淨化區，不同的濕地植物在工廠排水流入河流之前，降低水中的氮與磷。
captions: 漩渦：入口、裝置與活動。
河岸水處理的前後對比。
從工廠、雨水花園、濕地島到河流的水質淨化過程。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A former mine inspires the mining park, whose red structures can be climbed, played on and rested in. Together with the Swirl and the wetlands, it turns the polluted river edge into a recreational park for the city.
captions: Mining park: about time, climbing, leisure and playground.
Aerial view of the mining park.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 以舊礦場為靈感的礦場公園，其紅色構造物可以攀爬、遊戲與休憩。它與漩渦和濕地一起，讓受污染的河岸成為城市的休憩公園。
captions: 礦場公園：時間、攀爬、休閒與遊戲場。
礦場公園鳥瞰。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the river as a system.
2. Trace the site's industrial past.
3. Reconnect the banks with one gesture.
4. Let plants clean the water.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把河流當作一個系統來閱讀。
2. 追溯基地的工業歷史。
3. 以一個設計動作重新串連河岸。
4. 讓植物淨化水質。

pins.title: Campus Boundary
pins.description:
A closed school boundary in Shenzhen is expanded from a wall into a surface shared with the city.

Shenzhen, China | Graduation project | 2022 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 校園邊界
zh-Hant.description:
將深圳一所封閉學校的邊界，從一道牆擴展為與城市共享的面。

中國深圳｜畢業設計｜2022｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Exploded view: the slender campus boundary expanded into a surface of inside and outside.
爆炸圖：細長的校園邊界被擴展為一個由內與外構成的面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Not only at the worst period of the epidemic but even two years after the outbreak, the school in Nanshan District is still closed, which has caused discontent among students, nearby businesses and residents. A wall separates the school from the outside, and a road that used to connect to the industrial park has been closed.
captions: Sketch map of the current boundaries around the campus.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 不只在疫情最嚴重的時期，甚至在疫情爆發兩年後的今天，南山區的這所學校仍然封閉，引起學生、周邊商家與居民的不滿。一道圍牆將學校與外界隔開，原本通往產業園區的道路也已封閉。
captions: 校園周邊現有邊界的手繪分析圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A literature review traced how architecture moved from modernism's mechanical dualism, in which one is either one or the other, towards metabolism and symbiosis, in which the added part is connected to the existing facilities. A study of space patterns turns a fixed grid into loose, overlapping units.
captions: Space pattern: from a fixed grid to overlapping units.
Extension: the crowded entrances and exits on the border are expanded from points into lines to reduce congestion.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 文獻回顧追溯建築如何從現代主義非此即彼的機械二元論，走向代謝與共生的思考，讓新增部分與既有設施相連。對空間模式的研究，則把固定的網格轉化為鬆散而重疊的單元。
captions: 空間模式：從固定網格到重疊的單元。
延伸：把邊界上擁擠的出入口從點擴展為線，以減少壅塞。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each part of the boundary is redesigned as a type of edge that sets a new relationship between inside and outside. Extension, gym, courtyard, corridors, sight, interaction, route, transport hub and park each become an edge, compared before and after.
captions: Extension, gym and courtyard as edge.
Corridors, sight and interaction as edge.
Route, transport hub and park as edge.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 邊界的每一段都被重新設計為一種邊緣，建立內與外之間的新關係。延伸、體育館、庭院、廊道、視線、互動、路徑、交通樞紐與公園各自成為一種邊緣，並比較設計前後的差異。
captions: 以延伸、體育館與庭院作為邊緣。
以廊道、視線與互動作為邊緣。
以路徑、交通樞紐與公園作為邊緣。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The design allows the original slender boundary to be expanded into a surface, making it convenient for the students and teachers within the school. At the same time it brings vitality to the surrounding area.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 設計讓原本細長的邊界擴展為一個面，為校內師生帶來便利。同時，它也為周邊地區注入活力。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map who the boundary keeps out.
2. Sketch the edge as it is today.
3. Turn the line into a surface.
4. Give each edge its own program.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 繪製邊界把誰擋在外面。
2. 手繪邊界的現況。
3. 把線轉化為面。
4. 讓每一段邊緣擁有自己的機能。

pins.title: The New System of Market
pins.description:
An old food market in Shenzhen is rebuilt as a layered place to grow, trade, cook and meet.

Shenzhen, China | Market and community | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 市場新系統
zh-Hant.description:
將深圳的傳統菜市場重建為可以種植、交易、烹飪與相聚的多層場所。

中國深圳｜市場與社區｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Sections through the new market: agriculture, entertainment and communication under the housing above.
新市場剖面：住宅之下的農作、娛樂與交流。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In China, with the rise of supermarkets, department stores and shopping centres, old food markets known for their filth and disorder are gradually being discarded, and with the growth of online shopping they are in decline. Yet food markets are an important source of urban vitality, a platform for neighbourhood interaction at a time of urban isolation.
captions: Online vs onsite: social, time and quality issues, and the proposal of a lively, convenient and fresh market.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在中國，隨著超市、百貨公司與購物中心興起，以髒亂著稱的傳統菜市場逐漸被淘汰，網路購物的普及更讓它們日漸衰落。然而菜市場是城市活力的重要來源，在城市日益疏離的今天，更是鄰里互動的平台。
captions: 線上與線下：社交、時間與品質問題，以及熱鬧、便利、新鮮的市場提案。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Comparing online and onsite shopping showed that online buying is convenient and always available, while the market offers face-to-face contact and food whose quality can be seen. The project therefore keeps the human touch of the old market and gives it a new system that links commodities, selling, purchase and food through a social network.
captions: Old and new market systems linked by a social network.
From a market purely for sale to a theme-based market of planting, fishing grounds and teaching.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 比較線上與線下購物後發現，網購便利且隨時可得，市場則提供面對面的接觸，以及看得見品質的食材。因此本案保留傳統市場的人情味，並賦予它一套新系統，透過社交網絡串連商品、販售、購買與食物。
captions: 以社交網絡串連的新舊市場系統。
從單純販售的市場，轉變為種植、漁場與教學的主題式市場。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A link is created between the market and the residence above it, so that the two previously distinct functions are connected through daily life, entertainment and work. Agriculture, entertainment and communication are layered under the housing and joined by ramps that form active dynamic links between floors.
captions: Interaction between the market and the residence through life, entertainment and work.
Concept generation: adding theme functions, open hierarchical connections and active dynamic links.
Formation of spatial functions in the new market.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計在市場與上方住宅之間建立連結，讓原本分離的兩種機能透過生活、娛樂與工作串連起來。農作、娛樂與交流三種機能疊層配置在住宅之下，並以坡道在樓層之間形成活躍的動態連結。
captions: 市場與住宅透過生活、娛樂與工作產生互動。
概念生成：加入主題機能、開放的層級連結與動態連結。
新市場空間機能的生成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the new market people can grow and pick fresh fruit and vegetables on terraces, help water other people's crops via the internet, and exchange vegetables and fish before cooking them in a shared kitchen. The market becomes a platform for offline communication for all kinds of people.
captions: Exploded view: residential, roof, structure, ramps and three floor plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在新的市場裡，人們可以在梯田上種植與採摘新鮮蔬果，透過網路幫別人的作物澆水，也能交換蔬菜和魚，再到共享廚房烹煮。市場因此成為各種人進行線下交流的平台。
captions: 爆炸圖：住宅、屋頂、結構、坡道與三層平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Compare the online and onsite experience.
2. Keep what only a real place can give.
3. Link the new program to daily life.
4. Stack functions and join them with ramps.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 比較線上與線下的體驗。
2. 保留只有實體場所才能提供的價值。
3. 讓新機能與日常生活相連。
4. 將機能疊層，並以坡道串連。

pins.title: Street Reset
pins.description:
Four micro-renewals reconnect an old Zhuhai alley as a line people enjoy walking.

Zhuhai, China | Participatory street design | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 街道重置
zh-Hant.description:
四處微更新重新串連珠海的老巷弄，成為人們樂於漫步的路線。

中國珠海｜參與式街道設計｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Life on the street: a weekday and a weekend along the four renewed points of the alley.
街道生活：沿著巷弄四個更新節點的平日與週末。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In fast-moving, car-planned cities, urban roads are designed with the car as king, while pedestrians come second and lose their enjoyment of public streets. In an old neighbourhood near Gongbei Port in Zhuhai, the lively alleys have fallen into disrepair and are often avoided.
captions: Road analysis: congested main and feeder roads, overlooked alleys, and a new path through four points.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在快速發展、以汽車為規劃核心的城市裡，道路以車為王，行人退居次位，也失去了享受公共街道的樂趣。在珠海拱北口岸附近的老社區，原本熱鬧的巷弄日漸破敗，常被人們繞道避開。
captions: 道路分析：擁擠的主幹道與支路、被忽視的巷弄，以及串連四個節點的新路徑。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Street users, from the elderly and office workers to residents and students, were interviewed about their vision for the alley and involved in the planning with the designer. A sensory map recorded four sites: crowded and messy, an unpleasant odour, plant clutter and vacant land.
captions: Concept: views on the street from residents, students, tenants and tourists become key views for the design.
Sensory map of the four sites along the alley.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計者訪談了長者、上班族、居民與學生等街道使用者，了解他們對巷弄的想像，並邀請他們與設計者一起參與規劃。感官地圖記錄了四個基地：擁擠雜亂、氣味難聞、植栽雜亂與閒置空地。
captions: 概念：居民、學生、租戶與遊客對街道的看法，轉化為設計的關鍵視角。
沿著巷弄四個基地的感官地圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The four small points are micro-renovated around safety, health, identity and speed. A parents' waiting area separates people from motor vehicles, courier lockers with plants and seating replace the smelly rubbish corner, and a telescopic kitchen gives the community a place for picnics.
captions: Site 1, parents' waiting area: design process, area functions and plan.
Site 2, healthy streets: courier lockers, plant areas and enclosed activity areas.
Site 3, before and after: clearing overgrown vegetation and opening access to homes.
Site 3, community events: a telescopic kitchen unfolds into an open picnic table.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 四個小節點分別以安全、健康、認同與速度為主題進行微更新。家長等候區將行人與車輛分開，結合植栽與座椅的快遞櫃取代了氣味難聞的垃圾角落，可伸縮的廚房則讓社區有了野餐的場所。
captions: 基地一，家長等候區：設計流程、區域機能與平面。
基地二，健康街道：快遞櫃、植栽區與圍合的活動區。
基地三，改造前後：清理過度生長的植栽，打開通往住家的動線。
基地三，社區活動：可伸縮的廚房展開成開放的野餐桌。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: On the wide street of Site 4, the road is divided into super fast, fast and slow levels, and a separate cycle lane avoids conflicts with pedestrians. The four themes are linked into one living line, so that people can enjoy walking through the alleys again.
captions: Site 4, street speed: problems, strategies and the design process from human behaviour to form.
Site 4 master plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在基地四的寬闊街道上，道路依速度分為極快、快與慢三個層級，獨立的自行車道則避免與行人衝突。四個主題串連成一條生活軸線，讓人們重新享受在巷弄中漫步。
captions: 基地四，街道速度：問題、策略，以及從人的行為到形態的設計流程。
基地四總平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Walk the street and map how each group uses it.
2. Interview the people who live there.
3. Pick small points for micro-renewal.
4. Link the points into one walking line.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 走訪街道，記錄不同族群的使用方式。
2. 訪談在地居民。
3. 選定小節點進行微更新。
4. 將節點串連成一條步行路線。

pins.title: Stitching River Side
pins.description:
A former brewery on the Guangzhou riverfront is stitched back to the water and the city around the clock.

Guangzhou, China | Waterfront and industrial heritage | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 縫合河岸
zh-Hant.description:
廣州河岸的舊啤酒廠，全天候重新與水岸及城市縫合。

中國廣州｜濱水與工業遺產｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical model: the red walkways stitch the riverside site to the water.
實體模型：紅色步道將河岸基地與水面縫合在一起。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site on the bank of the Pearl River in Guangzhou was originally a brewery, later turned into a beer culture street for food, entertainment and leisure. It is used mostly at night and lacks popularity on weekdays, its office, culture, catering and landscape areas are rarely connected, and few people pass through the ground-floor waterfront.
captions: Uneven use of space between culture, catering and office, night and morning.
People flow analysis: fragmentation with the surroundings by day and vertical fragmentation at night.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於廣州珠江岸邊，原為一座啤酒廠，後來轉型為結合餐飲、娛樂與休閒的啤酒文化街。這裡多半只在夜間使用，平日人氣不足；辦公、文化、餐飲與景觀四個區域彼此少有連結，也很少有人經過一樓的濱水空間。
captions: 文化、餐飲與辦公空間在夜間與早晨的使用不均。
人流分析：白天與周邊斷裂，夜間則出現垂直方向的空間斷裂。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: To use the site efficiently, the project proposes a 24-hour event. The three themes of ecology, history and experience stitch together the inside and outside of the site, blur its hard boundary and add day and night activities.
captions: Activities schedule planning for a 24-hour party across office, culture, catering and leisure.
Strategy: stitch, blur the boundary, and increase day and night activities.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 為了有效利用基地，本案提出二十四小時活動的構想。生態、歷史與體驗三個主題縫合基地的內外，模糊原本生硬的邊界，並增加日夜的活動。
captions: 二十四小時派對的活動時程規劃，涵蓋辦公、文化、餐飲與休閒。
策略：縫合、模糊邊界，以及增加日夜活動。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The hard barge gradually becomes a soft one, blurring the separation between water and site and increasing biodiversity. The malt barn, the original starting point of brewing, becomes a beer-making experience workshop and the start of a browsing route through the production flow.
captions: Topic 1, opening natural boundaries, and Topic 2, the new beer business.
Master plan with the workshop, cultural square, platforms and cruise terminal.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 原本生硬的駁岸逐步轉為柔性駁岸，模糊水與基地的分隔，也增加生物多樣性。原本作為釀酒起點的麥芽倉，改造成啤酒釀造體驗工坊，並成為穿越生產流程的參觀路線起點。
captions: 主題一，打開自然邊界；主題二，新的啤酒產業。
總平面：工坊、文化廣場、親水平台與遊船碼頭。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The day and night activities of different groups are carried out throughout the 24 hours of the day. The site is stitched together both horizontally and vertically, so that people can fully experience the industrial heritage of the city's waterfront.
captions: Overall view from morning to dusk and night.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 不同族群的日夜活動在一天二十四小時中持續進行。基地在水平與垂直方向上都被縫合起來，讓人們能完整體驗城市濱水區的工業遺產。
captions: 從早晨到黃昏與夜晚的整體鳥瞰。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map who uses the site, when and where.
2. Find the breaks in time and space.
3. Plan a full 24-hour schedule.
4. Stitch the site with routes and soft edges.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 記錄誰在何時、何處使用基地。
2. 找出時間與空間上的斷裂。
3. 規劃完整的二十四小時時程。
4. 以路徑與柔性邊界縫合基地。

pins.title: Zhuhai 2050
pins.description:
A new transport system links Zhuhai's four industries into a 30-minute city of the future.

Zhuhai, China | Urban transport and planning | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 珠海2050
zh-Hant.description:
以新的交通系統串連珠海四大產業，打造未來的三十分鐘城市。

中國珠海｜城市交通與規劃｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Zhuhai 2050: a collage of the 30-minute city of the future.
珠海2050：未來三十分鐘城市的拼貼。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Zhuhai is an important node city in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, but because of its own unbalanced development it cannot effectively link up the urban clusters. Its existing basic transportation cannot help the city develop.
captions: Compare: land area, population density, city model and traffic connection of Shenzhen and Zhuhai.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 珠海是粵港澳大灣區的重要節點城市，但由於城市本身發展不均，無法有效串連周邊的城市群。現有的基礎交通也無法帶動城市發展。
captions: 比較：深圳與珠海的土地面積、人口密度、城市模型與交通連結。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The analysis found that the east-west road links are mainly carried by a single highway, passenger rail hubs sit in the east and industrial ones in the west, and most buildings and land-use types are concentrated in the east. Population is unevenly distributed as people move towards the education and business regions.
captions: Urban texture analysis: road networks, waterway grids, rail systems, building texture and population density.
Site land use analysis.
Population analysis: eastern and western population and migration direction.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 分析發現，城市東西向的道路連結主要只靠一條高速公路，客運鐵路樞紐集中在東部，工業鐵路樞紐則在西部，大部分建築與多元的土地使用也集中在東部。隨著人們逐漸遷往教育與商業區域，人口分布也不均衡。
captions: 城市紋理分析：道路網、水道網、鐵路系統、建築紋理與人口密度。
基地土地使用分析。
人口分析：東西部人口與遷移方向。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The transport system is rebuilt to link education, business, industry and agriculture, the four industries of the city. Each industry gets its own transport node, connected by new routes across the city.
captions: New urban transport system linking agriculture, education, business and industry.
Education: leisure connections let students and teachers skateboard, cycle and walk to the external railway system.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計重建交通系統，串連教育、商業、工業與農業四大產業。每個產業都有自己的交通節點，並以橫跨全市的新路線相連。
captions: 串連農業、教育、商業與工業的新城市交通系統。
教育：休閒連結讓師生可以滑板、騎車與步行，通往對外鐵路系統。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the business area, people can arrive by aircraft and enter the offices through a sky lobby, avoiding congestion in the buildings at peak hours. The formerly single-function node city becomes an industrial service city that attracts people from within and beyond Zhuhai.
captions: Business: towers wrapped by ramps and landing platforms.
Section through the business tower with sky platforms and the sky lobby.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在商業區，人們可以搭乘飛行器抵達，經由空中大廳進入辦公室，避開尖峰時段大樓內的擁擠。原本機能單一的節點城市，轉型為吸引城內外人口的產業服務型城市。
captions: 商業：以坡道與起降平台環繞的高塔。
商業高塔剖面：空中平台與空中大廳。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Compare the city with its neighbours.
2. Map roads, rail, water and land use in layers.
3. Find where people and industries are unbalanced.
4. Link the industries with one transport system.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 將城市與鄰近城市比較。
2. 分層繪製道路、鐵路、水系與土地使用。
3. 找出人口與產業失衡之處。
4. 以一套交通系統串連各產業。

pins.title: Parrot Shelter
pins.description:
A teahouse and care space where people keep depressed parrots company under woven bamboo trees.

Dongshankou, China | Interior and animal care | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 鸚鵡庇護所
zh-Hant.description:
在編織竹樹下，人們陪伴憂鬱鸚鵡的茶館與照護空間。

中國東山口｜室內設計與動物照護｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A woven bamboo tree, the support structure that holds the egg-shaped rooms.
編織竹樹，承托蛋形空間的支撐結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In China, when it comes to pets, most people only think of cats and dogs and believe parrots need only water and feed. Parrots are in fact highly intelligent and need company, and depression is becoming more common in domestic parrots, yet few people know how to read its symptoms.
captions: Site selection in Dongshankou: density of parrot owners, subway stations, old and new residential and commercial areas.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在中國，提到寵物，多數人只想到貓狗，並以為鸚鵡只需要水和飼料。其實鸚鵡非常聰明，也需要陪伴；家養鸚鵡的憂鬱問題越來越常見，卻很少人懂得辨認它的徵兆。
captions: 東山口的基地選址：鸚鵡飼主密度、地鐵站，以及新舊住商區。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Case studies showed that most existing stores use birds to attract customers and are based on putting people first, with stiff spaces in which birds feel unsafe and cannot move freely. The project turns this around and takes putting parrots first as its main idea, drawing elements such as the feather, nest, egg, tree and rock from the birds' own world.
captions: Element extraction and space intention: from feather, nest, egg and tree to partitions, knitting, shells and structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 案例研究發現，現有店家多半以鳥來吸引顧客，以人為優先，空間形式生硬，鳥在其中缺乏安全感，也無法自由活動。本案反轉這個邏輯，以鸚鵡優先為核心理念，並從羽毛、鳥巢、蛋、樹與岩石等鳥類世界汲取元素。
captions: 元素萃取與空間意向：從羽毛、鳥巢、蛋與樹，轉化為隔牆、編織、殼體與結構。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The first floor is a teahouse where people drink tea and play with the parrots, with consulting, examination and waiting rooms for parrot care. Height differences separate the routes of people and parrots while still letting them meet, and the undulating floor and feather-like partitions, which double as seats, make the space feel like a natural cave.
captions: Spatial organization: skylights, plant wall, egg-shaped rooms and the parrots' living space.
Streamline organization on two floors, with separate routes for people and parrots.
Section A-A through the woven trees and egg-shaped rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一樓是讓人們喝茶、與鸚鵡互動的茶館，並設有諮詢室、檢查室與候診室照顧鸚鵡。高低差將人與鸚鵡的動線分開，同時讓彼此仍能接觸；起伏的地形與兼作座椅的羽毛狀隔牆，讓空間宛如天然洞穴。
captions: 空間組織：天窗、植生牆、蛋形空間與鸚鵡的生活空間。
兩層樓的動線組織，人與鸚鵡各有路線。
A-A 剖面：穿過編織竹樹與蛋形空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The trees that support the eggs were tested in physical models at 1:10, 1:3 and 1:1, and the larger the scale, the harder the model was to make. Bamboo sticks bent by heat form the keel and cantilevers, secured with metal hoops, hemp rope and screws, and a hexagonal weave forms the outer skin.
captions: Physical model at 1:10, exploring the weaving process and structural stability.
Physical model at 1:3: cantilever, knitting and keel.
Physical model at 1:1: cantilever and keel joints.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 承托蛋形空間的竹樹以 1:10、1:3 與 1:1 的實體模型進行測試，比例越大，製作越困難。加熱彎曲的竹條構成龍骨與懸臂，以金屬環、麻繩與螺絲固定，外層則採用六角編織作為表皮。
captions: 1:10 實體模型，探索編織工法與結構穩定性。
1:3 實體模型：懸臂、編織與龍骨。
1:1 實體模型：懸臂與龍骨節點。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design for the real user, even an animal.
2. Study how existing cases fail that user.
3. Draw forms from the user's own world.
4. Test the structure at growing scales.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 為真正的使用者設計，即使是動物。
2. 研究既有案例如何忽略了這位使用者。
3. 從使用者自己的世界汲取形式。
4. 以逐步放大的比例測試結構。

pins.title: Ego in Scent
pins.description:
A perfume experience store where visitors pass through six spaces and leave with a scent of their own.

Shanghai, China | Interior and brand experience | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 氣味中的自我
zh-Hant.description:
讓訪客走過六個空間，最後帶走專屬氣味的香水體驗店。

中國上海｜室內設計與品牌體驗｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Seven interior spaces in sequence, from the red bath entrance to the glass showroom.
七個依序展開的室內空間，從紅色的浴室入口到玻璃展示廳。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: We perceive our own ego and the egos of others mainly by seeing and touching skin. The project asks whether there is another way, and whether people could perceive their own or others' egos through the sense of smell.
captions: The theory of twelve senses links the sense of smell to the sense of thought, and from there to the sense of ego.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 我們主要透過看見與觸碰皮膚，來感知自己與他人的「自我」。本案提問是否還有其他方式，讓人們能透過嗅覺感知自己或他人的自我。
captions: 十二感官理論將嗅覺與思考感相連，再延伸到自我感。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Studying the theory of twelve senses showed a strong link between the sense of smell and the sense of thought, the only sense related to the sense of ego. Human pheromones are abundant in sweat, and the design centres on a perfume made only of body and base notes that reacts with each wearer's own pheromones to create a personal scent.
captions: Inspiration and morphological examination: a crystal-like mesh that becomes bath, sauna, shower, spa, massage, aromatherapy and showroom.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究十二感官理論後發現，嗅覺與思考感緊密相關，而思考感是唯一與自我感相關的感官。人體費洛蒙大量存在於汗水中，設計便以一款只由體香與基調構成的香水為核心，它會與每位配戴者的費洛蒙作用，產生專屬的氣味。
captions: 靈感與形態推敲：如晶體般的網格，轉化為浴室、桑拿、淋浴、水療、按摩、芳療與展示廳。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Six of the seven spaces form a process that extracts the visitor's pheromones, from bath, sauna and shower to spa, massage and aromatherapy, and the seventh is the showroom. The building block is divided, raised, cut at different angles and twisted so it looks like a crystal, with separate routes for experiencers, customers and staff.
captions: Extraction process: the experiencer passes through six spaces and leaves with a perfume of their own.
Block generation in eight steps, from the street-facing entrance to the twisted crystal form.
Streamline organization for experiencers, customers and staff.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 七個空間中的六個構成萃取訪客費洛蒙的流程，從浴室、桑拿、淋浴，到水療、按摩與芳療，第七個則是展示廳。建築量體經過分割、抬升、以不同角度切削並扭轉，使它看起來像一顆晶體，並為體驗者、顧客與員工規劃各自的動線。
captions: 萃取流程：體驗者走過六個空間，最後帶走屬於自己的香水。
八個步驟的量體生成，從面向街道的入口到扭轉的晶體造形。
體驗者、顧客與員工的動線組織。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the bath a hot red outer zone makes visitors eager to reach the calm green interior, and later the aromatherapy space mixes their collected pheromones with the perfume. The journey ends in the showroom, where visitors who have received their own scent can try it on and consult the staff.
captions: Plans and material palette of the bath space.
Aromatherapy space, where the pheromones are mixed with the perfume.
The showroom at the end of the journey.
Showroom plan and material palette of glass brick, glass rod, brass and marble.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在浴室中，炙熱的紅色外圍讓訪客急於進入沉靜的綠色內部；之後的芳療空間則將收集到的費洛蒙與香水融合。旅程在展示廳結束，拿到專屬氣味的訪客可以在此試香，並向員工諮詢。
captions: 浴室空間的平面與材料配置。
芳療空間，費洛蒙在此與香水融合。
旅程終點的展示廳。
展示廳平面與玻璃磚、玻璃棒、黃銅與大理石的材料配置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a theory of perception.
2. Turn one sense into a spatial question.
3. Order the spaces as a process.
4. Give each step its own atmosphere.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一套感知理論出發。
2. 把一種感官轉化為空間問題。
3. 將空間依流程排序。
4. 為每個步驟營造各自的氛圍。

pins.title: Activation of a Boiler House
pins.description:
Bagasse bricks and curving routes bring an abandoned sugar factory boiler house back to life.

Guangzhou, China | Industrial renovation and material experiment | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 鍋爐房活化
zh-Hant.description:
以甘蔗渣磚與曲面動線，讓廢棄糖廠的鍋爐房重獲新生。

中國廣州｜工業建築改造與材料實驗｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of curving forms threaded through the frame of the old boiler house.
在舊鍋爐房框架中穿梭的曲面造形模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A space that cannot be used will always be abandoned, and the old sugar factory, once the largest sugar enterprise in Guangzhou, closed when demand for sugar fell. In its boiler house, where bagasse was pressed, the patio in the middle of the plant divides the space in two, and the two halves are not well connected.
captions: Site axonometric of the factory park, with the boiler house where bagasse was pressed.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 無法使用的空間終將被遺棄；這座曾是廣州最大製糖企業的老糖廠，也在糖的需求下滑後停產。在過去壓榨甘蔗渣的鍋爐房裡，廠房中央的天井把空間一分為二，兩側缺乏良好的連結。
captions: 廠區軸測圖，標示出過去壓榨甘蔗渣的鍋爐房。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The material experiment explored using bagasse, the waste of sugar production, as a building material, separating it into epidermis and dregs. Samples with ten to forty percent bagasse were tested for compressive and tensile strength, and the bricks were made by hand in a mould, layer by layer.
captions: Samples with ten, twenty, thirty and forty percent bagasse, tested for compressive and tensile strength.
Making a brick by hand: mould, paste, bagasse, pressing and repeating until the brick is complete.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 材料實驗探索以製糖的廢料甘蔗渣作為建築材料，並將它分為表皮與渣滓。研究以含甘蔗渣百分之十到四十的試體測試抗壓與抗拉強度，再以模具逐層手工製作磚塊。
captions: 含甘蔗渣百分之十、二十、三十與四十的試體，測試抗壓與抗拉強度。
手工製磚：模具、漿料、甘蔗渣、壓實，重複直到磚塊完成。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Inspired by molecular cuisine related to sugar, the design extracted elements from the site and studied a large series of spatial forms. These forms were organised into routes that cross the middle yard and link the two halves of the plant on every floor.
captions: Inspiration and site context: the patio divides the plant in two.
Morphological examination of spatial forms.
Streamline organization in four steps.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計從與糖相關的分子料理得到啟發，從基地萃取元素，推敲出一系列空間造形。這些造形被組織成穿越中庭的動線，在每一層樓連結廠房的兩側。
captions: 靈感與基地脈絡：天井把廠房一分為二。
空間造形的形態推敲。
四個步驟的動線組織。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Curving forms are put into the frame structure of the factory, creating new spaces and a transport system in the atrium that lets people move from one side to the other and from floor to floor. These spaces can hold new businesses that attract visitors, so that the old building is used again and the site is activated.
captions: Exploded axonometric of the new forms inserted into the factory frame.
Physical model: the curving forms suspended in the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 曲面造形被置入工廠的框架結構中，創造出新的空間，並在中庭形成交通系統，讓人們能從一側走到另一側、從一層到另一層。這些空間可以容納吸引遊客的新業態，讓老建築重新被使用，也活化整個基地。
captions: 置入工廠框架之新造形的爆炸軸測圖。
實體模型：懸吊於框架中的曲面造形。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the history of the building.
2. Turn its waste into a material test.
3. Study many forms before choosing.
4. Use the old frame to hold the new.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 閱讀建築的歷史。
2. 把它的廢料變成材料實驗。
3. 先推敲大量造形再做選擇。
4. 用舊的框架承載新的空間。

pins.title: Lighting the Living Quarters of an Art Academy
pins.description:
Lit boxes drawn from window frames turn a dark, neglected campus corner into a place to gather at night.

Guangzhou, China | Lighting and public space renovation | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 美術學院生活區的光環境改造
zh-Hant.description:
從窗框發展出的發光方盒，讓昏暗、被忽略的校園角落成為夜晚的聚集場所。

中國廣州｜照明與公共空間改造｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Day condition of the two hubs and two edges where the lighting boxes meet the buildings.
白天狀態下，兩處節點與兩道邊界上，燈光盒體與建築相接的情形。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A small ballroom on the second floor of a gymnasium in the living quarters of an art academy hosts many evening events, yet without lighting design the venue is dark at night and invited guests cannot find their way. The site is neglected during the day and no one feels safe there at night, so the project aims to make it stand out and be easier for students to discover and use.
captions: Distribution analysis of how people use the site in normal hours and during events, by day and night.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一所美術學院生活區內，體育館二樓的小禮堂經常舉辦晚間活動，但由於缺乏照明設計，場地入夜後一片漆黑，受邀的來賓常常找不到路。這裡白天乏人問津，夜晚也讓人缺乏安全感，因此本案希望讓它更醒目，讓學生更容易發現並使用。
captions: 分析人們在平日與活動期間、白天與夜晚如何使用場地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site analysis recorded what different users need, from performers and photographers to students who find the area too dark to enter alone at night. A lighting model with LED strips, mirror paper and coloured film explored linear light and the effects of different colours, using diffuse reflection to make the light more even.
captions: Lighting investigation model: LED lamps reflected by mirror paper and filtered by coloured film.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地分析記錄了不同使用者的需求，從表演者、攝影者，到覺得夜裡太暗而不敢獨自進入的學生。以 LED 燈條、鏡面紙與彩色玻璃紙製作的照明模型，探索線性光與不同色光的效果，並以漫反射讓光線更均勻。
captions: 照明研究模型：LED 燈經鏡面紙反射、透過彩色玻璃紙濾色。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The black window frames of the buildings were extracted as a design element and turned from a flat frame into a three-dimensional box in four sizes based on the human scale. The boxes serve as stairs or lamps, seats, tables or a whole space, and they combine into structures for performance, graffiti, chatting, shade and photography.
captions: Secondary elevation: the boxes attach to the building surfaces at two hubs and two edges.
Tactical interventions: four box sizes and the activities they support.
Construction details of the box joints.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計從建築的黑色窗框萃取元素，將平面的窗框轉化為立體方盒，並依人體尺度發展出四種尺寸。方盒可作為階梯或燈具、座椅、桌子，甚至整個空間，組合後成為表演、塗鴉、聊天、遮陽與拍照的構築。
captions: 次立面：方盒附著在兩處節點與兩道邊界的建築表面。
戰術介入：四種方盒尺寸與它們支持的活動。
方盒接點的構造細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Based on the students' feedback, the lighting types differ in shape and purpose, some for illumination, some guiding the way and some setting the atmosphere. Used as a secondary facade, the device softens the boundary between the buildings and their surroundings, and with people and lights present the place is no longer frightening but interesting to discover.
captions: Lighting design types by feature and function: illumination, guidance and atmosphere.
Construction details of the lit boxes.
Line drawing of the lighting device along the building.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 根據學生的回饋，燈光類型在形態與用途上各有不同，有的負責照明，有的引導路線，有的營造氛圍。作為建築的次立面，這套裝置柔化了建築與周遭環境的界線；有了人與光，這裡不再令人害怕，而是有趣、值得探索的地方。
captions: 依特徵與功能區分的燈光設計類型：照明、引導與氛圍。
發光方盒的構造細部。
沿建築展開的照明裝置線稿。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a problem you have lived.
2. Ask each user what they need.
3. Draw the form from the existing building.
4. Size every element to the body.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從自己親身經歷的問題出發。
2. 詢問每一類使用者的需求。
3. 從既有建築中提取形式。
4. 依人體尺度決定每個元素的大小。

pins.title: Multiple Realities
pins.description:
A material installation made from waste collected around the site, exploring existence through space, time and material.

Taipei | Material experiment and installation | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 多重現實
zh-Hant.description:
以基地周邊蒐集的廢棄物製成的材料裝置，從空間、時間與材料探討存在。

台北｜材料實驗與裝置｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The installation in multiple dimensions: which is real, which is imaginary.
多重維度中的裝置：哪個是真實，哪個是想像。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Reality, in other words, is existence, and the project describes existence through three aspects, space, time and material. It asks how materials can let people truly touch existence in a multi-dimensional perspective of 2D, 2.5D and 3D space.
captions: Project concept: space as form in multiple dimensions, time as traces of change, material as the feelings of people.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 換句話說，現實就是存在，本案從空間、時間與材料三個面向描述存在。它探問材料如何在 2D、2.5D 與 3D 的多維空間中，讓人真正觸摸到存在。
captions: 專案概念：空間是多維度的形式，時間是變化的痕跡，材料是人的感受。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The materials were selected from domestic garbage and waste collected around the site in Taipei: coffee grounds, peanut shells, chaff, hair, waste paper and branches. Each was combined with cement, resin or gelatin, and the samples were compared for flexibility, strength, workability, weight, tensile strength and water resistance.
captions: Material properties of each waste material across six criteria.
Texture experiments mixing waste materials with cement, resin and gelatin, with an original group, a time-variable group and a proportional control group.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 材料取自台北基地周邊的生活垃圾與廢棄物：咖啡渣、花生殼、穀糠、頭髮、廢紙與樹枝。每種材料分別與水泥、樹脂或明膠結合，並比較樣本的柔韌度、強度、可加工性、重量、抗拉強度與防水性。
captions: 各種廢棄材料在六項指標上的性能比較。
將廢棄材料與水泥、樹脂及明膠混合的質感實驗，分為原始組、時間變化組與比例對照組。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Further tests explored the contrast between vision and touch, and how light passes through each sample. Form studies then moved from a single plane to doubled planes, inserting earlier 2D drawings and creating a morphological surface, so that the materials could be combined into blocks of different sizes.
captions: Tenacity tests: samples that look hard may feel soft, and the other way round.
Light transmission of each sample from strong to weak.
Form generation from a single plane to combined blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 進一步的實驗探討視覺與觸覺之間的反差，以及光線如何穿透每個樣本。形態研究則從單一平面發展到雙重平面，置入先前的 2D 圖面並生成形態曲面，讓材料能組合成不同尺寸的塊體。
captions: 韌性測試：看起來堅硬的樣本，摸起來可能是柔軟的，反之亦然。
各樣本由強到弱的透光程度。
從單一平面到組合塊體的形態生成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The installation hangs strips of material above an arrangement of blocks, recording how objects fade, wither and shrink over time, and visitors experience it in real duration and perceive different existences, each forming their own insight into multiple realities. As a public installation it can be disassembled, reassembled and recycled, and the remaining waste can be reused in other industries.
captions: Design presentation: hanging strips above blocks of cement, resin and gelatin composites.
Installation size and construction, at 12.5 m by 12.5 m.
Recycling circle: raw material, process, processed products, heating and boiling back into material.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 裝置在塊體群上方懸掛材料條帶，記錄物件隨時間褪色、枯萎與收縮的過程；觀者在真實的時間中體驗它，感知不同的存在，各自形成對多重現實的理解。作為公共裝置，它可以拆解、重組與回收，剩餘的廢料也能再用於其他產業。
captions: 設計呈現：懸掛的條帶與下方水泥、樹脂及明膠複合材料塊體。
裝置尺寸與構造，平面為 12.5 公尺見方。
回收循環：原料、加工、成品，再經加熱熬煮回到原料。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Turn an abstract idea into three testable aspects.
2. Collect materials within walking distance of the site.
3. Test every sample with a control group.
4. Plan the end of life from the start.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把抽象概念拆成三個可以測試的面向。
2. 在基地步行範圍內蒐集材料。
3. 每個樣本都設對照組測試。
4. 從一開始就規劃材料的後續去處。

pins.title: Consumption Binge
pins.description:
A vertical tower of heaven, earth and inferno that turns the frenzy of consumption into a space for reflection.

Guangzhou, China | Conceptual architecture and urban device | 2020–2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 消費狂歡
zh-Hant.description:
由天堂、人間與地獄垂直組成的塔，把消費的狂熱轉化為反思的空間。

中國廣州｜概念建築與城市裝置｜2020–2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model perspective: heaven, earth and inferno stacked as three progressive states of consumption.
模型透視：天堂、人間與地獄垂直堆疊，呈現三種逐步推進的消費狀態。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project is a reflection on the frenzy of capitalist consumption, imagined as a paradise of vertical value fission and an experience pavilion for media. The outbreak of COVID-19 in 2020 made people rethink contemporary desires, and the project asks whether we can look again at this carnival from another angle.
captions: Theoretical research: from the primitive accumulation of capital to capitalism, consumerism and consumption alienation, from the 15th to the 21st century.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案反思資本主義消費的狂熱，將其想像為一座價值垂直裂變的樂園，以及一座媒體體驗館。2020 年新冠疫情爆發，促使人們重新思考當代的慾望，本案也藉此探問：我們能否從另一個角度重新審視這場狂歡。
captions: 理論研究：從資本原始積累到資本主義、消費主義與消費異化，橫跨 15 至 21 世紀。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The design strategy traced three consumer phases, original consumption, symbolic consumption and simulacrum consumption, and matched them to the heaven, the world and the inferno. Each phase was translated into spatial types such as a garden arcade, a market public space, a central church space, an inverted cone platform and an endless contradictory ladder.
captions: Types by morphology for each consumer phase.
Base forms of the three levels developed from the types.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計策略梳理出三個消費階段：原始消費、符號消費與擬像消費，並分別對應天堂、人間與地獄。每個階段再轉譯為空間類型，例如花園拱廊、市集公共空間、中央教堂空間、倒錐平台，以及無盡矛盾的階梯。
captions: 依消費階段歸納的形態類型。
由這些類型發展出的三層基本形體。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The base forms were stacked vertically into one tower above an underground space, with the structural system and atrium arranged to support the climb. Separate routes were planned for participants and bystanders, so that some people move through the carnival while others watch it.
captions: Experience tower section view.
Architectural composition: structural system, atrium structure, participant route and bystander route.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三層基本形體垂直疊合成一座塔，下方連接地下空間，並安排結構系統與中庭支撐向上的動線。參與者與旁觀者各有不同的路線，讓一部分人穿行於狂歡之中，另一部分人則在旁觀看。
captions: 體驗塔剖面。
建築構成：結構系統、中庭結構、參與者動線與旁觀者動線。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Participants follow a sequence of devices, from the tower of the world with an atrium more than 50 meters high to the ring coil, the world loop of advertising screens, brainwashing rings, electric shock strings, a sky elevator and endless stairs. The urban device turns the absurdity of endless desire into a spatial experience that invites visitors to reflect on it.
captions: Space installation: the participants' tour sequence through the operative devices.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 參與者依序經過一系列裝置：從中庭高逾 50 公尺的「世界之塔」，到環形線圈、布滿廣告螢幕的「世界迴圈」、洗腦環、電擊弦、天空電梯，以及無盡的階梯。這座城市裝置把無止境慾望的荒謬轉化為空間體驗，邀請觀者重新反思。
captions: 空間裝置：參與者穿越各個操作裝置的遊覽順序。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Build a theory diagram before drawing space.
2. Map each idea to a spatial type.
3. Stack the types into one clear section.
4. Design separate routes for actors and viewers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 在畫空間之前，先建立理論圖解。
2. 把每個概念對應到一種空間類型。
3. 將這些類型疊合成一張清楚的剖面。
4. 為參與者與觀看者分別設計路線。

pins.title: Home in the Tongsui Store
pins.description:
A Guangzhou bamboo tube house renovated into a home above a tongsui dessert shop, linked by a red stair.

Guangzhou, China | Heritage reuse and housing | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 糖水鋪裡的家
zh-Hant.description:
將廣州竹筒屋改造為樓下糖水鋪、樓上住家的空間，以一道紅色樓梯串連。

中國廣州｜舊建築再利用與住宅｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Building section model of the renovated bamboo house with its red stair.
改造後竹筒屋的剖面模型與紅色樓梯。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is an old bamboo tube house on an arcade commercial street in Guangzhou, a dangerous residential building that has become isolated and out of place. Interviews and a site survey with the homeowner showed narrow, unreasonable divisions of space, weak daylight, a lack of infrastructure and stairs too steep for the elderly.
captions: General problem: the existing building profile and its divisions of space, daylight, infrastructure and stairs.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是廣州一條騎樓商業街上的老竹筒屋，這棟危樓如今顯得孤立且格格不入。透過與屋主的訪談與現場調查，發現空間分隔狹窄且不合理、採光不足、基礎設施缺乏，樓梯也陡得讓長者難以行走。
captions: 主要問題：既有建築剖面，以及空間分隔、採光、基礎設施與樓梯的狀況。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Bamboo tube houses are long, narrow and deep, a characteristic Lingnan residence with a bay, a patio and a lane that bring in light and air. The study traced how the house grew through horizontal and vertical additions and partial demolition, and how a business and residence model could keep it alive.
captions: Traditional bamboo tube house in its most original type, with bay, patio and lane.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 竹筒屋是嶺南特色民居，面寬窄、進深長，透過開間、天井與巷道引入光線與空氣。研究梳理了房屋如何經由水平與垂直加建及局部拆除逐步演變，以及「前店後居」的模式如何讓它延續生命。
captions: 最原始類型的傳統竹筒屋，包含開間、天井與巷道。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The design works across three times, the survival of the past, the growth of the present and the rebirth of the future, and keeps traces of the old house while adding new parts. A red stair, its colour taken from brown sugar, winds through the floors to link the public dessert shop below with the family's private rooms above.
captions: Design strategy: subsistence, growth and renascence, with the steps of space generation.
Design performance: the physical model with public and private areas.
Sloping roof node details.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計以三個時間面向展開：過去的存續、現在的生長與未來的重生，在加入新構件的同時保留老屋的痕跡。一道紅色樓梯取色自紅糖，蜿蜒穿過各層，連結樓下對外的糖水鋪與樓上家人的私密空間。
captions: 設計策略：存續、生長與重生，以及空間生成的步驟。
設計表現：實體模型中的公共與私密區域。
坡屋頂節點細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The public area gains a water bar, a patio platform that collects rainwater for a tree, and a workshop and gazebo whose flexible modules switch between work, exhibition and rest. Brick walls with varied openness form a new epidermis, so the house becomes both a home for the elderly owners and a place that shares the local tongsui culture.
captions: Water bar with its size and views.
Patio platform: a patio that collects water, the red stair and the new rooftop.
Workshop and gazebo with free organized workshop modes.
Architectural section and the idea of a brick epidermis.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 公共區域新增了水吧、一處收集雨水澆灌樹木的天井平台，以及可在工作、展覽與休息之間切換的彈性模組工作坊與涼亭。開放程度不一的磚牆形成新的表皮，讓這棟房子既是年長屋主的家，也是分享在地糖水文化的場所。
captions: 水吧的尺寸與視圖。
天井平台：可集水的天井、紅色樓梯與新屋頂。
工作坊與涼亭，以及自由組織的工作坊模式。
建築剖面與磚砌表皮的構想。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Interview the people who live there.
2. Trace how the building type grew.
3. Plan for past, present and future.
4. Let one local story set the colour.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 訪談真正住在那裡的人。
2. 追溯建築類型的演變。
3. 同時規劃過去、現在與未來。
4. 讓一個在地故事決定色彩。

pins.title: The Birth of a Bowl of Xi’an Pasta
pins.description:
A themed noodle pavilion where visitors follow wheat to bowl and make Shaanxi pasta with their own hands.

Xi’an, China | Commercial space and exhibition design | 2021 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 一碗西安麵的誕生
zh-Hant.description:
以麵食為主題的體驗館，讓參觀者從小麥走到一碗麵，親手做出陝西麵食。

中國西安｜商業空間與展覽設計｜2021｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Broadcast box: equipment room, live room and seats, finished in red brick, acoustic board and wood.
直播盒：設備間、直播室與座席，以紅磚、吸音板與木材收尾。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A Xi'an restaurant brand with a history of nearly one hundred years faces a changing market and needs to be rebuilt, while the pasta culture of Shaanxi cuisine behind it is fading and many young people no longer know it. People now expect consumer places that are not only for eating but also fun and interesting.
captions: Consumer analysis of children, youth, the middle-aged and the elderly, with their keywords, consuming ability and ways of participating.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一家擁有近百年歷史的西安餐飲品牌面臨市場變化，需要重新打造；而它背後的陝西麵食文化正逐漸淡出視野，許多年輕人已不再了解。如今人們期待的消費場所，不只是用餐，也要有趣、好玩。
captions: 針對兒童、青年、中年與長者的消費者分析，包括關鍵字、消費能力與參與方式。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project combines the prototypes of a museum, a restaurant, a workshop and a retail store into one themed scene. It responds to demand, to the site and to the future, so the space becomes a transmitter of information, a platform for hands-on experience and a place that brings people together.
captions: Design idea: space prototypes for exhibiting, eating, making and shopping, developed in response to demand, the site and the future.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案將博物館、餐廳、工作坊與零售店的空間原型結合為一個主題場景。設計回應需求、基地與未來，讓空間成為資訊的傳遞者、親手體驗的平台，以及凝聚人群的場所。
captions: 設計構想：展示、用餐、製作與購物的空間原型，回應需求、基地與未來而發展。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The plan starts from the symmetrical layout of the historic city, places the main functions for operation and dining, then adds auxiliary functions, exhibition items and the final partition. Visitors follow the journey from wheat, grain and flour to paste, raw noodles, boiled noodles and the finished bowl.
captions: Spatial development from historical context to the basic plane partition.
How to participate in the preparation workshop and the detail design of the operation table.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面從古城的對稱格局出發，先配置操作與用餐的主要機能，再加入輔助機能、展示項目，最後完成空間分區。參觀者沿著從小麥、穀粒、麵粉到麵團、生麵、煮麵，直到完成一碗麵的旅程前進。
captions: 從歷史脈絡到基本平面分區的空間推演。
如何參與製麵工作坊，以及操作台的細部設計。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the family workshop visitors select raw materials, mill flour, knead dough and cook their own noodles, while masters perform the eight dishes of Shaanxi cuisine and teach one on one. Display walls of grain, motion-sensitive cabinets and a broadcast box for live streaming turn the dining space into a social place and a transmitter of culture.
captions: Experience processes from raw material selection to the chef foundry area.
Operating ways: master operation area and apprenticeship practice area.
Cultural cabinet with motion-sensitive and manual openings at three heights.
Raw material display wall and grain fiber wall.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在家庭工作坊中，參觀者挑選原料、磨粉、揉麵並親手煮麵，師傅則現場展演陝西八大碗，並一對一教學。穀物展示牆、感應式展櫃與直播盒，讓用餐空間轉變為社交場所與文化的傳播者。
captions: 從挑選原料到主廚工坊區的體驗流程。
操作方式：師傅操作區與學徒練習區。
文化展櫃，設有感應式與手動開啟的三種高度。
原料展示牆與穀物纖維牆。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Follow the product from raw material to table.
2. Mix programs that rarely meet.
3. Let visitors make, not only watch.
4. Size every display to the body.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 跟著產品從原料一路走到餐桌。
2. 混合平常很少相遇的機能。
3. 讓參觀者動手做，而不只是觀看。
4. 依人體尺度設計每一處展示。

pins.title: Accidental Death Mourning Hall
pins.description:
A mourning hall built from the five senses, leading the families of accidental victims from grief to a forest of trees.

China | Mourning hall and sensory space | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 意外死亡哀悼堂
zh-Hant.description:
以五感構築的哀悼堂，引領意外罹難者的家屬從悲傷走進一片樹林。

中國｜哀悼堂與感官空間｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Exploded view of the sequence: variable, exploring, deconstructive and dissipative spaces.
空間序列的爆炸圖：可變、探索、解構與消散的空間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The number of accidental deaths has been increasing in China in recent years, especially among minors, yet society tends to overlook the spiritual care of the families left behind. Some become mentally fragile and others develop physical illnesses, so the project uses an analysis of the five senses and spatial dynamics to soothe them.
captions: Sketches of reasoning: from the dead and the living to spatial modelling.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 近年中國的意外死亡人數持續增加，未成年人尤其明顯，但社會往往忽略了遺屬的心靈照顧。有些家屬變得心理脆弱，有些則出現身體疾病，因此本案以五感分析與空間動態，作為撫慰他們的方式。
captions: 推理草圖：從逝者與生者出發，發展到空間建模。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: People perceive the world through their senses, and the study deconstructed vision, hearing and touch into surface, line and point. Plan and elevation studies explored how pedestrian routes and the height of space affect the relationship between human emotion and space.
captions: Spatial studies in floor plans and elevations.
Entity modelling studies of variable, exploring, deconstructive and dissipative space.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 人透過感官感知世界，研究將視覺、聽覺與觸覺解構為面、線與點。平面與立面研究則探討行走路線與空間高度，如何影響人的情緒與空間之間的關係。
captions: 平面與立面的空間研究。
可變、探索、解構與消散空間的實體模型研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Material tests mixed sand and AB glue in different ratios to change texture, translucency and hardness, used soft materials to make hard objects that still feel soft, and filled glasses with water to produce different sounds. These results became the bricks, lights and pipes that shape each room.
captions: Material testing for light, texture and sound.
First and second floor plans with the left and right sections, following the life and death diagram.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 材料實驗以不同比例混合沙與 AB 膠，改變質感、透光度與硬度；以柔軟材料製作仍保有柔軟觸感的硬質物件；並在玻璃杯中注入不同水量，產生不同的聲音。這些成果成為塑造每個房間的磚塊、燈光與管道。
captions: 光、質感與聲音的材料實驗。
一、二樓平面與左右剖面，依循生死圖解展開。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Visitors arrive by ferry and pass through walls of varying heights, rooms whose ceiling holes cast different light, and a single staircase where water in the pipes changes the sound. At the end they reach a forest where the dead are buried at the bottom of the trees, each tree becoming a tombstone and a carrier of souls.
captions: Aerial view of the hall and the final forest.
Visiting process: the node sketch, the light-transmitting roof and the ceiling holes.
Visiting process: material walls, curved walls of varying heights and the sound staircase.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 參觀者搭渡輪抵達，穿過高低不一的牆、天花孔洞投下不同光影的房間，以及一道水在管中流動、聲音隨之改變的單跑樓梯。最後，他們走進一片森林，逝者安葬在樹下，每一棵樹都成為墓碑，也是靈魂的載體。
captions: 哀悼堂與最終森林的鳥瞰。
參觀流程：節點草圖、透光屋頂與天花孔洞。
參觀流程：材料牆、高低不一的曲牆，以及聲音樓梯。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the people who are left behind.
2. Break each sense into a design element.
3. Test materials with your own hands.
4. End the route with a place to stay.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從被留下來的人出發。
2. 把每一種感官拆解成設計元素。
3. 親手測試材料。
4. 讓路線的終點成為可以停留的地方。

pins.title: Campus Corner Space Renovation
pins.description:
Four corner spaces on a crowded campus renovated into a walkway, a rooftop canopy, movable activity modules and a vertical garden.

Taipa, Macau | Campus renovation | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 校園角落空間改造
zh-Hant.description:
將擁擠校園中的四處角落，改造為步道、屋頂頂棚、可移動活動模組與垂直花園。

澳門氹仔｜校園改造｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Section through the open rooftop exchange area, with its mesh canopy and structural details.
開放屋頂交流區的剖面，呈現網狀頂棚與構造細部。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A university campus in Taipa, Macau, has around 16,000 students but only 0.21 sq km of land, and it is welcoming more and more students, parents and visitors. The traditional functional set-up no longer meets the needs of this diverse population, so the student selected four corner spaces on campus for renovation.
captions: Scheme one: the traditional storm shelter only shelters from rain and sunlight.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 澳門氹仔的一所大學校園約有一萬六千名學生，土地卻只有 0.21 平方公里，同時迎來愈來愈多的學生、家長與訪客。傳統的功能配置已無法滿足這群多元使用者的需求，因此學生選定校園中的四處角落空間進行改造。
captions: 方案一：傳統的避雨亭只能遮雨與遮陽。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each corner was read through its own problem: a shelter with a single function at the bus stop, an office where too many teachers make students nervous, a playground used only for football and running, and candidates with nowhere to wait during exams. The campus also lacks greenery, and the school is looking for ways to create a garden.
captions: Seating forms for people waiting for the bus and the exploded view of the walkway, with its smart screen and all-in-one seating.
Structural speculation for the rooftop: mesh forms from moving points, and the layered canopy.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每個角落都從各自的問題出發：公車站旁只有單一功能的避雨亭、教師過多而讓學生緊張的辦公室、只用來踢足球與跑步的操場，以及考試時無處等候的考生。校園也缺乏綠化，學校正在尋找打造花園的方法。
captions: 為候車者設計的座椅形態，以及步道的爆炸圖，包含智慧螢幕與一體式座椅。
屋頂的結構推演：移動控制點生成的網狀形態，以及分層的頂棚。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The walkway gains seats and side screens that start working when the ground senses a person's pressure, and the rooftop canopy varies the number and position of its points to create different spaces. The activity module evolves from hexagons with folding walls, and its wood panels divide into displays, tables, chairs and other functions.
captions: Design strategies for the vertical walls and the three- and six-section wood panels.
Exploded view of the module, from the raising objects and base plate to the insulation layer.
Production process: disassembly of parts, assembling the track, building a stand and installing the panels.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 步道加入座椅，以及在地面感應到人的壓力時啟動的側邊螢幕；屋頂頂棚則改變控制點的數量與位置，創造不同的空間。活動模組由可折疊牆面的六邊形演變而來，木板再分割為展示、桌、椅等不同功能。
captions: 垂直牆面的設計策略，以及三段式與六段式木板。
模組的爆炸圖，從架高構件、底板到隔熱層。
生產流程：拆解構件、組裝軌道、搭建支架與安裝面板。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The playground gains clusters of modules for meals, performances, displays and lounging, while the exam waiting area becomes a vertical garden lounge built by setting up floor slabs. Its 24 plant modules can be moved at will to form aggregated, discrete and other spatial forms.
captions: Activity modules on the playground: mealtime, stage, display and lounge areas.
Functional analysis and the vertical garden lounge with its variable vegetation.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 操場加入一組組可供用餐、表演、展示與休憩的模組；考試等候區則透過架設樓板，成為垂直花園休憩空間。其中 24 個植栽模組可自由移動，組成聚合、分散等不同的空間形態。
captions: 操場上的活動模組：用餐、舞台、展示與休憩區。
功能分析，以及具可變植栽的垂直花園休憩空間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find the corners people already use.
2. Name one problem for each corner.
3. Design parts that can be built and moved.
4. Let users change the space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出人們已在使用的角落。
2. 為每個角落指出一個問題。
3. 設計可以建造與移動的構件。
4. 讓使用者改變空間。

pins.title: Mine Air Purifier
pins.description:
An air purifier for a coal mining area that gives workers fresh air and resting platforms and heals the abandoned land.

Inner Mongolia, China | Air purification and technology | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 礦區空氣淨化器
zh-Hant.description:
為採煤礦區設計的空氣淨化器，為工人提供新鮮空氣與休憩平台，並修復廢棄的土地。

中國內蒙古｜空氣淨化與科技｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Profile analysis: vegetation zones, activity platform, circular walkway and the decontamination areas below.
剖面分析：植栽區、活動平台、環形步道，以及下方的淨化區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Since the industrial revolution the demand for energy has never ceased, and coal mining has harmed not only the ecology but also the health of the workers who mine it. Countless abandoned pits cannot grow new vegetation, and countless workers suffer from cancer in their lungs.
captions: Functional concept: spiral staircase, vertical lifts, platforms, chat area, circular walkway and a high level garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 自工業革命以來，能源需求從未停止，而採煤不僅衝擊生態，也損害了採煤工人的健康。無數廢棄礦坑長不出新的植被，無數工人也飽受肺癌之苦。
captions: 功能構想：螺旋景觀樓梯、垂直電梯、各種平台、交談區、環形步道與高處花園。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The user analysis followed travellers, office workers, workers and residents through a day of vehicle exhaust, factory exhaust gas and domestic waste gas. The study then looked at how plants absorb carbon dioxide and block dust, and at the jellyfish, whose small holes in the tentacles control the flow of water and nutrients.
captions: Sources of inspiration: sketches of the jellyfish head and body.
The theory of air purification by plants, through chemical and physical approaches.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 使用者分析追蹤旅人、上班族、工人與居民的一天，他們分別面對汽車廢氣、工廠廢氣與家庭廢氣。研究接著探討植物如何吸收二氧化碳並阻擋粉塵，以及水母如何透過觸手上的小孔控制水與養分的進出。
captions: 靈感來源：水母頭部與身體的草圖。
植物淨化空氣的原理，分為化學與物理兩種途徑。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The chemical approach removes nitrogen from the air so that the remaining gas is oxygen with a purity of about 90 to 95 %, while the physical approach uses multiple layers of filters that keep out dust by the density of the mesh. Each approach became a stacked unit of fans, tanks and buffer systems, with rotating staircases, an elevator and rainwater collectors added around them.
captions: How air purifiers work, chemically and physically.
The physical and chemical purification units and their components.
Additional details: rotating staircases, elevator, mechanical clamps, shock absorber, rotating track and rainwater collectors.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 化學途徑將空氣中的氮氣移除，使剩下的氣體成為純度約 90 至 95 % 的氧氣；物理途徑則以多層濾網，依網目的密度阻擋粉塵。兩種途徑各自發展為由風扇、儲氣槽與緩衝系統堆疊而成的單元，周圍再加入旋轉樓梯、電梯與雨水收集器。
captions: 空氣淨化器的化學與物理運作方式。
物理與化學淨化單元及其構件。
其他細部：旋轉樓梯、電梯、機械夾具、減震器、旋轉軌道與雨水收集器。

sections.heading: Outcome
