Sections of the four tanks: children's center, restaurant and cafe, climbing gym and service center.
Elevation of the skywalk across the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 半埋於地下的儲槽在綠色地景下開出明亮的空間，紅色的空中步道則在樹梢上環繞，並在四處落地。入口廣場的螺旋樓梯串連上下層，也是一處觀景平台。
captions: 穿過儲槽與空中步道的剖軸測圖。
四座儲槽的剖面：兒童中心、餐廳與咖啡館、攀岩館與服務中心。
橫跨基地的空中步道立面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Open closed ground to everyone.
2. Read the terrain and the trees.
3. Give old structures new uses.
4. Tie the park together with one loop.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把封閉的土地向所有人打開。
2. 讀懂地形與樹木。
3. 賦予舊結構新的用途。
4. 用一條環線串起整座公園。

pins.title: "New" Community Activity Center
pins.description:
A community center that reconnects neighbors through shared activities.

Architecture | Community center | Neighborhood relations | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 「新」社區活動中心
zh-Hant.description:
一座以共享活動重新連結鄰里的社區中心。

建築設計｜社區中心｜鄰里關係｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Section perspective showing activities inside and outside the center.
剖透視，呈現中心內外的活動。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Many communities surround the site, yet neighborhood relationships have grown increasingly thin. Residents have some free time, but the activity spaces in the community are not enough for them to use it well.
captions: Links between residential areas, the study area and event venues.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地周邊有許多社區，鄰里關係卻日漸淡薄。居民雖然有一些空閒時間，社區裡的活動空間卻不足以讓他們好好運用。
captions: 住宅區、研究區與活動場地之間的連結。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A survey of residents' interests and favorite activity sites showed what children, students, commuters and the elderly each wanted to do. The activities were then combined and the size of each space was estimated.
captions: Strategy 1: block cutting and a matrix linking user groups to activities.
Strategy 2: preset layouts for yoga, hydrotherapy, gym, free, bookshop, music and KTV spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 透過調查居民的興趣與常去的活動地點，了解兒童、學生、通勤族與長者各自想做的事。接著把這些活動加以組合，並估算每個空間的大小。
captions: 策略一：量體切割，以及連結使用族群與活動的矩陣。
策略二：瑜伽、水療、健身、自由空間、書店、音樂與KTV空間的預設配置。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The building volume was pushed, pulled and cut to let in sunlight and open views between residents and students. A second strategy lets people check space information on their phones and other devices before they arrive.
captions: Form generation through pushing, cutting and opening sightlines.
Axonometric rendering of user groups and the devices they use.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 建築量體經過推、拉與切割，引入陽光，並在居民與學生之間打開視線。第二項策略讓人們在抵達前，就能透過手機等裝置查看空間資訊。
captions: 透過推拉、切割與開放視線的形體生成。
使用族群與其所用裝置的軸測渲染圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The center stacks a DIY exhibition hall, a coffee restaurant, resident activity areas and a square on stepped levels with a steel frame above a concrete base. A physical section model tested the scale of people's activities so that the spaces would be reasonable to use.
captions: Section nodes of the steel and concrete structure.
Physical section model with node and perspective models.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 活動中心在階梯式的樓層上疊合了DIY展覽廳、咖啡餐廳、居民活動區與廣場，以鋼構架在混凝土基座之上。實體剖面模型檢驗了人們活動的尺度，讓空間更合理好用。
captions: 鋼構與混凝土結構的剖面節點。
實體剖面模型，以及節點與透視模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask residents what they enjoy.
2. Match groups to activities.
3. Shape the volume for light and views.
4. Test the scale with a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 詢問居民喜歡做什麼。
2. 讓族群對應活動。
3. 為光線與視野塑造量體。
4. 用模型檢驗尺度。

pins.title: Natural Media Funeral Parlour
pins.description:
A funeral parlour where light, water, life and wind guide grief toward calm.

Architecture | Funeral parlour | Natural media | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 自然媒介殯儀館
zh-Hant.description:
一座以光、水、生命與風引導哀傷走向平靜的殯儀館。

建築設計｜殯儀館｜自然媒介｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Perspective section tracing how emotions change along the route through the building.
剖透視圖，追溯情緒沿著建築動線的轉變。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: As life expectancy grows and land for burial shrinks, the city faces a tense shortage of places for funerals. The local demand for funeral buildings keeps rising, while traditional funerals offer few ways to comfort the people left behind.
captions: Light and water: forms in the building, sun paths, rainfall and water speed.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 隨著平均壽命延長、可用於安葬的土地縮減，城市面臨喪葬空間緊張的處境。當地對殯葬建築的需求持續上升，而傳統喪禮卻少有方式能撫慰留下來的人。
captions: 光與水：建築中的形式、日照路徑、降雨與水流速度。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project studied four natural media on the site: light, water, life and wind. Sunshine, rainfall, wind speed and the surrounding landscape were analysed to see how each medium could shape people's emotions.
captions: Life and wind: energy fields, landscape framing, mountain-valley breezes and sensory design.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案研究基地上的四種自然媒介：光、水、生命與風。透過分析日照、降雨、風速與周邊地景，了解每種媒介如何影響人的情緒。
captions: 生命與風：能量場、地景取景、山谷風與感官設計。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Concept sketches brought in the infinity symbol to express the eternity of life, and the plan was shaped to follow the lake around the site and the sunlight. The surface was then studied for light channels, courtyards, a wind corridor and flowing water.
captions: Concept drawing linking the living and the departed through infinity symbols.
Form generation from the site, the lake edge and sunlight intensity.
Surface analysis of streamlines, courtyards, the wind corridor and water form.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 概念草圖引入無限符號，表達生命的永恆，平面則依循基地周邊的湖岸與日照塑形。接著研究建築表皮，安排光之通道、中庭、風廊與流動的水。
captions: 以無限符號連結生者與逝者的概念圖。
由基地、湖岸與日照強度推導的形體生成。
表皮分析：動線、中庭、風廊與水的形態。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The flowing building guides visitors through reception, waiting, mourning and funeral spaces, each tuned by light, water, life and wind. Its outline and its reflection in the water together form the infinity symbol.
captions: Form sequence from required area to a wind-shaped roof and light openings.
Underground plan of the service level.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 流動的建築引導來訪者依序經過接待、等候、追思與告別空間，每一處都以光、水、生命與風調和。建築輪廓與水中倒影共同構成無限符號。
captions: 從需求面積到風塑屋頂與採光開口的形體序列。
服務層的地下平面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose the natural media of the site.
2. Map each medium with data.
3. Link each space to an emotion.
4. Shape the form around the journey.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選定基地的自然媒介。
2. 以數據描繪每種媒介。
3. 讓每個空間對應一種情緒。
4. 依循旅程塑造形體。

pins.title: Revive the Lijia Alley
pins.description:
A phased street renewal that brings green space and daily life back to a historic alley.

Changsha, China | Urban design | Street renewal | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重振 Lijia 巷
zh-Hant.description:
一項分期街道更新，為歷史巷弄帶回綠意與日常生活。

中國長沙｜都市設計｜街道更新｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Phase one: the renewed commercial stretch of the alley.
第一期：更新後的巷弄商業段。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Lijia Alley, next to the city center of Changsha, is one of the few historic streets left in the city, yet it is poorly protected. The growing city center has taken over outdoor space, the population is ageing, and many homes still follow an unreasonable layout from the 1950s.
captions: Space making keeps the main body of two- and three-storey buildings while adding new frames.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: Lijia 巷緊鄰長沙市中心，是城內少數留存的歷史街道之一，卻缺乏妥善保護。市中心擴張侵占了戶外空間，人口持續老化，許多住宅仍沿用1950年代不合理的格局。
captions: 空間營造保留二層與三層建築的主體，並加入新的構架。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Data on unemployment, age and income showed that the alley lags behind both its district and the city. Site observation found many run-down two- and three-storey buildings that no longer suit daily life.
captions: Exploded view of routes for vehicles, pedestrians, residents and business, with building heights.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 失業率、年齡與收入的數據顯示，這條巷子落後於所在的區與整座城市。現地觀察則發現許多破舊的二、三層建築已不再適合日常居住。
captions: 分解圖：車行、步行、居民與商業動線，以及建築高度。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: New frames add parks, stages, markets and planting spaces along the street without erasing the old buildings. The alley is then planned in three phases: a commercial phase near the business district, a living phase for residents and a green phase toward the river.
captions: Phase two: the living stretch with a stage, homes and local shops.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 新的構架沿街加入公園、舞台、市集與種植空間，同時保留舊建築。巷弄接著分為三期規劃：靠近商業區的商業期、為居民而設的生活期，以及朝向河岸的綠化期。
captions: 第二期：設有舞台、住宅與在地小店的生活段。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The renewed alley mixes shops, homes, a stage and small parks along a greener walking street. Each phase uses its own planting strategy with vines, osmanthus and camphor trees.
captions: Phase three: the green stretch toward the river.
Planting strategies: vertical planting, plant frames and mixed blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 更新後的巷弄沿著更綠意的步行街，混合了商店、住宅、舞台與小公園。每一期各有種植策略，運用藤蔓、桂花與樟樹。
captions: 第三期：朝向河岸的綠化段。
種植策略：垂直綠化、植栽架與混合街區。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the data of the street.
2. Keep the main body of old buildings.
3. Plan the renewal in phases.
4. Give each phase its own planting.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀街道的數據。
2. 保留舊建築的主體。
3. 分期規劃更新。
4. 為每一期安排專屬的植栽。

pins.title: Accelerate the City
pins.description:
A replaceable vertical complex that lets the city renew itself as fast as technology.

Guangzhou, China | Architecture | Future city | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 加速城市
zh-Hant.description:
一座可替換的垂直綜合體，讓城市能與科技同步自我更新。

中國廣州｜建築設計｜未來城市｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Traditional and accelerated skyscraper forms, with the form exploration of stacked functions.
傳統與加速摩天樓形式，以及堆疊機能的形體探索。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Behind the rapid growth of Guangzhou lie population, environmental and traffic problems, and fast construction has eaten into green space. Buildings change far more slowly than technology, so people still live and work in spaces designed for a past era.
captions: Industrial metabolism: how fast each sector changes, leading to a vertical future complex.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州快速發展的背後，存在人口、環境與交通問題，加速興建也蠶食了綠地。建築的演變遠比科技緩慢，人們仍在為過去時代設計的空間中生活與工作。
captions: 產業代謝：各產業的變化速度，進而推導出垂直的未來綜合體。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project compared the pace of change in science, transport, commerce, finance and building renewal. It proposed a super complex that absorbs many building types and grows upward, so the ground can return to green space.
captions: Theoretical illustration of the complex growing upward above a green ground floor and transport lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案比較科技、交通、商業、金融與建築更新的變化速度。進而提出吸納多種建築類型、向上生長的超級綜合體，讓地面得以回歸綠地。
captions: 理論圖解：綜合體在綠色地面層與交通路線之上向上生長。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The tower is built from a core tube with stacked rings of living space, gears for kinetic energy and fan blades for wind energy. Replaceable units can be lifted, rotated and swapped by cranes, robotic arms and drones as the needs of the city change.
captions: Detailed structure of the core tube, rings and gears, with phases of uplift and replacement.
Drone transport, robotic arms, the space update system and rail transport.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 塔樓由核心筒構成，疊加居住空間環、動能齒輪與風能扇葉。可替換單元能隨城市需求改變，由吊車、機械手臂與無人機吊升、旋轉與更換。
captions: 核心筒、圓環與齒輪的細部構造，以及吊升與更換的階段。
無人機運輸、機械手臂、空間更新系統與軌道運輸。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A physical model shows how the rings turn around the spindle to adjust position, view and light. The model makes the idea of a building that renews itself easier to read than computer drawings alone.
captions: Model sequence: before, rotating and after.
Physical model of the rings and gears, with a node detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 實體模型展示圓環如何繞著主軸轉動，以調整位置、視野與採光。模型讓這座自我更新的建築構想，比單靠電腦圖面更容易理解。
captions: 模型序列：轉動前、轉動中與轉動後。
圓環與齒輪的實體模型，以及節點細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Compare how fast each sector changes.
2. Stack functions in one complex.
3. Make the units replaceable.
4. Test the moving parts with a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 比較各產業的變化速度。
2. 把機能疊合在一座綜合體中。
3. 讓單元可以替換。
4. 用模型測試可動構件。

pins.title: The Artistic Rebirth of the Harbor
pins.description:
Art is woven into a working port so that an old industrial area can regain its vitality.

Lyon, France | Urban renewal | 163.5 ha | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 港口的藝術重生
zh-Hant.description:
將藝術織入運作中的港口，讓舊工業區重獲活力。

法國里昂｜都市更新｜163.5 公頃｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The renovated factory facade, with slender vertical fins along the port.
改造後的工廠立面，沿港口排列細長的垂直鰭片。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Old industrial areas built on the edge of western cities have gradually been surrounded by new blocks and become part of the city. Port de Lyon at the southern end of Lyon once flourished, but as the city grew around it, its industrial development was held back.
captions: Aerial view of the port, with the warehouse, sheds and tanks chosen for renovation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 西方城市邊緣興建的舊工業區，逐漸被新街區包圍，成為城市的一部分。位於里昂南端的里昂港曾經繁榮，但城市在周圍擴張後，其工業發展受到阻礙。
captions: 港區鳥瞰，標示選定改造的倉庫、棚架與儲槽。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project studied the port's existing production chain and the gap left by the lack of art spaces in the south of the city. It kept the industrial character of the site and inserted exhibition, studio, business and service functions into the existing buildings.
captions: Operation diagrams: art packaging is added to the original production line.
Scheme generation from site factors, with the resulting master plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案研究港口既有的生產鏈，以及城市南部缺乏藝術空間的空缺。設計保留基地的工業特色，並在既有建築中植入展覽、工作室、商業與服務機能。
captions: 運作圖解：在原有生產線中加入藝術包裝環節。
從基地要素推導的方案生成，以及最終總平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In the factory, artist studios join the production line through an overpass and a light freight track. The original steel frame is kept, while balconies and railings strengthen the relationship between inside and outside.
captions: Factory design: roof, frame, living floors, art studio and transport layers.
Long section through the exhibition, office, packaging line and storage.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在工廠中，藝術家工作室透過天橋與輕型貨運軌道接入生產線。原有鋼構架被保留，陽台與欄杆則加強了室內外的關係。
captions: 工廠設計：屋頂、構架、居住樓層、藝術工作室與運輸層。
貫穿展覽、辦公、包裝生產線與倉儲的長剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Over time, artists settle in the port and more people come for leisure, work and living. The port is expected to become an art centre and a new symbol of Lyon.
captions: Diversification in time: workers, artists and the public gradually share the port.
Axonometric drawing of the renewed port and its streets.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 隨著時間推移，藝術家進駐港口，更多人前來休閒、工作與生活。港口可望成為一座藝術中心，以及里昂的新象徵。
captions: 隨時間多元化：工人、藝術家與大眾逐漸共享港口。
更新後港區與街道的軸測圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the existing production chain.
2. Keep the industrial character.
3. Insert art into the working line.
4. Show how use changes over time.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 梳理既有的生產鏈。
2. 保留工業特色。
3. 把藝術植入運作中的生產線。
4. 呈現使用方式隨時間的變化。

pins.title: Typological Exploration
pins.description:
A new university campus built from a meta-language drawn from local vernacular buildings.

Kunming, China | Urban design | University campus | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 類型學探索
zh-Hant.description:
以在地傳統民居提煉的後設語言，構築一座新的大學校園。

中國昆明｜都市設計｜大學校園｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A section through campus life, with drawn students meeting across the floors.
穿越校園生活的剖面，以手繪學生在各樓層間相遇。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: As college enrolment grows year by year, universities in China are expanding and the old campus can no longer meet the needs of a new one. This graduation project designed the unbuilt north campus of a university in Kunming, Yunnan.
captions: Extracting the type from three local vernacular buildings, then combining basic prototypes into an object.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 隨著大學招生逐年增加，中國各地大學正在擴建，舊校區已無法滿足新校區的需求。本畢業設計以雲南昆明一所大學尚未開發的北校區為對象。
captions: 從三種在地傳統民居中提取類型，再將基本原型組合成單體。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Typology describes a group of objects that share the same formal structure. The project drew a meta-language from local vernacular buildings, so that the regional memory could carry on in the new campus.
captions: Meta-language design, unit module deformation, and the library and dormitory built from the modules.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 類型學描述具有相同形式結構的一組物件。本案從在地傳統民居中提煉出一套後設語言，讓地域記憶得以延續到新校區。
captions: 後設語言設計、單元模組變形，以及由模組組成的圖書館與宿舍。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Teaching, research and living spaces were sized from a quota study of each discipline. The disciplines were set as islands around a central library to encourage exchange between them.
captions: Strategy, concept, master plan and axonometric view of the new campus.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 教學、研究與居住空間的規模，依各學科的配額研究而定。各學科被安排成圍繞中央圖書館的島嶼，以促進彼此交流。
captions: 新校區的策略、概念、總平面與軸測圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The library section shows how the courtyard type stacks into reading rooms and shared terraces. The campus offers a way to renew and expand a university while keeping its regional character.
captions: Library section with reading rooms and terraces.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 圖書館剖面呈現合院類型如何疊合成閱覽室與共享露台。這座校園提供了一種在延續地域特色的同時，更新與擴建大學的方式。
captions: 圖書館剖面，包含閱覽室與露台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study local building types.
2. Draw a shared design language.
3. Size spaces from real needs.
4. Combine units into a campus.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究在地建築類型。
2. 提煉共享的設計語言。
3. 依實際需求決定空間規模。
4. 把單元組合成校園。

pins.title: Village Paradise in the City
pins.description:
Activity platforms lifted into the air turn a village beside a new overpass into a paradise for its residents.

Chuxiong, China | Urban village renewal | 1.2 ha | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城中村樂園
zh-Hant.description:
抬升至空中的活動平台，讓新高架橋旁的村落成為居民的樂園。

中國楚雄｜城中村更新｜1.2 公頃｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the village, with the new overpass curving past its edge.
村落鳥瞰，新建高架橋沿其邊緣彎曲而過。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In Chinese cities, many villages are surrounded by urban construction and are often ignored as the city develops. A viaduct built high above this village in Chuxiong, Yunnan brings heavy traffic noise and pollution to its residents.
captions: Usage demand: user groups, main activities and the spaces they need.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在中國城市中，許多村落被城市建設包圍，在發展過程中常被忽視。一座高架橋從雲南楚雄這座村落上方高高跨過，為居民帶來嚴重的交通噪音與污染。
captions: 使用需求：使用族群、主要活動與所需空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Most young people work far away, so most residents are elderly people and children, and the village lacks public space and facilities. The plan answers the traffic and parking problems and the missing public space, turning the area into a place for many activities.
captions: Design concept: an ecological barrier, new green space and an overhead ground.
Platform strategy: materials and activities combined along the platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 多數年輕人在外地工作，居民多為老人與兒童，村內缺乏公共空間與設施。規劃回應交通、停車與公共空間不足的問題，將此地轉化為容納多種活動的場所。
captions: 設計概念：生態屏障、新增綠地與架空地面。
平台策略：沿平台組合材料與活動。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Woods are planted along the overpass as an ecological barrier, and activity platforms are lifted into the air to save the scarce ground for vegetable plots. Corridors and stairs link the platforms so residents can reach each activity space easily.
captions: Column forest, spatial interaction, continuous space and band attachment.
Platform composition: furniture, building, gravel, platform and farm layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 沿高架橋種植樹林作為生態屏障，並將活動平台抬升至空中，把稀缺的地面留給菜地。廊道與樓梯串連各平台，讓居民能輕鬆抵達每個活動空間。
captions: 柱林、空間互動、連續空間與帶狀附著。
平台構成：家具、建築、礫石、平台與農地等層次。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The master plan brings together a forest park, a village square, a sports park, a cooperative farm and the activity platform. The village, its architecture and its landscape become a lively sky paradise for the residents.
captions: Master plan of the renewed village.
Long section across the village and its platforms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 總平面整合森林遊樂園、村落廣場、運動公園、合作農場與活動平台。村落、建築與地景共同成為屬於居民的活力空中樂園。
captions: 更新後村落的總平面。
橫跨村落與平台的長剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study who still lives there.
2. Block noise with landscape.
3. Lift activity off the ground.
4. Link spaces into one route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究仍在此生活的人。
2. 以地景阻隔噪音。
3. 把活動抬離地面。
4. 把空間串成一條路徑。

pins.title: Urban Dwelling: Residing in the City
pins.description:
Six light parasite structures fill the gaps of a post-war London housing estate with spaces for artists and visitors.

London, UK | Parasitic architecture | Artist spaces | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市棲居：寄居於城
zh-Hant.description:
六座輕量寄生結構填補倫敦戰後住宅社區的縫隙，為藝術家與訪客提供空間。

英國倫敦｜寄生建築｜藝術家空間｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Site axonometric of the post-war housing estate and its surroundings.
戰後住宅社區及其周邊的基地軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The Golden Lane Estate is a 1950s council housing complex in the City of London, built on land devastated by wartime bombing. Business had become the main use of land in the City, and the project looks for the negative urban space left between its buildings.
captions: Six spaces for artists and visitors: gallery, square, gardens, office, studio and park.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: Golden Lane Estate 是倫敦金融城一座建於 1950 年代的公共住宅，坐落在戰時遭轟炸摧毀的土地上。商業已成為金融城的主要用地，本案尋找建築之間被遺留的負空間。
captions: 為藝術家與訪客設計的六個空間：藝廊、廣場、花園、辦公室、工作室與公園。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Parasitic architecture attaches to an existing larger structure to answer high rents and the lack of space in big cities. It is cheap to build, uses space efficiently and stays socially inclusive, so it suits the gaps of this estate.
captions: Floating gallery: workshop, terrace shop, gallery and rooftop bar along one section.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 寄生建築依附於既有的大型結構，回應大城市高租金與空間不足的問題。它造價低、空間利用有效率且具社會包容性，適合填補這座社區的縫隙。
captions: 漂浮藝廊：工作坊、露台商店、藝廊與屋頂酒吧沿同一剖面展開。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: For the air studio, the centre point between the existing buildings fixes the location, and Voronoi geometry is generated within the defined space. The dancing office uses a spring-based form-finding script to balance the mesh between its connection points.
captions: Air studio section, hung between two existing blocks.
Air studio plan and the parametric script that shapes it.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 空中工作室以既有建築之間的中心點決定位置，並在限定空間內生成 Voronoi 幾何。舞動辦公室以彈簧力學的找形腳本，平衡網格與各連接點之間的關係。
captions: 懸掛於兩棟既有建築之間的空中工作室剖面。
空中工作室平面與塑造其形體的參數化腳本。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Six light structures for studios, exhibitions, offices, gardens and a bar connect to the ground, open to the sky and lean on existing walls. They show that there is no need to build heavily to bring artists back into the city.
captions: Dancing office section with its flowing shell.
Dancing office plan between the existing buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 六座輕量結構容納工作室、展覽、辦公、花園與酒吧，連接地面、向天空開放並倚靠既有牆面。它們說明不必大興土木，也能讓藝術家重回城市。
captions: 具流動外殼的舞動辦公室剖面。
位於既有建築之間的舞動辦公室平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the empty gaps.
2. Read who the city lost.
3. Attach, do not demolish.
4. Let scripts find the form.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 標出空置的縫隙。
2. 了解城市失去了誰。
3. 依附而非拆除。
4. 讓腳本找出形體。

pins.title: Polyver: Vector Exploration of Polyline
pins.description:
Hand-made timber nodes without nails or glue grow from a polyline into a pedestrian bridge in Hyde Park.

London, UK | Timber structure | Pedestrian bridge | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: Polyver：折線的向量探索
zh-Hant.description:
不用釘子或膠的手作木節點，從一條折線發展成海德公園裡的人行橋。

英國倫敦｜木構造｜人行橋｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A structure grown from polylines, the starting point of the study.
由折線生長而成的結構，是這項研究的起點。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project explores how a simple polyline can become a structure, first as a built timber object and then as architecture. It asks how pieces can hold together without nails, ropes or glue.
captions: Material chart comparing fabrication, strength, workability and cost.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案探索簡單的折線如何成為結構，先做成實體木構物件，再發展為建築。它追問構件如何在不用釘子、繩索或膠的情況下彼此固定。
captions: 比較加工方式、強度、可加工性與成本的材料圖表。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Materials and wood types are compared for strength, workability and cost, and eucalyptus and camphor wood are chosen. The joint follows the traditional Chinese interlocking burr puzzle, which stands up through the connection of its own parts.
captions: Node decomposition and the two connection ways: cuboid and triangular insertion.
Node 1 made by hand in nine steps.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案比較各種材料與木種的強度、可加工性與成本，最後選用尤加利木與樟木。節點借鑑中國傳統的榫卯鎖，僅靠構件彼此咬合便能自立。
captions: 節點拆解與兩種接合方式：方形插接與三角插接。
以九個步驟手工製作節點一。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Wood is cut to three lengths and drilled with cube and triangle holes about 2.5 cm deep, so each node grips the sticks without glue. The parts close into one loop, so the nodes cannot fall loose.
captions: The finished timber model, indoors and outdoors.
3D model of the same node system.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 木料裁成三種長度，並鑽出約 2.5 公分深的方形與三角形孔，讓節點不用膠也能卡住木桿。所有構件組成一個封閉迴圈，使節點不會鬆脫。
captions: 完成的木構模型，室內與戶外。
同一節點系統的 3D 模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the second part the polyline system becomes a pedestrian bridge over a lake in Hyde Park, London. The bridge keeps a distance from the nearby galleries so walkers can see them in full, and it doubles as a rest area and a scenic spot.
captions: Renders of the polyline pedestrian bridge.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 第二部分將折線系統發展為倫敦海德公園湖上的一座人行橋。橋與鄰近藝廊保持距離，讓行人能看見其全貌，同時也是休憩區與觀景點。
captions: 折線人行橋的渲染圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one line.
2. Test the joint by hand.
3. Close the loop.
4. Scale it to a site.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一條線開始。
2. 親手測試節點。
3. 讓結構形成迴圈。
4. 放大到真實基地。

pins.title: Guangdong Cultural Centre
pins.description:
A truss-framed cultural centre on a hillside gives travellers on a mountain highway a place to rest, read and look at the view.

Guangdong, China | Cultural centre | Truss structure | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 廣東文化中心
zh-Hant.description:
以桁架構成的山坡文化中心，讓山區公路上的旅客有地方休息、閱讀與看風景。

中國廣東｜文化中心｜桁架結構｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The cultural centre stretched across a hillside in the mountains.
橫跨山坡的文化中心。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: This cultural centre sits in a mountainous village in Guangdong, close to a highway, where hills rise in the middle of the site. It should serve local culture and also give drivers and tourists a place to rest and read.
captions: Form steps: the figure-eight shape, the added triangles and the extra levels.
Ground floor plan with the reading room, court and exhibition.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座文化中心位於廣東山區的村落，靠近高速公路，基地中央是起伏的丘陵。它既要承載在地文化，也要讓駕車旅客有地方休息與閱讀。
captions: 形體步驟：「8」字形、增加的三角形與加高的樓層。
地面層平面，含閱覽室、庭院與展覽空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The initial form comes from the number eight, with the two rectangles at its ends as the main entrances. Triangular rest areas are added beside the shape to respond better to the site.
captions: First and second floor plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 最初的形體來自數字「8」，兩端的矩形是主要入口。形體兩側再加入三角形休憩區，更好地回應基地。
captions: 二樓與三樓平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: More levels are added above, and one main entrance extends down into a court on the basement level. A truss of rigid triangles carries the overhangs and spans, while columns support the reading space.
captions: The truss structure lifts the building over the slope.
Section through the levels, with courtyard and semi-outdoor spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 上方再加入更多樓層，其中一個主入口向下延伸為地下層的庭院。由剛性三角形組成的桁架承載懸挑與跨距，閱讀空間則以柱子支撐。
captions: 桁架結構讓建築跨越坡地。
穿越各層的剖面，含庭院與半戶外空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The building offers exhibition spaces, reading lounges and a small court along a route that follows the hills. Its open floors frame views of the mountains for visitors who stop on their journey.
captions: Axonometric drawing on the terrain and interior views.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築沿著順應丘陵的動線，提供展覽空間、閱讀休息區與一座小庭院。開放的樓層為途中停留的旅客框出山景。
captions: 地形上的軸測圖與室內視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Begin with a simple figure.
2. Bend it to the site.
3. Let structure carry the span.
4. Frame the landscape.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從簡單的圖形開始。
2. 讓它順應基地。
3. 讓結構承擔跨距。
4. 為地景取景。

pins.title: Santo Domingo School of Music
pins.description:
A small site in a crowded capital becomes a vertical school city with open spaces carved into its red blocks.

Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic | School | Vertical campus | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 聖多明哥音樂學校
zh-Hant.description:
擁擠首都中的小基地，化為在紅色量體中挖出開放空間的垂直校園城市。

多明尼加聖多明哥｜學校｜垂直校園｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The school tower and its low red wings around the playground.
學校高塔與環繞操場的低矮紅色側翼。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Santo Domingo is a dense seaside capital that lacks efficient public facilities, and the site for this music school is small. The school should evoke students' interest in learning and keep them engaged in school life.
captions: Open spaces carved into the dense red blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 聖多明哥是一座密集的濱海首都，缺乏有效率的公共設施，而這所音樂學校的基地也很小。學校需要激發學生的學習興趣，並讓他們持續投入校園生活。
captions: 在密集紅色量體中挖出的開放空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The study reads the city's culture of crowdedness, where dense, layered structures leave creative gaps between walls and masses. Three questions guide the design: how to make the best campus on a small site, how to serve teenage students and how to answer the climate.
captions: First floor plan with the playground at the centre.
Site axonometric and the life, study and exhibition programme blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究解讀這座城市的「擁擠文化」，層層堆疊的密集結構在牆與量體之間留下富創意的縫隙。設計由三個問題引導：如何在小基地上創造最好的校園、如何服務青少年學生，以及如何回應氣候。
captions: 以操場為中心的二樓平面。
基地軸測圖，以及生活、學習與展覽的機能量體。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Because the site is limited but the allowed floor area is generous, the school stacks its rooms into a small vertical school city. Open spaces inside the building create organised space for study, life and exhibition.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 由於基地有限但容積率寬裕，學校將教室堆疊成一座小型的「垂直校園城市」。建築內部的開放空間，為學習、生活與展覽創造有秩序的空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A tall tower rises beside low red wings that hold halls and courts, linked by stairs and terraces. The long section shows how study, life and performance stack into one compact campus.
captions: Long section through the tower and the performance spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 高塔矗立在容納大廳與庭院的低矮紅色側翼旁，以樓梯與露台相連。長剖面呈現學習、生活與演出如何疊合成一座緊湊的校園。
captions: 穿越高塔與演出空間的長剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read how the city lives.
2. Name the key questions.
3. Stack when land is short.
4. Keep space open inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀城市的生活方式。
2. 列出關鍵問題。
3. 土地不足就向上堆疊。
4. 在內部保留開放空間。

pins.title: Plants and Architecture in Symbiosis
pins.description:
Boundary models are divided and recombined into a timber building that weaves between existing trees.

Taipei, Taiwan | Architecture | Individual project | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 植物與建築的共生
zh-Hant.description:
邊界模型經拆解與重組，成為一座穿梭於既有樹木之間的木構建築。

台灣台北｜建築｜個人專案｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Timber volumes rising between the existing trees.
在既有樹木之間升起的木構量體。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project explores how plants and architecture can live together in daily life. It asks how a building can relate to the surrounding buildings and existing plants through its boundaries.
captions: Sections of the open boundary, light edge and selected penetration.
Drawing of different plants living in harmony above and below ground.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個專案探討植物與建築如何在日常生活中共生。它追問建築如何透過自身的邊界，與周邊建築及既有植物建立關係。
captions: 開放邊界、輕盈邊緣與選擇性穿透的剖面。
不同植物在地上與地下和諧共生的圖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Three boundary types were tested in models: open boundary, light edge and selected penetration. The models were then divided, and small blocks were used to form sixteen new building blocks.
captions: Models testing how each boundary filters light and shadow.
The sixteen blocks and the nine combined blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以模型測試三種邊界類型：開放邊界、輕盈邊緣與選擇性穿透。接著將模型拆解，再以小量體組成十六種新的建築量體。
captions: 測試各種邊界如何過濾光影的模型。
十六種量體與九種組合量體。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The sixteen blocks were combined into nine new blocks, which were superimposed a second time into one large building body. Timber joints from node to node and plane to plane hold the pieces together.
captions: Four detail blocks with their plans.
Volumes superimposed for the second time.
Node and plane joints in two steps.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 十六種量體組合成九種新量體，再次疊合成一個大型建築體。從節點到節點、從板到板的木構接合，將各部分固定在一起。
captions: 四個細部量體及其平面。
第二次疊合後的量體。
分兩步驟的節點與板件接合。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The generated modules connect along the stairs into a porous timber building. From above, the building weaves between the existing trees, linking interior space, plants and paths.
captions: Generated modules connected to form the building.
Roof plan weaving between the trees.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 生成的模組沿著階梯相連，成為一座多孔的木構建築。從上方看，建築穿梭於既有樹木之間，串連室內空間、植物與通道。
captions: 生成的模組相連形成建築。
穿梭於樹木之間的屋頂平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a relationship, not a form.
2. Test boundaries with models.
3. Combine blocks by clear rules.
4. Let joints hold the system.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從關係出發，而不是從形式出發。
2. 用模型測試邊界。
3. 依清楚的規則組合量體。
4. 讓接合撐起整個系統。

pins.title: Coming Home
pins.description:
A fragmented riverside district in Brisbane is planned around daily activities, a cultural belt and public space nodes.

Brisbane, Australia | Urban design | Sep–Dec 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 回家
zh-Hant.description:
布里斯本破碎的河畔街區，以日常活動、文化帶與公共空間節點重新規劃。

澳洲布里斯本｜都市設計｜2020年9–12月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the new urban building areas by the river.
河畔新城市建築區的鳥瞰圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Brisbane is a fast-growing riverside city, and this site sits between the river, a park and busy roads and bridges. The design asks how a fragmented riverside district can become a place where people feel at home.
captions: Site analysis of edges, function, traffic, green space, heritage and public places.
District conditions: function, traffic, flood issues, subareas and activity.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 布里斯本是一座快速成長的河畔城市，而基地位於河流、公園與繁忙道路及橋梁之間。設計追問破碎的河畔街區，如何成為讓人有歸屬感的地方。
captions: 基地分析：周邊、機能、交通、綠地、文化資產與公共場所。
街區現況：機能、交通、淹水問題、分區與活動。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The study maps economics, public realm, transport, social and cultural life and built form as layers of the city. Everyday activities such as walking, cooking, studying and dancing are linked into a network for the new district.
captions: Proposed activities linked across the district.
Five planning steps from platforms to local natural elements.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究將經濟、公共領域、交通、社會文化生活與建成形態，視為城市的不同圖層加以分析。走路、烹飪、讀書與跳舞等日常活動，被串連成新街區的活動網絡。
captions: 串連整個街區的活動構想。
從平台到在地自然元素的五個規劃步驟。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A cultural belt and two axes fix the central square, and each parcel then grows its own blocks and vertical cues. The grey space under the bridge is partitioned, cross-linked and streamlined into a lively public route.
captions: Strategy and planning steps for the space under the bridge.
Planning and axis generation for the building parcels.
Generation of key buildings such as the farm, school, market and apartments.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 文化帶與兩條軸線確立了中央廣場，各街廓再生成各自的量體與垂直線索。橋下的灰色空間經過分區、串連與流線整理，成為充滿活力的公共路徑。
captions: 橋下空間的策略與規劃步驟。
建築街廓的規劃與軸線生成。
農場、學校、市場與公寓等關鍵建築的生成。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Public space nodes host gatherings, rest and performance between the new buildings. The section shows low, layered blocks stepping down to the river in front of the city towers.
captions: Public space nodes for gathering and performance.
A-A section from the city towers down to the river.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 公共空間節點在新建築之間容納聚會、休憩與表演。剖面呈現低矮而層疊的量體，在城市高樓前方向河岸逐步降低。
captions: 供聚會與表演的公共空間節點。
從城市高樓延伸至河岸的A-A剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the city in layers.
2. Start from daily activities.
3. Fix axes before buildings.
4. Turn leftover space public.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 以圖層解讀城市。
2. 從日常活動出發。
3. 先定軸線再放建築。
4. 把剩餘空間還給公共。

pins.title: Herbal Garden
pins.description:
An abandoned herb-growing school plot becomes an art gallery and garden about traditional Chinese medicine.

Macau, China | Art gallery | Mar–May 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 草藥花園
zh-Hant.description:
曾種植草藥的廢棄校地，化為一座關於中醫藥的藝術館與花園。

中國澳門｜藝術館｜2020年3–5月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Planting rings and a sunken amphitheatre in the herbal garden.
草藥花園中的種植圓環與下沉劇場。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is an abandoned school plot in Macau that was once used to grow traditional Chinese medicine herbs. Hospitals and dormitories for medical students now surround it, so the project continues the old use with an art gallery about traditional Chinese medicine.
captions: Site map with the planting area marked.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是澳門一處曾用來種植中草藥的廢棄校地。周邊如今有醫院與醫學生宿舍，因此專案延續原本的用途，打造一座關於中醫藥的藝術館。
captions: 標示種植區的基地圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Interviews with people around the site and a questionnaire showed that most people have only heard of traditional Chinese medicine. Most of those who have learned about it did so through exhibitions, which points to a gallery with several ways to learn.
captions: Function areas for exhibition, discussion, projection, experience, light food and planting.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 對周邊居民的訪談與問卷顯示，多數人只聽過中醫藥而不甚了解。曾經學習過的人大多透過展覽認識它，這指向一座提供多種學習方式的展館。
captions: 展覽、討論、投影、體驗、輕食與種植等機能區。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The S-shaped curve of Tai Chi becomes the flow line of the site, and the foot acupoint map divides the site into areas. A round floor is cut along the curve, divided into two parts, linked again and opened with an atrium.
captions: Concept drawn from the Tai Chi curve and the foot acupoint map.
Five steps from an ordinary floor to an open atrium.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 太極的S形曲線成為基地的動線，腳底穴位圖則用來劃分基地區塊。圓形樓板沿著曲線切開、分為兩半，再重新連結並開出中庭。
captions: 取自太極曲線與腳底穴位圖的概念。
從普通樓板到開放中庭的五個步驟。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Two vaulted buildings hold exhibition, projection, office and history areas across a basement and a first floor. Planting areas, sunken spaces and an experience area for making herbal tea let visitors learn by doing.
captions: Master plan of the buildings and planting areas.
Section A-A through the two vaulted halls.
Experience area for making herbal tea.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 兩棟拱形建築在地下層與一樓容納展覽、投影、辦公與歷史區。種植區、下沉空間與製作草本茶的體驗區，讓參觀者在動手中學習。
captions: 建築與種植區的總平面圖。
穿越兩座拱形大廳的A-A剖面。
製作草本茶的體驗區。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Keep the memory of the site.
2. Ask the neighbours first.
3. Borrow form from the subject.
4. Let visitors learn by doing.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 保留基地的記憶。
2. 先問問周邊的人。
3. 從主題本身借取形式。
4. 讓參觀者動手學習。

pins.title: The Home of Pottery
pins.description:
A sunken building in a ceramics village follows the steps of making porcelain to give young makers a place to work and show.

Jingdezhen, China | Culture and studios | Jun–Aug 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 陶瓷之家
zh-Hant.description:
陶瓷村落中的下沉建築，依循瓷器的製作步驟，為年輕創作者提供創作與展示的場所。

中國景德鎮｜文化與工作室｜2020年6–8月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The sunken building glowing on the hillside at night.
夜晚在山坡上發光的下沉建築。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site sits on the edge of a village in Jingdezhen, the hometown of ceramics, where many artists have set up studios. Young makers from outside who cannot fit into local life need a place to show their work, a good place to create and a way into the community.
captions: Site layout: the new road links the new and old buildings, and the sunken building keeps the mountain views.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於陶瓷之鄉景德鎮一座村落的邊緣，附近有許多藝術家設立工作室。無法融入在地生活的外來年輕創作者，需要展示作品的地方、良好的創作環境，以及融入社區的途徑。
captions: 基地配置：新道路連結新舊建築，下沉的建築保留了望向山的視野。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The design follows the order in which ceramics are made, from china clay and moulding to glazing, firing and the finished piece. Each step is matched with an element such as water, sun or tree and turned into a space.
captions: Concept: each step of making ceramics becomes a space.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 設計依循陶瓷的製作順序，從瓷土、成型到上釉、燒製與成品。每個步驟都對應水、陽光或樹木等元素，並轉化為空間。
captions: 概念：陶瓷製作的每個步驟化為一個空間。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A sunken entrance, a courtyard fed by the stream, a zigzag corridor and a sunny open space follow the making process in sequence. Two sunken courtyards, a water yard and a sun yard, stand for the water and fire that porcelain needs.
captions: Water yard and sun yard in section and axonometric.
Study models of the sunken building.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 下沉入口、引入溪水的庭院、曲折的廊道與陽光充足的開放空間，依序呼應製作流程。水院與日院兩座下沉庭院，象徵瓷器所需的水與火。
captions: 水院與日院的剖面與軸測圖。
下沉建築的研究模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The building links production, tourism and communication so that artists, locals and visitors can share space. Sections and elevations show a low building tucked into the slope beneath the mountain.
captions: Programme axonometric for production, tourism and communication.
Ground floor plan.
Master plan between the stream, the mountain and the old building.
Elevations C-C and D-D.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築串連生產、觀光與交流，讓藝術家、在地居民與遊客共享空間。剖面與立面呈現一座嵌入山坡、低伏於山下的建築。
captions: 生產、觀光與交流的機能軸測圖。
一樓平面圖。
位於溪流、山與老建築之間的總平面圖。
C-C與D-D立面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design for a real user group.
2. Follow how things are made.
3. Pair each step with an element.
4. Sink in to keep the views.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 為真實的使用族群設計。
2. 依循事物的製作方式。
3. 為每個步驟配上一種元素。
4. 下沉建築以保留視野。

pins.title: Port of Culture
pins.description:
A damaged building in Mariupol becomes a cultural landmark whose routes weave collective memory and migration under a planted membrane roof.

Mariupol, Ukraine | Culture and exhibition | Feb–Apr 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 文化之港
zh-Hant.description:
馬立波一棟受損建築化身為文化地標，在植栽膜屋頂下交織集體記憶與遷徙的路徑。

烏克蘭馬立波｜文化與展覽｜2019年2–4月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The green membrane roof rises from the ground over the new cultural building.
綠色膜結構屋頂自地面升起，覆蓋新的文化建築。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A damaged historic building beside a church square in Mariupol is to become a new landmark for the city. The brief asks for an open space where residents can meet, share local stories and rebuild a sense of pride.
captions: Site analysis: the building in its dense low-rise block, with land use, height and road maps.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 馬立波教堂廣場旁一棟受損的歷史建築，將被轉化為城市的新地標。任務要求一處開放空間，讓居民相聚、分享在地故事，並重建對城市的認同。
captions: 基地分析：位於密集低層街廓中的建築，以及土地使用、高度與道路圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: String models pulled by hand test how the old volume can be split, dragged, rotated and reconnected. Four urban effects guide the form: a landmark, a public ramp, beams of light and a place of remembrance.
captions: String model steps: split, drag, rotate, adjust, connect and end.
Location impact: special landmark, public space, lighthouse and commemoration.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以手拉動的線材模型，測試舊量體如何被分割、拉伸、旋轉與重新連接。四種城市效應引導形體：地標、公共坡道、光束與紀念場所。
captions: 線材模型步驟：分割、拉伸、旋轉、調整、連接與完成。
區位影響：特殊地標、公共空間、燈塔與紀念。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The city history is read as four themes, fortress, wharf, industry and war, and each theme becomes a set of space elements. Two routes, one of collective memory and one of migration, weave through the exhibition levels.
captions: Model studies of space elements for the four themes.
Space elements and the linked routes of migration and collective memory.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 城市歷史被解讀為要塞、碼頭、工業與戰爭四個主題，每個主題轉化為一組空間元素。集體記憶與遷徙兩條路徑，交織穿越各個展覽樓層。
captions: 四個主題空間元素的模型研究。
空間元素，以及遷徙與集體記憶相互連結的路徑。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Two floors above ground and two below sit under one inflatable membrane roof with planted ridges. Interior views follow the routes from the children's entrance through spaces of memory and migration.
captions: Exploded axonometry from the roof outline down to the second basement.
Interior renderings along the memory and migration routes.
Node diagrams of the planted roof and the double inflatable membrane.
Structure of the tensile roof with light and structural columns.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 地上兩層與地下兩層，覆蓋在一片帶有植栽脊線的充氣膜屋頂之下。室內視角沿著路徑，從兒童入口穿越記憶與遷徙的空間。
captions: 從屋頂輪廓到地下二層的爆炸軸測圖。
沿記憶與遷徙路徑的室內渲染。
植栽屋頂與雙層充氣膜的節點圖。
張拉屋頂的結構，以及採光與結構柱。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read history as themes.
2. Test form with hands.
3. Turn themes into elements.
4. Weave two routes.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把歷史讀成主題。
2. 用雙手測試形體。
3. 將主題化為元素。
4. 編織兩條路徑。

pins.title: The Past and Future of KaoLao Pier
pins.description:
A silted fishing pier in Qingdao is revived with markets, timber jetties and a round history museum built on local memory.

Qingdao, China | Waterfront regeneration | Apr–Jul 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: KaoLao 碼頭的過去與未來
zh-Hant.description:
青島一座淤積的漁港，以市場、木棧道與一座承載在地記憶的圓形歷史博物館重獲新生。

中國青島｜濱水再生｜2019年4–7月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Cabin section: a timber seaside cabin on piles over the water.
小屋剖面：架於水面樁柱上的木構海邊小屋。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: An old fishing pier in Qingdao has silted up, and village fishing no longer brings a steady income. The group set out to revive the wharf through fishing, mariculture, processing, tourism and a seafood market.
captions: Changes in fishing places, nets, storage, materials, power and food from the 1950s to the 2010s.
Income ranges of village occupations, from external contractors to manufacture workers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 青島一座老漁港逐漸淤積，村裡的捕魚已無法帶來穩定收入。小組希望透過捕撈、海水養殖、加工、觀光與海鮮市場，讓碼頭重新活絡。
captions: 從1950年代到2010年代，捕魚地點、漁網、保存、材料、動力與食物的變化。
村中各種職業的收入範圍，從外部承包商到製造工人。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Interviews with a long-time villager traced how boats, nets and work changed over the decades. The findings showed that income was the key, so the plan links fishing, culture and ecology to draw visitors back.
captions: Market way: buying at the wharf, transport and take-away, aiming at a clean, energy-saving and well-routed flow.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 與長年居住的村民訪談，追溯船隻、漁網與工作數十年來的轉變。研究發現收入是關鍵，因此計畫串連漁業、文化與生態，重新吸引訪客。
captions: 市場動線：碼頭購買、運輸與外帶，目標是乾淨、節能且分流的動線。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Timber jetties tie the old concrete wharf to new market and leisure decks above the tidal flat. Each joint stacks layers of waterproofing, anti-damp mats and anti-corrosion paint to last by the sea.
captions: Node detail of the timber jetty meeting the concrete wharf.
Timber jetty section with fishing, walking and resting along the deck.
Stool design concept: a prototype on the wharf railing that works as a chair or a desk.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 木棧道將舊混凝土碼頭與潮間帶上的新市場及休閒平台相連。每個接點疊加防水、防潮墊與防腐塗層，以適應海邊環境。
captions: 木棧道與混凝土碼頭交接的節點詳圖。
木棧道剖面，沿線有垂釣、散步與休憩。
凳子設計概念：架在碼頭欄杆上的原型，可作為椅子或桌子使用。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A round history museum takes its plan from the lines of the nearby sea bridge, with a ramp circling the rooms. Its sections show seaweed roofs, oyster shell walls and white shell floors as the water and mud rise over time.
captions: Section 1:100 of a round wharf unit, showing sunlight, low-e glass, moisture and waste flows.
Museum plans with the circling ramp and the bridge-derived grid.
Museum sections for three stages of water and mud levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 圓形的歷史博物館以鄰近跨海大橋的線條為平面依據，坡道環繞各個展間。剖面呈現海草屋頂、蚵殼牆與白貝殼地面，回應水位與淤泥隨時間上升。
captions: 1:100剖面，呈現圓形碼頭單元的日照、低輻射玻璃、濕氣與廢水流向。
博物館平面，坡道環繞並以大橋線條劃分。
博物館三個水位與淤泥階段的剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Listen to local voices.
2. Find the key need.
3. Detail for the sea.
4. Design for change.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 傾聽在地聲音。
2. 找出關鍵需求。
3. 為海邊做細部。
4. 為變化而設計。

pins.title: Jinan Spring Pulse Remodeling
pins.description:
The old town of Jinan is reconnected to its springs through ditches, rain-collecting chimes and canopies, and devices that show how a spring forms.

Jinan, China | Urban renewal | May–Aug 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 濟南泉脈重塑
zh-Hant.description:
以水渠、集雨風鈴與頂棚，以及展示泉水成因的裝置，讓濟南老城重新與泉水相連。

中國濟南｜城市更新｜2020年5–8月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Masterplan: open and closed ditches link the spring groups across the old town.
總平面：明渠與暗渠串連老城中的各泉群。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The old town of Jinan grew around four groups of springs, which long shaped daily life in the city. Industrial growth and the loss of vegetation at the sources have lowered the flow, and some springs have even stopped.
captions: Landform, land use, transport and the blue and green network of the old town.
Spring origin: a geological section from the recharge mountains to the springs.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 濟南老城圍繞四大泉群發展，泉水長久以來塑造了城市的日常生活。工業化與泉源植被的破壞使水量下降，部分泉水甚至曾經斷流。
captions: 老城的地形、土地使用、交通與藍綠網絡。
泉水成因：從補給山區到泉口的地質剖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Small models recreated scenes of daily life with the springs, from washing vegetables to playing by the water. A strategy chart then weighed how far each move should revive the spring veins and how far it should bring water back into daily life.
captions: Models of life and leisure with spring water.
Strategy chart weighing each move between the spring veins and daily life.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以小模型重現人們與泉水共處的日常，從洗菜到在水邊玩耍。策略圖再衡量每項操作在恢復泉脈與讓水回到生活之間的比重。
captions: 泉水生活與娛樂的模型。
衡量各策略在泉脈與日常生活之間比重的圖表。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Rain wind chimes hang on gables and partition walls, ringing on sunny days and collecting rain on wet ones. Woven canopies in hexagon and quadrangle forms shelter squares and parking while gathering rainwater.
captions: Rain wind chime: pipe section and its use on gables and partition walls.
Parking canopy forms and section.
Public space section under a rain-collecting canopy.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 雨水風鈴掛在山牆與隔牆上，晴天作為風鈴，雨天收集雨水。六邊形與四邊形的編織頂棚為廣場與停車場遮蔽，同時收集雨水。
captions: 雨水風鈴：管件剖面及其在山牆與隔牆上的應用。
停車場頂棚形式與剖面。
集雨頂棚下的公共空間剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Valve devices modelled on the heart show how a spring forms, with a large voice-controlled type for squares and a small push-button type for narrow streets. A ferry route along the old moat ties the spring nodes into one network.
captions: Moat park section with the ferry route.
Spring valve device: valve details, sections and working principle.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 仿照心臟瓣膜的裝置讓人理解泉水如何形成，大型聲控款適用於廣場，小型按鈕款適用於窄巷。沿舊護城河的遊船路線將各泉水節點串成一個網絡。
captions: 護城河公園與遊船路線剖面。
泉水瓣膜裝置：瓣膜細部、剖面與運作原理。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the water's history.
2. Model daily life.
3. Weigh each strategy.
4. Make the hidden visible.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 閱讀水的歷史。
2. 以模型呈現日常。
3. 衡量每項策略。
4. 讓看不見的被看見。

pins.title: Melbourne Affordable Housing
pins.description:
Mixed groups of residents share homes that grow over the roofs of central Melbourne, using space that the city has left unused.

Melbourne, Australia | Affordable housing | Jun–Oct 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 墨爾本可負擔住宅
zh-Hant.description:
不同居民群體共享的住宅，沿墨爾本市中心的屋頂生長，利用城市閒置的空間。

澳洲墨爾本｜可負擔住宅｜2020年6–10月｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Room configurations for each group, combined into nine household tribes.
各群體的房型配置，組合成九種家戶族群。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Melbourne's population keeps growing, and rising house prices and rents have pushed many families out of the city centre. Land in the centre is tight on the ground, yet much usable space above existing buildings is left unused.
captions: House and flat price changes across the city's districts.
Median rent compared across districts of the city.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 墨爾本人口持續成長，房價與租金上漲使許多家庭被迫離開市中心。市中心的地面土地有限，但既有建築上方仍有大量可用空間未被利用。
captions: 城市各區的獨棟與公寓房價變化。
城市各區的租金中位數比較。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A daily time loop traced when different groups of residents use shared space, from early work hours to late evening rest. The groups were then paired by how well they can help one another, mixing natives, families, students, skilled workers and newcomers.
captions: Population life time loop over twenty-four hours.
Mixed habitation groups and options beside housing indicator charts.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以一日時間循環追蹤不同居民群體使用共享空間的時段，從清晨上班到深夜休息。再依彼此能否互相幫助來配對群體，混合在地居民、家庭、學生、技術工作者與新移民。
captions: 二十四小時的人口生活時間循環。
混居群體與組合方式，以及住宅相關指標圖表。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A nine-metre dwelling unit is divided into rooms of different sizes to suit each group and budget. Tribes are joined into four clusters, with crowd flow weaving through living, business and public areas.
captions: Four clusters combining tribes, with living, business and public areas.
Cluster IV with rooftops, ramps and shared spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以九公尺見方的住宅單元，依群體需求與經濟能力分割成不同大小的房間。各族群再組合成四個聚落，人流穿梭於居住、商業與公共空間之間。
captions: 四個由族群組合而成的聚落，含居住、商業與公共區。
聚落四的屋頂、坡道與共享空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The building spreads up from a park over existing roofs, with public space at the base, dense homes in the middle and many small shared spaces at the top. Wind and solar powered clocks on the roofs show the daily change in house prices and rents as a gentle public reminder.
captions: Section details: middle floors, balcony ventilation and a passive solar house.
Models of the building units.
Warning clock: parts, dial and gear drawings.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築從公園沿既有屋頂向上蔓延，底部是公共空間，中段為密集住宅，頂部則有許多小型共享空間。屋頂上以風力與太陽能驅動的時鐘，每日顯示房價與租金的變化，作為溫和的公共提醒。
captions: 剖面細部：中段樓層、陽台通風與被動式太陽能住宅。
建築單元模型。
警示時鐘：構件、錶盤與齒輪圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the numbers.
2. Map daily rhythms.
3. Pair people who help.
4. Grow into unused space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 讀懂數據。
2. 描繪日常節奏。
3. 配對能互助的人。
4. 向閒置空間生長。

pins.title: Cambodian Restaurant and Cookery School
pins.description:
A restaurant and cookery school in Brisbane draws on Cambodian cuisine, shared meals and green gardens.

Brisbane, Australia | Restaurant and cookery school | 2018 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 柬埔寨餐廳與烹飪學校
zh-Hant.description:
一座位於布里斯本的餐廳與烹飪學校，以柬埔寨料理、共享餐食與綠色花園為設計起點。

澳洲布里斯本｜餐廳與烹飪學校｜2018年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Sectional model of the restaurant and cookery school.
餐廳與烹飪學校的剖面模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The brief asked for a restaurant and cookery school in Brisbane that carries the taste of one food culture. The project starts from Cambodian cuisine and the way people share a meal.
captions: The steps of a traditional noodle dish, from preparation and cooking to serving.
Table drawings of a small family, a group of friends and a couple, during and after meals.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 題目要求在布里斯本設計一座承載單一飲食文化的餐廳與烹飪學校。本案從柬埔寨料理以及人們共享一餐的方式出發。
captions: 一道傳統米線料理的步驟，從備料、烹煮到上菜。
小家庭、朋友聚餐與兩人用餐時，餐中與餐後的桌面圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site sits where a secondary road meets a primary road, a spot that can draw in passers-by. A wide set of massing studies tested how the volumes could open to the street and to light.
captions: Massing model on the site at the corner of the two roads.
Massing studies comparing different ways of carving and stacking the volume.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於次要道路與主要道路的交會處，能吸引往來行人。大量量體研究測試建築如何向街道與光線打開。
captions: 位於兩條道路轉角的基地量體模型。
比較不同切削與堆疊方式的量體研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A central garden, a roof garden and planted shelves bring green space into a crowded neighbourhood. Dining sits on the lower levels and the cookery school above, with a basement for service.
captions: Green spaces: roof garden, dining area, central garden, shelves and social space.
Sections 1 and 2 through the dining floors and the central garden.
Exploded levels from the basement to the cookery school.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 中央花園、屋頂花園與種植層架，為擁擠的街區帶來綠意。用餐空間位於下層，烹飪學校在上層，地下室作為後勤使用。
captions: 綠色空間：屋頂花園、用餐區、中央花園、層架與社交空間。
穿過用餐樓層與中央花園的剖面一與剖面二。
從地下室到烹飪學校的分層爆炸圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The street façade becomes a colourful billboard, while the side facing the garden stays clear and simple. A section perspective shows people cooking, eating and resting across the floors.
captions: Section perspective with the stairs, terraces and planting.
Façade design: glass panel sets, colour studies and elevations.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 面向街道的立面成為一面繽紛的看板，面向花園的一側則保持清透簡潔。剖透視呈現人們在各樓層烹飪、用餐與休憩。
captions: 呈現樓梯、露台與植栽的剖透視。
立面設計：玻璃面板組合、色彩研究與立面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a culture.
2. Draw how people eat.
3. Test many masses.
4. Let green tie it together.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一種文化出發。
2. 畫出人們如何用餐。
3. 測試多種量體。
4. 以綠意串連整體。

pins.title: Meerkat Mansion and Entrance Building
pins.description:
A zoo enclosure in Brisbane where visitors and meerkats watch each other along interlocking ramps.

Brisbane, Australia | Zoo enclosure and entrance | 2017 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 狐獴屋與入口建築
zh-Hant.description:
位於布里斯本的動物園展區，遊客與狐獴沿著交錯的坡道彼此觀看。

澳洲布里斯本｜動物園展區與入口｜2017年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of the meerkat mansion: interlocking ramps under a light roof.
狐獴屋模型：輕盈屋頂下相互交錯的坡道。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Brisbane once had zoos, but they closed amid growing concern for animals kept in poor enclosures under the constant gaze of the public. The brief asked for a new zoo layout where one enclosure and its entrance rethink how visitors and animals meet.
captions: Zoo zoning, with the meerkat mansion and entry building at the heart of the plan.
From the conventional zoo to new strategies: interlocking levels, switched roles and spaces fitted to each animal.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 布里斯本曾有動物園，但因外界日益關注圈養動物的福祉而關閉，這些動物常處於簡陋的圍欄中、承受大眾不斷的注視。題目要求規劃一座新的動物園，以其中一個展區與入口建築重新思考遊客與動物的相遇方式。
captions: 動物園分區圖，狐獴屋與入口建築位於規劃核心。
從傳統動物園到新策略：交錯的樓層、互換的角色，以及依動物習性設計的空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Two assigned precedent buildings were taken apart and recombined into a set of hybrid forms. These forms were then matched to the habits of meerkats, which love to run, jump and watch moving things.
captions: Hybrid forms drawn from transforming the two precedent buildings.
Viewing ideas: looking from the same level, from another structure, across, down and popping up from below.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 將兩座指定的參考建築拆解、重組，發展出一系列混合形體。再將這些形體對應狐獴的習性：喜愛奔跑、跳躍，並好奇地觀察移動的事物。
captions: 由兩座參考建築轉化而來的混合形體。
觀看方式：平視、從另一結構觀看、橫向對望、俯視，以及從地下冒出觀看。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Spiral ramps for visitors and meerkats wrap around each other, so both sides watch one another. Towers, a roof terrace and an underground maze give each viewpoint its own place.
captions: Connection, transformation and event program for the mansion.
Mansion plans from the roof terrace down to the underground maze.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 遊客與狐獴的螺旋坡道彼此纏繞，讓雙方互相觀看。塔樓、屋頂平台與地下迷宮，為每一種觀看方式提供各自的位置。
captions: 狐獴屋的連結、轉化與活動計畫。
狐獴屋平面，從屋頂平台到地下迷宮。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The entrance building holds ticketing, a recreation area and a café beside the woodland paths. Sections show visitors climbing the ramps while the meerkats run and dig below.
captions: Site plan of the mansion and the entrance building among the trees.
Ground and first level plans of the entrance building.
Three sections through the entrance building and the mansion.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 入口建築容納售票、休閒區與咖啡廳，緊鄰林間步道。剖面呈現遊客沿坡道上行，狐獴則在下方奔跑與挖掘。
captions: 狐獴屋與入口建築在樹林中的配置圖。
入口建築一樓與二樓平面。
穿過入口建築與狐獴屋的三道剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Question the old model.
2. Study the animal.
3. Remix precedents.
4. Design for both sides.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 質疑舊有模式。
2. 研究動物習性。
3. 重組參考案例。
4. 為雙方而設計。

pins.title: Skate Park Training Facility
pins.description:
A skate park in Brisbane where a looping roof grows out of the slope and links outdoor and indoor skating.

Brisbane, Australia | Skate park | 2017 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 滑板公園訓練設施
zh-Hant.description:
位於布里斯本的滑板公園，環狀屋頂自坡地生長而出，串連戶外與室內的滑板空間。

澳洲布里斯本｜滑板公園｜2017年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Street view of the skate park, its curved roof rising out of the slope.
滑板公園街景，彎曲的屋頂自坡地中升起。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The brief asked for a training facility for elite skateboarders in a park in Brisbane. The site is bumpy, crossed by random footpaths and surrounded by busy roads and dense housing.
captions: Site analysis: surroundings, transport and access, trees and footpaths.
Who the park serves: older people, children, families, skaters and animals.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 題目要求在布里斯本一座公園內設計菁英滑板選手的訓練設施。基地地形起伏，雜亂的步道穿越其間，周邊是繁忙道路與密集住宅。
captions: 基地分析：周邊環境、交通與出入、樹木與步道。
公園的使用者：長者、孩童、家庭、滑板者與動物。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project reads site as a sense of place and surface as the ground where building and landscape meet. Studies of site, daily life and program set out how the park could welcome all ages.
captions: Site, life and program: placing the building where the footpaths cross.
Skate elements from ramps and bowls to rails and pipes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案將「基地」理解為場所精神，將「表面」視為建築與地景交會的地面。透過基地、日常生活與機能的研究，探討公園如何迎接各個年齡層。
captions: 基地、生活與機能：將建築置於步道交會處。
從坡道、碗池到扶手與管道的各種滑板元素。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Drawings of skaters in motion show the dynamic, fluent and curvy lines of the sport. These lines shape a looping roof that links the outdoor skating platform with the indoor training hall below.
captions: Skater movement studies that lead to the curved forms.
Site plan, with vehicle access from the north-west and pedestrian access from two sides.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 描繪滑板者動作的圖面，呈現這項運動動態、流暢而彎曲的線條。這些線條塑造出環狀屋頂，串連戶外滑板平台與下方的室內訓練館。
captions: 引出曲線形體的滑板動作研究。
配置圖，車輛由西北側進入，行人則可從兩側進出。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The building uses the height difference of the site, so the indoor skating area sits partly below ground. Above it lie a function room, a roof terrace and a skating platform on the roof.
captions: Exploded axonometric from the indoor skating area up to the outdoor facilities.
Roof, first level, ground level and basement plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築利用基地的高低差，使室內滑板區部分位於地面以下。其上依序是多功能室、屋頂露台與屋頂滑板平台。
captions: 從室內滑板區到戶外設施的分解軸測圖。
屋頂、二樓、一樓與地下室平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the ground.
2. Know every user.
3. Draw the movement.
4. Let the roof play.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀地形。
2. 認識每位使用者。
3. 畫出動作。
4. 讓屋頂成為遊戲場。

pins.title: Residing in the City
pins.description:
An urban park, a pixel landscape and a temporary artwork station slip new public space into dense Oakland.

Oakland, USA | Urban public space | 2018 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 棲居城市
zh-Hant.description:
城市公園、像素地景與臨時藝術站，將新的公共空間置入高密度的奧克蘭。

美國奧克蘭｜城市公共空間｜2018年｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Pixel landscape: greenery, pools, paving and pavilions broken into pieces between the towers.
像素地景：綠地、水池、鋪面與亭子被拆解成碎片，置入高樓之間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Oakland is already a high-density, well-developed city, and most of its land is taken by buildings. The project looks for ways to improve daily life and the look of the city while keeping its original structure.
captions: Pattern plan for the pixel landscape in the central office zone.
Land use map of commercial, residential and public space.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 奧克蘭已是高密度且高度開發的城市，大部分土地都已被建築占據。本案在保留原有城市紋理的前提下，尋找改善市民生活品質與城市景觀的方法。
captions: 中央辦公區像素地景的圖案平面。
商業、住宅與公共空間的土地使用圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The city has many museums and galleries, but most are indoor and small, and outdoor gathering spots are few. Underused car parks and leftover gaps between buildings became the chances for new public space.
captions: Urban park sections: a stage, an entrance, a platform and two chairs.
Urban park site plan on a former car park.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 城市裡有許多博物館與藝廊，但多為室內小型空間，戶外聚集場所十分有限。閒置的停車場與建築之間的零碎空隙，成為新公共空間的契機。
captions: 城市公園剖面：舞台、入口、平台與兩處座椅。
建於原停車場上的城市公園配置圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A rectangular basic form was reshaped into an organic shell that shelters a stage and a theatre. Gaps between the ribs let sunlight and rain reach the planting below.
captions: Form studies: from a basic box to an organic shell that lets sunlight through.
Three options for an artwork station on a rooftop, between buildings or over a car park.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 從長方形的基本形體出發，逐步修改成有機的殼體，庇護舞台與劇場。肋條之間的縫隙讓陽光與雨水落到下方的植栽。
captions: 形體研究：從基本方盒到讓陽光穿透的有機殼體。
藝術站的三種方案：屋頂、建築之間或停車場上方。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A temporary artwork station plugs into the gap between a group of apartment buildings and a store beside a freeway. Its sections show a light, porous structure climbing above and around the existing buildings.
captions: Site of the artwork station between apartments and a store.
Sections A and B through the artwork station.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 臨時藝術站嵌入高速公路旁一群公寓與一家商店之間的空隙。剖面呈現輕盈多孔的結構，在既有建築之上與周圍攀升。
captions: 位於公寓與商店之間的藝術站基地。
穿過藝術站的剖面A與剖面B。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Keep the city fabric.
2. Find leftover space.
3. Break it into pieces.
4. Plug in, lightly.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 保留城市紋理。
2. 找出剩餘空間。
3. 將地景拆解成碎片。
4. 輕巧地嵌入。

pins.title: Inspired by Structure
pins.description:
Folded models and joint tests grow into a modular tower that is both structure and home.

Architecture | Modular tower | Structure study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 從結構出發
zh-Hant.description:
從摺疊模型與接點實驗出發，發展成一座兼具結構與居所的模組化高塔。

建築｜模組化高塔｜結構研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Forming a building: a tower wrapped in a repeating structural frame.
形成建築：以重複結構框架包覆的高塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project asks how a structure can be both beautiful and useful at the same time. It starts from small material tests rather than from a given site or program.
captions: Exploded figure: a hand-made model pulled apart into its parts.
Models formed by folding and transforming triangles, cast in a cardboard mould.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案探討結構如何同時兼具美感與實用性。它從小型材料實驗出發，而非從既定的基地或機能開始。
captions: 爆炸模型：將手作模型拆解成各個部件。
以三角形連續摺疊與變形而成的模型，以紙板模具澆鑄。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Different joint types were compared for strength, stiffness, complexity and reliability. Physical models then tested which joint could be repeated and assembled.
captions: Comparing joint types by strength, stiffness, complexity, reliability and stress mode.
Exploring the physical model, from single joints to a final assembled unit.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 比較不同接點類型的強度、剛度、複雜度與可靠度。再以實體模型測試哪一種接點可以重複組裝。
captions: 依強度、剛度、複雜度、可靠度與受力方式比較接點類型。
探索實體模型，從單一接點到最終組裝單元。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The chosen joint grows from a tetrahedron into a three-way node. A stress analysis shows that the frame is fairly even in stress, which suits modular building in many directions.
captions: Joints constructed from a tetrahedron, step by step.
Stress analysis of the frame, with drawings of the repeated structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 選定的接點由四面體發展為三向節點。應力分析顯示整體框架受力相當均勻，適合向多個方向進行模組化建造。
captions: 由四面體逐步建構而成的接點。
框架的應力分析，以及重複結構的圖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The frame becomes a tower that holds single rooms, lofts and family units in triangular plans. A derivative tower stacks a commercial base, apartments, lofts and penthouses inside the same structure.
captions: Planar graph of room types in a triangular plan.
Room models: loft, single room, compact and continuity.
Derivative building: commercial complex, apartment, loft and penthouse.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 框架發展成一座高塔，在三角形平面中容納單人房、樓中樓與家庭單元。衍生出的高塔在同一結構內，依序疊放商業基座、公寓、樓中樓與頂層住宅。
captions: 三角形平面中各種房型的平面圖。
房間模型：樓中樓、單人房、緊湊型與連續型。
衍生建築：商業綜合體、公寓、樓中樓與頂層住宅。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start with material.
2. Test the joint.
3. Check the stress.
4. Grow it into space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從材料開始。
2. 測試接點。
3. 檢查受力。
4. 發展成空間。

pins.title: New Urban Life
pins.description:
A greenway and roof gardens turn a former racetrack neighbourhood into a place to walk, play and meet.

Guangzhou, China | Urban design | 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 新都市生活
zh-Hant.description:
以綠廊與屋頂花園，把舊賽馬場街區轉化為步行、運動與相聚的地方。

中國廣州｜都市設計｜2019｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A green running track threads through the rebuilt neighbourhood and its roof gardens.
一條綠色跑道穿過重建後的街區與屋頂花園。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Daily life spent on screens has made many people sedentary. The project rebuilds a former racetrack neighbourhood in Guangzhou so that people walk outside and meet face to face.
captions: Urban change around the site, from farmland and villages to high-rise blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 日常生活被螢幕佔據，讓許多人習慣久坐。本案重建廣州一處舊賽馬場街區，讓人們走到戶外、面對面交流。
captions: 基地周邊的都市變遷，從農地與村落轉為高樓街廓。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site is ringed by busy roads on three sides and has only two gates. That makes it hard for people to walk in, even though subway and bus lines are close by.
captions: Circulation analysis: public transport, traffic and accessibility.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地三面被繁忙道路包圍，且只有兩個出入口。即使地鐵與公車就在附近，人們仍難以步行進入。
captions: 動線分析：大眾運輸、交通與可及性。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A north-south greenway runs through the middle of the site, and a tunnel below it takes cars off the surface. Most buildings carry roof gardens that link people with nature.
captions: Future development plan: form, edge, orientation and place.
Schematic layers: circulation, roads, buildings, greenway and roof gardens.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一條南北向綠廊貫穿基地中央，其下的隧道把車流移出地面。多數建築設有屋頂花園，讓人與自然相連。
captions: 未來發展計畫：形態、邊界、方向與場所。
設計分層：動線、道路、建築、綠廊與屋頂花園。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The master plan mixes offices, a sports field, an art centre, homes and a central park along the greenway. Work, green space and community life overlap so that the old sporting spirit of the site lives on.
captions: Master plan of the neighbourhood along the greenway.
Work life, green life and human life across the plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 總體配置沿綠廊混合辦公、運動場、藝術中心、住宅與中央公園。工作、綠地與社區生活彼此交疊，讓基地原有的運動精神得以延續。
captions: 沿綠廊展開的街區總體配置。
整體配置中的工作生活、綠色生活與人的生活。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the site history.
2. Map how people move.
3. Draw one strong spine.
4. Layer life along it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 閱讀基地歷史。
2. 描繪人的移動。
3. 畫出一條清楚的主軸。
4. 沿主軸疊加生活。

pins.title: Building a Prison
pins.description:
Models and drawings test how a prison can balance privacy and security around one control tower.

Architecture | Prison | Privacy study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 建構一座監獄
zh-Hant.description:
以模型與圖面，探討監獄如何圍繞一座控制塔，在隱私與安全之間取得平衡。

建築｜監獄｜隱私研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A hand-drawn labyrinth of towers, bridges and stairs.
手繪的迷宮，由高塔、橋與樓梯交織而成。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project asks how privacy and security can be balanced inside a prison. It treats the building as a study of how walls, distance and paths decide what people can see and reach.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案探討監獄內部如何在隱私與安全之間取得平衡。它把建築當作一項研究，觀察牆、距離與路徑如何決定人能看見與抵達的範圍。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Early drawings imagine a maze of towers and stairs that is easy to enter and hard to leave. Three prototype models then test hanging cells, a vertical maze of stairs and an open grid.
captions: Three prototype models that recombine the earlier elements.
Prototype sections, each rated for privacy and security.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 早期的圖面想像一座由高塔與樓梯構成、易進難出的迷宮。接著以三個原型模型，測試懸吊的房間、垂直的樓梯迷宮與開放格架。
captions: 三個重新組合先前元素的原型模型。
原型剖面，各自標示隱私與安全的程度。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The prototypes are combined into one block of stacked layers around a central control tower. Common cell rooms sit on the outer layer, with more isolated rooms toward the centre.
captions: Axonometric and exploded view of the layered block.
Plan with a single entrance and the cell rooms on the outer ring.
Plan with the guard office and control tower at the centre.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 這些原型被整合成一座圍繞中央控制塔、層層堆疊的量體。一般房間位於外層，隔離程度較高的房間則往中心配置。
captions: 分層量體的軸測圖與爆炸圖。
單一入口、房間位於外圈的平面。
警衛辦公室與控制塔位於中心的平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Renders show a light, open frame where stairs and bridges cross through the courtyard. The sections show how vertical circulation and the cell rooms stack around the tower.
captions: Views from a common cell room and from an isolated section.
Sections of the vertical circulation and the common cell rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 渲染圖呈現一座輕盈開放的框架，樓梯與天橋穿越中庭。剖面則說明垂直動線與房間如何圍繞高塔堆疊。
captions: 從一般房間與隔離區看出去的視角。
垂直動線與一般房間的剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Draw the idea by hand.
2. Build three prototypes.
3. Rate each one.
4. Combine the best parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先用手繪表達想法。
2. 做出三個原型。
3. 逐一評估。
4. 整合最好的部分。

pins.title: Implantation of Changeable Wall
pins.description:
Corridors, balconies and moving walls let a city housing block switch between shop and home.

Guangzhou, China | Residential | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 可變牆的植入
zh-Hant.description:
以走廊、陽台與可移動的牆，讓都市住宅量體在店面與住家之間切換。

中國廣州｜住宅｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Cutaway view of the block, with staggered balconies and changeable rooms.
量體剖切透視，可見錯落的陽台與可變的房間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: During a lockdown, a residential community in central Guangzhou saw many shops left empty while residents could not live normally. The project asks how one building can serve both everyday trade and safe home life when that happens.
captions: Site location and site condition analysis in the city centre.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在封控期間，廣州市中心一處住宅社區的許多店面閒置，居民也無法正常生活。本案探討一棟建築如何在這種情況下，同時支持日常商業與安全的居家生活。
captions: 位於市中心的基地位置與現況分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied which activities each group in the community lost during the lockdown. Three needs came out of this, and each one led to a strategy, starting with managing the district in different periods.
captions: Strategy one: the district before, during and after a lockdown.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究社區中各族群在封控期間失去了哪些活動。由此歸納出三項需求，每一項都對應一個策略，首先是依不同時期管理街區。
captions: 策略一：封控前、封控期間與解除後的街區。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Outside corridors and staggered balconies act as a separate route and a social space in a lockdown, and as shop frontage in normal times. Inside, walls that move let a room change between shop, home and mixed use.
captions: Strategy two: corridors and balconies keep sightlines between neighbours.
Strategy three: generating interior layouts from private to public.
Interior forms shown in perspective plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 外部走廊與錯落的陽台，在封控時作為獨立動線與社交空間，平時則成為店面的延伸。室內則以可移動的牆，讓房間在店面、住家與混合用途之間轉換。
captions: 策略二：走廊與陽台保留鄰里之間的視線。
策略三：從私密到公共生成室內配置。
以透視平面呈現的室內形式。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The floor plan and section show the changeable wall across the whole building. An entrance bathroom works as a buffer, so people who need to stay apart and other residents use separate routes.
captions: Floor plan, section and three ways the wall can change.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 平面與剖面呈現可變牆在整棟建築中的應用。入口浴室作為緩衝區，讓需要隔離的人與其他住戶使用不同的動線。
captions: 平面、剖面與牆體的三種變化方式。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask who lost what.
2. Turn needs into strategies.
3. Design for two modes.
4. Show the change in plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 問誰失去了什麼。
2. 把需求轉成策略。
3. 為兩種模式設計。
4. 在平面上呈現轉變。

pins.title: Implantation of Welfare Index
pins.description:
A welfare index built from residents' needs guides the renewal of a dense urban village.

Guangzhou, China | Urban village renewal | 2018 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 福祉指數的植入
zh-Hant.description:
以居民需求建立的福祉指數，引導一座高密度城中村的更新。

中國廣州｜城中村更新｜2018｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The renewed village, with roof terraces, planting and residents drawn around it.
更新後的城中村，屋頂露台、綠化與周圍手繪的居民。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Urban villages give low-income residents and new arrivals a cheap place to start, but they are crowded and short of light, air and open space. The project asks how one village in central Guangzhou can become livable while keeping its own texture and scale.
captions: Village types and the ways villages cluster in the city.
How the village grew, period by period.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 城中村為低收入居民與外來者提供低門檻的落腳處，但也擁擠、缺乏採光、通風與開放空間。本案探討廣州市中心的一座城中村，如何在保留原有肌理與尺度的同時變得宜居。
captions: 城中村的類型，以及它們在城市中聚集的方式。
城中村逐期成長的過程。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student ran a field survey and interviews with residents, then drew the village layer by layer. Hand-made section models show how people actually live inside the dense buildings.
captions: Exploded analysis of the village, from ground to roofs.
Hand-made section models of villagers' activities inside buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生對居民進行實地問卷與訪談，再逐層繪製這座城中村。手作的剖面模型呈現人們如何在密集的建築中實際生活。
captions: 城中村的爆炸分析，從地面到屋頂。
呈現村民室內活動的手作剖面模型。

sections.heading: Development
