sections.body: Using capability theory, the student built a welfare index from living, environment and leisure indicators. Each weak indicator is turned into a design move, such as better room layouts, planting that cleans the air and new leisure space.
captions: Welfare indicators compared against the living environment.
From present situation to improvement direction and strategy.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生運用可行能力理論，以居住、環境與休閒等指標建立福祉指數。每一項偏弱的指標都轉化為設計手法，例如改善房間配置、以植栽淨化空氣，以及增加休閒空間。
captions: 福祉指標與居住環境的對照。
從現況、改善方向到設計策略。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Roof terraces, enclosed courtyards and new interior layouts are implanted into the existing blocks. The village keeps its dense grain but gains greenery, safer lanes and more places to gather.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂露台、圍合中庭與新的室內配置被植入既有的街廓中。城中村保有原本緊密的紋理，同時多了綠意、更安全的巷道與更多聚集的場所。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask residents first.
2. Measure what is missing.
3. Turn each gap into a move.
4. Keep the village grain.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先問居民。
2. 量測缺少什麼。
3. 把每個缺口轉成設計手法。
4. 保留村落的紋理。

pins.title: Implantation of City Canopy
pins.description:
An umbrella taken apart becomes a folding canopy for an old shopping street.

Guangzhou, China | Commercial street | 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市頂篷的植入
zh-Hant.description:
把雨傘拆解後，轉化為老商業街上可摺疊的頂篷。

中國廣州｜商業街｜2019｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A folding canopy spans the street from wall to wall.
可摺疊的頂篷從牆到牆橫跨街道。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Busy old shopping streets have little room, yet they need shade and shelter from the rain. The project asks whether a flexible device, folded into the corner of a building, can open over the street when needed.
captions: Taking an umbrella apart: opening process and raindrop paths.
The umbrella frame drawn as a pattern.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 熱鬧的老商業街空間有限，卻需要遮陽與避雨。本案探討一種收在建築轉角的彈性裝置，能否在需要時展開覆蓋街道。
captions: 拆解雨傘：開啟過程與雨滴軌跡。
以圖案形式繪製的傘骨。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The umbrella frame is reduced to two parts, a node and a fixture, and each is tested in study models. A movement study shows how the parts fold in and stretch out along a wall.
captions: Node design, fixture design and how the parts move.
Physical models of the node fixed to a wall, with and without a cover.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 傘骨被簡化為節點與固定件兩個部分，並各自以研究模型測試。一系列動作研究呈現這些部件如何沿著牆面收合與伸展。
captions: 節點設計、固定件設計與部件的運動方式。
固定在牆上的節點實體模型，有覆面與無覆面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The device is placed along an arcade shopping street in Guangzhou with many shops and visitors. Zoom views show where the canopy meets corners, junctions and wider parts of the street.
captions: Axonometric of the shopping street, with the canopy shown in pink.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 裝置被置入廣州一條商店與遊客眾多的騎樓商業街。放大視圖呈現頂篷與轉角、路口及街道較寬處的關係。
captions: 商業街軸測圖，頂篷以粉紅色標示。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Four canopy strategies grow from one wall bracket to frames that link both sides and turn corners. Each one changes how open or sheltered the street feels, from public to semi-private.
captions: Strategy one: a single bracket covers one side of the street.
Strategy two: two brackets join in the middle to cover the whole street.
Strategy four: a cross-shaped frame covers an intersection.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 四種頂篷策略從單一牆面支架，發展到連接兩側並轉過路口的框架。每一種都改變街道的開放或遮蔽程度，從公共到半私密。
captions: 策略一：單一支架覆蓋街道一側。
策略二：兩側支架在中央相接，覆蓋整條街。
策略四：十字形框架覆蓋路口。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Take an object apart.
2. Keep the key parts.
3. Test them in models.
4. Scale them to the street.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 拆解一件物品。
2. 保留關鍵部件。
3. 用模型測試。
4. 放大到街道尺度。

pins.title: Heretical Intervention
pins.description:
One photo is read in many ways and grows into a folded space between two buildings.

Guangzhou, China | Cultural building | 2018 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 異質介入
zh-Hant.description:
一張照片被多角度解讀，生長為兩棟建築之間的摺疊空間。

中國廣州｜文化建築｜2018｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Light falls through folded planes inside the building.
光線穿過建築內部的摺疊面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project starts from one photo the student took and asks how many design ideas a single image can hold. Each way of looking at it, from shape to colour to density, could lead to a different space.
captions: Drawings that pull outlines, geometry and density out of the photo.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案從學生自己拍攝的一張照片出發，探問一張影像能容納多少設計概念。從形狀、色彩到密度，每一種觀看方式都可能導向不同的空間。
captions: 從照片中抽取輪廓、幾何與密度的圖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The extracted ideas are sorted into three themes: outline, geometry and density. Each theme is then tested with its own material in small study models.
captions: Study models for each theme.
Wire models that turn outlines into volume.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 抽取出的概念被歸納為輪廓、幾何與密度三個主題。每個主題再以各自的材料，在小型研究模型中測試。
captions: 各主題的研究模型。
把輪廓轉化為量體的線材模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The outline theme and the triangle theme are combined into a space of lines, surfaces and volume. This growth is drawn in section as it climbs between the floors of two blocks.
captions: Close views of the folded paper model.
Section showing the structure growing between floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 輪廓主題與三角形主題被結合為由線、面與量體構成的空間。剖面圖呈現這個構造如何在兩棟量體的樓層之間向上生長。
captions: 摺紙模型的近景。
呈現構造在樓層間生長的剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model sets a cluster of folded triangles between two plain boxes. The folded mass works as a medium that links the two buildings and casts changing light inside.
captions: Physical model, top view.
Physical model, front view.
Physical model, overall view.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型在兩個素淨的方盒之間置入一團摺疊三角形。這個摺疊量體作為媒介連接兩棟建築，並在室內投下變化的光影。
captions: 實體模型俯視。
實體模型正面。
實體模型整體。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one image.
2. Pull out several ideas.
3. Test each with a material.
4. Combine the strongest two.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一張影像出發。
2. 抽取多個概念。
3. 為每個概念選材料測試。
4. 結合最有力的兩個。

pins.title: Modern Garden Architecture
pins.description:
Principles of the classical garden shape a new commercial complex.

Suzhou, China | Commercial complex | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 現代園林建築
zh-Hant.description:
古典園林的原則塑造一座新的商業綜合體。

中國蘇州｜商業綜合體｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A long section shows shops, offices and courtyards under layered roofs.
長剖面呈現層疊屋頂下的商店、辦公與庭院。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project asks whether the classical Chinese garden still has something to teach modern architecture. It tests this question on a new commercial complex in Suzhou.
captions: Hand sketches of how garden buildings mix daily uses.
Rockery, plants and water taken apart in sketches.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 本案探問中國古典園林是否仍能為現代建築帶來啟發。這個問題在蘇州一座新的商業綜合體中被檢驗。
captions: 手繪速寫：園林建築如何混合日常機能。
以速寫拆解假山、植栽與水景。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Seven principles are drawn out of the garden, from free function and asymmetry to winding routes and borrowed scenery. Each one is turned into simple building forms and roof studies.
captions: Single building forms made from roof and box types.
Studies of the roof structure and the atrium courtyard.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 從園林中歸納出七項原則，包括自由的機能、不對稱、曲折的路徑與借景。每一項都被轉化為簡單的建築形體與屋頂研究。
captions: 由屋頂與方盒類型組合的單體形式。
屋頂結構與中庭的研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The complex is stacked as layers of shops, public rooms, offices and roof gardens. Curved roofs and broken volumes keep the garden feeling of many small buildings.
captions: Exploded axonometric of the spaces and roofs.
Line elevation of the complex.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 綜合體被堆疊為商業、公共活動、辦公與屋頂花園等層次。彎曲的屋頂與錯落的量體，保留了園林中眾多小建築的感受。
captions: 空間與屋頂的爆炸軸測圖。
綜合體的線稿立面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Low garden buildings sit at the base while a tower rises to meet the city. Inside, a maker space opens floor by floor for different groups of people.
captions: Sections at the four entrances.
The complex set against the city.
Sectional perspective of the maker space.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 低矮的園林建築位於基座，塔樓則向上與城市對話。內部的創客空間逐層展開，服務不同的人群。
captions: 四個入口的剖面。
綜合體與城市的關係。
創客空間的剖透視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Sketch a historic type.
2. Name its principles.
3. Turn each into form.
4. Stack them into a program.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 速寫一種歷史類型。
2. 歸納它的原則。
3. 把每項原則轉為形體。
4. 把形體疊合成機能。

pins.title: Wind, Always With Me
pins.description:
Ventilation towers bring cool air and shared space to an urban village.

Guangzhou, China | Ventilation tower | 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 風，與我同在
zh-Hant.description:
通風塔為城中村帶來涼風與共享空間。

中國廣州｜通風塔｜2019｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A new ventilation tower rises between dense village blocks.
新的通風塔在密集的村落樓房之間升起。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Homes in a dense urban village in Guangzhou are hot, dark and poorly ventilated. Residents also lack shared space for daily activities.
captions: Towers spread across the village roofs.
A profile of the village with its new towers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州一處密集城中村的住宅炎熱、昏暗且通風不良。居民也缺少日常活動的共享空間。
captions: 通風塔分布在村落屋頂之上。
加入通風塔後的村落輪廓。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The project studies the traditional wind-catching tower, which pulls cool air down like a chimney in reverse. Several air-trap shapes and duct layouts are compared before one is chosen.
captions: Air trap shapes, duct design and staged cooling.
How the tower is generated.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 本案研究傳統的捕風塔，它像反向的煙囪般把涼風引入室內。設計比較了多種捕風口形狀與風道配置後才確定方案。
captions: 捕風口形狀、風道設計與分段降溫。
通風塔的生成過程。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Towers come in large, medium and small sizes to fit wide plots and narrow lanes. Light modules for living, work and leisure are stacked around the central duct.
captions: Strategies for large, medium and small towers.
Exploded view of the tower.
Floor plans and functional modules.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 通風塔分為大、中、小三種尺度，以適應寬地塊與窄巷。居住、工作與休閒的輕量模組圍繞中央風道堆疊。
captions: 大、中、小型通風塔的策略。
通風塔的爆炸圖。
平面與機能模組。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A timber model tests the tower, its stairs and its stacked homes. It shows how one structure can cool rooms and add shared space at the same time.
captions: Physical model of the ventilation tower.
Model details of stair nodes and housing modules.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 木構模型檢驗了通風塔、樓梯與堆疊的居住空間。它展示一個結構如何同時為室內降溫並增加共享空間。
captions: 通風塔的實體模型。
樓梯節點與居住模組的模型細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a climate type.
2. Test its airflow.
3. Scale it to the site.
4. Build it as a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一種氣候類型。
2. 測試它的氣流。
3. 依基地調整尺度。
4. 以模型建造驗證。

pins.title: Climate Adaptive Architecture
pins.description:
A museum learns from vernacular houses to stay cool without machines.

Guangzhou, China | Museum | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 氣候適應性建築
zh-Hant.description:
一座向傳統民居學習、不靠機械也能保持涼爽的博物館。

中國廣州｜博物館｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Ring-shaped halls of the museum sit under a sweeping arch.
環形展廳坐落在一道大弧形屋頂之下。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Guangzhou is hot, humid and rainy for much of the year. The project asks how a museum can stay comfortable without relying on heavy machines.
captions: Studies of orientation, wind and daylight.
Climate elements drawn from vernacular buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州一年中大部分時間炎熱、潮濕且多雨。本案探問一座博物館如何不依賴大量機械也能保持舒適。
captions: 朝向、風與日照的研究。
從傳統民居中提取的氣候元素。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Round earth houses, stilt houses, cave dwellings, rain corridors and arcades are studied as climate tools. Each one shows a simple way to shade, ventilate or keep out rain.
captions: Hand sketch of a round earth house as a case study.
Vernacular elements turned into new building parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 圓形土樓、干欄式建築、窯洞、風雨廊與騎樓都被視為應對氣候的工具來研究。每一種都展示了遮陽、通風或防雨的簡單方法。
captions: 以圓形土樓為案例的手繪速寫。
傳統元素轉化為新的建築構件。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The museum is split into a mountain zone and a water zone across the site. Ring halls, raised floors and covered walks are layered into one landscape.
captions: Axonometric of the mountain and river zones.
Exploded layers of the water pavilion.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 博物館在基地上分為山區與水區兩部分。環形展廳、架空樓板與有頂步道被層疊成一片完整的地景。
captions: 山區與河區的軸測圖。
水上展館的分層爆炸圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the water pavilion, visitors turn wheels that pump water and drive fans to cool the hall. A timber model tests the ring structure and its details.
captions: Water-wheel cooling equipment.
Physical model of the museum.
Model details of the ring structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在水上展館中，參觀者轉動水車抽水並帶動風扇，為展廳降溫。木構模型檢驗了環形結構與其細部。
captions: 水車驅動的降溫裝置。
博物館的實體模型。
環形結構的模型細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the local climate.
2. Sketch vernacular answers.
3. Extract simple elements.
4. Combine them into one form.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 分析在地氣候。
2. 速寫傳統民居的對策。
3. 提取簡單的元素。
4. 把元素組合成整體形式。

pins.title: Container Kindergarten
pins.description:
Seven containers give a crowded neighbourhood a kindergarten with play on every roof.

Xiangtan, China | Kindergarten | 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 貨櫃幼兒園
zh-Hant.description:
七個貨櫃量體，讓擁擠的社區擁有一座屋頂也能遊戲的幼兒園。

中國湘潭｜幼兒園｜2019｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Physical model of the kindergarten and its courtyards.
幼兒園與庭院的實體模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The kindergarten sits in a dense residential community in Xiangtan with little open ground. Children lack space to play and the old building gives them little to enjoy.
captions: General layout of the site.
Axonometric of the container buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這所幼兒園位於湘潭一個密集的住宅社區，開放用地很少。孩子缺少遊戲的空間，舊建築也難以帶給他們樂趣。
captions: 基地總平面。
貨櫃式建築群的軸測圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site plan is first divided by function and then rotated to add interest. A corridor is set up to tie each part together.
captions: Steps of the plane generation.
Steps of the form and circulation generation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 總平面先依功能劃分，再加以旋轉以增加趣味。接著設置一條廊道把各部分串連起來。
captions: 平面生成的步驟。
形體與動線生成的步驟。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A U-shaped layout holds seven containers around an inner and an outer courtyard. Classrooms, dining and play rooms are stacked and linked by ramps and terraces.
captions: Exploded layout with the floor plans.
Elevations and a section through the courtyard.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: U 形布局把七個貨櫃量體圍繞內外兩個庭院排列。教室、餐廳與活動室層層疊放，並以坡道和平台相連。
captions: 分層布局與各層平面。
立面與穿過庭院的剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: An air trail lets children walk from the ground up to the roof and lets parents watch over them. The playground rises across the roofs so the small site gains more room for activity.
captions: Render of the outdoor parent trail.
Overview of the physical model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一條空中步道讓孩子能從地面走上屋頂，也讓家長能從旁看顧。遊戲場沿屋頂抬升，使小小的基地獲得更多活動空間。
captions: 戶外家長步道的渲染圖。
實體模型全景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the limits of the site.
2. Divide the plan by function.
3. Link the parts with one path.
4. Test the form in a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀基地的限制。
2. 依功能劃分平面。
3. 用一條路徑串連各部分。
4. 以模型檢驗形體。

pins.title: Museum of Intimate Relationship
pins.description:
A riverside museum turns water, wind and light into a walk through the parts of love.

Guangzhou, China | Museum | 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 親密關係博物館
zh-Hant.description:
一座河岸博物館，把水、風與光化為穿越愛情各個面向的散步。

中國廣州｜博物館｜2019｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Sections along the visitor route, from dark rooms to open water.
沿參觀路線的剖面，從幽暗空間走向開闊水面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: When love fades, both partners are affected. The museum asks whether walking through different spaces can help couples understand love and keep it alive.
captions: Map of the riverside site.
Analysis of the site, its natural conditions and the route.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 當愛情逐漸消退，雙方都會受到影響。這座博物館探問，走過不同的空間能否幫助伴侶理解愛並讓它延續。
captions: 河岸基地的地圖。
基地、自然條件與路線的分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Love is read as three parts, intimacy, passion and commitment, which mix into eight types. Each type is matched with a mix of water, wind and light and the mood it creates.
captions: Conditions, space feelings and mood swings for each type of love.
Comparison of two ground conditions on the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 愛被解讀為親密、激情與承諾三個部分，並組合出八種類型。每一種類型都對應一組水、風與光的條件，以及它帶來的情緒。
captions: 各種愛情類型對應的環境條件、空間感受與情緒起伏。
基地上兩種地面狀態的比較。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The museum opens to the city instead of closing itself off from it. Small spaces test wind corridors, underwater galleries and rooms with strong or weak light.
captions: Design concept and plane generation.
Studies of wind, water and light spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 博物館向城市開放，而不是自我封閉。一系列小空間分別測試風廊、水下展廊，以及光線強弱不同的房間。
captions: 設計概念與平面生成。
風、水與光的空間研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Three routes, light for commitment, water for intimacy and wind for passion, lead visitors from dark spaces to the open river. Along the way the feeling of each space changes step by step.
captions: Function nodes and the three routes.
Section perspective along the water.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 三條路線分別以光代表承諾、以水代表親密、以風代表激情，引導參觀者從幽暗空間走向開闊的河面。沿途每個空間的感受都逐步轉變。
captions: 功能節點與三條路線。
沿水面的剖透視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name the feeling to design.
2. Break it into simple parts.
3. Match each part to a condition.
4. Link them along one route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 說出要設計的感受。
2. 把它拆成簡單的部分。
3. 為每個部分配上一種環境條件。
4. 沿著一條路線串連起來。

pins.title: Urban Street Renovation and Flyover
pins.description:
A kapok-shaped flyover and three new street styles give walkers room in a busy district.

Guangzhou, China | Flyover and street | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市街道改造與天橋設計
zh-Hant.description:
一座木棉造型的天橋與三種新街道風格，為繁忙地區的行人留出空間。

中國廣州｜天橋與街道｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial render of the diamond-shaped flyover and its central spire.
菱形天橋與中央尖塔的鳥瞰渲染圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Busy roads in the Tianhe District cut the area apart and leave walkers with little room to stop. The streets also lack a clear local character.
captions: Analysis of traffic flow at the junction.
Activities the flyover should hold.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 天河區繁忙的道路把地區切割開來，行人幾乎沒有停留的空間。街道也缺少鮮明的在地特色。
captions: 路口交通流線分析。
天橋需要容納的活動分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The plan starts from a diamond that follows the edges of the road. It then takes the petals of the kapok, the city flower, as its shape.
captions: Steps of the plane generation.
Steps of the form development.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 平面從一個貼合道路邊緣的菱形開始。接著以市花木棉的花瓣作為形態。
captions: 平面生成的步驟。
形體推演的步驟。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: An outer ring keeps walkers moving while an inner ring gives them places to stay and rest. A central spire holds the deck and links it to the skyline of the district.
captions: Exploded view of the flyover.
Section through the flyover.
General layout at the junction.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 外環讓行人順暢通行，內環則提供停留與休息的地方。中央尖塔拉起橋面，並與地區的天際線呼應。
captions: 天橋的分層爆炸圖。
穿過天橋的剖面。
路口的總平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Below the flyover, the old roads are moved and planted to make streets for walking. Three street styles, classical garden, local flower and future frame, give each part its own feel.
captions: Plan of the renovated street.
Three street styles.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在天橋下方，舊道路被調整並加以綠化，成為適合步行的街道。古典園林、在地花卉與未來框架三種街道風格，讓每一段都有自己的氛圍。
captions: 改造後街道的平面。
三種街道風格。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Trace how people move.
2. Find a local symbol.
3. Separate passing from staying.
4. Give each street a theme.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 追蹤人們如何移動。
2. 找出在地的象徵。
3. 區分通行與停留。
4. 為每條街道設定主題。

pins.title: Residential in Green Space
pins.description:
Stepped green housing offers affordable homes to people who move to the city for work.

Shenzhen, China | Housing | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 綠色空間中的住宅
zh-Hant.description:
層層退台的綠色住宅，為到城市工作的人提供負擔得起的家。

中國深圳｜住宅｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Layers of the green roof over the housing blocks.
住宅群上方綠色屋頂的分層圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Many people who move to Shenzhen for work cannot afford homes in the city centre. Low-income families, new graduates, people looking for work and people with disabilities all need a place to live.
captions: Building program and links to the city.
Ways to combine buildings with green space.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 許多到深圳工作的人負擔不起市中心的住房。低收入家庭、應屆畢業生、正在求職的人與行動不便者都需要一個安身之處。
captions: 建築計畫與城市的連結。
建築與綠地結合的方式。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Green space and buildings in the city are often kept apart. The project tests balconies, roof gardens, courtyards and green walls as ways to bring them together.
captions: Steps of the block generation.
Apartment types and the functional partition.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 城市中的綠地與建築往往彼此分離。本案測試陽台、屋頂花園、庭院與綠牆，作為讓兩者結合的方法。
captions: 量體生成的步驟。
各種戶型與功能分區。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The blocks are divided by function and stepped so that ramps and green terraces run through them. Several apartment types serve the different groups of residents.
captions: Standard floor plans of the two blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 量體依功能劃分並層層退台，讓坡道與綠色平台貫穿其中。多種戶型對應不同的居民群體。
captions: 兩棟住宅的標準層平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Solar panels, sun visors, green roofs and vertical planting help lower the energy use of the homes. Ramps let residents with disabilities walk through the whole building.
captions: Solar panel and building section model.
Roof structure, sun visor and wetland section.
Vertical greening model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 太陽能板、遮陽板、綠色屋頂與垂直綠化幫助降低住宅的能耗。坡道讓行動不便的居民也能走遍整棟建築。
captions: 太陽能板與建築剖面模型。
屋頂構造、遮陽板與濕地剖面。
垂直綠化模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name who will live there.
2. List what each group needs.
3. Weave green space into the blocks.
4. Detail the green systems.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 說出誰會住在這裡。
2. 列出各群體的需求。
3. 把綠地編織進量體。
4. 深化綠色系統的細部。

pins.title: The City Dehumidifier
pins.description:
A stepped building on a slope cools and dries the air through ground pipes and plant roots.

Xiangtan, China | Wellness building | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市除濕機
zh-Hant.description:
一座沿坡地退台的建築，透過地下管道與植物根系為空氣降溫除濕。

中國湘潭｜養生建築｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of the building with its timber grille.
帶有木格柵的建築模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the humid south of China, many people feel that damp air weighs on the body. The project asks whether a building itself can work as a dehumidifier.
captions: Moist wind comes in and dry air flows out.
Prototype spaces drawn from verbs for each kind of damp.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在潮濕的中國南方，許多人覺得濕氣會加重身體的負擔。本案探問建築本身能否像除濕機一樣運作。
captions: 潮濕的風進入，乾燥的空氣流出。
從對應各種濕氣的動詞推演出的原型空間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Local habits for removing damp were grouped into four ways: sweating in a sauna, massage, exercise and diet. Each way became one type of space for its own group of users.
captions: Model perspective and summer and winter sun study.
Section model showing the paths of the air.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 在地祛濕的習慣被歸納為四種方式：桑拿出汗、按摩、運動與飲食。每一種方式都成為一類空間，服務各自的使用者。
captions: 模型透視與夏冬日照分析。
呈現空氣路徑的剖面模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Outside air is first drawn through pipes in the ground, where it cools and loses water. It then passes a layer of plant aerial roots, which take up more of the moisture.
captions: Floor plans from the ground floor up.
Sections A and B across the sloping site.
Exploded view of the four kinds of space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 室外空氣先被引入地下管道，在其中降溫並除去水分。接著空氣通過植物氣根層，進一步吸收濕氣。
captions: 由地面層往上的各層平面。
橫跨坡地的A、B剖面。
四類空間的爆炸圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The building steps up the slope, so visitors pass the four kinds of space in turn along one route. Wall and roof details show how the grilles, green roof and root layer handle the air.
captions: Detailed vertical section of the pool wall.
Wall section with the aerial-root layer.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 建築沿坡地層層升起，訪客沿著一條動線依序經過四類空間。牆身與屋頂的細部說明格柵、綠屋頂與氣根層如何處理空氣。
captions: 池畔牆身的詳細剖面。
帶有氣根層的牆身剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a feeling in the body.
2. Study the local ways of easing it.
3. Turn each way into a space.
4. Let the section carry the air.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從身體的感受出發。
2. 研究在地的舒緩方式。
3. 把每種方式轉為空間。
4. 讓剖面承載空氣的流動。

pins.title: Listening to the Sound
pins.description:
A noisy green square in the city becomes a quiet place for five groups of users.

Guangzhou, China | Public square | 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 聆聽聲音
zh-Hant.description:
城市中一處嘈雜的綠色廣場，成為五類使用者的安靜去處。

中國廣州｜公共廣場｜2019｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the square and its activity zones.
廣場與各活動區的鳥瞰圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is a green square in busy central Guangzhou, with many trees but little to do. Noise from the roads around it also keeps people from staying.
captions: Noise levels from the roads around the site.
Survey of five groups of users on the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是廣州繁忙市中心的一處綠色廣場，樹木很多，卻少有可以做的事。周邊道路的噪音也讓人們不願停留。
captions: 周邊道路的噪音分布。
基地上五類使用者的調查。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The survey found five main groups of users, from office workers to local residents and people without stable homes. A shared management system links shops, studios, a museum and housing to keep the square alive over time.
captions: Management system that ties the uses together.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 調查找出五類主要使用者，從上班族、在地居民到沒有穩定住處的人。一套共同的管理系統串連商店、工作室、博物館與住宿，讓廣場長久保持活力。
captions: 串連各種用途的管理系統。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The routes were redrawn into curving paths that open a large central space among the trees. Small activity modules give each group of users a place to play, rest or perform.
captions: Masterplan of the square.
From the original routes to the refined design.
Activity modules for the five groups of users.
Eight scenes the central square can host.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 動線被重新繪製成彎曲的路徑，在樹林中打開一處大型中央空間。小型活動模組讓每一類使用者都有遊戲、休息或表演的地方。
captions: 廣場總平面圖。
從原有動線到深化設計。
對應五類使用者的活動模組。
中央廣場可容納的八種場景。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Buildings on the edge use green walls, laminated glass and soundproof walls to block the noise of the city. The central museum is cut open in section so that air and light move through it.
captions: Green wall sections of the edge buildings.
Section of the central museum.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 邊界建築以綠牆、夾層玻璃與隔音牆阻擋城市噪音。中央博物館在剖面上被打開，讓空氣與光線貫穿其中。
captions: 邊界建築的綠牆剖面。
中央博物館剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Listen to the site first.
2. Find who already uses it.
3. Give each group a place.
4. Use green to soften the noise.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先聆聽基地。
2. 找出已在使用它的人。
3. 為每個群體安排位置。
4. 以綠意緩和噪音。

pins.title: Signals of the Heart
pins.description:
Five themed spaces turn a meeting between strangers into a slow route of finding each other.

Guangzhou, China | Interactive pavilion | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 心的訊號
zh-Hant.description:
五個主題空間，讓陌生人之間的相遇成為一條慢慢找到彼此的路線。

中國廣州｜互動展亭｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The ice-breaking dance space under the glass dome.
玻璃穹頂下的破冰舞蹈空間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In many city parks in China, parents look for partners for their grown children, while young people want to choose love freely. The project looks for a new way to balance the wishes of both sides.
captions: Ramp, glowing pillars and dome in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在中國許多城市公園裡，父母為成年子女尋找對象，而年輕人則希望自由選擇愛情。本案尋找一種平衡雙方期望的新方式。
captions: 坡道、發光柱與穹頂的分層。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Data and field research traced how these meeting customs began and why they still exist. The design turns one meeting into a route of five themed spaces for eight participants.
captions: The wall of memories with pictures and videos.
Concrete frame, steel shelves and acrylic boxes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 透過資料與田野研究，追溯這些相親習俗的起源與至今仍存在的原因。設計把一次相遇轉化為一條由五個主題空間組成、供八位參與者體驗的路線。
captions: 放置照片與影片的記憶之牆。
混凝土框、鋼架與壓克力盒。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: After a dance, participants learn about each other at a wall of boxes and then search for coloured pillars among metal curtains. Each colour stands for one person, so choosing becomes a slow game of finding.
captions: Layers of the choosing device.
Metal curtain and pillars among the trees.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一場舞蹈之後，參與者在盒子之牆前認識彼此，接著在金屬簾幕間尋找彩色光柱。每一種顏色代表一個人，讓選擇成為一場慢慢尋找的遊戲。
captions: 選擇裝置的分層。
樹林中的金屬簾幕與光柱。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Pairs then share a small cinema with quiet spaces for two under the stairs. In a final maze, a phone app signals when two people who chose each other come close.
captions: Stepped cinema space for the pairs.
Roof, frame and membrane of the cinema.
Layers of glass, mirror and concrete in the maze.
The heartbeat maze.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 配對者接著共享一座小型電影院，階梯下設有兩人的安靜空間。在最後的迷宮中，當互相選擇的兩人靠近時，手機應用程式會發出訊號。
captions: 供配對者使用的階梯電影空間。
電影空間的屋頂、框架與膜材。
迷宮中玻璃、鏡面與混凝土的分層。
心跳迷宮。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe a custom closely.
2. Ask why it still lasts.
3. Turn each step into a space.
4. Let materials set the mood.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 仔細觀察一種習俗。
2. 追問它為何延續至今。
3. 把每一步轉為空間。
4. 讓材料營造氛圍。

pins.title: Animal Box
pins.description:
Stacked habitat boxes invite people to meet animals again, with respect.

Guangzhou, China | Exhibition building | 2020 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 動物盒子
zh-Hant.description:
層層堆疊的棲地盒子，邀請人們以尊重重新認識動物。

中國廣州｜展覽建築｜2020｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The Animal Box at night.
夜晚的動物盒子。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Most people know animals only in a simple way, through zoos, school and the internet. The project asks how a building can help people see animals as complex lives that deserve respect.
captions: How people come to know animals.
Sketches of boxes stacked and shifted to make cross views.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 多數人只透過動物園、學校與網路，以簡單的方式認識動物。本案探問建築如何幫助人們把動物看作值得尊重的複雜生命。
captions: 人們認識動物的途徑。
堆疊錯位的盒子形成交錯視野的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each animal habitat is set out as a box with its own sound, light, terrain and humidity. Some boxes use virtual reality, while others offer real experiences such as a bat cave or a snake maze.
captions: Arrangement of the virtual and real systems.
Expected scenes inside the animal boxes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每一種動物棲地都被設定為一個盒子，各有其聲音、光線、地形與濕度。有些盒子使用虛擬實境，另一些則提供蝙蝠洞或蛇迷宮等真實體驗。
captions: 虛擬與真實系統的配置。
動物盒子內預期的場景。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The boxes are grouped into virtual reality, real experience, education and office areas around a central core. A few times a month, a blind box day opens rooms whose content visitors do not know in advance.
captions: Functional areas of the building.
Interior on a blind box day.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 盒子被分為虛擬實境、真實體驗、教育展示與行政四區，環繞中央核心配置。每月數次的盲盒日，會開放訪客事先不知道內容的房間。
captions: 建築的各功能分區。
盲盒日的室內場景。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The section shows how the boxes of different heights stack around stairs and open floors. Visitors move from habitat to habitat and meet each animal in its own setting.
captions: Long section through the boxes.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖面呈現不同高度的盒子如何圍繞樓梯與開放樓層堆疊。訪客從一處棲地走到另一處，在各自的環境中與每一種動物相遇。
captions: 穿越各盒子的長剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Question what people think they know.
2. Give each subject its own box.
3. Set the senses for every box.
4. Stack the boxes into a route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 質疑人們自以為知道的事。
2. 為每個對象設一個盒子。
3. 為每個盒子設定感官條件。
4. 把盒子堆疊成一條路線。

pins.title: The Bridging
pins.description:
Light new units bridge over an old block so new and old neighbours can stay together.

Guangzhou, China | Community renewal | 2019 | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 橋接
zh-Hant.description:
輕量的新單元跨越舊街區，讓新舊鄰里得以共同生活。

中國廣州｜社區更新｜2019｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The new units laid over the old blocks.
新單元疊置於舊街區之上。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Large-scale demolition of old city blocks pushes residents out and breaks long-standing community life. The project asks whether a gentler, embedded way of renewal can let new and old communities live together.
captions: First sketch of units bridging the old houses.
Model of two stacked units.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 舊城街區的大規模拆除迫使居民離開，也打斷了長久以來的社區生活。本案探問一種更溫和的嵌入式更新，能否讓新舊社區共同生活。
captions: 新單元跨越舊屋的初步草圖。
兩層疊置單元的模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The survey traces how open space in the courtyard houses shrank over time as land prices rose. The narrow tube houses that remain were then catalogued as a set of types.
captions: Courtyard houses and their shrinking open space.
Survey of existing house types.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 調查追溯合院住宅的開放空間如何隨地價上漲而逐漸縮減。留存下來的狹長竹筒屋被整理成一組類型。
captions: 合院住宅與逐漸縮減的開放空間。
既有住宅類型調查。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Light modules are set on top of retained structures, with a shared middle layer for public activities. Youth apartments sit above, while original residents keep their homes below.
captions: Steps of the embedding strategy.
Section through the old and new community.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 輕量模組被架設在保留的結構之上，中間層作為公共活動的共享空間。青年公寓位於上方，原有居民則保留下方的住所。
captions: 嵌入策略的步驟。
新舊社區的剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Roof walkways tie the new units together across the block and lead down to an open square. The model shows how the added construction rests lightly on the existing house.
captions: Model detail of the added construction.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂步道將街區中的新單元串連起來，並通往一處開放廣場。模型呈現加建部分如何輕巧地落在既有住宅之上。
captions: 加建部分的模型細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read how the block changed over time.
2. Keep what residents still use.
3. Add light layers instead of clearing.
4. Link the layers with a shared route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀街區隨時間的變化。
2. 保留居民仍在使用的部分。
3. 以輕量層次取代拆除。
4. 用共享路徑連結各層。

pins.title: Another Sustainable
pins.description:
A community building that changes shape as residents earn points for green habits.

Architecture | Community building | Participatory design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 另一種永續
zh-Hant.description:
一座隨居民累積環保點數而改變形態的社區建築。

建築｜社區建築｜參與式設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The community building seen from the square.
從廣場望向社區建築。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Sustainable design is often reduced to technology alone, while the habits of the people using a building are left out. The project asks whether a building can encourage residents to act sustainably themselves.
captions: Site plan of the community building.
Points earned for saving water, saving power and sorting waste.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 永續設計常被簡化為技術問題，使用建築的人的習慣卻被忽略。本案探問建築能否鼓勵居民自己採取永續的行動。
captions: 社區建築的配置圖。
節水、節電與垃圾分類所累積的點數。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Residents earn points on a phone app for everyday green actions, and the community level rises as the points add up. With these points they vote on which functions and forms the building should take.
captions: Illustration of the scheme and its spaces.
Possible forms the building can take.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 居民透過手機應用程式，為日常的環保行動累積點數，社區等級也隨之提升。他們再以這些點數投票，決定建築應有的功能與形式。
captions: 方案及其空間的圖解。
建築可能呈現的各種形式。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Floors are built from modular components that can be rotated, reversed or added as needs change. The plan groups a tea hall, reading, fitness and game rooms around a shared platform.
captions: Assembly and disassembly of the components.
Steps of a transforming floor in the model.
Third floor plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 樓層由可旋轉、翻轉或增加的模組構件組成，以回應不同需求。平面將茶室、閱讀、健身與遊戲空間環繞一處共享平台配置。
captions: 構件的組裝與拆卸。
模型中樓層轉換的步驟。
三樓平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The facade panels unfold, half fold or fold depending on sun and wind, and their pattern follows the residents' votes. The section shows how farm, reading, fitness and public spaces stack around a central core.
captions: Section through the stacked functions.
How votes and weather shape the facade.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 立面板依日照與風況而展開、半折或收合，其圖樣也隨居民的投票而改變。剖面呈現農園、閱讀、健身與公共空間如何圍繞中央核心堆疊。
captions: 穿越堆疊功能的剖面。
投票與天氣如何塑造立面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Treat behaviour as part of sustainability.
2. Turn daily actions into simple rules.
3. Let users vote on the form.
4. Build with parts that can change.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把行為視為永續的一部分。
2. 將日常行動轉為簡單規則。
3. 讓使用者投票決定形式。
4. 用可變的構件來建造。

pins.title: The Rhapsody of Future Office
pins.description:
Robotic arms build and remove rooms inside an open frame, following each worker's space rights.

Guangzhou, China | Office building | Future work | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 未來辦公狂想曲
zh-Hant.description:
機械手臂依每位工作者的空間權利，在開放框架中建造與拆除房間。

中國廣州｜辦公建築｜未來工作｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Section through the office and its customised rooms.
辦公室及其客製房間的剖面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Long working hours have pulled many people's lives apart from their work. The project asks whether a future office can be humane enough that people want to come to work.
captions: The frame filling up as more users arrive.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 長工時讓許多人的生活與工作逐漸脫節。本案探問未來的辦公室能否足夠人性化，讓人們願意前來工作。
captions: 隨使用者增加而逐漸填滿的框架。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each person has a set right to space for working, furniture and shared use. These rights become the rules that decide how large each office can grow.
captions: Rules for personal, furniture and public space.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每個人都擁有一定的工作、家具與公共空間使用權。這些權利成為決定每間辦公室能擴展多大的規則。
captions: 個人、家具與公共空間的規則。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Inside an open steel frame, robotic arms pick components, stretch floor slabs and close each room to suit the program. Before a room is made, users can preview it in a virtual view and decide whether to build it.
captions: Steps of room generation.
Previewing a room before it is built.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在開放的鋼構框架中，機械手臂挑選構件、延展樓板，並依需求圍合出每個房間。房間生成之前，使用者可先在虛擬畫面中預覽，再決定是否建造。
captions: 房間生成的步驟。
建造前預覽房間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each zone has two robotic arms that work along set tracks to make and remove rooms. Offices, a lobby, a bar, a restaurant and a fitness room share one changing frame.
captions: Robotic arm zones in the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每個分區配有兩支機械手臂，沿既定軌道建造與拆除房間。辦公室、大廳、酒吧、餐廳與健身房共享同一個可變的框架。
captions: 框架中的機械手臂分區。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from how people feel at work.
2. Write space rights as rules.
3. Let the frame stay, and rooms change.
4. Preview before you build.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從人們工作時的感受出發。
2. 把空間權利寫成規則。
3. 框架固定，房間可變。
4. 先預覽，再建造。

pins.title: Family Unit
pins.description:
Folding living units slot into idle city spaces as a new kind of council house.

London, United Kingdom | Council housing | Modular design | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 家庭單元
zh-Hant.description:
可折疊的居住單元嵌入城市閒置空間，成為新型公共住宅。

英國倫敦｜公共住宅｜模組化設計｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Exploded section of the family unit.
家庭單元的爆炸剖面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In a dense, high-priced city, council housing is slow to build and costly to rent. The project looks for a new type of council house that fits into narrow and rarely used spaces.
captions: Traditional and new council houses compared.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在高密度、高房價的城市中，公共住宅興建緩慢且租金昂貴。本案尋找一種能嵌入狹窄或少用空間的新型公共住宅。
captions: 傳統與新型公共住宅的比較。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Idle plots in the city were sorted by shape into rectangles, trapezoids and triangles. A scheme was then drawn for each shape, with standard and ground floor plans.
captions: Three schemes for different idle spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 城市中的閒置地塊依形狀被分為矩形、梯形與三角形。再針對每種形狀繪製方案，包含標準層與地面層平面。
captions: 針對不同閒置空間的三種方案。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each living unit folds like a small tent and stretches down when in use, with a shared living room below. Units are made in a standard set that fits on a medium truck and is spliced together on site.
captions: How the units are moved and assembled.
Model of a unit unfolding.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每個居住單元像小帳篷一樣折疊，使用時向下展開，下方則是共享客廳。單元以標準組件製作，可裝上中型貨車，並在現場拼接。
captions: 單元的運輸與組裝方式。
單元展開的模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The structure goes up first and the units are then hung inside, which saves time and cost. Louvres and rain shields fold with the weather to keep air moving and rain out.
captions: Construction details of the unit.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 先建立結構，再將單元吊掛其中，節省時間與成本。百葉與遮雨板隨天氣折疊，保持通風並阻擋雨水。
captions: 單元的構造細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find the spaces the city leaves idle.
2. Sort them by shape.
3. Design one kit that fits many shapes.
4. Plan how it travels and assembles.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出城市閒置的空間。
2. 依形狀加以分類。
3. 設計一套適用多種形狀的組件。
4. 規劃其運輸與組裝方式。

pins.title: Bridge: Renewing the Fengqing Community
pins.description:
A light new layer above old houses joins young newcomers and long-time residents.

Guangzhou, China | Community renewal | Housing | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 橋：鳳慶社區的更新
zh-Hant.description:
在老屋之上加建輕量層體，連接年輕新住民與原有居民。

中國廣州｜社區更新｜住宅｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the renewed community.
更新後社區的鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: An old community in the historic core of Guangzhou faces an ageing population, ageing houses and many empty homes. Large demolition and rebuilding would erase its history, so the project looks for a gentler way to renew it.
captions: Site status of planning, ownership, height and protection.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州歷史城區中的一個老社區，面臨人口老化、房屋老舊與空置率高的問題。大規模拆除重建會抹去其歷史，因此本案尋找一種更溫和的更新方式。
captions: 規劃、權屬、層數與保護狀態的現況分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each plot was mapped by planning status, land ownership, storey count and protection level. The local tube house type, long and narrow with small courtyards, was studied in section as the base unit.
captions: Sections of the tube house and the new residential building.
Steps for layering and joining the communities.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每塊基地依規劃狀態、土地權屬、樓層數與保護等級逐一標記。並以剖面研究在地狹長、帶小天井的竹筒屋，作為基本單元。
captions: 竹筒屋與新住宅的剖面。
社區分層與整合的步驟。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: New homes and offices for young people are built as a light layer above the old houses, keeping the original structure below. Standard module units for living, work and shared use are joined by simple nodes.
captions: Concept steps for the residential and office buildings.
Floor plans of a residential building.
Module units and their structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 為年輕人設計的新住宅與辦公空間，以輕量層體建於老屋之上，保留下方原有結構。居住、工作與共享用途的標準模組，以簡單節點相互連接。
captions: 住宅與辦公建築的概念步驟。
住宅建築的各層平面。
模組單元與其構造。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A shared upper level links the new and old communities with landscape spaces for rest, shelter and meeting. Over time the new layer grows step by step until the two communities blend into one.
captions: Landscape elements drawn from local street life.
Future growth of the community in stages.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 共享的上層空間以休憩、遮蔽與交流的景觀場所連接新舊社區。隨時間推移，新的層體逐步生長，直到兩個社區融為一體。
captions: 取自在地街道生活的景觀元素。
社區未來的分階段生長。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the site plot by plot.
2. Study the local house type in section.
3. Add a light layer that keeps the old below.
4. Plan growth in stages.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 逐塊記錄基地現況。
2. 以剖面研究在地屋型。
3. 加上保留老屋的輕量層體。
4. 分階段規劃生長。

pins.title: Cantonese Opera Street Museum
pins.description:
A path of open stages brings Cantonese opera back into the streets of the old town.

Guangzhou, China | Museum | Cultural heritage | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 粵劇街道博物館
zh-Hant.description:
一條開放舞台的路徑，讓粵劇重回老城的街道。

中國廣州｜博物館｜文化遺產｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial drawing of the opera street by the river.
河畔戲曲街道的鳥瞰圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The existing opera museum stands closed off inside its block and feels apart from the old town around it. The project asks how Cantonese opera could return to the daily life of the streets.
captions: Site analysis of texture, height, green and roads.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 現有的戲曲博物館在街區中自成一體，與周邊老城區顯得疏離。本案探問粵劇如何重新回到街道的日常生活之中。
captions: 肌理、高度、綠化與道路的基地分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Staff, residents, visitors and performers were studied to see how each group meets the opera. Four kinds of stage were compared for sound, light, sight lines and comfort.
captions: Development of four stage forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究工作人員、居民、遊客與演員，了解各群體如何接觸戲曲。並比較四種舞台在聲音、光線、視線與舒適度上的表現。
captions: 四種舞台形式的推演。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A path of open stages winds from the river through the old blocks to the museum. Each of four theme areas ties the opera to a different part of the city, from the river to city life.
captions: The four theme areas at night.
First floor plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一條由開放舞台串成的路徑，從河岸穿過老街區通往博物館。四個主題區各自將戲曲連結到城市的不同部分，從河流到城市生活。
captions: 夜間的四個主題區。
一層平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Light is brought into the halls through roof joints, studied in sections and a physical model. The facade details show how the new building meets the brick fabric of the old town.
captions: Light analysis sections.
Physical model of the lighting construction.
Partial facade and wall section.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 光線透過屋頂接縫引入展廳，並以剖面與實體模型加以研究。立面細部說明新建築如何與老城的磚造肌理相接。
captions: 光線分析剖面。
採光構造的實體模型。
局部立面與牆身剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask who meets the culture today.
2. Compare stage types side by side.
3. Link stages into one city path.
4. Test light with a real model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 探問今天誰接觸這項文化。
2. 並列比較各種舞台類型。
3. 將舞台串成一條城市路徑。
4. 以實體模型測試光線。

pins.title: Spatial Experiment: Gradient Prototype
pins.description:
Model studies turn density into a tower that shifts from closed to open.

Studio study | Model study | Spatial experiment | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 空間實驗：漸變原型
zh-Hant.description:
以模型研究將密度轉化為由封閉漸變為開放的塔。

設計課研究｜模型研究｜空間實驗｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Fifty test models of tall buildings.
五十個高層建築測試模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: We often notice only what we can see and miss the parts of a space that we cannot. The project explores concentration and density through a series of diagrams and models.
captions: Four ways of joining parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 我們常只注意看得見的部分，而忽略空間中看不見的部分。本案透過一系列圖解與模型，探索集中度與密度。
captions: 四種構件的接合方式。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Fifty tall building models were made first to test how a building looks from outside. Simple actions such as inlay, join, hook and collect were then used to build new models.
captions: Models A to D.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 首先製作五十個高層建築模型，測試建築的外在形貌。再以嵌入、接合、勾掛與聚集等簡單動作建構新的模型。
captions: 模型 A 至 D。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each model was rebuilt as a second version that stacks floors of changing density. Openings grow from closed rooms at the base to open space at the top.
captions: Second versions of the four models.
Plans showing the change in opening degree.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每個模型再發展為第二版本，以密度漸變的樓層堆疊而成。開口由底部封閉的房間，逐漸過渡到頂部的開放空間。
captions: 四個模型的第二版本。
開口程度漸變的平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A final concept model joins the studies into one tower with a soft, blurred edge. Its arches and frames move from public space at the bottom to private space at the top.
captions: Combined concept model.
Close views of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終概念模型將各項研究整合為一座邊界模糊的塔。其拱與框架由底部的公共空間過渡到頂部的私密空間。
captions: 整合概念模型。
模型近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Make many quick models.
2. Name a few simple actions.
3. Rebuild each model as a gradient.
4. Join the best into one.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 快速製作大量模型。
2. 定義幾個簡單動作。
3. 將每個模型重建為漸變。
4. 將最佳者整合為一。

pins.title: Period of Solidification
pins.description:
A printed vase cut into slices becomes columns that give time a form.

Studio study | Concept design | 3D printing | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 凝固期
zh-Hant.description:
將列印的花瓶切片重組成柱體，為時間賦予形體。

設計課研究｜概念設計｜3D 列印｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Render of a hall of reassembled columns.
重組柱體構成的大廳渲染。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Time is everywhere in daily life, yet it is hard to explain what it is. The project tries to give this abstract idea a form through 3D printed models and space.
captions: Circle slices of different sizes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 時間存在於日常生活的每個角落，卻很難說清它是什麼。本案嘗試透過 3D 列印模型與空間，為這個抽象概念賦予形體。
captions: 不同大小的圓形切片。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Ideas of time from several thinkers were read as the starting point. One view, that a life is made of many moments, led to the idea of a column made of slices.
captions: A 3D printed vase model.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以多位思想家對時間的看法作為出發點。其中一種觀點認為人生由許多片刻構成，由此發展出由切片組成柱體的想法。
captions: 3D 列印的花瓶模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A printed vase was cut into slices and the pieces were stacked again by hand in new orders. Each new column keeps the same material but takes a different shape.
captions: Stacking the slices again by hand.
Column variants from the same slices.
One reassembled column.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 將列印的花瓶切成薄片，再以手工依新的順序重新堆疊。每根新柱體材料不變，形狀卻各不相同。
captions: 以手工重新堆疊切片。
由相同切片組成的各式柱體。
一根重組後的柱體。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The columns are set out as a field that people can walk through at full scale. The space suggests that time is only a period of solidification between city and nature.
captions: Render of the column field.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這些柱體以實際尺度排列成可供穿行的柱林。空間暗示時間只是城市與自然之間的一段凝固期。
captions: 柱林的渲染。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick an abstract idea.
2. Read a few views on it.
3. Make it into one simple object.
4. Scale the object up to space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選定一個抽象概念。
2. 閱讀關於它的幾種觀點。
3. 將其轉化為一個簡單物件。
4. 把物件放大成空間。

pins.title: Reinventing Shape and Spontaneous Growth
pins.description:
Small spaces drawn from three case studies stack into a parasitic architecture for an urban village.

Guangzhou | Parasitic architecture | Urban village | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重塑形態與自發生長
zh-Hant.description:
由三個案例提取的小空間，堆疊成城中村的寄生建築。

廣州｜寄生建築｜城中村｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Timber model of the parasitic cluster.
寄生建築群的木構模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Urban villages near the university town grow on their own, with small rooms and shops added wherever space allows. The project asks how a parasitic architecture could grow from small spaces into a construction mode.
captions: Detail of the parasitic model.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 大學城周邊的城中村自發生長，小房間與店鋪在任何可用空間中不斷加建。本案探討寄生建築如何從小空間出發，發展成一種建造模式。
captions: 寄生模型細部。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Three case study buildings were read through writing, critical observation, collage and physical models. The space script of one house was turned into a sequence of section models.
captions: Section models from the case study house.
Site sections of the village.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以寫作、批判性觀察、拼貼與實體模型解讀三個案例建築。其中一棟住宅的空間腳本被轉化為一系列剖面模型。
captions: 案例住宅的剖面模型。
村落的基地剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The three cases were broken down into structural types that could be stacked in the village. Their sections were then varied by size, opening and slope into many small space forms.
captions: Structure types drawn from the three cases.
Matrix of small space forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 將三個案例拆解為可在村中堆疊的結構類型。再依尺寸、開口與坡度變化其剖面，衍生出大量小空間形態。
captions: 由三個案例提取的結構類型。
小空間形態矩陣。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Selected forms became small rooms ranked from private to public, each drawn in plan and section. Stacked together in the timber model, they show how the cluster could keep growing over time.
captions: Small rooms drawn in plan, section and axonometric.
More small rooms ranked by privacy.
The full timber model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 選出的形態成為由私密到公共分級的小房間，各自繪製平面與剖面。在木構模型中層層堆疊，呈現建築群如何隨時間持續生長。
captions: 以平面、剖面與軸測繪製的小房間。
依私密程度分級的更多小房間。
完整的木構模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read a few cases in many ways.
2. Pull out their spatial types.
3. Vary them into a family of forms.
4. Test the forms in a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 以多種方式解讀幾個案例。
2. 提取其空間類型。
3. 變化出一系列形態。
4. 在模型中測試這些形態。

pins.title: Line Offset Pop-up Shop
pins.description:
Offset boxes of different sizes turn a busy square into a pop-up shop to wander through.

Guangzhou | Pop-up shop | Experience space | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 線性偏移快閃店
zh-Hant.description:
不同尺寸的偏移量體，將繁忙廣場轉化為可漫遊的快閃店。

廣州｜快閃店｜體驗空間｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Axonometric of the pop-up shop in the business district.
快閃店位於商業區中的軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site sits in a busy square of the city's business district, where many people pass through every day. The project asks how a pop-up shop could turn this flow into a space to walk, pause and gather.
captions: Paper study models.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地位於城市商業區一處繁忙廣場，每天有大量人流經過。本案探討快閃店如何將這股人流轉化為可行走、停留與聚集的空間。
captions: 紙模型研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Paper models and parti diagrams tested how rectangular boxes of different sizes could slide and offset. Line studies then traced how a route could wind between open and narrow, dark and bright.
captions: Parti diagrams of the offset boxes.
Line studies from the conception phase.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以紙模型與構想圖測試不同尺寸的矩形量體如何滑移與偏移。再以線條研究描繪路徑如何在開闊與狹窄、明與暗之間迂迴。
captions: 偏移量體的構想圖。
構思階段的線條研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Habits such as taking shortcuts, following others and avoiding crowds shaped the plan. A central space holds meetings, parties and talks, while smaller rooms offer screening, rest, reading and snacks.
captions: Behaviour patterns of visitors.
Uses of the central main space.
Smaller experience rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 抄捷徑、跟隨他人與避開人群等行為習慣形塑了平面。中央空間容納聚會、派對與講座，較小的房間則提供放映、休息、閱讀與點心。
captions: 訪客的行為模式。
中央主空間的使用方式。
較小的體驗房間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each box was set out with its own route, enclosure, interface and material, from mirror to perforated metal and glass. Stacked together, the boxes form a light and layered shop that changes as people move through it.
captions: Exploded view of the boxes.
Matrix of routes, interfaces and materials.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每個量體各自設定路徑、圍合、介面與材料，從鏡面到穿孔金屬與玻璃。量體堆疊後構成輕盈而多層次的店舖，隨人們穿行而變化。
captions: 量體爆炸圖。
路徑、介面與材料矩陣。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch how people move on site.
2. Test simple boxes in paper.
3. Give each box one use.
4. Set a material for each box.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察人們在基地中的移動。
2. 以紙模型測試簡單量體。
3. 為每個量體指定一種用途。
4. 為每個量體選定材料。

pins.title: Recore: Textile District Renewal
pins.description:
An old textile district keeps its factory roofs and grows new markets, parks and halls beneath them.

Xi'an | Urban renewal | Industrial heritage | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: Recore：紡織區更新
zh-Hant.description:
老紡織區保留廠房屋頂，在其下生長出新的市集、公園與展館。

西安｜城市更新｜工業遺產｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Axonometrics of the phased development.
分期開發的軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The textile district grew around large old factories that were later left empty and cut off from the city. The project asks how the district could keep its industrial memory while bringing back jobs and daily life.
captions: Urban texture across four periods.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這片紡織區圍繞大型老工廠發展，後來工廠閒置，與城市脫節。本案探討如何在保留工業記憶的同時，為片區重新帶回工作機會與日常生活。
captions: 四個時期的城市肌理。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Maps of the urban texture showed how the factory blocks broke the street grid over time. A masterplan then linked the old buildings with new uses along a green spine.
captions: Masterplan with the proposed typology.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 城市肌理分析顯示工廠街廓如何隨時間切斷街道網絡。總體規劃再以一條綠色軸線，將舊建築與新功能串連起來。
captions: 配置新類型的總體規劃。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The roof of the main factory is kept as the memory of the city, while the space under it is split into smaller streets. Each old building was tested with moves such as cutting, adding and opening to the street.
captions: Form concept for the factory roof.
Strategies for the existing buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 主廠房的屋頂作為城市記憶被保留，其下空間則被切分為較小的街道。每棟舊建築都以切割、加建與向街道開放等手法進行測試。
captions: 廠房屋頂的形態概念。
既有建築的改造策略。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The renewal grows in three phases, from markets and a park to a mall, theatre and research centre. Layered by function, the new programs sit on top of the old factory as one walkable whole.
captions: Exploded view of the functions.
Program analysis of the main building.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 更新分三期展開，從市集與公園到商場、劇場與研究中心。新功能依類別分層疊加在舊廠房之上，形成可步行的整體。
captions: 功能分層爆炸圖。
主建築的機能分析。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map the texture over time.
2. Find what memory to keep.
3. Test simple moves on each building.
4. Phase the change.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 繪製不同時期的肌理。
2. 找出要保留的記憶。
3. 對每棟建築測試簡單手法。
4. 分期推動改變。

pins.title: Entropy: A Folding Market
pins.description:
Folding stalls let a periodic market grow on market days and fold away the rest of the week.

Xi'an | Market design | Temporary structure | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 熵：可折疊的市集
zh-Hant.description:
可折疊的攤位讓定期市集在趕集日展開，其餘時間收合。

西安｜市集設計｜臨時構築｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Bird's-eye view of the market on a weekend.
週末市集的鳥瞰圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A periodic country market gathers crowds of traders on market days but leaves a large empty ground the rest of the week. The project asks how one site could hold both the busy market and quieter weekday uses.
captions: Section of the market and its sheds.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 定期的鄉間市集在趕集日聚集大量商販，其餘時間卻留下一大片空地。本案探討同一基地如何同時容納熱鬧的市集與平日較安靜的使用。
captions: 市集與棚架的剖面示意。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Drawings of how traders bargain and agree on a price showed the habits that make the market lively. Stall types, trading areas and use over time were then counted to size the new layout.
captions: Drawn panels of trading gestures.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以手繪記錄商販討價還價與成交的方式，呈現讓市集充滿活力的習慣。再統計攤位類型、交易面積與時段使用量，作為新配置的尺度依據。
captions: 交易手勢的手繪分格。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A family of folding stalls was designed that open into shops on market days and fold back into walls or benches. A shared tree stall and loose modules can also turn into tables and seats.
captions: Stall modules opening step by step.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計一系列可折疊的攤位，趕集日展開成店舖，平日收合成牆或長椅。樹下的共享攤位與可自由組合的模組，也能轉變為桌椅。
captions: 逐步展開的攤位模組。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: On weekdays the same ground stays open for other activities, with ramps and a footbridge tying it to the street. The market can grow and shrink each week, so the site is never fully empty.
captions: Bird's-eye view of the site on a weekday.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 平日同一片場地開放給其他活動使用，坡道與天橋將其連接到街道。市集可每週擴張與收縮，讓基地不再完全閒置。
captions: 平日基地的鳥瞰圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch the site on busy and quiet days.
2. Draw how people trade.
3. Design parts that fold away.
4. Show both states.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察基地忙碌與安靜的日子。
2. 描繪人們的交易方式。
3. 設計可收合的構件。
4. 呈現兩種狀態。

pins.title: Spotlight: Courtyard House Opera Theatre
pins.description:
A regional courtyard house is opened up to become a small theatre for local opera.

Chaoshan | Theatre | Vernacular dwelling | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 聚光：合院戲曲劇場
zh-Hant.description:
將地方合院民居打開，轉化為地方戲曲的小劇場。

潮汕｜劇場｜傳統民居｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Natural light entering the reworked house.
自然光進入改造後的民居。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Local opera troupes in the region are shrinking, and the old courtyard houses where people once gathered stand empty. The project asks whether one such house could be turned into a small theatre for the opera.
captions: The courtyard house type of the region.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 地方戲班日漸萎縮，人們過去聚集的老合院也逐漸空置。本案探討能否將這樣一座合院改造成小型戲曲劇場。
captions: 當地的合院民居類型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The house type has four wings around a central court, with deep timber roofs and narrow side lanes. Exploded drawings took the original house apart into roof, frame, walls and plan.
captions: Exploded axonometrics of the original house.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 這種民居以四翼圍合中央天井，配有深遠的木構屋頂與狹窄的側巷。爆炸圖將原有民居拆解為屋頂、構架、牆體與平面。
captions: 原有民居的爆炸軸測圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The roofs were lifted and opened so that light and air can reach a larger hall below. New details join the old timber columns and rafters to rebar and a concrete base.
captions: Section of the transformed house.
Structure details of the new joints.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 將屋頂抬升並開啟，讓光線與空氣進入下方更大的廳堂。新的節點把原有木柱與椽條以鋼筋接合到混凝土基座上。
captions: 改造後民居的剖面。
新節點的構造細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The court becomes an opera stage with a band stage beside it and seats in the wings around it. The section model shows how the old house can hold a full performance and its audience.
captions: Auditorium side of the section model.
Theatre plan drawn over the model base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 天井成為戲台，旁邊設有樂隊台，四周翼房布置觀眾席。剖面模型呈現老民居如何容納一場完整演出與觀眾。
captions: 剖面模型的觀眾席一側。
繪於模型基座上的劇場平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a local building type.
2. Take it apart in drawings.
3. Change one part at a time.
4. Test the new use in a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選定一種在地建築類型。
2. 以圖面將其拆解。
3. 一次改變一個部分。
4. 用模型測試新用途。

pins.title: Micro Reservoir Construction: A Water-Collecting Tower
pins.description:
A high-rise for young residents that collects rainwater, makes power from it and cleans it for reuse.

Shenzhen | Housing | Water and energy | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 微型水庫建造：集水塔樓
zh-Hant.description:
一座為年輕住戶設計的高層建築，收集雨水、以之發電並淨化再利用。

深圳｜住宅｜水與能源｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Elevation of the reservoir tower.
蓄水塔樓立面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Young people in Shenzhen face rising rents and crowded housing, while the city's rivers and reservoirs are polluted. The project asks whether a high-rise for young residents could also collect, clean and reuse water.
captions: Historical development and network maps of the city.
Housing supply and the case for a vertical answer.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳的年輕人面對不斷上漲的租金與擁擠的居住環境，城市的河流與水庫也受到污染。本案探討一座為年輕住戶設計的高層建築，能否同時收集、淨化並再利用水資源。
captions: 城市的歷史發展與路網圖。
住房供給問題與垂直方案的提出。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A timeline traced how people have stored and moved water, from pile dwellings and canals to water mills and dams. These older devices became the starting point for small water systems inside a tower.
captions: From past to present: ways of storing and moving water.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 時間軸梳理了人們儲水與輸水的方式，從干欄式住屋、運河到水車與水壩。這些傳統裝置成為塔樓內部小型水系統的出發點。
captions: 從過去到現在：儲水與輸水的方式。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Rainwater is collected at the top and falls through the units, turning small turbines before it is stored and reused. Grey water and sewage pass through a series of planted ponds that clean it step by step.
captions: Water, power and nutrient cycle through the tower.
Sewage purification mechanism.
Micro power generation from falling water.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 雨水在頂部收集，流經各住宅單元並推動小型渦輪，再被儲存與再利用。灰水與污水則流經一系列植栽池，逐步得到淨化。
captions: 水、電與養分在塔樓中的循環。
污水淨化機制。
以落水發電的微型發電系統。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each unit carries a sloped roof reservoir, shading fins tuned to the sun path and a light frame that holds the water. A timber model tests how the roof, frame and living space fit together.
captions: Unit shape, shading and solar track.
Roof reservoir and hydropower axonometric.
Timber model of one unit.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每個單元配有傾斜的屋頂蓄水池、依日照路徑調整的遮陽板，以及承托水體的輕型構架。木構模型則測試屋頂、構架與居住空間如何組合。
captions: 單元形態、遮陽與日照軌跡。
屋頂蓄水池與水力發電軸測圖。
單一單元的木構模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one local resource.
2. Study how people used it in the past.
3. Draw its full cycle through the building.
4. Test one unit in a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一種在地資源出發。
2. 研究人們過去如何使用它。
3. 畫出它在建築中的完整循環。
4. 以模型測試單一單元。

pins.title: Village in the City: A Street Texture Tower
pins.description:
Small street elements of an urban village are catalogued and rebuilt as the sections of a new tower.

Architecture | Urban village | Street texture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城中村：街道肌理塔樓
zh-Hant.description:
將城中村的小型街道元素整理成圖錄，再重組為一座新塔樓的剖面。

建築｜城中村｜街道肌理｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A drawn streetscape of the urban village.
城中村的街景繪圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The village in the city grew without a master plan, so its order comes from ownership, use and daily needs rather than from design. The project asks how this unplanned order could be read and carried into a new building.
captions: Detail of the streetscape drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 城中村在沒有總體規劃的情況下生長，其秩序來自產權、使用與日常需求，而非設計。本案探討如何解讀這種非規劃的秩序，並將其帶入一座新建築。
captions: 街景繪圖局部。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Stairs, fences, walls, steps and platforms in the village were drawn one by one as small street elements. They were then sorted by depth and openness to show how each one shapes shared space.
captions: Catalogue of street texture elements.
Depth and openness series.
The elements placed back along the village.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 將村中的樓梯、圍欄、牆體、台階與平台逐一繪製為小型街道元素。再依深度與開放度加以分類，說明每一種元素如何塑造共享空間。
captions: 街道肌理元素圖錄。
深度與開放度序列。
將元素放回村落的軸測長卷。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A hand-drawn profile was rotated, folded and spliced to form four sections of a new building. Point and volume studies then grew a porous shell that links levels from ground industry up to a sky greenhouse.
captions: Point, volume and deepen logic.
Axonometric of the tower and its levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 將手繪剖面旋轉、摺疊並拼接，形成新建築的四段剖面。點與體量的研究再生成多孔外殼，串連從地面產業層到空中溫室的各個樓層。
captions: 點、體量與深化的邏輯。
塔樓及其各樓層的軸測圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Study models and scenes test the stacked platforms and stairs inside the tower. A node detail lets rainwater run along the curved shell into a filter, while the same joint carries the weight of each block.
captions: Study models and interior scenes.
Exploded node and its physical model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 研究模型與場景測試塔樓內層疊的平台與樓梯。節點細部讓雨水沿曲面外殼流入過濾器，同一節點也承托每個量體的重量。
captions: 研究模型與室內場景。
節點爆炸圖與實體模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Draw the street as you find it.
2. Pull out its small elements.
3. Sort them by how they shape space.
4. Rebuild them in a new section.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 依現況繪製街道。
2. 抽取其中的小型元素。
3. 依其塑造空間的方式分類。
4. 在新的剖面中重組它們。

pins.title: Shiweitang: Industrial Waterfront Regeneration
pins.description:
An old riverside industrial district is reopened to the city with new uses, repaired streets and waterways.

Guangzhou | Urban regeneration | Industrial waterfront | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 石圍塘：工業水岸再生
zh-Hant.description:
以新功能、修補後的街道與水道，讓舊河岸工業區重新向城市開放。

廣州｜城市再生｜工業水岸｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Masterplan of the site strategy.
基地策略總平面圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The old industrial district of Shiweitang in Guangzhou has fallen out of use, leaving empty works and old rail lines. The project asks how the area could become a living part of the city again without losing its industrial past.
captions: Analysis of history, land use, climate and transport.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州石圍塘的舊工業區已逐漸荒廢，留下空置的廠房與舊鐵道。本案探討如何讓這片地區重新融入城市生活，同時保留其工業記憶。
captions: 歷史、土地使用、氣候與交通分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Maps of land use, transport, green space and building condition showed where the site was cut off and where it could be joined up. A management study then set out how the government, developers and artists could share the cost and the gains.
captions: Management and fund flow among the entities.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 土地使用、交通、綠地與建物現況的分析圖，顯示出基地被切斷之處與可以重新連結之處。管理研究則說明政府、開發商與藝術家如何分擔成本並共享收益。
captions: 各方之間的管理與資金流動。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Five planning concepts were set out, from weaving the site back together to keeping local identity and a sound economy. A hand-drawn concept line followed the river and linked the new uses along it.
captions: Five planning concepts and the programme links.
Concept drawing along the river.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 本案提出五項規劃概念，從重新編織基地到保留在地特色與健全經濟。手繪概念線沿著河道展開，串連沿岸的新功能。
captions: 五項規劃概念與功能關聯。
沿河展開的概念草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The masterplan opens the riverbank, repairs the street network and places a museum, a station, parks, homes and technology spaces across the site. Small self-driving boats on the waterways serve as taxis, markets, stages and carriers between the key nodes.
captions: Long section across the site.
Strategy diagrams for water, green space and mobility.
Location table of the new programmes.
Key nodes along the waterways.
Axonometric and section of a reused factory.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 總平面打開河岸、修補街道網絡，並在基地中配置博物館、車站、公園、住宅與科技空間。水道上的小型自動駕駛船隻在各關鍵節點之間擔任水上計程車、市集、舞台與運輸工具。
captions: 橫跨基地的長剖面。
水、綠地與交通的策略圖。
新功能的區位表。
沿水道的關鍵節點。
再利用廠房的軸測圖與剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map what cuts the site off.
2. Set a few clear planning concepts.
3. Work out who pays and who gains.
4. Place each new use on the plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 繪出切斷基地的因素。
2. 訂定幾項清楚的規劃概念。
3. 釐清由誰出資、由誰受益。
4. 將每項新功能落在平面上。

pins.title: Vertical Art Settlement: Designing with Sound
pins.description:
Noise recorded on the site is mapped and turned into the form of an art settlement.

Guangzhou | Art settlement | Sound study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 垂直藝術聚落：以聲音設計
zh-Hant.description:
將基地錄下的噪音繪製成圖，轉化為藝術聚落的形態。

廣州｜藝術聚落｜聲音研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Site models of the settlement.
聚落的基地模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A survey of the site recorded air pressure, terrain, sound and the movement of people, and found that noise was the most serious issue. Sound therefore became the starting point for the design of a vertical art settlement in Guangzhou.
captions: Site survey of air pressure, terrain and sound.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地調查記錄了氣壓、地形、聲音與人流，發現噪音是最嚴重的問題。因此聲音成為廣州一座垂直藝術聚落的設計出發點。
captions: 氣壓、地形與聲音的基地調查。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sounds recorded on the site were turned into data with software and shown as spectrograms. These readings were then joined with hand-drawn lines of how sound spreads across the ground.
captions: Spectrograms of the recorded sound.
Plan composition drawn from the sound.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 將基地錄下的聲音以軟體轉換為數據，並以頻譜圖呈現。再把這些讀數與手繪的聲音傳播線結合起來。
captions: 錄音的頻譜圖。
由聲音推演出的平面構成。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The sound map was split into positive and negative forms, raised into a 3D field and cut into blocks. Virtual lines then moved from the flat plan into three-dimensional routes and volumes.
captions: Layers from sound data to form.
Axonometric steps of the settlement.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 將聲音地圖拆分為正形與負形，抬升為三維場域並切分為量塊。虛擬線條再從平面轉化為立體的路徑與量體。
captions: 從聲音數據到形態的圖層。
聚落的軸測推演步驟。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A set of white site models shows the settlement growing over the terrain as a field of studios and shared spaces. Closer model views test how the work and living parts sit together.
captions: Close views of the models.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一組白色基地模型呈現聚落如何在地形上生長為工作室與共享空間的場域。近距離的模型視角則測試工作與生活部分如何並置。
captions: 模型近照。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Survey the site with all the senses.
2. Pick the strongest issue.
3. Turn it into data and drawings.
4. Build the form from those layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 用各種感官調查基地。
2. 選出最強烈的議題。
3. 將它轉化為數據與圖面。
4. 由這些圖層建構形態。

pins.title: Chaotic Era: A Curving Terraced Settlement
pins.description:
Free curves and layered lines loosen rigid building forms into a terraced settlement.

Architecture | Terraced settlement | Curve study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 混沌時代：曲線層疊聚落
zh-Hant.description:
以自由曲線與層疊線條鬆動僵硬的建築形態，形成層疊的聚落。

建築｜層疊聚落｜曲線研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Layered line collage.
層疊的線條拼貼。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project starts from the idea that people are both emotional and rational beings. A dense collage of lines and marks explores how order and disorder can sit together.
captions: A film poster used as a reference.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品從「人同時是感性與理性的存在」這個想法出發。一幅密集的線條與記號拼貼，探討秩序與混亂如何並存。
captions: 作為參考的電影海報。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Free curves traced from living forms are used to loosen the rigid lines of conventional buildings. A hand sketch tests how these curves can wrap and grow over a built mass.
captions: Sketch of curves growing over a building.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以從生命形態中描摹出的自由曲線，鬆動傳統建築的僵硬線條。一張手繪草圖測試這些曲線如何包覆並生長於建築量體之上。
captions: 曲線生長於建築上的草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A long section sets organic, curving forms against a stepped base and an industrial skyline. It shows complexity and contradiction as a richer choice than a single clear order.
captions: Long section of the curving forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一張長剖面將有機的曲線形態置於階梯式基座與工業天際線之前。它呈現出複雜與矛盾，比單一清晰的秩序更為豐富。
captions: 曲線形態的長剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The renders show a settlement of stacked blocks with terraces, bridges and roof gardens. Paths and green roofs link the levels into one lively, layered place.
captions: View across the terraces.
Aerial view of the settlement.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 渲染圖呈現一座由堆疊量體構成的聚落，配有露台、天橋與屋頂花園。步道與綠屋頂把各層連結成一個生動而多層次的場所。
captions: 橫越露台的視角。
聚落鳥瞰。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a personal idea.
2. Draw it freely as lines.
3. Turn the lines into curves and mass.
4. Test the form in section and views.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從個人的想法出發。
2. 自由地以線條畫出來。
3. 將線條轉化為曲線與量體。
4. 以剖面與視角測試形態。

pins.title: Urbanism of Nature: A Furniture Landscape Tower
pins.description:
Furniture forms are sliced into layers and stacked into a tower of flowing interior landscape.

Architecture | Interior landscape | Furniture study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 自然的都市主義：家具地景塔樓
zh-Hant.description:
將家具形態切分為圖層，堆疊成一座室內地景流動的塔樓。

建築｜室內地景｜家具研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of the tower.
塔樓模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Space and human behaviour shape each other, and furniture decides much of how people eat, rest and meet. The project asks how furniture could be turned into interior space itself.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 空間與人的行為彼此塑造，而家具在很大程度上決定了人們如何用餐、休息與相聚。這個作品探問家具如何能轉化為室內空間本身。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Everyday objects such as a lounge, table, chair, bathtub, sofa, bench and toilet were studied as shared forms. Their profiles were sliced into contour layers so they could become part of a terrain.
captions: Furniture forms sliced into contour layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 躺椅、桌子、椅子、浴缸、沙發、長凳與馬桶等日常物件被當作共通形態加以研究。它們的輪廓被切分為等高層，使其能成為地形的一部分。
captions: 切分為等高層的家具形態。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A basic slope was folded inward to invite conversation, with openings that give vertical circulation. Several layers were combined so the openings also bring in light and air.
captions: Slope, inward flow and access diagrams.
Plans of the layered openings.
Exploded layers of the interior.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一個基本坡面向內折疊以促進交談，並以開口提供垂直動線。多個圖層疊合，使這些開口同時引入光線與空氣。
captions: 坡面、內向動線與可達性圖解。
層疊開口的平面。
室內的分解圖層。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The layers stack into a tower whose floors flow like landscape, shown in section and in interior model views. Laser-cut acrylic and printed models test how the gradient ceilings shape the living space.
captions: Section through the tower.
Interior model views with scale figures.
Acrylic model studies.
Laser-cut acrylic model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這些圖層堆疊成一座樓層如地景般流動的塔樓，以剖面與室內模型視角呈現。雷射切割壓克力與列印模型則測試漸變天花如何塑造居住空間。
captions: 塔樓剖面。
附比例人偶的室內模型視角。
壓克力模型研究。
雷射切割壓克力模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch how the body uses objects.
2. Find the forms objects share.
3. Slice them into layers.
4. Stack the layers into space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察身體如何使用物件。
2. 找出物件共通的形態。
3. 將它們切分為圖層。
4. 把圖層堆疊成空間。

pins.title: Beacon of Hope: A Mobile Modular School
pins.description:
A school of folding timber classrooms that can be taken apart and rebuilt wherever children need it.
