Architecture | Mobile school | Modular timber | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 希望燈塔：可移動的模組化學校
zh-Hant.description:
以摺疊木構教室組成的學校，可拆解並在孩子需要之處重建。

建築｜可移動學校｜模組化木構｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Plan of the modular campus on its slope.
坡地上模組化校園的平面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Children in unstable regions can lose their schools overnight, and rebuilding takes time that education cannot spare. This competition entry asks how a school could be taken apart quickly and put back together wherever it is needed.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 身處不穩定地區的孩子可能一夕之間失去學校，而重建所需的時間是教育無法等待的。這個競圖作品探問，學校能否被快速拆解，並在需要之處重新組立。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site study mapped where pupils walk, gather, shelter and find quiet on the hillside. A circulation spine inspired by a traditional woven pattern was then simplified step by step to free up open ground.
captions: Layout development from spine to open campus.
Solar, heat gain and airflow analysis of one classroom.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地研究描繪了學生在山坡上行走、聚集、避護與獨處的位置。一條取材自傳統編織圖紋的動線主軸隨後被逐步簡化，以釋放更多開放地面。
captions: 從主軸到開放校園的配置推演。
單一教室的日照、得熱與氣流分析。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Paper folding tests turned the woven grid into a window panel that can be closed, half open or fully open. The panels sit in a light timber frame with fabric and board infill above a gabion base of local stone.
captions: Paper folding tests.
Sketches of the foldable window wall.
Structure details of the folding frame.
Material section with timber, fabric, board and stone.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 摺紙測試將編織網格轉化為可全關、半開或全開的窗板。窗板嵌入輕量木構架，以布料與板材填充，下方則是以在地石材構成的石籠基座。
captions: 摺紙測試。
可摺疊窗牆的草圖。
摺疊框架的構造細部。
木材、布料、板材與石材的材料剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each classroom stacks a gabion base, folding window walls, a timber frame and a lifted canopy, all removable for rapid assembly. Sections and a scale model show how the canopy shades shared roof terraces linked by stairs.
captions: Exploded axonometric of one classroom.
Elevation and section across the slope.
Physical model section.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每間教室由石籠基座、摺疊窗牆、木構架與抬升的頂棚堆疊而成，皆可拆卸以便快速組裝。剖面與比例模型呈現頂棚如何為以樓梯相連的共享屋頂平台遮陽。
captions: 單一教室的分解軸測。
橫跨坡地的立面與剖面。
實體模型剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map how children use the site.
2. Abstract a local pattern into a grid.
3. Test the grid by folding paper.
4. Build it as a kit of parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 描繪孩子如何使用基地。
2. 將在地圖紋抽象為網格。
3. 以摺紙測試網格。
4. 把它做成一套構件。

pins.title: Havenopause: A Cave-like Retreat for Menopause
pins.description:
A soft, cave-like retreat that uses enclosure, gentle light and quiet to support women through menopause.

Architecture | Restorative space | Women's health | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: Havenopause：為更年期而設的洞穴休憩所
zh-Hant.description:
以包覆、柔光與寧靜陪伴女性度過更年期的柔軟洞穴休憩所。

建築｜療癒空間｜女性健康｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Elevation of the cave-like retreat.
洞穴般休憩所的立面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Menopause brings physical and emotional changes that are often overlooked or misunderstood. The project asks how architecture could offer a quiet place of calm for women going through this life stage.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 更年期帶來的身心變化常被忽視或誤解。這個作品探問，建築能否為正經歷這個人生階段的女性提供一處平靜之所。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Diagrams map how symptoms rise and fall across three stages, and how reliance on medication has grown. Studies of low-stimulation therapy suggested that enclosure, soft light and muffled sound can ease anxiety and poor sleep.
captions: Symptoms across the three stages.
Medication use and its side effects.
How cave-like qualities answer each need.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 圖解描繪症狀在三個階段中的起伏，以及對藥物依賴的增加。低刺激療法的研究指出，包覆感、柔和光線與減弱的聲響有助於緩解焦慮與失眠。
captions: 三個階段中的症狀分布。
藥物使用及其副作用。
洞穴般特質如何回應各種需求。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Hand-shaped clay models explored enclosure, porosity and flow through touch. Six digital forms, from a listening pod to a grounding garden, were then refined into layered floor plans.
captions: Hand-made clay models.
Six digital concept models.
Floor plans of three levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以手捏塑的黏土模型透過觸感探索包覆、孔隙與流動。從聆聽艙到接地花園的六個數位形體，隨後被深化為層疊的樓層平面。
captions: 手作黏土模型。
六個數位概念模型。
三個樓層的平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The retreat becomes a soft shell on slender tree-like legs, with a spiral stair rising through pockets of shade and light. A perspective section and a white physical model show how enclosed and semi-open rooms offer different degrees of privacy.
captions: Perspective section through two retreats.
White physical model.
Details of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 休憩所成為立於纖細樹狀支柱上的柔軟殼體，螺旋梯穿越明暗交錯的空間向上延伸。透視剖面與白色實體模型呈現封閉與半開放的房間如何提供不同程度的私密性。
captions: 穿越兩座休憩所的透視剖面。
白色實體模型。
模型細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from an overlooked need.
2. Turn research into spatial qualities.
3. Shape those qualities by hand.
4. Refine them into a building.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從被忽視的需求出發。
2. 將研究轉化為空間特質。
3. 用雙手塑造這些特質。
4. 把它們深化成建築。

pins.title: Modular LiveBlock: A Reconfigurable Stage System
pins.description:
A kit of printed joints and timber rods that assembles quickly into stadium, festival and arena stages.

Architecture | Stage system | Discrete assembly | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: Modular LiveBlock：可重組的舞台系統
zh-Hant.description:
以列印接頭與木桿組成的構件系統，可快速組裝成體育場、音樂節與室內場館舞台。

建築｜舞台系統｜離散組裝｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: From factory printing to assembly in a stadium.
從工廠列印到體育場內的組裝。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Touring concerts spend much of their time and budget building and striking stages, and each venue asks for a different set. The project asks whether one kit of reusable parts could serve many kinds of stage.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 巡迴演唱會的大量時間與預算花在搭建與拆除舞台上，而每個場地又需要不同的配置。這個作品探問，能否以一套可重複使用的構件服務多種舞台。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A study of stage history and current touring shows how construction and load-out dominate the production schedule. A role-based study sets out what designers, engineers, technicians and performers each value in a stage.
captions: Time spent on each production phase and growth trends.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 對舞台演變與當代巡演的研究顯示，搭建與撤場佔據了製作時程的大部分。一項以角色為基礎的研究，釐清了設計師、工程師、技術人員與表演者各自重視的舞台面向。
captions: 各製作階段的時間分配與成長趨勢。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: H-shaped joints were 3D printed, tested and redesigned with a carved connection and bolted plates for stability. Small S-scale joints combine into M-scale floors, walls, stairs and columns, which then form L-scale stage spaces.
captions: 3D-printed joint tests.
Redesigned component after structural testing.
Timber model exploration.
S-scale joints with single, double and triple passes.
M-scale floor, wall, stair and column assemblies.
L-scale configurations at human scale.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: H 形接頭經 3D 列印與測試後，改以刻槽接合與螺栓固定板重新設計以提升穩定性。小尺度的 S 級接頭組合成 M 級的樓板、牆、樓梯與柱，再構成 L 級的舞台空間。
captions: 3D 列印接頭測試。
結構測試後重新設計的構件。
木材模型探索。
單、雙、三向穿接的 S 級接頭。
M 級的樓板、牆、樓梯與柱組合。
人體尺度下的 L 級配置。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Parts are printed in a factory, trucked to the venue and assembled by robotic arms into the stage. The same kit forms a stadium stage, an open festival stage and an arena stage viewed from all sides.
captions: Assembled and exploded views of the system.
Stadium, festival and indoor arena configurations.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 構件在工廠列印、以卡車運至場地，再由機械手臂組裝成舞台。同一套構件可組成體育場舞台、開放的音樂節舞台，以及四面觀看的室內場館舞台。
captions: 系統的組合與分解視圖。
體育場、音樂節與室內場館的配置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find where time and cost are lost.
2. Design the smallest joint first.
3. Test it and redesign it.
4. Scale the kit up to whole spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出時間與成本耗損之處。
2. 先設計最小的接頭。
3. 測試並重新設計。
4. 把構件放大成完整空間。

pins.title: Re:Opera: A Pop-up Cantonese Opera Stage
pins.description:
A modular pop-up stage that brings Cantonese opera back into the streets as a walkable garden of scenes.

Guangzhou | Pop-up architecture | Cantonese opera | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: Re:Opera：快閃粵劇舞台
zh-Hant.description:
將粵劇帶回街頭的模組化快閃舞台，化為一座可漫遊的場景庭園。

廣州｜快閃建築｜粵劇｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Bird's-eye view of the pop-up opera garden.
快閃粵劇庭園的鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Cantonese opera has moved from open public settings into enclosed theatres, and fewer young people now come across it by chance. The project proposes a temporary, modular stage that brings the opera back into everyday streets in Guangzhou.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 粵劇已從開放的公共場域移入封閉的劇院，年輕人偶然接觸它的機會也越來越少。這個作品提出一座臨時的模組化舞台，讓粵劇重新回到廣州的日常街道。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Audience data shows a falling and ageing audience, held back by rigid formats, language barriers and little presence in public space. A renewal district by the waterfront was chosen because walking routes from residents and visitors meet there.
captions: Audience trend, age and attendance constraints.
Strategy from fixed stage to pop-up movement.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 觀眾數據顯示觀眾數量下降且日趨高齡，受限於僵化的演出形式、語言門檻與在公共空間中的缺席。基地選在一處水岸更新街區，因為居民與遊客的步行路線在此交會。
captions: 觀眾趨勢、年齡與觀演限制。
從固定舞台到快閃動線的策略。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The scenes of one classic opera were read as a journey from movement to enclosure and finally revelation. Stage stills were translated into spatial sketches, required scenes and four spatial frameworks that guide the massing.
captions: Plot analysis with stage stills as reference.
From storyboard to diagram, sketch and required scene.
Conceptual massing evolution.
Four spatial frameworks with study models.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一齣經典粵劇的場景被解讀為從移動、封閉到最終揭示的旅程。舞台劇照被轉譯為空間草圖、所需場景，以及引導量體配置的四種空間框架。
captions: 以舞台劇照為參考的情節分析。
從分鏡到圖解、草圖與所需場景。
概念量體演變。
四種空間框架與研究模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Six loosely arranged pop-up spaces form a walkable garden where the audience follows the story from scene to scene. Light timber frames allow the stage to be assembled and taken down easily.
captions: Living room and corridor scenes.
Study room scene.
Palace and mansion scenes.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 六個鬆散配置的快閃空間構成一座可漫遊的庭園，觀眾隨著故事在場景之間移動。輕量木構架讓舞台能輕鬆組裝與拆卸。
captions: 客廳與迴廊場景。
書房場景。
宮殿與府邸場景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask why an art form lost its audience.
2. Read the story as a sequence of spaces.
3. Turn each scene into a framework.
4. Place the scenes along a walk.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 探問一種藝術為何失去觀眾。
2. 把故事讀成一連串空間。
3. 將每個場景轉為框架。
4. 沿著步行路線安排場景。

pins.title: Fragmented Self: A Tower of Many Personalities
pins.description:
Six personalities from a film are translated into six spatial fragments and assembled into one tower.

Architecture | Character-based spatial study | Fragmentation | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 破碎的自我：多重人格之塔
zh-Hant.description:
將一部電影中的六種人格轉譯為六個空間碎片，並組裝成一座塔樓。

建築｜角色空間研究｜碎片化｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Axonometric of the tower inside its mesh skin.
包覆於網狀表皮中的塔樓軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A single person can hold several conflicting identities at once, yet buildings usually assume one coherent user. The project asks how a fragmented mind could be translated into one inhabitable tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一個人可能同時擁有數種相互衝突的身分，建築卻往往假設只有一位一致的使用者。這個作品探問，一個破碎的心智能如何被轉譯為一座可居住的塔樓。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A film about a character with several personalities served as the reference, and its storyline was mapped chapter by chapter. Each personality was then read as a set of traits such as fear, control, innocence or defence.
captions: A fearful self as a maze of soft fragments.
An artistic self as a stretched canopy.
An ordered self as a stacked, guarded volume.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 作品以一部描寫多重人格角色的電影為參考，逐章梳理其敘事結構。每一種人格再被解讀為一組特質，例如恐懼、控制、天真或防衛。
captions: 恐懼的自我化為柔軟碎片構成的迷宮。
藝術性的自我化為延展的頂棚。
秩序的自我化為層疊而戒備的量體。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Six personalities were abstracted into six drawings and six study models, each with its own spatial logic and material feel. Contrasting conditions such as control, vulnerability and protection were kept side by side instead of resolved.
captions: A childlike self as playful arches and holes.
A controlling self as rigid walls and frames.
A defensive self as a swollen, cave-like ground.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 六種人格被抽象為六張圖面與六個研究模型，各自擁有獨特的空間邏輯與材質感。控制、脆弱與保護等對立狀態被並置保留，而非被調和。
captions: 孩子般的自我化為輕快的拱與孔洞。
控制的自我化為剛硬的牆與框架。
防衛的自我化為膨脹如洞穴的地景。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The fragments are assembled into a vertical tower around a central core, wrapped in a soft mesh skin. Plans and a section show how the different spaces interlock floor by floor.
captions: Two floor plans.
Section through the tower.
Model views of the coloured fragments.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這些碎片沿著中央核心組裝成一座垂直塔樓，外覆柔軟的網狀表皮。平面與剖面呈現不同空間如何逐層交錯咬合。
captions: 兩層平面圖。
塔樓剖面。
彩色碎片的模型視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a story with a clear inner conflict.
2. Map the plot before drawing space.
3. Give each identity its own spatial rules.
4. Assemble the fragments without erasing their differences.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇一個內在衝突清晰的故事。
2. 先梳理情節，再畫空間。
3. 為每個身分訂定各自的空間規則。
4. 組裝碎片時保留彼此的差異。

pins.title: Edge of Production: Industrial Waterfront Regeneration
pins.description:
A former port waterfront in Shenzhen is reconnected to the city through industrial reuse and a continuous public realm.

Shenzhen | Urban regeneration | Adaptive reuse | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 生產的邊緣：工業水岸再生
zh-Hant.description:
透過工業再利用與連續的公共領域，讓深圳一處昔日港口水岸重新與城市相連。

深圳｜都市再生｜適應性再利用｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the regenerated waterfront district.
更新後水岸街區的鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A former port and heavy-industrial waterfront in Shenzhen is fragmented by large brownfields and port infrastructure. These barriers cut the city off from its shoreline and leave open spaces scattered and disconnected.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳一處昔日港口與重工業水岸被大片棕地與港口設施切割得支離破碎。這些屏障使城市與海岸線隔絕，開放空間也零散而互不相連。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Six map layers trace roads, metro, bus routes, green areas, industrial land and new development zones across the district. Reading them together shows where pedestrian links break and where old industrial structures still hold a strong presence.
captions: Site layers from roads to new development.
District plan with green and industrial areas.
Waterfront site plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 六張圖層分別梳理道路、地鐵、公車路線、綠地、工業用地與新開發區。疊合閱讀後，可以看出步行連結在哪裡中斷，以及哪些舊工業構造仍具強烈的存在感。
captions: 從道路到新開發區的基地圖層。
標示綠地與工業區的街區平面。
水岸基地平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The strategy is grouped into three families of moves for the waterfront, the industrial heritage and the city centre. Abandoned tanks and sheds are reused as parks, exhibition spaces and performance areas.
captions: Waterfront moves.
Industrial heritage reuse.
City centre blocks with green terraces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 策略被歸納為三組操作，分別對應水岸、工業遺產與城市中心。廢棄的儲槽與廠房被再利用為公園、展覽空間與表演場地。
captions: 水岸操作。
工業遺產再利用。
帶有綠化露台的城市中心街廓。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A continuous pedestrian network now ties commercial, residential and public spaces back to the sea. The former industrial edge becomes an inclusive public landscape for everyday life.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一條連續的步行網絡將商業、居住與公共空間重新連回海邊。昔日的工業邊緣轉化為一片支持日常生活的包容性公共地景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map each network as its own layer.
2. Overlay layers to find the broken links.
3. Sort moves into a few clear families.
4. Reuse what the site already has.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 將每種網絡各自畫成一層。
2. 疊合圖層，找出斷裂的連結。
3. 把操作歸納為幾組清楚的類型。
4. 善用基地既有的元素。

pins.title: Silvertown Vertical Farm: Urban Food Infrastructure
pins.description:
A modular vertical farm that brings food production back into post-industrial London as public infrastructure.

London | Vertical farming | Urban food infrastructure | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 銀城垂直農場：城市糧食基礎設施
zh-Hant.description:
將糧食生產以公共基礎設施的形式帶回後工業倫敦的模組化垂直農場。

倫敦｜垂直農業｜城市糧食基礎設施｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Axonometric of the vertical farm along the waterfront.
沿著水岸展開的垂直農場軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: London's food system is detached from the city it serves, with long supply chains and uneven access to fresh food. Silvertown, a former landscape of production and logistics, now sits between regeneration pressure and food insecurity.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 倫敦的糧食系統與它所服務的城市彼此疏離，供應鏈漫長，新鮮食物的取得也不平均。銀城一帶曾是生產與物流的地景，如今夾在都市更新壓力與糧食不安全之間。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A concept model of stacked rhombus cells tested how light, air and views can pass through a dense vertical structure. Holographic paper on the cells made the paths of sunlight and reflection visible.
captions: Concept model seen from below.
Light study with reflective cells.
Cells aggregated into one porous system.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以層疊菱形單元構成的概念模型，測試光線、空氣與視線如何穿透密集的垂直結構。單元上的全像紙讓日照與反射的路徑變得可見。
captions: 從下方仰望概念模型。
以反光單元進行的光線研究。
單元聚合成一個多孔的系統。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: By day the porous structure supports learning, research and public circulation, while by night it switches to grow-lighting and automated irrigation. Each module stacks a roof canopy, a control deck, growing platforms and a community deck on a hexagonal frame.
captions: Daytime light and public use.
Nighttime system operation.
Exploded production module.
Layers from canopy to structural frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 白天，多孔的結構容納學習、研究與公共動線；夜間則切換為植物補光與自動灌溉。每個模組在六角形框架上依序疊合屋頂膜、控制層、栽培平台與社區作業層。
captions: 白天的採光與公共使用。
夜間的系統運作。
生產模組爆炸圖。
從屋頂膜到結構框架的分層。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The modules link to a low-temperature district energy loop that exchanges heat with neighbouring buildings. Food production returns to the city as everyday infrastructure that also offers local work.
captions: Connection to the district energy loop.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模組連接一套低溫區域能源迴路，與鄰近建築交換熱能。糧食生產因此以日常基礎設施的姿態回到城市，同時提供在地就業。
captions: 與區域能源迴路的連結。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Treat the building as a working system.
2. Test light and air with a physical model.
3. Design for both day and night.
4. Plug the module into city networks.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把建築視為一套運作中的系統。
2. 用實體模型測試光與空氣。
3. 同時為白天與夜晚設計。
4. 讓模組接入城市網絡。

pins.title: Longyearbyen Coastal Ecological Framework
pins.description:
A sediment-driven nearshore infrastructure that helps the Arctic coast grow new habitat over time.

Svalbard | Coastal ecology | Nearshore infrastructure | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 朗伊爾城海岸生態框架
zh-Hant.description:
以沉積作用驅動的近岸基礎設施，讓北極海岸隨時間長出新的棲地。

斯瓦巴｜海岸生態｜近岸基礎設施｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The Arctic region with the site marked.
標示基地位置的北極區域圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Climate change is reshaping ocean currents, sediment flows and coastlines across the Arctic. In Longyearbyen, sediment slowly builds new land, yet coastal habitats remain fragmented and vulnerable.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 氣候變遷正在改變北極的洋流、沉積物流動與海岸線。在朗伊爾城，沉積物緩慢地堆積出新的土地，海岸棲地卻依然破碎而脆弱。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Maps of vulnerable species, tidal currents, fresh water and vegetation show where the coast is most sensitive and where links are missing. Shallow, stable water near the shore was found suitable for light-touch structures that guide sedimentation.
captions: Sensitive and common species along the coast.
Tidal currents and critical water resources.
Fragmented green patches.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 針對脆弱物種、潮流、淡水與植被的分析圖，揭示海岸最敏感的區段與缺失的生態連結。近岸淺而穩定的水域被判定適合設置輕觸式構造，以引導沉積。
captions: 沿岸的敏感物種與常見物種。
潮流與關鍵水資源。
破碎的綠地斑塊。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Rock-filled gabions act as groynes that slow the water and trap sediment over time. Over two decades they are expected to fill, grow over with mosses and grasses, and turn into new coastal habitat.
captions: From gabion structure to land formation.
Branching concept model of sediment growth.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 填滿石塊的石籠作為突堤，減緩水流並逐步攔截沉積物。在二十年間，它們預期會被填滿、長出苔蘚與草本，轉化為新的海岸棲地。
captions: 從石籠構造到土地成形。
呈現沉積生長的分枝狀概念模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A raised corridor follows the sediment flow and stitches inland vegetation to the shore. After twenty years an emergent green corridor and a stabilised platform offer habitat and quiet public access.
captions: Accretion-led growth after twenty years.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一條架高的廊道順著沉積物流向延伸，將內陸植被縫合到海岸。二十年後，新生的綠色廊道與穩定的平台同時提供棲地與低干擾的公共通道。
captions: 二十年後由淤積帶動的生長。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map natural forces before drawing form.
2. Work with slow processes, not against them.
3. Design across a long timeline.
4. Let the structure become habitat.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先描繪自然力量，再畫形體。
2. 順應緩慢的過程，而非對抗。
3. 以長時間軸進行設計。
4. 讓構造轉化為棲地。

pins.title: Holding the Crossing
pins.description:
A layered pedestrian bridge that turns a busy crossing into a place to pause, gather and move with ease.

Shenzhen | Pedestrian bridge | Urban connector | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 守住通道
zh-Hant.description:
一座層疊式人行橋，讓繁忙的通道成為可以停留、聚集並從容通行的地方。

深圳｜人行橋｜城市連接體｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A woven canopy over the crossing at dusk.
黃昏時覆蓋在通道上方的編織頂棚。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A large plaza next to a busy railway crossing in Shenzhen is used almost only for passing through. It lacks shade, shelter and places to pause, so it feels empty despite the crowds.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳一處緊鄰繁忙鐵路通道的大型廣場，幾乎只被用來穿越。這裡缺乏遮蔭、庇護與停留的地方，即使人潮眾多，仍顯得空曠。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Site diagrams trace roads, green space, water and pedestrian access around the plaza. They show that daily movement is strong while comfort and a sense of place are missing.
captions: Roads, access and surrounding uses.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地分析圖梳理廣場周邊的道路、綠地、水系與步行動線。分析顯示這裡日常人流強勁，卻缺乏舒適感與場所感。
captions: 道路、動線與周邊使用。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A pedestrian bridge is stacked in layers, from a ground concourse to play platforms, green terraces and a glass climate veil. Section studies test how people can either keep moving or slow down and stay.
captions: Operational layers of the shared section.
Section analysis of the bridge.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一座人行橋以層疊方式組成，從地面通廊到遊憩平台、綠色露台與玻璃氣候罩。剖面研究測試人們如何能持續通行，或放慢腳步停留。
captions: 共享剖面的運作層次。
人行橋的剖面分析。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A second, water-based connector extends the route with a curved envelope over a framework of ribs. Its plan holds seating, gardens and small leisure spaces, turning the crossing into an extension of everyday city life.
captions: Envelope, structure and pedestrian layers.
Masterplan of the water-based connector.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 第二段臨水連接體以曲面外殼覆蓋肋狀結構，延續步行路徑。平面中配置座位、花園與小型休閒空間，讓通道成為日常城市生活的延伸。
captions: 外殼、結構與步行層。
臨水連接體的總平面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe how people actually move.
2. Design for both passing and pausing.
3. Stack uses in section.
4. Let climate shape the envelope.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察人們真實的移動方式。
2. 同時為通過與停留而設計。
3. 在剖面中疊合使用。
4. 讓氣候塑造外殼。

pins.title: Weaving Back the Sugar Factory
pins.description:
Pedestrian links and a woven walkway that reconnect a former sugar factory to its neighbourhood and river.

Industrial heritage | Pedestrian linkage | Riverfront regeneration | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重新編織糖廠
zh-Hant.description:
以步行連結與編織般的步道，讓舊糖廠重新接回社區與河流。

工業遺產｜步行連結｜河岸再生｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The regenerated sugar factory from above.
俯瞰再生後的糖廠。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A former riverside sugar factory sits cut off from the new town around it, its sheds and silos left behind. Residents face a long detour to reach the riverfront, and the site offers little to the people who live nearby.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座臨河的舊糖廠被周邊新城隔離，廠房與筒倉閒置多年。居民須繞遠路才能抵達河岸，基地也幾乎無法回應附近居民的需求。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Site analysis weighs the heritage value of the factory against its spatial fragmentation and an unused stretch of riverfront. The findings point to linkage, not new buildings, as the key to reviving the area.
captions: Heritage value, fragmentation and waterfront potential.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地分析權衡工廠的遺產價值、空間破碎化與閒置的河岸地帶。分析結果指出，振興此地的關鍵在於連結，而非新建築。
captions: 遺產價值、空間破碎與河岸潛力。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The local craft of silk making, from cocoon to thread to fabric, is translated into pods, an elevated passage and a link bridge. Five strategies then layer community commons, slow mobility, heritage, creative work and a riverfront corridor onto the site.
captions: Forms drawn from cocoon, thread and fabric.
Five layered strategies.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在地的絲綢工藝，從蠶繭、絲線到布料，被轉譯為聚集艙體、架高步道與連接橋。五項策略再將社區共享、慢行系統、遺產軸線、創意工坊與河岸廊道疊加到基地上。
captions: 取自蠶繭、絲線與布料的形態。
五項疊加策略。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The masterplan weaves a continuous walkway through a play area, museums, workshops and a waterfront green park. Old industrial fabric becomes an everyday public landscape that reconnects the neighbourhood to the river.
captions: Masterplan with key spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 總平面以一條連續步道串起遊戲區、博物館、工坊與濱水綠地公園。舊工業紋理成為日常的公共地景，讓社區重新與河流相連。
captions: 標示主要空間的總平面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read what the site already offers.
2. Draw form from local craft.
3. Repair links before adding buildings.
4. Let heritage stay in daily use.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先讀懂基地既有的資源。
2. 從在地工藝提取形態。
3. 先修補連結，再增加建築。
4. 讓遺產留在日常使用中。

pins.title: Spatial Development Plan for Enfield
pins.description:
A spatial plan that links housing, jobs and transport to reduce inequality across a London borough.

London | Spatial planning | Just city | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 恩菲爾德空間發展規劃
zh-Hant.description:
一份串連住宅、就業與交通的空間規劃，縮小倫敦一個行政區內的不平等。

倫敦｜空間規劃｜公正城市｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Key spatial diagram of the plan.
規劃的關鍵空間圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The eastern side of Enfield in north London has weaker public transport, fewer local services and a concentration of deprivation. A divide between east and west shapes access to jobs, homes and everyday amenities.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 倫敦北部恩菲爾德的東側大眾運輸較弱、在地服務較少，貧困也較為集中。東西之間的落差，影響了居民取得工作、住宅與日常設施的機會。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A SWOT map marks town centres with good and poor provision, growth areas and places where transport access is very low. It turns scattered data into a clear picture of where the plan should act first.
captions: SWOT analysis across the borough.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: SWOT 分析圖標示服務良好與不足的城鎮中心、成長地區，以及大眾運輸可及性極低的地點。它把零散的數據整理成清楚的圖像，指出規劃應優先介入之處。
captions: 全區的 SWOT 分析。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Housing growth is steered to well-connected brownfield sites near stations, protecting green belt and heritage areas. Each site is tested for density, height and the share of affordable homes it can carry.
captions: Sites for new housing.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 住宅成長被引導至車站周邊交通便利的棕地，同時保護綠帶與歷史保存區。每處基地都經過密度、高度與可負擔住宅比例的檢驗。
captions: 新住宅的開發基地。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Employment land is placed beside new bus and cycling routes so that jobs sit close to the homes that need them. Together the layers form a spatial plan for a fairer, fifteen-minute borough.
captions: Sites for employment land.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 就業用地沿著新的公車與自行車路線配置，讓工作機會靠近需要它的住宅。這些圖層共同構成一份更公平的十五分鐘城市空間規劃。
captions: 就業用地的開發基地。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map inequality before proposing change.
2. Link homes, jobs and transport.
3. Protect green land first.
4. Test every site against clear criteria.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先描繪不平等，再提出改變。
2. 串連住宅、工作與交通。
3. 優先保護綠地。
4. 以明確準則檢驗每處基地。

pins.title: The Floating Community
pins.description:
A floating, 3D-printed settlement that turns plastic waste into homes and supports marine life below.

New York | Floating settlement | Circular construction | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 漂浮社區
zh-Hant.description:
一座以 3D 列印打造的漂浮聚落，將塑膠廢料轉化為住宅，並支持水下的海洋生態。

紐約｜漂浮聚落｜循環營建｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The floating settlement seen from above.
俯瞰漂浮聚落。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Jamaica Bay in New York is an ecologically dynamic edge where water, wetland and city meet. The project asks how a community could live on the water while giving back to the habitat beneath it.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 紐約牙買加灣是水域、濕地與城市交會、生態變動劇烈的邊緣地帶。這個專案提問：一個社區如何生活在水上，同時回饋水面下的棲地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Collage and site mapping study the bay, its marine life and the neighbourhoods along its shore. Plastic waste collected from nearby homes is identified as a local resource for building.
captions: Concept collage of life above and below the water.
Site context around the bay.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 拼貼與基地圖研究海灣、海洋生物與沿岸社區。從附近住宅收集的塑膠廢料，被視為可用於建造的在地資源。
captions: 水上與水下生活的概念拼貼。
海灣周邊的基地脈絡。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Plastic waste is mixed with concrete and 3D-printed on site into housing units tailored to each household. Walls and furniture slide along integrated tracks, so homes can be reconfigured over time.
captions: Printed unit modules, plan and section.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 塑膠廢料與混凝土混合，在基地現場以 3D 列印製成依各戶需求量身打造的住宅單元。牆體與家具可沿整合軌道移動，讓住家能隨時間重新配置。
captions: 列印單元模組、平面與剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Hexagon-based islands of lightweight concrete form a modular archipelago with solar panels above and turbines and artificial reefs below. Aquaponic farms complete a closed loop of food, energy and housing on the water.
captions: Masterplan of the hexagon islands.
Turbines and reefs below the waterline.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 以輕質混凝土構成的六角形島嶼組成模組化群島，上方設置太陽能板，下方則有水力渦輪與人工魚礁。魚菜共生農場讓水上的食物、能源與住宅形成封閉循環。
captions: 六角形島嶼的總平面圖。
水面下的渦輪與魚礁。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Treat waste as a material.
2. Design above and below the surface.
3. Let homes change with their users.
4. Close the loop of food and energy.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把廢料視為材料。
2. 同時設計水面上與水面下。
3. 讓住家隨使用者改變。
4. 讓食物與能源形成循環。

pins.title: Wetland Gallery
pins.description:
An educational bird-watching gallery on a floodplain, held up by hollow tree-like columns that double as nests.

New Jersey | Bird-watching gallery | Wetland education | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 濕地藝廊
zh-Hant.description:
一座位於氾濫平原上的教育型賞鳥藝廊，以兼作鳥巢的中空樹狀柱撐起。

新澤西｜賞鳥藝廊｜濕地教育｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The gallery with its sloped rooftop deck above the river.
沿河而立、設有斜屋頂平台的展館。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Along the Hackensack River in New Jersey, wetland birds and a low-lying neighbourhood share a floodplain that floods again and again. The brief asks for an educational bird-watching site where people can learn about the wetland without disturbing it.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在新澤西州哈肯薩克河沿岸，濕地鳥類與低窪社區共享一片反覆淹水的氾濫平原。題目要求一座教育型賞鳥基地，讓人們在不打擾濕地的前提下認識它。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Seasonal studies map the birds, plants and flood records of the site and its surroundings. Winter backyard feeders, where people and birds meet at close range, become the starting idea.
captions: Flora and fauna of the river edge.
Chunk model of the structure and nests.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 季節性研究整理了基地及周邊的鳥類、植物與淹水紀錄。冬季後院餵鳥器讓人與鳥近距離相遇，成為設計的出發點。
captions: 河岸的動植物分析。
結構與鳥巢的局部模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Hollow steel columns, narrow at the base and wide at the top, carry the floors and hold nesting cavities of different sizes. Feeder tubes link the nests to the rooms inside, so visitors can watch birds return without being seen.
captions: Tree-like column types.
Plan with nests and supports.
How people and birds meet at the nest.
Section of shared spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 下窄上寬的中空鋼柱承托樓板，柱內設有大小不一的築巢空間。餵食管將鳥巢與室內相連，讓訪客能在不被察覺的情況下觀察鳥類歸巢。
captions: 樹狀柱的類型。
鳥巢與支撐的平面配置。
人與鳥在巢邊相遇的方式。
共享空間的剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Classrooms, an exhibition space and a glasshouse garden sit above the floodplain, while the ground stays open for a wildlife garden and boat mooring. A polycarbonate skin filters light and a bamboo roof deck turns visitors toward the water and the sunset.
captions: Exploded axonometric of the layers.
Plans from ground floor to roof.
Long section through the gallery.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 教室、展覽空間與溫室花園抬升於氾濫平原之上，地面層則保留給野生動物花園與船隻停泊。聚碳酸酯外皮過濾光線，竹製屋頂平台則將訪客的視線引向水面與夕陽。
captions: 各層構造的爆炸軸測圖。
從地面層到屋頂的各層平面。
穿越展館的長向剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a daily encounter.
2. Let structure host other species.
3. Lift the program above the flood.
4. Design how people watch, not only what they see.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從日常的相遇出發。
2. 讓結構也能容納其他物種。
3. 將機能抬升至淹水線之上。
4. 設計人們觀看的方式，而不只是看見的東西。

pins.title: Reimagining Tegel
pins.description:
Courtyard urbanism for a disused airport terminal, where housing, gardens and workshops support refuge and exchange.

Berlin | Airport transformation | Courtyard urbanism | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重新想像泰格爾
zh-Hant.description:
為閒置機場航廈提出的中庭都市主義，以住宅、花園與工作坊支持安置與交流。

柏林｜機場轉型｜中庭都市主義｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The hexagonal courtyard reimagined as a shared garden and neighbourhood.
六角形中庭被重新想像為共享花園與社區。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The decommissioned Tegel Airport in Berlin leaves a large hexagonal terminal and its courtyard without a use. The project asks how the site could give displaced families a home while opening it to the people of the city.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 柏林已停用的泰格爾機場，留下一座大型六角形航廈與中庭無人使用。這個專案提問：基地如何為流離失所的家庭提供居所，同時向城市居民開放。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Mapping and user studies compare the needs of new residents with those of local visitors. Timber stick models test a branching, lightweight structure that could grow across the courtyard.
captions: The airport site within the city.
Early timber stick models.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地圖與使用者研究比較了新住民與在地訪客的不同需求。木構桿件模型則測試一種可在中庭中延展、輕巧的分枝結構。
captions: 機場基地在城市中的位置。
早期的木桿件模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Homes, schools and cafeterias line the terminal ring, while the courtyard fills with planting beds, workshops and trellises for growing herbs and spices. Unit plans use sliding doors and storage walls so each family can reshape its rooms over time.
captions: Adaptable family units and their uses.
Model of the planting trellis.
Joint studies for the trellis.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 住宅、學校與餐廳沿著航廈環狀配置，中庭則布滿種植床、工作坊與用來栽種香草與香料的棚架。單元平面以拉門與收納牆組成，讓每個家庭能隨時間調整房間。
captions: 可調整的家庭單元與使用方式。
種植棚架模型。
棚架的節點研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A bike lane and a communication park run beneath an open roof whose angled tiles control light and collect rain. Raised walkways, a viewing tower and workshops turn the courtyard into a garden for exchange between residents and visitors.
captions: Roof tiles that control light.
Long section across the courtyard.
Viewing tower and rain-fed workshops.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 自行車道與交流公園位於開放式屋頂之下，屋頂以不同角度的板片調節光線並收集雨水。高架步道、瞭望塔與工作坊，讓中庭成為住民與訪客交流的花園。
captions: 調節光線的屋頂板片。
橫跨中庭的長向剖面。
瞭望塔與雨水回收工作坊。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read an empty structure as a resource.
2. Design for two user groups at once.
3. Let planting carry culture and income.
4. Build shared ground before shared rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把閒置的結構視為資源。
2. 同時為兩種使用者設計。
3. 讓植栽承載文化與收入。
4. 先建立共享的地面，再談共享的房間。

pins.title: Floating Eco-Islands
pins.description:
Artificial habitats made from abandoned bamboo rafts that move feeding grounds away from the busy shore.

Shenzhen Bay | Floating habitat | Bird conservation | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 漂浮生態島
zh-Hant.description:
以廢棄竹筏打造的人工棲地，將鳥類覓食區移離熱鬧的岸邊。

深圳灣｜漂浮棲地｜鳥類保育｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Planted bamboo rafts give waterbirds a safe place to feed.
種上植物的竹筏，為水鳥提供安全的覓食處。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Shenzhen Bay is a tidal estuary where resident and migratory waterbirds feed close to busy promenades and seawalls. Human disturbance near the shore pushes the birds away from the places they rely on.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳灣是一處潮汐河口，留鳥與候鳥在熱鬧的步道與海堤旁覓食。岸邊的人為干擾，正把鳥類推離牠們依賴的棲地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A months-long field study logs the tides and records where each bird group feeds as the water rises and falls. It also finds abandoned bamboo floats and small islands that appear at low tide, which become the raw material of the design.
captions: Bird sightings across the bay.
Tide levels over one week.
Where birds feed at each stage of the tide.
Shoreline section by bird group.
Bamboo floats and low-tide islands found on site.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 為期數月的田野調查記錄潮汐，並觀察各類鳥群在漲退潮之間於何處覓食。調查也發現了廢棄的竹筏與低潮時才浮現的小島，成為設計的素材。
captions: 灣區內的鳥類觀察紀錄。
一週的潮位變化。
各潮汐階段鳥類的覓食位置。
依鳥類族群整理的海岸剖面。
在基地發現的竹筏與低潮小島。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The bamboo rafts are reinforced, anchored to the seabed and fitted with planting boxes for reeds and other aquatic plants. Oysters living inside the bamboo help filter the water and add habitat for fish.
captions: Habitat, research and submerged islands.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 竹筏經過補強並錨定於海床，再加上栽種蘆葦等水生植物的種植箱。棲息在竹管內的牡蠣協助淨化水質，也為魚類增加棲地。
captions: 棲地島、研究島與淹沒島的配置。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The rafts extend the low-tide islands and become new islands when the water covers them, moving food and shelter away from the shore. A tide model tests how many rafts are needed to keep the habitat area steady between high and low water.
captions: The model seen from above.
High and low tide in the model.
Details of the planted rafts.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 竹筏延伸了低潮小島，並在海水淹沒時自成島嶼，將食物與庇護所移離岸邊。潮汐模型則測試需要多少竹筏，才能讓棲地面積在漲退潮之間維持穩定。
captions: 從上方俯瞰模型。
模型中的高潮與低潮。
種植竹筏的細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe the site over time.
2. Design for the species, not the visitor.
3. Reuse what the site already holds.
4. Test the idea with a working model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 長時間觀察基地。
2. 為物種而非訪客設計。
3. 再利用基地既有的資源。
4. 用可運作的模型驗證想法。

pins.title: Bio-based Material
pins.description:
Interlocking hempcrete blocks for a dry-stacked ceiling built without mortar.

New York | Material research | Hempcrete ceiling | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 生物基材料
zh-Hant.description:
以互鎖式麻石灰磚打造、無需砂漿的乾式堆疊天花板。

紐約｜材料研究｜麻石灰天花板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Interlocking hempcrete blocks held by timber members.
以木構件固定的互鎖式麻石灰磚。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Ceilings are usually built with mortar, adhesives and energy-heavy materials that are hard to take apart. The project asks whether a bio-based block could form a ceiling by stacking alone.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 天花板通常以砂漿、黏著劑與高耗能材料建造，難以拆解。這個專案提問：生物基材料製成的磚塊，能否僅靠堆疊就構成天花板。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Hemp hurds are mixed with a lime binder, pressed into moulds and tamped by hand. Workshops compare several binders and mould versions to learn how timing, moisture and compaction change the result.
captions: Mixing and casting steps.
Single mould and stacked moulds for the mock-up.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 將大麻稈芯與石灰黏結劑混合，壓入模具並以手工夯實。工作坊比較多種黏結劑與模具版本，了解時間、濕度與壓實程度如何影響成果。
captions: 混合與澆鑄步驟。
單一模具與用於實體模型的組合模具。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Stepped and notched blocks lock into each other, so the ceiling can be dry-stacked without mortar. Timber supports run through the blocks to carry lateral forces and tie the system to the facade.
captions: Section of the stacked ceiling.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 階梯狀並帶有凹槽的磚塊彼此咬合，讓天花板無需砂漿即可乾式堆疊。木支撐穿過磚塊承受側向力，並將系統與立面相連。
captions: 堆疊式天花板的剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A full mock-up tests how the blocks interlock, hold their shape and work with the timber frame. The study points toward low-carbon ceilings that can be assembled, taken apart and reused.
captions: Ceiling mock-up with timber supports.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完整的實體模型測試磚塊的咬合、形狀穩定度，以及與木構架的配合。這項研究指向可組裝、可拆解並能再利用的低碳天花板。
captions: 附木支撐的天花板實體模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the material.
2. Let geometry replace glue.
3. Test by making, again and again.
4. Design for taking apart.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從材料出發。
2. 讓幾何取代黏著。
3. 反覆動手製作來測試。
4. 為拆解而設計。

pins.title: Sediment, Tide, and Habitat
pins.description:
A coastal landscape that uses sediment and tide to restore wetland habitat on a delta edge.

Guangzhou | Coastal landscape | Habitat restoration | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 沉積、潮汐與棲地
zh-Hant.description:
以沉積與潮汐修復三角洲邊緣濕地棲地的海岸地景。

廣州｜海岸地景｜棲地修復｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A coastal park where people and wetland habitat share the edge.
人與濕地棲地共享水岸的海岸公園。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The low-lying delta coast faces rising seas, storm surges and shrinking habitat for birds and fish. Hard embankments hold back water but cut the land off from the tide.
captions: Flood risk and bird distribution across the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 低窪的三角洲海岸面臨海平面上升、風暴潮，以及鳥類與魚類棲地縮減。堅硬的堤岸雖能擋水，卻讓土地與潮汐斷開。
captions: 基地的淹水風險與鳥類分布。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The study maps flooding, bird species and how the coast reacts when surges overtop the embankment. These scenarios show where wetland can absorb water instead of resisting it.
captions: Storm surge scenarios along the river embankment.
Section through freshwater and brackish wetland.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究繪製淹水、鳥類物種，以及風暴潮越過堤岸時海岸的反應。這些情境指出濕地可以吸納而非抵擋海水的位置。
captions: 沿河堤岸的風暴潮情境。
淡水與半鹹水濕地剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sediment, tide and planting are treated as tools that slowly reshape the coastline. Woodland, shrub, wetland and creek habitats are arranged as a pattern that keeps evolving.
captions: Changing coastal landscape and habitat tendencies.
A constantly evolving pattern of habitats.
Plant and animal species for each habitat.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 沉積、潮汐與植栽被視為慢慢重塑海岸線的工具。林地、灌叢、濕地與潮溝棲地被編排成一套持續演化的格局。
captions: 變動中的海岸地景與棲地趨勢。
持續演化的棲地格局。
各棲地對應的動植物物種。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The landscape is drawn across several future stages as land and water trade places. Paths and platforms let visitors walk through the wetland without disturbing the birds.
captions: The landscape across future stages.
Renderings of the restored habitats.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 地景在多個未來階段中被描繪，呈現陸地與水域的消長。步道與平台讓訪客穿越濕地，又不打擾鳥類。
captions: 地景在未來各階段的樣貌。
修復後棲地的透視圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the coast as a moving system.
2. Map water and wildlife together.
3. Design in stages over time.
4. Let nature do part of the work.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把海岸當作移動中的系統來閱讀。
2. 同時繪製水與野生動物。
3. 隨時間分階段設計。
4. 讓自然完成部分工作。

pins.title: Sawtooth Horizons
pins.description:
A cultural centre under a folded sawtooth roof that filters daylight into four programs.

Tartu | Cultural centre | Folded roof | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 鋸齒地平線
zh-Hant.description:
在折板鋸齒屋頂下過濾日光、容納四種機能的文化中心。

塔爾圖｜文化中心｜折板屋頂｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of the folded sawtooth roof.
折板鋸齒屋頂模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A library, art museum, restaurant and theatre must share one building without losing their own character. The project looks for a single roof that can hold these programs together.
captions: Generating the folded roof.
The building taken apart into roof, auditorium, structure, ramp and base.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 圖書館、美術館、餐廳與劇場必須共用一棟建築，又不失各自的性格。這個專案尋找一片能把這些機能整合起來的屋頂。
captions: 折板屋頂的生成。
拆解為屋頂、觀眾席、結構、坡道與基座的建築系統。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Concept models test a looping ramp threaded under a folded surface. The ground below breaks into fragments that become separate rooms and courtyards.
captions: Concept collage and study models.
Fragmented ground and plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 概念模型測試一條穿行於折板之下的迴圈坡道。下方的地面被打散成片段，形成各自獨立的房間與庭院。
captions: 概念拼貼與研究模型。
破碎化的地面與平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The sawtooth folds turn away from direct sun and let soft light fall into the halls below. Roof, supports and base are detailed as three layers that work together.
captions: Sections showing the roof as a daylight filter.
Details of roof, support and base structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 鋸齒折板避開直射陽光，讓柔和的光線灑入下方空間。屋頂、支撐與基座被細化為三個彼此配合的層次。
captions: 呈現屋頂作為採光濾網的剖面。
屋頂、支撐與基座結構細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The roof steps down toward the river and links the building with the landscape. Ramps lead visitors from the ground up across the folds.
captions: Aerial view toward the river.
Views of the final model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂朝河岸逐級下降，將建築與地景相連。坡道引導訪客從地面一路走上折板。
captions: 朝向河岸的鳥瞰。
最終模型視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find one gesture that unites many programs.
2. Let light shape the section.
3. Take the building apart into systems.
4. Test the idea in physical models.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出一個能整合多種機能的手勢。
2. 讓光線形塑剖面。
3. 把建築拆解成系統。
4. 以實體模型測試想法。

pins.title: Under the Hood
pins.description:
A plug-in city that grows over a coastal gas station inside a leaning truss frame.

Los Angeles | Plug-in city | Mixed use | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 引擎蓋之下
zh-Hant.description:
在傾斜桁架中、於海岸加油站上方生長的插入式城市。

洛杉磯｜插入式城市｜混合使用｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The plug-in structure seen up close.
近看插入式結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A gas station at a busy coastal crossroads sits between the highway, the hills and the beach. The project asks how a small site could grow into a mixed housing and commercial city.
captions: A material study that makes time visible.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座加油站位於繁忙的海岸路口，夾在公路、山丘與海灘之間。這個專案提問：一塊小基地如何長成混合住宅與商業的城市。
captions: 讓時間變得可見的材料研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A material study records how a soft block changes shape over time. This idea of slow change becomes the rule for how the building is added to and rearranged.
captions: Time slices inserted into a fixed truss frame.
Exploded section of the stacked programs.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 材料研究記錄一塊柔軟材料隨時間改變形狀的過程。這種緩慢變化的概念，成為建築如何被增加與重新排列的規則。
captions: 插入固定桁架中的時間切片。
堆疊機能的爆炸剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A fixed truss frame receives new volumes in successive slices that are lifted, rotated and moved. The structure stays continuous while the uses inside keep shifting.
captions: Model elevation of the leaning frame.
Section through the frame and the hillside.
Front and back views of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 固定的桁架結構以連續切片的方式接納新量體，並將其抬升、旋轉與移動。結構保持連續，內部的使用方式則不斷變動。
captions: 傾斜框架的模型立面。
穿過框架與山坡的剖面。
模型的正面與背面視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The tower leans toward the ocean and drops a network of floors over the old station. It reads less like a finished object and more like an architecture that is always being rewritten.
captions: Plan of the floor network.
Aerial view with the coastal hills.
Sectional axonometric of the stacked floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 塔樓向海洋傾斜，在舊加油站上方鋪展出一套樓板網絡。它不像完成的物件，更像一座不斷被改寫的建築。
captions: 樓板網絡平面。
與海岸山丘一同呈現的鳥瞰。
堆疊樓板的剖面軸測。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Turn a material test into a design rule.
2. Separate the lasting frame from changing uses.
3. Design for growth over time.
4. Draw the building in slices.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把材料實驗轉化為設計規則。
2. 區分恆常的框架與變動的使用。
3. 為隨時間成長而設計。
4. 以切片繪製建築。

pins.title: Inhabited
pins.description:
A long fabrication addition where machines and students share one translucent building.

Los Angeles | Education | Fabrication addition | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 棲居
zh-Hant.description:
機器與學生共享一棟半透明建築的長條加工增建。

洛杉磯｜教育建築｜加工增建｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of the long building and its inserted volumes.
長條建築與插入量體的模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A long school building beside a former rail corridor needs more space for making and fabrication. The project treats machines, not only people, as the main users of the new addition.
captions: A base linear framework and its volume variations.
Sketches of the inserted volumes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一棟緊鄰舊鐵道走廊的長條校舍，需要更多製作與加工空間。這個專案把機器而不只是人，視為新增建築的主要使用者。
captions: 基礎線性框架與量體變化。
插入量體的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A continuous linear volume is tested in many versions that sink, lift, attach or tilt. Each move opens the ground below for movement and gathering.
captions: Site axonometric with workshops, printing, lecture halls and library.
Plans of the linear building.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一個連續的線性量體被測試成下沉、抬升、附掛或傾斜等多種版本。每個動作都讓下方地面釋放出來，供人通行與聚集。
captions: 標示工作坊、印刷、演講廳與圖書館的基地軸測。
線性建築平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Workshops, printing rooms, lecture halls and a library are placed as separate volumes along the line. A shared circulation spine ties them together while machines keep working inside.
captions: Long section through workshops and halls.
Models of the volumes and circulation.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 工作坊、印刷室、演講廳與圖書館以獨立量體沿線排列。一條共享的動線主軸將它們串起，機器則在其中持續運作。
captions: 穿過工作坊與演講廳的長剖面。
量體與動線的模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The addition reads as one long translucent bar lit from within at night. Production, learning and climate control become part of the same continuous machine.
captions: Night elevation of the translucent bar.
Model details.
The long model seen from the street.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 新增建築呈現為一條在夜間由內透光的半透明長條。生產、學習與氣候調節成為同一部連續機器的一部分。
captions: 半透明長條的夜間立面。
模型細部。
從街道看長條模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask who the real user is.
2. Start with one simple line.
3. Test many variations of the same volume.
4. Let the section tell the story.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 問清楚真正的使用者是誰。
2. 從一條簡單的線開始。
3. 測試同一量體的多種變化。
4. 讓剖面說故事。

pins.title: Carmen, Rewritten
pins.description:
An opera stage reimagined as a machine of fate that finally dissolves into flowing curtains.

Stage design | Opera | Performative architecture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重寫卡門
zh-Hant.description:
把歌劇舞台重新想像成一部命運機械，最後化為流動布幔。

舞台設計｜歌劇｜表演性建築｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of the stage machine lit in blue.
以藍光照亮的舞台機械模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A classic opera usually sits in front of a fixed painted backdrop. The project asks how the stage itself can act out the story of love, freedom and fate.
captions: The opera poster used as a starting reference.
Study of flowing fabric curtains.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 經典歌劇通常在固定的彩繪布景前演出。這個專案追問舞台本身如何演出愛、自由與命運的故事。
captions: 作為起點參考的歌劇海報。
流動布幔的研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The story is reset in a warehouse-like factory where every person is given a role. Each act is tied to a card of fate and a matching costume for the main characters.
captions: Costume lineup for the main characters, made with AI tools.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 故事被移到一座像倉庫的工廠，每個人都被分派一個角色。每一幕都對應一張命運之牌，以及主要角色的服裝。
captions: 以 AI 工具生成的主要角色服裝系列。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A rotating machine of trusses, glass vessels and gears becomes the set for the third act. As it turns and locks, it shows a system that slowly closes around the heroine.
captions: The machinery of fate as a working model.
Stage view of the first act.
Stage view of the second act.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 由桁架、玻璃容器與齒輪組成的旋轉機械，成為第三幕的布景。它轉動並鎖定時，呈現一個逐漸包圍女主角的體系。
captions: 以可動模型呈現的命運機械。
第一幕的舞台畫面。
第二幕的舞台畫面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the last act the machine breaks into large flowing curtains that drift across the stage. The fabric turns the closing scene into a moment of release rather than control.
captions: Costume in front of the blue curtain.
Curtains moving across the stage.
The full cast in the final scene.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最後一幕，機械化為大片流動的布幔飄過舞台。布料讓終場成為釋放的一刻，而不是控制。
captions: 藍色布幔前的服裝。
布幔在舞台上移動。
終場的全體角色。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the story as a sequence of spaces.
2. Give each act one clear device.
3. Build the device as a moving model.
4. Let material carry the ending.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把故事讀成一連串的空間。
2. 每一幕給一個清楚的裝置。
3. 把裝置做成可動模型。
4. 讓材料承載結局。

pins.title: Lithium Lab Geevor
pins.description:
A geothermal lithium lab on a former tin mine, with a planted greenhouse at its core.

Cornwall | Industrial heritage | Lithium lab | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 吉弗鋰實驗室
zh-Hant.description:
在舊錫礦上建造的地熱鋰實驗室，以一座植栽溫室為核心。

康瓦爾｜工業遺產｜鋰實驗室｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial render of the greenhouse factory.
溫室工廠的鳥瞰渲染。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A former tin mine on a rugged coast has lost its industry and much of its local work. The project asks how a new lithium lab can bring production back while respecting the mining heritage.
captions: Site topography above the old mining tunnels.
Research on geothermal lithium extraction.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座位於崎嶇海岸的舊錫礦，失去了產業，也失去了許多在地工作。這個專案追問新的鋰實驗室如何在尊重礦業遺產的同時，讓生產重新回來。
captions: 舊礦坑隧道上方的基地地形。
地熱提鋰的研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Underground tunnels and hot brine make the site suitable for geothermal lithium extraction. The study maps how energy, water and material can move from the ground into the plant.
captions: Masterplan steps from mass to zones to plan.
Masterplan along the slope and heritage route.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 地下隧道與熱鹵水，讓基地適合進行地熱提鋰。研究梳理能源、水與材料如何從地底流入工廠。
captions: 從量體、分區到平面的配置步驟。
沿坡地與遺產路線展開的總體配置。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The station, greenhouse, factory, office and visitor sectors are linked along one connected route. A planted greenhouse sits at the heart of the plant as its environmental core.
captions: Axonometric of the program sectors.
Section through the greenhouse core.
Long section from visitor centre to factory.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 車站、溫室、工廠、辦公與訪客區沿一條連續路線串接。一座種滿植物的溫室位於廠區中心，作為環境核心。
captions: 各機能區的軸測圖。
穿過溫室核心的剖面。
從訪客中心到工廠的長剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Timber and steel frames with double facades give the factory and office natural ventilation. Visitors can watch production through glass while the greenhouse cleans the air.
captions: Structure explosions of the factory and office.
Construction explodes of the office and factory.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 木構與鋼構搭配雙層立面，為工廠與辦公空間帶來自然通風。訪客可以隔著玻璃觀看生產，溫室則同時淨化空氣。
captions: 工廠與辦公的結構分解圖。
辦公與工廠的構造分解圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read what lies under the ground.
2. Follow the flow of energy.
3. Put the climate system at the centre.
4. Let visitors see the work.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 讀懂地底下有什麼。
2. 跟著能源的流動走。
3. 把氣候系統放在中心。
4. 讓訪客看見工作。

pins.title: Bloom Street Power Station Renewal
pins.description:
A disused brick power station turned into a cultural venue with a climbable chimney.

Manchester | Adaptive reuse | Cultural venue | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 布魯姆街發電站更新
zh-Hant.description:
把廢棄磚造發電站改造成可攀登煙囪的文化場館。

曼徹斯特｜再利用｜文化場館｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The old power station with its chimney and new roof.
保留煙囪與新屋頂的舊發電站。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A disused brick power station stands empty in a dense city block. The project asks how its chimney and walls can carry a new public life without losing their industrial character.
captions: Explosion of the existing roof, walls, chimney and basement.
Street sections showing the station in its context.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座廢棄的磚造發電站，空置在密集的城市街廓中。這個專案追問煙囪與牆體如何承載新的公共生活，又不失去工業特質。
captions: 既有屋頂、牆體、煙囪與地下室的分解圖。
呈現發電站與周邊關係的街道剖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The study records the roof, columns, facade walls and basement that can be kept. It also maps the routes and open spaces that could draw people into the block.
captions: Design strategy steps for entry and public space.
An auditorium and bar complex inside the shell.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究記錄可保留的屋頂、柱列、立面牆與地下室。同時梳理能把人引入街廓的路徑與開放空間。
captions: 入口與公共空間的設計策略步驟。
置入舊殼體內的演講廳與酒吧複合空間。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: An auditorium is hung inside the old shell, while a stair climbs the chimney to a viewing point. A light steel frame supports the new floors without loading the historic walls.
captions: Section of the chimney stair and hall.
Detail where new floors meet the old facade.
Explosion of the new structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 演講廳懸掛在舊殼體內，一座樓梯則沿煙囪攀升到觀景點。輕量鋼構支撐新樓板，不讓荷重落在歷史牆體上。
captions: 煙囪樓梯與大廳的剖面。
新樓板與舊立面交接的細部。
新結構的分解圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The station reopens as a cultural venue with a public hall, bar and auditorium under a new sawtooth roof. The chimney becomes a landmark that visitors can now climb.
captions: Aerial view of the renewed station.
Views of the hall, bar and auditorium.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 發電站以文化場館重新開放，新的鋸齒屋頂下有公共大廳、酒吧與演講廳。煙囪成為訪客可以攀登的地標。
captions: 更新後發電站的鳥瞰。
大廳、酒吧與演講廳的室內視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Record what must stay.
2. Hang the new inside the old.
3. Keep loads off the heritage walls.
4. Give the landmark a new use.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 記錄必須保留的部分。
2. 讓新的懸在舊的裡面。
3. 不讓荷重落在遺產牆上。
4. 給地標新的用途。

pins.title: Riverside Greenhouse
pins.description:
A timber greenhouse laboratory that helps restore a polluted riverbank.

River Goyt | Landscape | Greenhouse laboratory | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 河岸溫室
zh-Hant.description:
協助修復受污染河岸的木構溫室實驗室。

戈伊特河｜地景｜溫室實驗室｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The greenhouse laboratory along the riverside.
沿河岸展開的溫室實驗室。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A polluted riverside beside an old mill site has lost its green edge. The project asks how a small laboratory can help restore nature while opening the bank to the public.
captions: Location, zoning and climate study.
Drawing that traces the history of the river town.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一段緊鄰舊磨坊遺址的河岸受到污染，失去了綠色邊緣。這個專案追問一座小型實驗室如何協助恢復自然，同時把河岸開放給公眾。
captions: 基地位置、分區與氣候研究。
追溯河岸城鎮歷史的圖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The study traces how the river and the town grew together over time. It also tests a long-term planting plan that slowly turns the bank back into a green buffer.
captions: Design iteration along the curve of the river.
Elevations of the long greenhouse.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究追溯河流與城鎮如何隨時間一起成長。同時測試一套長期植栽計畫，讓河岸逐步回復為綠色緩衝帶。
captions: 沿河道曲線的設計迭代。
長條溫室的立面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Timber frames and long beams carry a sloped roof over a curved plan that follows the water. The remaining brick wall from the old factory is kept as part of the new structure.
captions: Explosion of roof, timber frame and kept walls.
Distribution of greenhouse, lab and exhibition areas.
Public and private flows through the building.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 木構架與長樑支撐斜屋頂，覆蓋一個順著水岸彎曲的平面。舊工廠留下的磚牆被保留，成為新結構的一部分。
captions: 屋頂、木構架與保留牆體的分解圖。
溫室、實驗室與展覽空間的配置。
建築中公共與私密的動線。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The roof collects rain, lets in winter sun and guides air through the greenhouse. Visitors walk a promenade beside the labs while the planting gradually restores the riverbank.
captions: Strategies for ventilation, sunlight, rain and greenery.
Section showing the sloped roof and climate flow.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂收集雨水、引入冬季陽光，並引導空氣穿過溫室。訪客沿著實驗室旁的步道行走，植栽則逐步修復河岸。
captions: 通風、日照、雨水與綠化的策略。
呈現斜屋頂與氣候流動的剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Trace the history of the place.
2. Plan for slow change.
3. Keep what remains.
4. Let the roof do the climate work.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 追溯場所的歷史。
2. 為緩慢的改變做規劃。
3. 保留留下來的東西。
4. 讓屋頂負責氣候工作。

pins.title: Folded Cultural Centre in Tartu
pins.description:
A folded cultural centre that gathers a city's scattered public spaces into one landscape.

Tartu, Estonia | Architecture | Cultural centre | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 塔爾圖摺疊文化中心
zh-Hant.description:
把城市分散的公共空間收攏為一片地景的摺疊文化中心。

愛沙尼亞塔爾圖｜建築｜文化中心｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The folded cultural centre seen from above.
俯瞰摺疊形態的文化中心。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A cultural centre is proposed for a riverside city with many scattered public spaces. The project asks how one building can gather these spaces into a single connected landscape.
captions: Render of the sculpted form.
Maps of public spaces and movement around the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座文化中心位於一座公共空間分散的河岸城市。專案追問一棟建築如何把這些空間串聯成一片連續的地景。
captions: 雕塑形體的渲染圖。
基地周邊公共空間與動線的地圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Mapping shows how people move between the river, the parks and the old centre. A morphological study then tests many folded forms before one is chosen.
captions: Morphological study of folded forms.
Exploded axonometric of massing, soft landscape and circulation.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 地圖分析呈現人們如何在河岸、公園與舊城之間移動。接著以形態研究測試多種摺疊形體，再從中選出一個方案。
captions: 摺疊形體的形態研究。
量體、軟性地景與動線的分解軸測圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The massing is split into soft landscape, flexible spaces and routes that weave through each other. Physical models check how the sharp folds meet the ground.
captions: Form diagram and physical model.
Close view of the folded model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 量體被拆解為軟性地景、彈性空間與彼此交織的路徑。實體模型用來檢驗銳利的摺面如何落到地面。
captions: 形體圖解與實體模型。
摺疊模型的近景。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The plan and section show halls set inside a continuous folded shell. Light falls through the gaps and gives the interiors a calm, cave-like feeling.
captions: Floor plan.
Section through the folded shell.
Interior views lit through the folds.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 平面與剖面呈現大廳被包覆在連續的摺疊外殼之中。光線從縫隙灑入，讓室內帶有安靜如洞穴般的氛圍。
captions: 平面圖。
穿過摺疊外殼的剖面。
光線從摺面間灑入的室內視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map how people move.
2. Test many forms quickly.
3. Split the mass into layers.
4. Check the idea with models.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先畫出人的移動。
2. 快速測試多種形體。
3. 把量體拆成層次。
4. 用模型檢驗想法。

pins.title: Levanella Post-Factory
pins.description:
A former factory reopened as a landscape for upcycling clothes.

Arezzo, Italy | Adaptive reuse | Upcycling factory | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 萊瓦內拉後工廠
zh-Hant.description:
重新開放為衣物回收再造地景的舊工廠。

義大利阿雷佐｜既有建築再利用｜回收再造工廠｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial view of the post-factory among the hills.
山丘間的後工廠鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: An existing distribution factory is turned into a post-production landscape for upcycling clothes. The project asks how a closed industrial box can open up to show making, repair and reuse.
captions: Layered analysis of the site, routes and greenery.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座既有的物流工廠被轉化為回收再造衣物的後生產地景。專案追問一個封閉的工業盒子如何打開，讓製作、修補與再利用被看見。
captions: 基地、路徑與綠地的分層分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Layered site studies map the routes, the green edges and the long factory blocks. A form sequence then cuts, lifts and folds the roof to make new open spaces.
captions: Massing model of the folded roofs.
Form generation sequence.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 分層基地研究標示出路徑、綠色邊界與長條形的廠房量體。接著以形體推演把屋頂切開、抬升與摺疊，創造新的開放空間。
captions: 摺疊屋頂的量體模型。
形體生成推演。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The plan keeps the old factory ring and inserts workshops, studios and storage in the middle. Modular storage towers hold materials and can be reconfigured for different uses.
captions: Floor plan and typical unit plans.
Model of a modular storage unit.
Axonometrics of the unit programmes.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面保留舊廠房的環狀配置，並在中央置入工坊、工作室與倉儲。模組化的倉儲塔用來存放材料，並能依不同用途重新組合。
captions: 平面圖與典型單元平面。
模組化倉儲單元模型。
各單元機能的軸測圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Timber truss frames carry the new roofs and can be taken apart and rebuilt. The long section shows making, display and storage linked along one continuous route.
captions: Section of the structural system.
Detail section of the timber truss frame.
Axonometric long section.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 木桁架支撐新的屋頂，並可拆解後再重新組裝。長剖面呈現製作、展示與倉儲沿著一條連續路徑串連在一起。
captions: 結構系統剖面。
木桁架的細部剖面。
軸測長剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the existing building.
2. Cut and lift before adding.
3. Design parts that can move.
4. Build so it can be rebuilt.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先讀懂既有建築。
2. 先切開抬升再加建。
3. 設計可移動的構件。
4. 讓建造可以重來。

pins.title: Red Line Habitat: A Mars Outpost
pins.description:
A speculative modular habitat and observation outpost for Mars.

Mars | Speculative design | Planetary outpost | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 紅線棲居：火星前哨
zh-Hant.description:
為火星構想的模組化棲居地與觀測前哨。

火星｜推想設計｜行星前哨｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The habitat tower rising through stacked rings.
穿越層層環狀結構升起的棲居塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: This speculative proposal imagines an observation outpost and habitat on Mars. It asks how people could build and live in a place with thin air, dust and extreme cold.
captions: Line drawing of the habitat structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個推想式提案想像一座位於火星的觀測前哨與棲居地。專案追問在空氣稀薄、沙塵與極寒的環境中，人類如何建造並生活。
captions: 棲居結構的線稿。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The habitat is broken into modules, some for orbit and some for the ground. Each module has a clear task, such as docking, farming, storage or living.
captions: Modules for the orbital platform.
Modules for the surface base.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 棲居地被拆解為多個模組，部分在軌道上，部分在地表。每個模組都有明確任務，例如對接、種植、倉儲或居住。
captions: 軌道平台的模組。
地表基地的模組。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A flow diagram links the modules into one assembly sequence from orbit to the ground. Arrows mark how each module connects to the next one.
captions: Assembly flow linking the modules.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 流程圖把各模組串成一條從軌道到地表的組裝順序。箭頭標示每個模組如何接續下一個模組。
captions: 串連各模組的組裝流程。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Simulation stills show cable robots putting the platform together step by step. The three stills compare the platform at different moments of the build.
captions: Simulation stills of robotic assembly.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模擬畫面呈現纜索機器人一步步組裝平台。三張畫面比較平台在組裝過程中不同時刻的狀態。
captions: 機器人組裝的模擬畫面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the hardest condition.
2. Break the system into modules.
3. Give each part one job.
4. Show how it gets built.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從最嚴苛的條件開始。
2. 把系統拆成模組。
3. 讓每個部分只做一件事。
4. 說明它如何被建造。

pins.title: Post-Arctic Waterfront
pins.description:
A phased public wetland that filters water and builds habitat on an Arctic shore.

Longyearbyen, Svalbard | Landscape | Coastal wetland | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 後北極水岸
zh-Hant.description:
在北極海岸過濾水質、營造棲地的分期公共濕地。

斯瓦巴群島朗伊爾城｜地景｜海岸濕地｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Map of the coastal waterfront with tide and flow charts.
海岸水岸地圖與潮汐、水流圖表。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: An Arctic harbour town faces melting ground, rising water and growing tourism along its shore. The project turns the waterfront into a phased public wetland that filters water and makes new habitat.
captions: Drawing of the Arctic context.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座北極港灣小鎮正面對凍土融化、水位上升與沿岸觀光增加的壓力。專案把水岸轉化為分期發展的公共濕地，用來過濾水質並營造新的棲地。
captions: 北極區域脈絡圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sediment tests study how mud and gravel settle in water over time. Three sea-level scenarios show how the shore could change in the coming decades.
captions: Sediment settling tests.
Sea-level scenarios for the shore.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 沉積實驗研究泥沙與碎石如何隨時間在水中沉降。三個海平面情境呈現海岸在未來數十年可能出現的變化。
captions: 泥沙沉降實驗。
海岸的海平面變化情境。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Landscape blocks test outflow, sedimentation, filtration and water storage in several stages. Each stage lets the planting grow a little further into the bay.
captions: Landscape process phases.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 地景模塊分階段測試出流、沉積、過濾與儲水。每一個階段都讓植栽再往海灣多延伸一些。
captions: 地景過程的分期。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A system diagram links filtering, habitat and visitor routes into one public landscape. Birds, plants and people share a soft shoreline instead of a hard edge.
captions: System diagram of the wetland.
Species and the shoreline profile.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 系統圖把過濾、棲地與遊客路線串連成一片公共地景。鳥類、植物與人共享一條柔性的海岸線，而不是堅硬的邊界。
captions: 濕地的系統圖。
物種與海岸線剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Test the material first.
2. Draw the future scenarios.
3. Grow the design in phases.
4. Share the edge with nature.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先測試材料。
2. 畫出未來的情境。
3. 分階段讓設計生長。
4. 與自然共享邊界。

pins.title: Urban Vertical Farm
pins.description:
A disused dockside flour mill reborn as a vertical farm open to the public.

London, UK | Architecture | Vertical farm | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 都市垂直農場
zh-Hant.description:
把碼頭旁的廢棄麵粉廠改造為向大眾開放的垂直農場。

英國倫敦｜建築｜垂直農場｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Exploded axonometric of the farm, leisure and market spaces.
農場、休閒與市集空間的爆炸軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A large disused flour mill stands empty beside the old docks of east London. The project turns it into an urban vertical farm that grows fresh food and opens the building to the public.
captions: Axonometric of the existing mill.
Location map of the docks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座廢棄的大型麵粉廠閒置在倫敦東區的舊碼頭旁。專案把它轉化為都市垂直農場，既生產新鮮食物，也讓建築重新向大眾開放。
captions: 既有磨坊的軸測圖。
碼頭區位圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A strategy map links cultivation, education, business and environment into one loop. Rainwater and river water are filtered and stored to feed the planting.
captions: Strategy map of the farm.
Water circulation system.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 策略圖把種植、教育、商業與環境串成一個循環。雨水與河水經過過濾與儲存後，用來灌溉植栽。
captions: 垂直農場的策略圖。
水循環系統。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Staff routes, visitor routes and water pipes are layered through every floor. Each crop gets its own planting method, light level and growing equipment.
captions: Functional system of routes and water.
Planting types and equipment.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 員工動線、訪客動線與水管系統逐層穿過每一個樓層。每一種作物都有各自的種植方式、光照條件與栽培設備。
captions: 動線與水系統的功能分析。
植栽類型與設備。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Two long sections show the farm floors, gardens and water tanks working together inside the old frame. A physical model tests the new structure set into the existing mill.
captions: Long section one.
Long section two.
Physical model of the mill.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 兩張長剖面呈現農場樓層、花園與水箱如何在舊結構中協同運作。實體模型則檢驗新結構嵌入既有磨坊的方式。
captions: 長剖面一。
長剖面二。
磨坊的實體模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the old building first.
2. Draw the full resource loop.
3. Layer routes and water together.
4. Test the insertion in a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先閱讀舊建築。
2. 畫出完整的資源循環。
3. 把動線與水系統疊合在一起。
4. 用模型檢驗新舊結合。

pins.title: From Shelter to Community
pins.description:
A former airport refugee camp rethought as a lasting community.

Berlin, Germany | Architecture | Community housing | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 從庇護所到社區
zh-Hant.description:
把前機場的難民營重新思考為長久的社區。

德國柏林｜建築｜社區住宅｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Axonometric of the self-sustaining community around the terminal ring.
環繞航廈環形建築的自給社區軸測圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A closed city airport holds large empty halls and open land at the edge of Berlin. The project rethinks a temporary refugee camp there as a lasting community with homes, work and shared life.
captions: Site map and terrain studies.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座已關閉的城市機場在柏林邊緣留下大片空置的航廈與空地。專案把那裡的臨時難民營重新思考為一個長久的社區，結合住所、工作與共同生活。
captions: 基地地圖與地形分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Prefabricated modular homes are studied as a base unit that families can assemble quickly. Several plan types grow from single rooms to larger households over time.
captions: Modular house plan types.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究以預製模組住宅作為家庭可以快速組裝的基本單元。多種平面類型可以隨時間從單人房間擴展為較大的家庭住宅。
captions: 模組住宅的平面類型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The plans place a market, study areas, a public park, a church and a mosque inside and around the ring. Shared buildings use arches and domes to give each gathering place its own character.
captions: First and second floor plans.
Render of a domed prayer hall.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面在環形建築內外配置市集、學習區、公園、教堂與清真寺。公共建築以拱圈與圓頂，讓每一個聚集場所都有自己的性格。
captions: 一樓與二樓平面圖。
圓頂禮拜堂的渲染圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Two long sections show the craft workshops, homes and market stalls set under the old terminal roof. Physical models test the timber market frame and the stacked modular houses.
captions: Long section one.
Long section two.
Model of the market frame.
Model of the modular houses.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 兩張長剖面呈現手作工坊、住宅與市集攤位如何安置在舊航廈屋頂下。實體模型則檢驗木構市集框架與堆疊的模組住宅。
captions: 長剖面一。
長剖面二。
市集框架模型。
模組住宅模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the people who will live there.
2. Design one unit that can grow.
3. Give shared places a clear identity.
4. Test the system in models.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從將要居住的人出發。
2. 設計一個可以生長的單元。
3. 讓公共場所擁有清楚的識別。
4. 用模型檢驗整個系統。

pins.title: Tangjia Bay Reborn
pins.description:
A mangrove reserve and shoreline museum that help an endangered seagrass recover.

Zhuhai, China | Landscape | Coastal restoration | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 唐家灣重生
zh-Hant.description:
以紅樹林保護區與海岸博物館協助瀕危海草復育。

中國珠海｜地景｜海岸復育｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Cutaway section of the shoreline museum among the mangroves.
紅樹林間海岸博物館的剖透視圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: An endangered seagrass along the shore of Tangjia Bay is fading under intensive human activity. The project restores the living shoreline with a mangrove reserve and a small public museum.
captions: Location map of the bay.
Analysis of the surrounding coast.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 唐家灣沿岸一種瀕危海草在密集的人為活動下逐漸消失。專案以紅樹林保護區與一座小型公共博物館，修復這條有生命的海岸線。
captions: 海灣區位圖。
周邊海岸分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: An ecological drawing maps how birds, fish, crabs and plants depend on the mangrove. Planting mangroves first is used to calm the water and hold sediment for the seagrass.
captions: Ecological relationship drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 生態關係圖描繪鳥類、魚類、螃蟹與植物如何依賴紅樹林。先種植紅樹林，可以讓水流趨緩並留住泥沙，為海草創造生長條件。
captions: 生態關係圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Curving paths and boardwalks thread through planted islands across the reserve. The museum sits at the edge with exhibition rooms, a café and open decks facing the water.
captions: Master plan axonometric.
Landscape plan of the reserve.
Museum floor plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 彎曲的步道與棧道穿梭在保護區的植栽島之間。博物館位於邊緣，配置展覽室、咖啡廳與面向水面的開放平台。
captions: 總體配置軸測圖。
保護區地景平面圖。
博物館平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Sections compare the young saplings in the first year with a denser mangrove five years later. A physical model shows the timber roofs and boardwalks floating over the restored water.
captions: Sections in the first year and later.
Long section through the mangrove.
Physical model of the museum.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖面比較第一年剛種下的幼苗與五年後更茂密的紅樹林。實體模型呈現木構屋頂與棧道漂浮在修復後的水面上。
captions: 第一年與數年後的剖面。
穿越紅樹林的長剖面。
博物館的實體模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one species at risk.
2. Map the whole ecosystem.
3. Let landscape lead the building.
4. Draw the site over time.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個瀕危物種開始。
2. 畫出整個生態系統。
3. 讓地景引導建築。
4. 畫出基地隨時間的變化。

pins.title: Urban Living Room
pins.description:
A district art museum extended and renovated as a living room for the city.

Shenzhen, China | Architecture | Museum renovation | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市客廳
zh-Hant.description:
把區級美術館擴建改造為城市的客廳。

中國深圳｜建築｜美術館改造｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Cutaway of the old and new galleries.
新舊展廳的剖透視圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A district art museum in dense Shenzhen mostly draws parents with young children and feels closed to the street. The project extends and renovates it as an urban living room for everyday public life.
captions: Axonometric of the existing building.
Site and context maps.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳高密度城區中的一座區級美術館，觀眾多為家長與幼童，對街道也顯得封閉。專案透過擴建與改造，把它變成服務日常公共生活的城市客廳。
captions: 既有建築的軸測圖。
基地與周邊脈絡圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Local opera groups, office workers, young people and older residents are studied as new audiences. The strategy links immersion, flexibility and activation through markets, a park and an outdoor theatre.
captions: Museum activation strategy.
Early concept sketch.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 研究把在地戲曲團體、上班族、年輕人與年長居民視為新的觀眾。策略以市集、公園與戶外劇場，串連沉浸、彈性與活化三個目標。
captions: 美術館活化策略。
早期概念草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The form grows from the existing block through an extension, a viewing platform and a sunken plaza. A green roof and a sloping garden route lift the public realm above the street.
captions: Form evolution diagrams.
Aerial render of the extension.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 量體從既有建築出發，依序加入擴建、觀景平台與下沉廣場。綠色屋頂與坡道花園路徑，把公共空間抬升到街道之上。
captions: 量體演變圖。
擴建的鳥瞰渲染圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Five gallery types range from the preserved old hall to a sculpture garden and an exploratory gallery. Calm classic rooms sit beside open and changing spaces so the museum serves many kinds of visits.
captions: Diagrams of the five gallery types.
