Render of a classic gallery.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 五種展廳類型，從保留的舊展廳到雕塑花園與探索式展廳。安靜的經典展室與開放多變的空間並置，讓美術館能容納各種參觀方式。
captions: 五種展廳類型的分析圖。
經典展廳的渲染圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask who is missing today.
2. Turn each audience into a space.
3. Grow the form step by step.
4. Mix calm and lively rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先問今天誰沒有來。
2. 把每一種觀眾轉化為空間。
3. 一步步發展量體。
4. 讓安靜與活潑的空間並置。

pins.title: House in Nesso
pins.description:
A lakeside house on a steep slope, shaped by climate simulations.

Nesso, Italy | Architecture | Climate-responsive house | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 內索湖畔住宅
zh-Hant.description:
一棟依氣候模擬塑形的陡坡湖畔住宅。

義大利內索｜建築｜氣候回應住宅｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Section showing sun paths and airflow through the house.
呈現日照與氣流穿越住宅的剖面圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A small single-family house sits on a steep slope above Lake Como in northern Italy. The brief asks how the form can answer the local climate instead of relying on machines.
captions: Local climate and lake breeze analysis.
Site location from region to slope.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一棟小型獨棟住宅，位於義大利北部科莫湖畔的陡坡上。設計題目是讓建築形體回應在地氣候，而不是依賴機械設備。
captions: 在地氣候與湖風分析。
從區域到坡地的基地位置圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Gable, flat and curved roofs in several orientations are tested with thermal simulations for the hottest and coldest days. An east-west gable roof gives the lowest indoor peak and becomes the base for a second round.
captions: First round of roof performance tests.
Second round comparing gable and hipped variants.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以熱環境模擬，在最熱與最冷的日子測試不同朝向的山牆屋頂、平屋頂與曲面屋頂。東西向山牆屋頂的室內峰值溫度最低，成為第二輪測試的基礎。
captions: 第一輪屋頂性能測試。
第二輪比較山牆與四坡屋頂變化。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Airflow simulations check how valley and lake breezes move around the chosen volume. Deep roof overhangs and solar panels on the roof and boundary walls are then tuned to the western sun.
captions: Airflow simulation around the house.
Second section through the slope.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 氣流模擬檢查山谷風與湖風如何繞過選定的量體。接著依西向日照調整深遠的屋簷，以及屋頂與邊牆上的太陽能板。
captions: 住宅周邊的氣流模擬。
穿越坡地的第二道剖面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The house turns west toward the lake and steps across three floors on the slope. Shading, cross-ventilation and solar energy work together to keep the rooms comfortable with less energy.
captions: Site plan.
Plans of the three floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 住宅面西朝向湖面，沿坡地分為三層。遮陽、對流通風與太陽能共同作用，以較少的能源維持室內舒適。
captions: 配置圖。
三個樓層的平面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the local climate first.
2. Test simple roof options.
3. Keep the best one and refine it.
4. Let the section carry the idea.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先讀懂在地氣候。
2. 測試簡單的屋頂選項。
3. 保留最佳方案並深化。
4. 讓剖面承載設計概念。

pins.title: Dongshan Bus Station
pins.description:
A small bus station with a folded canopy in an old Guangzhou quarter.

Guangzhou, China | Architecture | Bus station | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 東山公車站
zh-Hant.description:
廣州老街區中一座帶有折板頂篷的小型公車站。

中國廣州｜建築｜公車站｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial render of the station and its folded canopy.
車站與折板頂篷的鳥瞰渲染圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Dongshankou in Guangzhou is an old residential quarter that mixes Eastern and Western building styles and has recently become a social media hotspot. The project asks how a small bus station can respond to this crowded image of the place.
captions: Volume studies from floor to main structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州東山口是融合中西建築風格的老住宅區，近年成為社群媒體上的熱門地點。專案思考一座小型公車站，如何回應這個被大量影像包圍的場所。
captions: 從樓層到主結構的量體研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student reads the district as a mix of the real street and its online image. Floors are stacked as varied blocks and then tied together by a simple frame.
captions: Isometric drawing of the station.
Selection of floor plates and materials.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生把街區解讀為真實街道與網路影像的混合。各樓層以不同的量塊堆疊，再由簡潔的框架串連起來。
captions: 車站的等角透視圖。
樓板與材質的選擇。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A beam and column grid holds the stacked rooms and a folded canopy above them. Bus bays sit on the ground floor while the upper floors open to the street.
captions: Beam and column construction.
Plans of the four floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 梁柱網格承托堆疊的房間與上方的折板頂篷。公車停靠位設在地面層，上層樓面則向街道開放。
captions: 梁柱構造。
四個樓層的平面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Street views show the canopy as a strange flash above the old lanes at night. By day the station reads as a light marker that invites people in from the street.
captions: Night view from the west street.
View from the fourth floor.
Street view of the station.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 街景圖中，頂篷在夜晚的老街上方如同一道奇異的閃光。白天車站則像一個輕盈的地標，邀請行人從街上進入。
captions: 西側街道的夜景。
四樓視角。
車站街景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read both the street and its image.
2. Stack simple blocks first.
3. Tie them with one clear frame.
4. Test the idea in street views.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 同時閱讀街道與它的影像。
2. 先堆疊簡單的量塊。
3. 以一套清楚的框架串連。
4. 用街景檢驗概念。

pins.title: Campus District Reformation
pins.description:
Looping public routes that open a closed campus to its city.

Guangzhou, China | Landscape urbanism | Campus district | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 校園街區再造
zh-Hant.description:
以環狀公共路徑把封閉校園向城市打開。

中國廣州｜地景都市主義｜校園街區｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Overhead perspective of the new campus district.
新校園街區的俯瞰透視圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A university district in Guangzhou presents itself as a symbol of progress, yet its campus is closed and cut off from the city around it. The project asks how planning can open this gap between the official image and everyday space.
captions: Industrial and public service heat maps.
Landscape analysis of the district.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州的一處大學街區以進步的象徵自居，校園卻封閉且與周邊城市隔絕。專案探問規劃如何打開官方形象與日常空間之間的落差。
captions: 產業與公共服務熱度圖。
街區的地景分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student maps industry, public services and green space to find where the campus and the city could meet. Three kinds of lines from philosophy, rigid, supple and flight, become a way to turn these readings into space.
captions: Site plan with the new routes.
Studies of rigid, supple and flight lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生分析產業、公共服務與綠地，找出校園與城市可以相遇的地方。哲學中的剛性線、柔性線與逃逸線，成為把分析轉化為空間的方法。
captions: 加入新路徑的配置圖。
剛性線、柔性線與逃逸線的研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Looping corridors lift public routes over roads and link campus buildings, parks and the waterfront. A layered section stacks academic, public and natural levels across the district.
captions: Corridor structure.
Field structure logic of order and conflict.
Stereoscopic structure of the layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 環狀廊道把公共路徑抬升越過道路，串連校園建築、公園與水岸。分層剖面把學術、公共與自然三個層次疊合在街區之中。
captions: 廊道結構。
秩序與衝突的場域結構邏輯。
各層次的立體結構。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The plan turns the closed campus into a network of shared paths, gardens and gathering places. Views of a waterfront chapel and a central park show the calm everyday spaces it creates.
captions: Waterfront chapel.
Central park after the rain.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 方案把封閉的校園轉化為共享路徑、花園與聚集場所的網絡。水岸禮拜堂與中央公園的視角，呈現它所創造的寧靜日常空間。
captions: 水岸禮拜堂。
雨後的中央公園。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Compare the image with the ground.
2. Map what the city already has.
3. Use a concept to draw lines.
4. Show the result as daily life.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 比較形象與真實場地。
2. 盤點城市既有的資源。
3. 用概念來畫出路徑。
4. 以日常生活呈現成果。

pins.title: Rooftop Farm in an Urban Village
pins.description:
A light rooftop farm frame that brings light and nature to an urban village.

Shenzhen, China | Urban design | Urban village rooftop | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城中村屋頂農場
zh-Hant.description:
以輕盈的屋頂農場框架，為城中村帶來光線與自然。

中國深圳｜都市設計｜城中村屋頂｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A rooftop farm frame rising above the lanes of an urban village.
在城中村巷弄上方升起的屋頂農場框架。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Urban villages in Shenzhen are dense, dark and left out of formal planning. Many residents live in rooms with little sunlight, few shared spaces and almost no contact with nature.
captions: Regulatory planning map of the city.
Sections of village life by day and night.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 深圳的城中村密集、昏暗，長期被排除在正式規劃之外。許多居民住在缺乏日照與共享空間、幾乎接觸不到自然的房間裡。
captions: 城市的控制性規劃圖。
城中村日夜生活的剖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student compares problems inside the village with possible fixes such as shared rooms, greenery and rooftop light. Sunlight studies show that the rooftop is the brightest and most natural place left in the village.
captions: Problem and solution diagrams.
Sunlight, city texture and field studies.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生把城中村內部的問題與可能的對策對照，例如共享空間、綠化與屋頂採光。日照分析顯示，屋頂是城中村裡最明亮、也最接近自然的地方。
captions: 問題與對策分析圖。
日照、城市肌理與場域研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A light steel frame is added on top of existing buildings, with a roof that collects rainwater and modules for planting. Simple joints let the parts be assembled and grown step by step.
captions: Structure, water and planting systems.
Material axonometric of the rooftop frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在既有建築頂部加建輕鋼框架，屋頂收集雨水，並配置種植模組。簡單的接頭讓構件可以逐步組裝與擴展。
captions: 結構、水與種植系統。
屋頂框架的材料軸測圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Folded canopies spread across the rooftops and form a shared farm above the lanes. Residents gain bright rooms for growing food, resting and meeting neighbours.
captions: Rooftop canopies across the village.
Shared rooftop room.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 折板頂篷在屋頂之間延展，在巷弄上方形成共享農場。居民因此獲得明亮的空間，可以種植、休息並與鄰居相遇。
captions: 橫跨城中村的屋頂頂篷。
共享的屋頂空間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find what daily life lacks.
2. Look for unused light and space.
3. Design a kit that can grow.
4. Show it in real streets.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出日常生活缺少什麼。
2. 尋找被閒置的光線與空間。
3. 設計一套可以生長的構件。
4. 在真實街道中呈現成果。

pins.title: Turning Waste Into Treasure
pins.description:
A waste transfer station reborn as a public recycling exhibition hall.

Guangzhou, China | Architecture | Waste transfer station | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 變廢為寶
zh-Hant.description:
將垃圾轉運站改造為公共回收展覽館。

中國廣州｜建築設計｜垃圾轉運站｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The renewed waste transfer station on a busy city street.
位於繁忙街道上、經過改造的垃圾轉運站。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: An old waste transfer station sits in the middle of a historic shopping and tourist district in Guangzhou. Its single treatment method and strong smell cut it off from the schools and attractions around it.
captions: Site axonometric with nearby schools, community and attractions.
Design vision and recycling process.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座老舊的垃圾轉運站位於廣州歷史商業與觀光街區的中心。單一的處理方式與強烈異味，使它與周邊的學校和景點隔絕。
captions: 標示周邊學校、社區與景點的基地軸測圖。
設計願景與回收流程。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student maps how each kind of waste is collected, sorted and processed. These flows become the strategy that separates dirty work from clean public space.
captions: Graded waste disposal process.
Design strategy and concept models.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生梳理每一種垃圾的收集、分類與處理流程。這些流線成為將作業區與潔淨公共空間分開的設計策略。
captions: 分級垃圾處理流程。
設計策略與概念模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The volume is stacked floor by floor, with trucks and pipes feeding waste into a central core. Visitors walk around this core and watch the sorting process through glass.
captions: Form generation steps.
Garbage transport by truck in the first phase.
Waste classification floors around the core.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 量體逐層堆疊，卡車與管道把垃圾送入中央核心。參觀者環繞核心行走，隔著玻璃觀看分類過程。
captions: 量體生成步驟。
第一階段以卡車運送垃圾。
環繞核心的垃圾分類樓層。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The station becomes a public science hall where recycling is shown as an exhibition. Handmade modules let visitors turn sorted material into new objects.
captions: Handmade module models.
Long section through the station.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 轉運站成為一座公共科普展館，把回收過程當作展覽呈現。手作模組讓參觀者把分類後的材料轉化為新物件。
captions: 手作模組模型。
轉運站長向剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Follow the flow of material.
2. Separate dirty and clean paths.
3. Let people see the process.
4. Turn a problem into a public place.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 追蹤材料的流向。
2. 分開髒污與潔淨的動線。
3. 讓人看見處理過程。
4. 把問題轉化為公共場所。

pins.title: Haizhu Lake Wetland Museum Hub
pins.description:
An ecological renewal that turns a lake front plaza into a wetland museum hub.

Guangzhou, China | Urban design | Wetland museum | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 海珠湖濕地博物館樞紐
zh-Hant.description:
把湖畔前廣場轉化為濕地博物館樞紐的生態更新。

中國廣州｜都市設計｜濕地博物館｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The wetland museum hub on the lake front plaza.
位於湖畔前廣場的濕地博物館樞紐。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The front plaza of a city lake in Guangzhou is underused and lacks shops and public amenities. Its wetland ecology is also weakly connected to the busy new district around it.
captions: Site analysis of the lake, wildlife and access.
Space types mixing wetland, lawn and buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 廣州一座城市湖泊的前廣場使用率低，缺乏商業與公共設施。它的濕地生態也與周邊繁忙的新城區連結薄弱。
captions: 湖泊、生物與交通的基地分析。
混合濕地、草坪與建築的空間類型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studies the current plants, water edges and how people move across the plaza. A layered landscape of canopy, wetland and water becomes the base of the design.
captions: Current plant status and layered landscape.
Form derivation in six steps.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究現有植栽、水岸以及人們穿越廣場的方式。由樹冠、濕地與水域組成的分層地景，成為設計的基礎。
captions: 現有植栽狀況與分層地景。
六個步驟的形體推演。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The building sinks into the ground and opens toward the lake in curved terraces. Shops, a gym and a wetland exhibition hall are linked by ramps and vertical paths.
captions: Exploded axonometric of programs and circulation.
Floor plans from basement to upper level.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 建築下沉入地面，以弧形平台向湖面展開。商店、健身空間與濕地展覽館由坡道和垂直動線相互連接。
captions: 功能與動線的爆炸軸測圖。
從地下層到上層的各層平面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Green terraces and trails let visitors move from the city edge down to the water. A wetland museum hangs over the lake so people can watch birds and plants up close.
captions: Bird's-eye view from the city side.
Section through the wetland museum.
Physical model of the project.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 綠色平台與步道讓參觀者從城市邊緣一路走到水邊。濕地博物館懸挑於湖面上，讓人近距離觀察鳥類與植物。
captions: 從城市一側看的鳥瞰圖。
濕地博物館剖面。
專案實體模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the ecology of the site.
2. Map how people move.
3. Shape the ground, not just the building.
4. Test it in a physical model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 閱讀基地的生態。
2. 描繪人們的移動方式。
3. 塑造地面，而不只是建築。
4. 用實體模型檢驗。

pins.title: Occupying the Void
pins.description:
A vertical logistics and greenhouse frame that revives a historic fruit market.

Hong Kong | Architecture | Market adaptive reuse | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 佔據虛空
zh-Hant.description:
以垂直物流與溫室框架，活化一座歷史果欄。

香港｜建築設計｜市場活化再利用｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A new structure rises above the historic fruit market roofs.
新結構在歷史果欄的屋頂上方升起。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A historic fruit market in Hong Kong works mostly at night, and its trucks crowd the narrow streets. During the day much of its space stands empty while the area around it is very dense.
captions: Site analysis of the market blocks and streets.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 香港一座歷史果欄主要在夜間運作，貨車塞滿狹窄的街道。白天大部分空間閒置，而周邊地區卻極度密集。
captions: 果欄街區與街道的基地分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student records how goods, trucks and traders move through a full week. A time and cost study shows how the night delivery cycle could be sorted by floor.
captions: Nighttime distribution cycle in section.
Truck routes to the loading floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生記錄一整週貨物、貨車與商販的移動方式。時間與成本研究顯示，夜間配送流程可以按樓層加以分流。
captions: 夜間配送流程剖面。
通往各裝卸樓層的貨車路線。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A vertical frame stacks loading, parking and cold storage above the old market without touching its structure. A greenhouse farm and retail floor sit on top under a light glass shell.
captions: Plans from loading area to greenhouse farm.
Layers of the greenhouse shell.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一個垂直框架在舊市場上方堆疊裝卸、停車與冷藏空間，而不觸碰原有結構。頂層在輕盈的玻璃外殼下設置溫室農場與零售空間。
captions: 從裝卸區到溫室農場的各層平面。
溫室外殼的構造層次。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The market keeps its historic halls while gaining new space for logistics and public life. Clear targets show expected gains in traffic, land use, food waste and noise.
captions: Long section through the market and new frame.
Cross section toward the street.
Key metrics and improvement targets.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 果欄保留了歷史建築，同時獲得物流與公共生活的新空間。明確的指標呈現交通、土地利用、廚餘與噪音方面的預期改善。
captions: 穿越市場與新框架的長向剖面。
朝向街道的橫向剖面。
關鍵指標與改善目標。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a place over time.
2. Find the empty hours.
3. Add without erasing.
4. Measure what changes.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從時間面向研究場所。
2. 找出閒置的時段。
3. 加建而不抹除。
4. 衡量改變了什麼。

pins.title: Healing Anchor
pins.description:
An old agricultural machinery factory adapted into a care campus for older residents.

Jiangmen, China | Architecture | Adaptive reuse for elderly care | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 療癒錨點
zh-Hant.description:
將舊農業機械廠改造為長者照護園區。

中國江門｜建築設計｜長照活化再利用｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The old factory reborn among blossoming trees.
在繁花樹木間重生的舊工廠。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A disused agricultural machinery factory in Jiangmen sits in an area with a fast-ageing population. Older residents lack nearby places for care, social life and medical support.
captions: Site analysis with nearby health facilities.
Urban regeneration options for the factory blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 江門一座廢棄的農業機械廠，位於人口快速老化的地區。年長居民附近缺乏照護、社交與醫療支援的場所。
captions: 標示周邊醫療設施的基地分析。
工廠街廓的都市再生方案。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studies the factory layout, local demographics and how older people use the area each day. These findings shape a plan that keeps the industrial halls and adds care uses.
captions: Planning flow across the factory area.
Regenerative synergy between heritage and wellness.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究工廠配置、在地人口結構，以及長者每天如何使用這個地區。這些發現形成一個保留工業廠房並加入照護功能的計畫。
captions: 整個廠區的規劃流程。
工業遺產與健康照護的再生協同。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The ground floor becomes a senior activity space with gardens and a winding water path. Upper floors hold a high-care hub and assisted living rooms linked by a second-floor walkway.
captions: Ground floor senior activity space.
Second floor high-care hub.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一樓成為長者活動空間，配有花園與蜿蜒的水景步道。上層設置高度照護中心與協助生活住房，並以二樓連廊相連。
captions: 一樓長者活動空間。
二樓高度照護中心。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The factory turns into a care campus where daily life, nursing and community meet. Unit plans show rooms sized for different levels of care.
captions: Third floor assisted living.
High-care and intermediate care unit plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 工廠轉化為一座照護園區，讓日常生活、護理與社區交會。單元平面呈現對應不同照護等級的房間尺度。
captions: 三樓協助生活樓層。
高度照護與中度照護單元平面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from who will live there.
2. Keep what the place remembers.
3. Plan care as daily life.
4. Check every room at human scale.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從誰會住在這裡開始。
2. 保留場所的記憶。
3. 把照護規劃成日常生活。
4. 以人的尺度檢視每個房間。

pins.title: The Wave
pins.description:
A woven bamboo pavilion that people can climb, touch and plant in.

Taiwan | Installation | Bamboo pavilion | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 浪
zh-Hant.description:
一座可攀爬、觸摸與種植的編織竹構亭。

台灣｜裝置設計｜竹構亭｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Elevation of the woven bamboo pavilion.
編織竹構亭的立面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The brief asks for a temporary installation in an outdoor museum plaza. The student wants it to be more than a shade, a place people can climb, touch and live with.
captions: Pavilion views from different angles.
Location analysis of bamboo resources.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 任務要求在戶外美術館廣場設計一座臨時裝置。學生希望它不只是遮蔽物，而是人們可以攀爬、觸摸並與之共處的場所。
captions: 不同角度的亭子視圖。
竹材資源的區位分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studies a traditional pressure-one-pick-one bamboo weaving technique. Simple triangle units are tested and grown into larger structural parts.
captions: Evolution of unit components.
Evolution of larger components.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究傳統的「壓一挑一」竹編技法。簡單的三角單元經過測試，再發展成更大的結構構件。
captions: 單元構件的演變。
大型構件的演變。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Planting units with soil and small plants are woven into the bamboo frame. A series of models refines the canopy shape step by step.
captions: Planting units of plants, soil and bamboo.
Model evolution toward the final form.
Steps for bamboo weaving.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 含土壤與小型植物的種植單元被編入竹構框架中。一系列模型逐步修正頂篷的形態。
captions: 由植物、土壤與竹材組成的種植單元。
邁向最終形態的模型演變。
竹編步驟。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final wave is a self-supporting bamboo shell with stairs and platforms inside. Tested node joints show how the parts are tied together by hand.
captions: Partial view of the woven structure.
Node construction and joint tests.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的波浪是一座自承重竹殼，內部設有樓梯與平台。經過測試的節點顯示構件如何以手工綁接。
captions: 編織結構的局部視圖。
節點構造與接頭測試。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Learn a craft by hand.
2. Turn it into a unit.
3. Grow the unit into a structure.
4. Test joints at full scale.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 親手學習一種工藝。
2. 把它轉化為單元。
3. 讓單元生長成結構。
4. 以足尺測試接點。

pins.title: Turtle Tower
pins.description:
A tower of shell-like rooms inspired by how turtles stack.

Spatial Design | Model | Shell tower | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 龜塔
zh-Hant.description:
一座受烏龜堆疊習性啟發的殼狀空間塔。

空間設計｜模型｜殼體塔｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Final model of the turtle tower.
龜塔的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student has kept turtles for years and noticed that they stack on top of each other. The project asks whether this habit of stacking for safety and sunlight can become a spatial tower.
captions: Concept drawing of stacked shell volumes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生多年飼養烏龜，觀察到牠們會彼此堆疊。這個作品探問，這種為了安全與日照而堆疊的習性，能否轉化為一座空間塔。
captions: 堆疊殼體量體的概念圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student draws the plates of shells and undersides to learn their patterns and joints. These drawings become a kit of interlocking plates.
captions: Sketches of shell and underside plates.
Sketches of shell patterns.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生描繪龜甲與腹甲的甲片，以理解其紋理與接合方式。這些圖面成為一套可互相嵌合的板片系統。
captions: 龜甲與腹甲板片的草圖。
龜甲紋理的草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Paper plates are cut to mimic shell plates, and wooden sticks form the frame that holds them. Painted panels, jelly-wax water and small stones tie the tower to a pond setting.
captions: Shell plate studies in paper and wood.
Cutting, painting and assembling the plates.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 紙板被裁切成仿龜甲的板片，木條則構成支撐它們的框架。上色的板片、果凍蠟水面與小石頭，讓塔與池塘環境相連。
captions: 以紙與木製作的甲片研究。
裁切、上色與組裝板片。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model stacks shell-like rooms on a light frame above a pond. Close views show how scale figures move through the layered shells.
captions: Close views of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型將殼狀空間堆疊在池塘上方的輕框架上。近景顯示比例人如何穿行於層層殼體之間。
captions: 模型近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch a habit in nature.
2. Draw its parts closely.
3. Turn the parts into a kit.
4. Build and test the stack.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察自然中的一種習性。
2. 細緻描繪其組成部分。
3. 把部分轉化為構件。
4. 動手搭建並測試堆疊。

pins.title: Turtle Habitat
pins.description:
A landscape model that gives turtles water, caves, grass and islands.

Landscape Design | Model | Animal habitat | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 烏龜棲地
zh-Hant.description:
一座為烏龜提供水域、洞穴、草地與島嶼的地景模型。

地景設計｜模型｜動物棲地｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Final model of the turtle habitat.
烏龜棲地的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: After years of building small habitats at home, the student asks what an ideal home for turtles could be. The design must offer water, caves, grass and islands in one landscape.
captions: Outline studies of the terrain.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 多年在家中搭建小型棲地後，學生探問烏龜理想的家是什麼樣子。設計必須在同一地景中提供水域、洞穴、草地與島嶼。
captions: 地形輪廓研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each zone is matched to a need: caves for rest, grass for basking and water for swimming. A plan sketch arranges these zones around a looping stream.
captions: Plan sketch of the habitat zones.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每個區域都對應一種需求：洞穴供休息、草地供曬背、水域供游泳。平面草圖將這些區域安排在一條環繞的溪流周圍。
captions: 棲地分區的平面草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The base terrain is shaped in clay, with caves built over a wire frame. Sand, grass powder and small shrubs are added, and wax is poured to form the water.
captions: Clay terrain with caves and islands.
Planting and water surfaces added.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 基地地形以黏土塑造，洞穴則建在鐵絲框架上。接著加入沙、草粉與小型灌木，再倒入蠟形成水面。
captions: 帶有洞穴與島嶼的黏土地形。
加上植栽與水面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model joins shallow and deep water, streams, caves and marsh into one habitat. It shows how zoning and material choices can shape a whole ecosystem.
captions: Views of water and cave spaces.
Close views of islands and caves.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型把淺水、深水、溪流、洞穴與濕地整合為一個棲地。它展示分區與材料選擇如何塑造完整的生態系統。
captions: 水域與洞穴空間的視圖。
島嶼與洞穴的近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a real need.
2. Map each need to a zone.
3. Shape the ground by hand.
4. Add material in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從真實需求出發。
2. 將每種需求對應到一個分區。
3. 親手塑造地形。
4. 分層加入材料。

pins.title: Metallic Foam Morphologies
pins.description:
Porous printed forms that turn a lab material into a home for fish.

Spatial Design | Material study | Porous habitat | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 金屬泡沫形態
zh-Hant.description:
將實驗室材料轉化為魚類棲所的多孔列印形態。

空間設計｜材料研究｜多孔棲地｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Printed porous model with small fish.
帶有小魚的列印多孔模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project grows out of a summer research study on nickel foam used to break down an antibiotic in water. The student asks how such porous materials could later return to nature as shelter for fish and other sea life.
captions: Hand-drawn diagram of the material preparation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品源自一項暑期研究，主題是用於分解水中抗生素的鎳泡沫。學生探問，這類多孔材料日後能否回到自然，成為魚類與其他海洋生物的棲身之所。
captions: 材料製備流程的手繪圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The hand-drawn diagram records each step from mixing to firing the porous structure. This lab process sets the logic of pores and channels that the design follows.
captions: Parametric script that grows the porous form.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 手繪圖記錄了從混合到燒製多孔結構的每一個步驟。這個實驗流程確立了設計所依循的孔洞與通道邏輯。
captions: 生成多孔形態的參數化程式。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A parametric script turns the foam pattern into hollow units under a hexagon cap. The units can hang alone or join into clusters like a reef.
captions: Renders of single and clustered units.
Hexagon caps seen from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 參數化程式將泡沫紋理轉化為六角形頂蓋下的中空單元。這些單元可以單獨懸掛，也可以像礁石一樣組合成群。
captions: 單一與群組單元的渲染圖。
從上方看六角形頂蓋。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The resin models are hung in water, and small fish swim in and out of the pores. The test shows how a lab material can be reshaped into a living habitat.
captions: Hanging columns in water.
Fish moving through the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 樹脂模型被懸掛在水中，小魚在孔洞間穿梭進出。這次測試展示實驗室材料如何被重塑為有生命的棲地。
captions: 水中的懸掛柱體。
在模型中穿梭的魚。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a material study.
2. Draw the process by hand.
3. Script the form.
4. Test it with living users.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從材料研究出發。
2. 親手畫出流程。
3. 以程式生成形態。
4. 與真實使用者一起測試。

pins.title: Travel Tales
pins.description:
Travel sketches cut, recombined and built into a layered landscape.

Spatial Design | Model | Landscape collage | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 旅行故事
zh-Hant.description:
將旅行速寫裁切、重組，並建構成層疊地景。

空間設計｜模型｜地景拼貼｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Final model of layered landscapes.
層疊地景的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student keeps a sketchbook on every trip and is drawn to natural landscapes. The project asks how scattered travel memories could become one three-dimensional space.
captions: Travel sketches cut and collaged into new scenes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生每次旅行都帶著速寫本，並深受自然地景吸引。這個作品探問，零散的旅行記憶能否成為一個立體空間。
captions: 旅行速寫被裁切並拼貼成新的場景。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sketches of favourite places are cut into distinct fragments and recombined into new images. Each fragment keeps one strong trait of its scene, such as layers of rock or lines of trees.
captions: Cutting and assembling board pieces.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生將喜愛地點的速寫裁切成不同碎片，再重新組合成新的畫面。每個碎片都保留其場景的一項鮮明特徵，例如岩層或樹列。
captions: 裁切與組裝板材構件。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The collages are translated into two volumes built from stacked and slotted board. Solid and void are balanced so that each volume reads as one composition.
captions: Volume one from above.
Volume one from the side.
Volume two from above.
Volume two from the side.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 拼貼被轉譯為兩個以堆疊與插接板材構成的量體。實與虛之間取得平衡，使每個量體都成為完整的構圖。
captions: 從上方看第一量體。
從側面看第一量體。
從上方看第二量體。
從側面看第二量體。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model hangs a cloud of layers over thin columns and terraced ground. Close views show how lines from the sketches become ramps, ribs and caves.
captions: Close-up views of the model.
Layered details of ground and canopy.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型將層層雲狀量體懸於細柱與階梯狀地面之上。近景顯示速寫中的線條如何化為坡道、肋片與洞穴。
captions: 模型近景。
地面與頂蓋的層疊細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Sketch what moves you.
2. Cut it into fragments.
3. Recompose a new scene.
4. Build it in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 速寫打動你的事物。
2. 將它裁切成碎片。
3. 重組出新的場景。
4. 以層疊方式建構。

pins.title: The Carbon Sink of Scars
pins.description:
An installation of three damaged habitats that absorb our carbon.

Spatial Design | Installation | Carbon sink | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 傷痕碳匯
zh-Hant.description:
以三個受損棲地構成、吸收人類碳排放的裝置。

空間設計｜裝置｜碳匯｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The three habitats joined into one installation.
三個棲地組合成一件裝置。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Oceans, forests and the atmosphere absorb most of the carbon people release. The project asks how a small installation could show both their role as carbon sinks and the damage they carry.
captions: Silent Sea: resin water over a white foam base.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 海洋、森林與大氣吸收了人類排放的大部分碳。這個作品探問，一件小型裝置如何同時呈現它們作為碳匯的角色，以及它們所承受的傷害。
captions: 沉默之海：樹脂水面覆於白色發泡底座上。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each habitat is read through one kind of harm: acidifying water, burned forest and polluted air. Industrial materials such as PVC board, wax, clay, wire and acrylic are chosen to tell that story.
captions: Carving and casting the sea model.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每個棲地都透過一種傷害來解讀：酸化的海水、焚燒的森林與污染的空氣。學生選用 PVC 板、蠟、黏土、鐵絲與壓克力等工業材料來講述這個故事。
captions: 雕刻與澆鑄海洋模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A white foam base stands for bleached coral, and a clay block with wire trees stands for a forest stripped by fire. A cotton cloud hangs over a small clay city to make the invisible air visible.
captions: Entombed Life: wire trees on a burned clay ground.
Miasma: a cotton cloud over a clay city.
Cloud studies from two angles.
The city beneath the cloud.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 白色發泡底座象徵白化的珊瑚，黏土塊與鐵絲樹則代表被大火剝奪養分的森林。棉花雲懸於小型黏土城市之上，讓看不見的空氣變得可見。
captions: 掩埋之生：焦土黏土上的鐵絲樹。
瘴氣：黏土城市上空的棉花雲。
從兩個角度觀看雲的研究。
雲層下的城市。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The three pieces sit side by side as one carbon sink at a scale of about thirty centimetres. Together they show places that sustain life while bearing the scars of human actions.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 三件作品並列為一個約三十公分尺度的碳匯。它們共同呈現了維繫生命、同時承受人類行為傷痕的場所。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a system to explain.
2. Split it into parts.
3. Give each part a material.
4. Rejoin them as one piece.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇一個要說明的系統。
2. 將它拆成幾個部分。
3. 為每個部分選擇材料。
4. 將它們重新組合成一件作品。

pins.title: Motion Morphology
pins.description:
A hurdling jump traced, lofted and hung as a spatial form.

Spatial Design | Installation | Motion study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 運動形態學
zh-Hant.description:
將一次跨欄動作描繪、放樣並懸掛成空間形態。

空間設計｜裝置｜動態研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final installation hung in space.
懸掛於空間中的最終裝置。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student trains as a hurdler and wanted to turn this movement into a spatial form. The project asks how running, leaping and landing could be held still as one object.
captions: Gesture drawings of eight frames from the jump.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生是一名跨欄選手，希望將這項運動轉化為空間形態。這個作品探問，奔跑、躍起與落地如何被凝結成單一物件。
captions: 跨欄動作中八個畫格的動態速寫。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Still frames from practice videos were studied, and six key moments of the jump were picked out. The path of each joint was traced and the frames were layered into one composite drawing.
captions: Joint paths layered across the key frames.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究練習影片中的靜止畫格，並挑選出跨欄動作中的六個關鍵瞬間。每個關節的運動路徑都被描繪下來，並疊合成一張多畫格合成圖。
captions: 關鍵畫格中疊合的關節路徑。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The limb paths were lofted into smooth curves that pass through a row of vertical panels. These curves were then thickened into ribbons that read as a trace of the body in space.
captions: Lofted curves through the panels.
The body trace cut by the panels.
Shaping the ribbons.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 四肢的路徑被放樣成平滑曲線，穿過一列垂直板片。這些曲線再被加厚成帶狀體，成為身體在空間中留下的軌跡。
captions: 穿越板片的放樣曲線。
被板片切分的身體軌跡。
塑造帶狀體。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final piece hangs panels, a frame and textured ribbons on thin wires. It turns the timing and rhythm of one jump into a ghosted memory of movement.
captions: Side view of the ribbons.
Ribbons between two panels.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終作品以細線懸掛板片、框架與帶有質感的帶狀體。它將一次跨欄的節奏與時序，轉化為一段如殘影般的運動記憶。
captions: 帶狀體側視。
兩片板片之間的帶狀體。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Film a movement you know.
2. Pick its key frames.
3. Trace the paths between them.
4. Build the paths in space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 拍攝一個你熟悉的動作。
2. 挑選它的關鍵畫格。
3. 描繪畫格之間的路徑。
4. 在空間中建構這些路徑。

pins.title: Pulling, Intersect, Arrange
pins.description:
Three spatial verbs tested in sticks and card, then joined in one hybrid model.

Spatial Design | Model | Spatial tension | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 拉伸、交錯、排列
zh-Hant.description:
以木條與紙板測試三個空間動詞，再結合成一個混合模型。

空間設計｜模型｜空間張力｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The hybrid model in card, wood sticks and PVC sheet.
以紙板、木條與 PVC 片製作的混合模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was drawn to the layered triangular geometry of a well-known pavilion. The project asks how that tension could be turned into simple actions that make space.
captions: Diagrams of pulling, intersecting and arranging.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生深受一座知名展館層疊三角幾何的吸引。這個作品探問，這種張力如何轉化為能生成空間的簡單動作。
captions: 拉伸、交錯與排列的圖解。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Three verbs were drawn out of the geometry: pulling, intersecting and arranging. Each verb was tested with wooden sticks and card in small study models.
captions: Study models of pulling.
Study models of intersecting and arranging.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生從幾何中提煉出三個動詞：拉伸、交錯與排列。每個動詞都以木條與紙板在小型研究模型中測試。
captions: 拉伸的研究模型。
交錯與排列的研究模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Of the three verbs, pulling gave the strongest sense of spatial tension and became the focus. Drawings and a tall study model pushed the stretched triangles into denser layers.
captions: Pattern drawing of stretched triangles.
Vertical study model.
Tension drawings and an elevation study.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三個動詞之中，拉伸最能表現空間張力，因此成為重點。圖面與高聳的研究模型將被拉伸的三角形推向更密集的層次。
captions: 被拉伸三角形的圖樣繪圖。
垂直研究模型。
張力繪圖與立面研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The hybrid model, about thirty-two inches long, combines all three verbs along one ground. Pulled peaks rise over intersecting frames and arranged planes to form a continuous landscape.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 約三十二英吋長的混合模型將三個動詞結合於同一基地上。被拉起的尖峰升起於交錯的框架與排列的平面之上，形成連續的地景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a form you admire.
2. Name the actions inside it.
3. Test each action in a model.
4. Combine the strongest ones.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一個你欣賞的形式。
2. 為其中的動作命名。
3. 以模型測試每個動作。
4. 結合最有力的動作。

pins.title: Echoes of the Horizon
pins.description:
A pavilion of stretched card planes over a timber frame.

Spatial Design | Pavilion | Model | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 地平線的回聲
zh-Hant.description:
在木構架上撐開紙板平面的展亭。

空間設計｜展亭｜模型｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The pavilion model in card, wood sticks and PVC sheet.
以紙板、木條與 PVC 片製作的展亭模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The pavilion grows from the pulling studies of an earlier exercise. The project asks how stretched planes could become a roof that people walk beneath.
captions: The roof planes seen from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座展亭延續自先前練習中的拉伸研究。這個作品探問，被拉伸的平面如何成為人們可在其下行走的屋頂。
captions: 從上方看屋頂平面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Thin sticks act as cables that pull folded card planes into sharp peaks. The frame below sets a raised floor and a stair so the roof can be seen from inside.
captions: Side view of the frame and roof.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 細木條如拉索般將折疊紙板拉成尖峰。下方的構架設定了抬高的樓板與樓梯，使人能從內部觀看屋頂。
captions: 構架與屋頂的側視。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The model was photographed from eye level to test the feeling of the interior. A charcoal drawing then studied light, shadow and the stair inside the space.
captions: Eye-level view inside the model.
Charcoal drawing of the interior space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生從視線高度拍攝模型，測試室內的空間感受。接著以炭筆繪圖研究空間中的光影與樓梯。
captions: 模型內部的視線高度視角。
室內空間的炭筆繪圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model is about twenty-five inches wide and eighteen inches tall. Its peaks and cables echo a horizon line seen from the raised floor.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型約二十五英吋寬、十八英吋高。其尖峰與拉索呼應從抬高樓板望出的地平線。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from an earlier study.
2. Give it a ground and a frame.
3. Look at it from eye level.
4. Draw the space you see.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從先前的研究出發。
2. 為它加上地面與構架。
3. 從視線高度觀看。
4. 畫出你看見的空間。

pins.title: Garden
pins.description:
A cliffside sculpture garden shaped through colour collages and small cuboid models.

Landscape Design | Sculpture garden | Model | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 花園
zh-Hant.description:
透過色彩拼貼與小型立方體模型塑造的崖邊雕塑花園。

景觀設計｜雕塑花園｜模型｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Small cuboid models in foam-core and card.
以泡沫板與紙板製作的小型立方體模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The brief is a sculpture garden on a cliffside site, shielded by buildings and facing the sea. The garden must hold two sculptures, one tall and one flat, set in visual contrast.
captions: Colour collage of flowing shapes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 題目是一座位於崖邊、被建築包圍且面向大海的雕塑花園。花園須容納一高一平的兩件雕塑，並形成視覺對比。
captions: 流動形狀的色彩拼貼。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A first model set out the layout and the spatial links across the site. Collages then explored texture, colour and the character of each sculpture.
captions: Collage and plan study of the garden.
A second collage and plan study.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 第一個模型先確立配置與基地中的空間關係。接著以拼貼探索質感、色彩與每件雕塑的性格。
captions: 花園的拼貼與平面研究。
第二組拼貼與平面研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Small models about two inches on each side tested how solid blocks could be carved and opened. Each cuboid tried a different balance of mass, void and surface.
captions: More cuboid studies of carving and opening.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 邊長約兩英吋的小模型測試實心量體如何被切削與打開。每個立方體都嘗試不同的量體、虛空與表面平衡。
captions: 更多切削與開口的立方體研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The work brings together visual appeal, user comfort and smooth circulation along the cliff. The collages and cuboids give the garden a clear and distinct character.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這件作品在崖邊兼顧視覺吸引力、使用者舒適度與流暢的動線。拼貼與立方體賦予花園清晰而獨特的性格。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the site and its edges.
2. Collage colour and texture.
3. Carve small blocks.
4. Set them on the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀基地與其邊界。
2. 拼貼色彩與質感。
3. 切削小型量體。
4. 將它們置於基地。

pins.title: Vertical Garden
pins.description:
A knitted wall garden where other species are invited to settle and grow.

Landscape Design | Vertical garden | Habitat | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 垂直花園
zh-Hant.description:
一面編織的牆面花園，邀請其他物種前來棲居與生長。

景觀設計｜垂直花園｜棲地｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished wall of sticks, soil, stones and plants.
以木條、土壤、石頭與植物完成的牆面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In traditional gardens, people are the only authors of the design. The project shifts the act of drawing a garden to other species and lets them choose where to settle.
captions: Natural materials collected around the community.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在傳統花園中，人類是唯一的設計者。這個作品將「繪製花園」的行為交給其他物種，讓牠們自行選擇棲居之處。
captions: 在社區周邊收集的天然材料。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Natural materials were collected nearby and sorted into small micro-environments. Tests of dry to moist soil, stone and mixes found that a soil and stone mix worked best for plant growth.
captions: Soil, stone and mixed samples at four wetness levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生在附近收集天然材料，並將其分成不同的微環境。從乾燥到濕潤的土壤、石頭與混合物測試中，發現土石混合最有利於植物生長。
captions: 四種濕度下的土壤、石頭與混合樣本。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Knitted patterns turn the wall into a habitat with zones for plants, rocky insect shelters and flowers for butterflies. Branches woven through the panels support soil health.
captions: Knitted panels with mapped habitat zones.
Panels after planting.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 編織圖樣將牆面轉化為棲地，劃分出植物、多岩昆蟲棲所與吸引蝴蝶的花卉區。穿插於板片間的枝條則維持土壤健康。
captions: 標示棲地分區的編織板片。
種植後的板片。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final wall is about forty-five inches tall and built from wooden sticks, soil, branches, stones and plants. Over time the growth on the wall records where life chose to stay.
captions: Close-up of the growing surface.
The panels during the growing process.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終牆面約四十五英吋高，以木條、土壤、枝條、石頭與植物構成。隨著時間推移，牆上的生長記錄了生命選擇停留之處。
captions: 生長表面的近景。
生長過程中的板片。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect what is nearby.
2. Test it in small samples.
3. Weave a frame for growth.
4. Let other life finish it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集身邊的材料。
2. 以小樣本測試。
3. 編織供生長的框架。
4. 讓其他生命完成它。

pins.title: Rowing
pins.description:
Hand-drawn studies that map the motion of a rowing stroke and the anatomy of the boat.

Design Drawing | Motion study | Rowing | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 划船
zh-Hant.description:
以手繪研究划船動作的節奏，以及船身與船槳的構造。

設計繪圖｜動作研究｜划船｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aquatic kinetic sketch in pencil and pen.
以鉛筆與鋼筆繪製的水上動態草圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Rowing is felt as rhythm, force and repetition, which is hard to show in a single picture. The project asks how a first-person experience of the sport can become a set of drawings.
captions: Motion studies of the stroke, first frames.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 划船的感受來自節奏、力量與重複，很難以單一畫面呈現。這個作品探問如何將第一人稱的運動經驗轉化為一組繪圖。
captions: 划槳動作研究的前段畫格。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The stroke was broken into a sequence of frames seen from above. Each frame records the angle of the oars and the position of the body in the boat.
captions: Later frames of the stroke sequence.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生將划槳動作拆解為一系列俯視畫格。每一格記錄船槳的角度與身體在船中的位置。
captions: 划槳序列的後段畫格。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The overlapping frames were layered into a kinetic sketch built with ruler and compass. A sectional drawing then studies the boat hull, rigger and oar as one connected machine.
captions: Sectional drawing of the boat and oar.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 重疊的畫格以尺規與圓規疊合成一張動態草圖。接著以剖面圖研究船身、槳架與船槳如何連成一部機械。
captions: 船身與船槳的剖面圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The series ends with a long drawing that follows the full sweep of the oar. Together the sheets turn a physical sport into a precise record of motion and structure.
captions: Sectional drawing of the oar sweep.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 系列以一張追蹤船槳完整划幅的長幅繪圖作結。這些圖面將一項身體運動轉化為精確的動作與構造紀錄。
captions: 船槳划幅的剖面圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a lived experience.
2. Break motion into frames.
3. Layer the frames into one drawing.
4. Draw the object that makes the motion.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從親身經驗出發。
2. 將動作拆成畫格。
3. 把畫格疊成一張圖。
4. 畫出產生動作的物件。

pins.title: Rhythm
pins.description:
Plastic rod and tracing paper models that map the rhythm and force of a rowing arm.

Model Making | Kinetic structure | Rowing | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 節奏
zh-Hant.description:
以塑膠桿與描圖紙模型，描繪划船手臂的節奏與力量。

模型製作｜動態結構｜划船｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Model of rowing kinetic synergy in plastic strips and bamboo cane.
以塑膠條與竹籤製作的划船動態協同模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project analyses the motion of the arm during a rowing stroke. It maps rhythm, amplitude and force as a structure rather than a picture.
captions: Three early study models.
Drawing of the arm through the stroke.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品分析划船時手臂的動作。它將節奏、幅度與力量轉化為結構，而非單純的圖像。
captions: 三個早期研究模型。
划槳過程中手臂的繪圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A line drawing traces the arm through each stage of the stroke. Early study models test how frames of the movement can be joined in space.
captions: Arm structure model, first view.
Arm structure model, second view.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 線描圖追蹤手臂在划槳各階段的位置。早期研究模型則測試動作的各個畫格如何在空間中連結。
captions: 手臂結構模型，第一視角。
手臂結構模型，第二視角。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Plastic rods simulate the skeletal structure of the arm, held together with nylon cable ties. Layers of tracing paper reveal how the volume of the arm changes as it moves.
captions: The arm structure model in full.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 塑膠桿模擬手臂的骨骼結構，並以尼龍束帶固定。多層描圖紙則顯示手臂在動作中體積的變化。
captions: 手臂結構模型全貌。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model joins the plastic arm structure to a woven bamboo base. It reads as one body that holds the rhythm of the whole stroke.
captions: The synergy model held by hand.
Detail of plastic strips over the bamboo base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型將塑膠手臂結構與編織竹籤底座結合。它成為一個承載完整划槳節奏的整體。
captions: 手持中的協同模型。
塑膠條與竹籤底座的細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose one movement.
2. Draw it in stages.
3. Build each stage as structure.
4. Join the stages into one body.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選定一個動作。
2. 分階段繪製。
3. 將每個階段做成結構。
4. 把各階段連成一體。

pins.title: Identity II: Duality of Self
pins.description:
Cardboard reliefs and a spatial framework that pair sharp blocks with soft curved layers.

Model Making | Relief collage | Identity | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 身分 II：自我的雙重性
zh-Hant.description:
以紙板浮雕與空間框架，並置銳利量塊與柔軟曲層。

模型製作｜浮雕拼貼｜身分｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Intersecting Frameworks in corrugated cardboard, wooden sticks and brown paper.
以瓦楞紙板、木條與牛皮紙製作的〈交錯框架〉。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The series grows out of an earlier study of a fragmented self. It asks how resilience and softness can live together in one composition.
captions: Line studies for the first relief.
First relief: sharp blocks in coloured paper.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個系列延續先前關於「破碎自我」的研究。它探問韌性與柔軟如何共存於同一個構成之中。
captions: 第一件浮雕的線條研究。
第一件浮雕：以色紙構成的銳利量塊。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Simple line drawings test how geometric and organic edges can be combined. Small colour studies then guide the material choice for each relief.
captions: Line studies for the second relief.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 簡單的線條圖測試幾何與有機邊緣如何結合。小幅色彩研究接著引導每件浮雕的材料選擇。
captions: 第二件浮雕的線條研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sharp blocks stand for resilience, while curved layers of corrugated board express softness. The two reliefs set the balance between the two qualities in different ways.
captions: Second relief: curved layers in corrugated board.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 銳利量塊象徵韌性，瓦楞紙板的曲層則表達柔軟。兩件浮雕以不同方式拿捏兩者的平衡。
captions: 第二件浮雕：瓦楞紙板的曲層。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The reliefs are lifted into a free-standing framework of folded planes and sticks. Seen from different sides, the hard and soft parts keep changing places.
captions: Framework model from above.
Framework model, side view.
Framework model, another side.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 浮雕最終被延伸為由摺面與木條構成的獨立框架。從不同角度觀看，硬與軟的部分不斷交換位置。
captions: 框架模型俯視。
框架模型側視。
框架模型另一側。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name two opposite qualities.
2. Draw them as lines.
3. Build them as a relief.
4. Lift the relief into space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 定義兩種相反的特質。
2. 以線條畫出它們。
3. 做成浮雕。
4. 將浮雕延伸到空間。

pins.title: Design From My Childhood
pins.description:
A colourful model of an emotional space for young children, drawn from the student's own childhood drawings.

Spatial Design | Children's space | Colour | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 來自童年的設計
zh-Hant.description:
從學生自己的童年畫作出發，為幼兒打造的一座色彩豐富的情緒空間模型。

空間設計｜兒童空間｜色彩｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Final model in wooden sticks, PVC, acrylic, timber panel and mirrors.
以木條、PVC、壓克力、木板與鏡面製作的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project starts from a question the student carried since childhood: why some colours and spaces feel calm, safe or overwhelming. It aims to create an emotional space that supports, soothes or gently activates young children.
captions: The student's own childhood drawings.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品源自學生從小就有的疑問：為什麼某些色彩與空間讓人感到平靜、安全或不知所措。它希望創造一個能支持、安撫或溫和激發幼兒的情緒空間。
captions: 學生自己的童年畫作。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied their own childhood drawings for the colours, forms and marks used in different moods. These traces were translated into abstract colour compositions.
captions: Abstract compositions from colour relationships.
Spatial studies built from the abstractions.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生分析自己童年畫作中，不同情緒下使用的色彩、形狀與筆觸。這些痕跡被轉譯為抽象的色彩構成。
captions: 從色彩關係發展的抽象構成。
由抽象構成發展的空間研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The abstractions became spatial studies that use colour psychology to shape volumes, thresholds and light. Process models test these ideas at a child's scale.
captions: Process models.
Overview of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 抽象構成被發展為空間研究，以色彩心理學塑造量體、門檻與光線。過程模型則以兒童尺度測試這些想法。
captions: 過程模型。
模型全景。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model joins red, orange and blue volumes with stairs, platforms and a mirrored threshold. It reflects how children perceive space long before they can describe it.
captions: Front view of the model.
Side view with the mirrored threshold.
Details of the volumes.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以樓梯、平台與鏡面門檻串連紅、橘、藍三色量體。它反映出兒童在能夠言說之前，便已感知空間的方式。
captions: 模型正面。
帶鏡面門檻的側面。
量體細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a personal memory.
2. Extract its colours and marks.
3. Turn them into space.
4. Test at the user's scale.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從個人記憶出發。
2. 萃取其中的色彩與筆觸。
3. 轉化為空間。
4. 以使用者尺度測試。

pins.title: Transformable Shelter
pins.description:
A foldable shelter of sticks and origami that shifts between openness and enclosure.

Structural Design | Foldable shelter | Origami | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 可變形庇護所
zh-Hant.description:
以木條與摺紙構成的可摺疊庇護所，在開放與圍合之間轉換。

結構設計｜可摺疊庇護所｜摺紙｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Close-up of the shelter in wooden sticks, paper and corrugated paper.
以木條、紙與瓦楞紙製作的庇護所近景。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project explores adaptable space that can shift between openness and enclosure. It grew from an earlier personal project by the student.
captions: Study of structure.
Study of origami folds.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品探索能在開放與圍合之間轉換的可變空間。它延伸自學生先前的一個個人計畫。
captions: 結構研究。
摺紙研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Small stick frames tested how joints let a unit open and close. Origami studies tested folds that could cover the frames and still move.
captions: Units combined into a curved chain.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 小型木條框架測試節點如何讓單元開合。摺紙研究則測試能覆蓋框架又能活動的摺法。
captions: 單元組合成弧形鏈。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The frame units were joined into chains that bend into arcs and clusters. Folded paper panels were then fixed between the sticks to make a skin.
captions: Two combinations of the units.
Study model with origami skin.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 框架單元被串接成能彎成弧形與群組的鏈狀結構。接著將摺紙板固定於木條之間，形成表皮。
captions: 兩種單元組合。
帶摺紙表皮的研究模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final structure folds and unfolds by hand, supporting both interaction and retreat. A sequence of photos shows the space changing as it moves.
captions: Folding the structure by hand.
The space in motion.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終結構可以徒手摺疊與展開，同時支持互動與退隱。一系列照片呈現空間在運動中的變化。
captions: 徒手摺疊結構。
運動中的空間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design one moving unit.
2. Test folds that can skin it.
3. Chain the units together.
4. Move it and record the space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 設計一個可動單元。
2. 測試能覆蓋它的摺法。
3. 將單元串接起來。
4. 讓它運動並記錄空間。

pins.title: Summer Studio I: Form Operations
pins.description:
A series of physical models that test basic form operations and combine them into one layered composition.

Architecture | Physical model | Form operations | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 暑期設計課 I：形式操作
zh-Hant.description:
以一系列實體模型測試基本形式操作，並將它們組合為一件層疊的構成。

建築設計｜實體模型｜形式操作｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final layered model of paper, card and sticks over a line drawing.
以紙、卡紙與木條疊合在線稿上的最終層疊模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The studio starts from simple verbs of form rather than a building program. Each operation has to be shown clearly in a small physical model.
captions: Reflection, stack and geometry models.
Intersect, span and filter diagrams.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這門課以形式的基本動詞為起點，而非建築機能。每一種操作都必須在小型實體模型中清楚呈現。
captions: 反射、堆疊與幾何模型。
交錯、跨越與過濾的圖解。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Six operations were tested: reflection, stack, geometry, intersect, span and filter. Quick diagrams fixed the logic of each one before it was built.
captions: Spiral stick model, first view.
Spiral stick model, second view.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生測試了六種操作：反射、堆疊、幾何、交錯、跨越與過濾。在動手製作前，先以快速圖解確立每一種操作的邏輯。
captions: 螺旋木條模型，第一視角。
螺旋木條模型，第二視角。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Rotating sticks around black blocks turned repetition into a spiral of movement. Wavy cut screens on stacked boxes explored how light is filtered through a surface.
captions: Filter box model from the front.
Filter box model from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 木條繞著黑色量塊旋轉，讓重複變成螺旋的運動。堆疊盒體上的波浪鏤空面則探討光線如何穿過表面被過濾。
captions: 過濾盒體模型正面。
過濾盒體模型俯視。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final piece layers the earlier operations over a large line drawing. Curved screens, stick fans and black frames meet in one composition.
captions: Perspective of the layered model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終作品將先前的操作疊合在一張大幅線稿上。曲面屏、木條扇形與黑色框架在同一個構成中交會。
captions: 層疊模型透視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick one verb of form.
2. Diagram it first.
3. Build it small and fast.
4. Combine the verbs into one piece.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個形式動詞。
2. 先畫圖解。
3. 小而快地做出來。
4. 把動詞組合成一件作品。

pins.title: Summer Studio II: Environmental Education Pavilion
pins.description:
A park pavilion of towers, decks and a walkway over water, studied in plans, sections and stick models.

Architecture | Pavilion | Environmental education | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 暑期設計課 II：環境教育亭
zh-Hant.description:
由塔、平台與水上步道組成的公園展亭，以平面、剖面與木條模型推演。

建築設計｜展亭｜環境教育｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Larger stick model of the tower in basswood, plywood and tracing paper.
以椴木條、夾板與描圖紙製作的大型塔體模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The pavilion invites visitors from a busy setting gradually into nature. It needs places to meditate, look out, gather and observe local ecology.
captions: Functional diagram of the five spaces.
Architecture plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座展亭引導訪客從喧囂環境逐步走入自然。它需要提供冥想、眺望、聚會與觀察在地生態的場所。
captions: 五個空間的機能圖。
建築平面圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The program was split into a contemplation niche, a watch tower, a group learning deck, an exhibition corner and a sensory walkway. A functional diagram arranged them around a green platform.
captions: Sections through the tower, deck and walkway.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 機能被拆解為冥想角落、瞭望塔、團體學習平台、展示角與感官步道。機能圖將它們環繞一座綠色平台配置。
captions: 穿越塔、平台與步道的剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sections test how the tower rises above the trees while the walkway stays low over the water. Basswood and card models check the joints between the parts.
captions: Axonometric sketch.
Pavilion model in basswood and card.
Details of stairs and frames.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 剖面測試塔體如何高出樹冠，而步道則低伏於水面之上。椴木與卡紙模型檢查各部分之間的銜接。
captions: 軸測草圖。
椴木與卡紙製作的展亭模型。
樓梯與框架細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A larger stick model develops the tower as an open frame of stairs, trusses and enclosed rooms. Hand sketches study the light and depth inside the structure.
captions: Inside the tower model.
Views of the tower model.
Perspective sketches of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 大型木條模型將塔體發展為由樓梯、桁架與封閉房間組成的開放框架。手繪草圖研究結構內部的光線與深度。
captions: 塔體模型內部。
塔體模型各視角。
塔體透視草圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. List the experiences first.
2. Diagram how they connect.
3. Cut sections to test height.
4. Build to check the joints.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先列出要提供的體驗。
2. 以圖解說明它們如何連結。
3. 以剖面測試高度。
4. 動手製作檢查銜接。

pins.title: Rift Pavilion
pins.description:
A twisted wind tower of rotated floors that turns a sunken city plaza into a quiet green retreat.

Architecture | Pavilion | Wind tower | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 裂隙展亭
zh-Hant.description:
以旋轉樓板構成的扭轉風塔，將下沉的城市廣場轉化為安靜的綠色休憩地。

建築設計｜展亭｜風塔｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Tower model in plywood, frosted acetate and green fibre.
以夾板、霧面醋酸片與綠色纖維製作的塔體模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is a sunken city plaza that feels cut off, underused and short of greenery. The project turns this isolation into a chance for a quiet, green retreat.
captions: Aerial view of the tower in the plaza.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是一處下沉的城市廣場，與城市隔絕、使用率低且缺乏綠意。這個作品將這份隔絕轉化為打造安靜綠色休憩地的機會。
captions: 塔體位於廣場中的鳥瞰。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The concept draws on traditional windcatchers that capture air from above and cool it through underground water. A twisted form was chosen to catch wind from all sides.
captions: Floor plans rotating up the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 概念取自傳統捕風塔，從高處擷取空氣，並透過地下水流降溫。扭轉的形體則用來從各個方向捕捉風。
captions: 沿塔身逐層旋轉的平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Rotated floors form a spiral void that brings air and light down through the tower. Lower levels stay shaded, middle levels hold plants, and the top opens to the sky through an oval skylight.
captions: Line drawings of the tower.
Hand sketch of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 旋轉的樓板形成螺旋狀中空，將空氣與光線引入塔內。下層保持陰涼，中層種植植物，頂層則透過橢圓天窗向天空開放。
captions: 塔體線稿。
塔體手繪草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A staircase circles the centre and reveals changing light and views on the way up. Models show the planted floors and the water channels that run through the site.
captions: Inside the tower model.
Site model with water channels.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 樓梯環繞中心而上，沿途展現變化的光線與景觀。模型呈現種植樓層，以及穿越基地的水道。
captions: 塔體模型內部。
帶水道的基地模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name what the site lacks.
2. Borrow a climate idea.
3. Draw it floor by floor.
4. Build it to test light.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 指出基地缺少什麼。
2. 借用一種氣候策略。
3. 逐層繪製。
4. 動手製作測試光線。

pins.title: Reimagined Vaultypes
pins.description:
Historic vault types redrawn as light frameworks of rattan, wire and mesh for temporary public rest spaces.

Architecture | Temporary pavilion | Vault structure | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重構拱頂類型
zh-Hant.description:
將歷史拱頂類型重新詮釋為藤條、金屬線與網材構成的輕量框架，作為臨時公共休憩空間。

建築設計｜臨時展亭｜拱頂結構｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Final model in rattan rods, wire mesh, metal wire and wooden dowels.
以藤條、金屬網、金屬線與木釘製作的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project designs temporary public spaces for people waiting in airport transit zones, such as asylum seekers. These spaces offer rest, social contact and calm through light and geometry.
captions: Sketches comparing vault types.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品為在機場轉運區等候的人們，例如尋求庇護者，設計臨時公共空間。這些空間透過光線與幾何提供休息、交流與平靜。
captions: 比較各種拱頂類型的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sketches compared barrel, cross, quadripartite, fan and sail vaults for structure and proportion. Stripped of stone, each vault was reduced to lines and curves that meet.
captions: Side and top views set on a square grid.
Chipboard study models from bent strips.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 草圖比較筒拱、交叉拱、四分肋拱、扇形拱與帆拱的結構與比例。去除石材後，每種拱頂被簡化為交會的線與曲線。
captions: 置於方格上的側視與俯視圖。
以彎折紙板條製作的研究模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Chipboard strips bent over moulds tested rib spacing and spatial logic. The vault types were then composed into one system on a grid to keep the scale consistent.
captions: Rattan rib tests on the cutting mat.
Mesh vaults over the platforms.
Detail of a sail vault.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以模具彎折的紙板條測試肋的間距與空間邏輯。接著將各種拱頂組合在方格上，形成尺度一致的系統。
captions: 切割墊上的藤條肋測試。
平台上方的網材拱頂。
帆拱細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the final model, rattan forms the quadripartite and fan vaults while bent wire defines the cross vaults. Wooden dowels give vertical support and wire mesh adds depth beneath the ribs.
captions: Vistas under the vaults.
Elevation of the model.
The model from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以藤條構成四分肋拱與扇形拱，以彎折金屬線界定交叉拱。木釘提供垂直支撐，肋下的金屬網則增添層次。
captions: 拱頂下的視景。
模型立面。
模型俯視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a historic type.
2. Reduce it to lines.
3. Test the lines in material.
4. Compose them into a system.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一種歷史類型。
2. 將它簡化為線條。
3. 以材料測試線條。
4. 組合成一套系統。

pins.title: Labyrinth of Faith and Ruin
pins.description:
A circular maze tower in resin, acrylic and clay that retells a journey through a ruined world.

Spatial Narrative | Model | Maze tower | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 信念與廢墟的迷宮
zh-Hant.description:
以樹脂、壓克力與黏土製作的環形迷宮塔，重述一段穿越廢墟世界的旅程。

空間敘事｜模型｜迷宮塔｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The tower model lit from within.
由內部照亮的塔體模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project was inspired by a post-apocalyptic novel about a father and son on a long journey. It asks how that path can be rebuilt as a maze where life and death seem reversed.
captions: Concept sketch of the circular maze.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品的靈感來自一部描寫父子長途跋涉的末日小說。它探問如何將這段旅程重建為一座生死彷彿顛倒的迷宮。
captions: 環形迷宮的概念草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A sketch mapped the journey as rings of walls around a central goal. At the centre sits a fragile belief that keeps the travellers moving forward.
captions: Making the walls, base and resin sea.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 草圖將旅程描繪為環繞中心目標的層層牆體。中心是一份讓旅人持續前行的脆弱信念。
captions: 製作牆體、基座與樹脂海面的過程。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Circular walls and floor plates create a fragmented terrain, linked by small ladders. Dark acrylic and clay give a worn wooden texture, while yellow layers stand for flashbacks breaking through.
captions: The tower on its resin sea base.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 環形牆體與樓板構成破碎的地形，並以小梯子相連。深色壓克力與黏土營造出磨損的木質紋理，黃色層次則象徵穿透而出的回憶。
captions: 置於樹脂海面基座上的塔。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished tower rises from an epoxy sea that holds the remains of a lost civilisation. Close views show the narrow passages and ladders that make up the journey.
captions: Inner walls and ladders.
A passage between the rings.
The upper rings.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的塔從環氧樹脂海面中升起，海中留存著消逝文明的殘骸。近景呈現構成旅程的狹窄通道與梯子。
captions: 內牆與梯子。
環與環之間的通道。
上層的環。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a story.
2. Map the journey as a plan.
3. Give each moment a material.
4. Build the path to be walked.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個故事出發。
2. 將旅程畫成平面。
3. 為每個時刻選擇材料。
4. 把路徑做成可走的空間。

pins.title: Between Chaos and Clarity
pins.description:
Plaster blocks and layered clear PVC that turn a personal rhythm of thinking into structure.

Spatial Design | Concept model | Material contrast | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 混沌與清晰之間
zh-Hant.description:
以石膏量塊與層疊透明PVC，將個人的思考節奏轉化為結構。

空間設計｜概念模型｜材料對比｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Final model in plaster, PVC sheets and PVC rods.
以石膏、PVC板與PVC棒製作的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project began from the student's curiosity about their own way of thinking. It treats a restless rhythm of attention as a source of design rather than a weakness.
captions: Tests of layering, material contrast and fragmentation.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品源自學生對自身思考方式的好奇。它將不安定的專注節奏視為設計的來源，而非缺點。
captions: 層疊、材料對比與碎裂的測試。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The experience was summed up in three ideas: layering, material contrast and fragmentation. Each idea was tested in a quick model before the final piece.
captions: Plaster casting tests.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生將經驗歸納為三個關鍵概念：層疊、材料對比與碎裂。每個概念都先以快速模型測試，再進入最終作品。
captions: 石膏翻模測試。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Plaster stands for focus while clear PVC expresses scattered thought. Layered and cracked plates show how the mind reorganises information to find order.
captions: Layered PVC inside a block.
Cracked PVC plates.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 石膏代表專注，透明PVC則表達發散的思緒。層疊與碎裂的板片呈現心智如何重組資訊以找到秩序。
captions: 量塊內的層疊PVC。
碎裂的PVC板片。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Sharp triangular openings in the walls mark moments of heightened awareness. Gaps between the four blocks suggest mental jumps that still connect.
captions: Interior between the blocks.
View through a triangular opening.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 牆面上尖銳的三角開口標示出感知高度敏銳的時刻。四個量塊之間的縫隙則暗示仍然相連的思緒跳躍。
captions: 量塊之間的內部。
透過三角開口的視景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe your own habits.
2. Name three key ideas.
3. Give each a material.
4. Let the contrast become form.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察自己的習慣。
2. 歸納三個關鍵概念。
3. 為每個概念選擇材料。
4. 讓對比成為形式。

pins.title: Between Waters
pins.description:
Platforms and paths along a campus stream that let students pause, study and rest beside water.

Landscape Architecture | Campus stream | Learning spaces | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 水之間
zh-Hant.description:
沿著校園溪流配置的平台與步道，讓學生能在水邊停留、讀書與休憩。

景觀建築｜校園溪流｜學習空間｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Site model in wooden board, stone, wax, acrylic, epoxy resin, clay and foam.
以木板、石頭、蠟、壓克力、環氧樹脂、黏土與泡棉製作的基地模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student often watched a stream outside the campus lounge and found calm in its flow during busy study. The project asks how architecture could merge water and learning.
captions: Watercolour of the stream and its banks.
Pencil sketches of the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生常在校園交誼廳看著窗外的溪流，在忙碌的課業中從流水裡找到平靜。這個作品探問建築如何將水與學習融合。
captions: 溪流與兩岸的水彩。
基地鉛筆速寫。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Watercolour and pencil studies recorded the banks, bridges and trees along the stream. The stream's movement was then translated into circulation paths and platforms.
captions: Shaping the topography and waterways.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 水彩與鉛筆研究記錄了溪流沿岸的堤岸、橋梁與樹木。接著將溪水的流動轉譯為動線與平台。
captions: 塑造地形與水道的過程。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The topography was shaped in foam and clay, and varied spaces were built from templates. Acrylic sheets stand for waterways while wax and epoxy resin capture the fluid quality of water.
captions: View from under the bridge.
Acrylic waterway over the stream.
A raised pavilion by the bank.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 地形以泡棉與黏土塑造，多樣的空間則以模板製作。壓克力板代表水道，蠟與環氧樹脂則捕捉水的流動質感。
captions: 從橋下望去的景象。
跨越溪流的壓克力水道。
岸邊架高的小亭。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Red boxes and long bridges step along the stream and frame places to study and meditate. Clear ramps link the platforms so that nature shapes how people move through the site.
captions: The model from above.
Stairs among the trees.
Long elevation along the stream.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 紅色盒體與長橋沿著溪流錯落，圍塑出讀書與冥想的場所。透明坡道串連各個平台，讓自然決定人們在基地中的移動方式。
captions: 模型俯視。
樹間的樓梯。
沿溪長向立面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a place you know.
2. Draw it by hand.
3. Turn its movement into paths.
4. Model the materials of water.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從熟悉的地方出發。
2. 親手描繪它。
3. 將它的流動轉為路徑。
4. 以模型表現水的材質。

pins.title: City of Masks
pins.description:
Traditional ritual masks abstracted into spatial models that read the hidden emotions of a fast-moving city.

Shenzhen | Spatial design | Ritual masks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 面具之城
zh-Hant.description:
將傳統儺戲面具抽象為空間模型，解讀快速變動城市中隱藏的情緒。

深圳｜空間設計｜儺戲面具｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final pavilion-like construct in laser-cut board and wood.
以雷射切割板材與木材製作的最終展亭式構築。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student grew up in a city of speed, migration and reinvention, but watched traditional ritual opera with grandparents in the countryside. The project asks whether urban spaces, like masks, also hide the emotions of city life.
captions: Line drawings traced from four ritual masks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生在一座充滿速度、遷徙與更新的城市長大，卻曾隨祖父母在鄉間觀看傳統儺戲。這個作品探問城市空間是否也像面具一樣，隱藏著城市生活的情緒。
captions: 描繪自四張儺戲面具的線稿。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Four masks were traced, then reduced to geometric lines and abstracted into grids. Each mask carries a character trait, from discipline to care, loyalty and energy.
captions: Geometric reduction and grid abstraction.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生描繪四張面具，再將其簡化為幾何線條並抽象為網格。每張面具都承載一種性格特質，從紀律、關懷到忠誠與能量。
captions: 幾何簡化與網格抽象。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each trait became a small spatial model, using vertical planes, soft curves, rigid grids or radiating lines. Field research in several districts of the city linked each model to an urban character.
captions: Discipline and protection: balanced planes around an axis.
Kindness and care: soft, enclosed curves.
Loyalty and strength: vertical grids.
Energy and power: radiating lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每一種特質都被轉化為小型空間模型，運用垂直面、柔和曲線、剛性網格或放射線條。學生在城市多個區域的田野調查，將每個模型連結到一種城市性格。
captions: 紀律與守護：環繞軸線的平衡面。
慈愛與關懷：柔和圍合的曲線。
忠誠與力量：垂直網格。
能量與力量：放射線條。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final composition joins the four models into an abstract pavilion of curved ribbons, corrugated towers and reflective floors. It turns the hidden geometry of ritual masks into a sculptural spatial language.
captions: Curved gold ribbons.
Corrugated towers.
A reflecting court.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終構成將四個模型結合為由曲面飾帶、瓦楞塔體與反光地面組成的抽象展亭。它將儺戲面具中隱藏的幾何轉化為雕塑性的空間語言。
captions: 彎曲的金色飾帶。
瓦楞塔體。
反光中庭。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a cultural memory.
2. Trace it by hand.
3. Reduce it to geometry.
4. Build each trait as space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從文化記憶出發。
2. 親手描繪它。
3. 簡化為幾何。
4. 將每種特質做成空間。

pins.title: Geometry of Divinity
pins.description:
A line-and-arc composition lifted into a white and mirror-chrome model of discs, stairs and columns.

Architecture | Concept model | Geometry | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 神性的幾何
zh-Hant.description:
將線與弧的平面構成延伸為由圓盤、樓梯與柱體組成的白色與鏡面鉻模型。

建築設計｜概念模型｜幾何｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Final model in resin and mirror chrome vinyl.
以樹脂與鏡面鉻貼膜製作的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project studies how simple geometric shapes can create spaces that feel sacred. It began from extracting elements from a modern master's buildings that achieve this effect.
captions: Plane composition of parallel lines and arcs.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品研究簡單的幾何形狀如何創造出具神聖感的空間。它從萃取現代建築大師作品中達成此效果的元素開始。
captions: 由平行線與弧線構成的平面構成。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The extracted elements were redrawn as a two-dimensional composition of parallel lines and arcs. Circles, bands and stepped lines set up the rules for the model.
captions: Stair and discs rising from the columns.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 萃取的元素被重新繪製為由平行線與弧線構成的二維構成。圓形、帶狀與階梯狀線條確立了模型的規則。
captions: 從柱體升起的樓梯與圓盤。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The composition was turned into a three-dimensional model in Rhino. Discs became platforms, bands became stairs and arcs became curved screens.
captions: Upper stair and platforms.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生在Rhino中將平面構成轉化為三維模型。圓形成為平台，帶狀成為樓梯，弧線則成為曲面屏。
captions: 上方的樓梯與平台。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model sets white platforms on mirror-chrome columns that reflect light and space. Its stairs and discs rise like a small sacred landscape.
captions: Light on the lower platforms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型將白色平台架設於反射光線與空間的鏡面鉻柱上。樓梯與圓盤層層升起，宛如一處小型的神聖地景。
captions: 下方平台上的光影。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study strong precedents.
2. Extract their basic shapes.
3. Compose them on paper.
4. Lift the drawing into space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究有力的先例。
2. 萃取其基本形狀。
3. 在紙上進行構成。
4. 將圖面延伸至空間。

pins.title: From Batter to Bricks
pins.description:
Baking gestures translated into porous plaster layers and modular bricks that filter light.

Material Design | Plaster bricks | Light | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 從麵糊到磚塊
zh-Hant.description:
將烘焙動作轉譯為能過濾光線的多孔石膏層與模組化磚塊。

材料設計｜石膏磚｜光線｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Stacked plaster slabs with irregular holes under warm light.
暖光下層疊的多孔石膏板。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student learned from childhood baking how soft batter changes through time and heat. The project asks how simple baking actions can become ways of shaping form and space.
captions: Channel, stack and drizzle form experiments.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生從童年的烘焙經驗中，學到柔軟的麵糊如何隨時間與溫度改變。這個作品探問簡單的烘焙動作如何成為塑造形式與空間的方法。
captions: 引流、堆疊與淋灑的形式實驗。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Three words, channel, stack and drizzle, were tested in three small models. Each piece translated a baking gesture into a physical form.
captions: Sketches of porous slabs.
Details of the stacked slabs.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生以引流、堆疊、淋灑三個詞，製作三個小模型進行測試。每件作品都將一個烘焙動作轉譯為實體形式。
captions: 多孔板片草圖。
層疊板片細部。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Plaster slabs with irregular holes were cast and stacked so that light filters down through the voids. The result feels solid and transparent at the same time.
captions: Sketches for modular bricks.
Study of a single brick.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生翻製帶有不規則孔洞的石膏板並層層堆疊，讓光線從孔隙間向下灑落。成果同時給人實體與通透的感受。
captions: 模組化磚塊草圖。
單一磚塊研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The slabs then became modular bricks that let light in from the side when stacked into a wall. The pattern of holes gives texture and rhythm while letting the wall breathe.
captions: The brick wall lit from behind.
The white brick wall.
Two lit bricks.
Brick surface details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 板片接著發展為模組化磚塊，堆疊成牆時讓光線從側面進入。孔洞的圖案帶來質感與節奏，也讓牆面得以呼吸。
captions: 從背後打光的磚牆。
白色磚牆。
兩塊發光的磚。
磚面細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from an everyday action.
2. Name it in one word.
3. Test each word in material.
4. Turn the result into a unit.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從日常動作出發。
2. 用一個詞命名它。
3. 以材料測試每個詞。
4. 將成果發展為單元。

pins.title: Life & Preservation
pins.description:
A timber model of a floating memorial shelter that keeps the vernacular of fishing villages alive on the water.

Hong Kong | Model | Floating fishing village | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 生命與保存
zh-Hant.description:
以木構模型打造漂浮紀念庇護所，讓漁村的地方語彙在水上延續。

香港｜模型｜水上漁村｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final memorial shelter model in weathered wooden sticks, tarpaulin and painted boats.
以風化木條、帆布與彩繪小船製作的紀念庇護所最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Redevelopment often removes structures with deep cultural value, such as the floating fishing villages of rafts, timber grids and net cages. The project asks how that heritage can live on while meeting present-day needs.
captions: Elevation sketch of the shelter above sculpted reef forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
