zh-Hant.body: 都市更新常會移除具有深厚文化價值的構造，例如由竹筏、木格架與網箱組成的水上漁村。這個作品探問這份遺產如何在回應當代需求的同時延續下去。
captions: 庇護所立於雕塑礁體之上的立面草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied raft typologies, tying and lashing joints and the way boats are stored around a working structure. A low-carbon marine cement was considered for reef sculptures below the shelter, so coral could settle on its rough surface.
captions: Weathered sticks cut and framed into grids.
Cross-bracing prototype derived from raft types.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究竹筏類型、綁紮與捆接節點，以及小船如何收納在作業構造周圍。庇護所下方的礁體雕塑考慮使用低碳海洋水泥，讓珊瑚能附著於粗糙表面。
captions: 風化木條切割並組成格架。
源自竹筏類型的斜撐原型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Nets and meshes form a breathable plinth that recalls cage-culture farms. A perimeter gantry lets boats be hoisted along the facade, so the shelter doubles as a typhoon-day harbour.
captions: Net and mesh plinth.
Hanging fleet system.
Gantry with hoisted boats.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 網與網布構成可透氣的基座，呼應網箱養殖場。外圍吊架讓小船沿立面吊起收納，使庇護所在颱風天也能兼作避風港。
captions: 網與網布基座。
懸吊船隊系統。
吊架與吊起的小船。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model combines a pitched timber roof, a green tarpaulin and a ring of painted boats into one floating memorial. Its hand-built frames keep the rough character of the village while giving it a new public role.
captions: Roof and sign detail.
Side view with scale figures.
Tarpaulin roof view.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型將斜木屋頂、綠色帆布與一圈彩繪小船結合為一座漂浮紀念物。手作框架保留漁村的粗獷質感，同時賦予它新的公共角色。
captions: 屋頂與招牌細部。
附比例人偶的側視。
帆布屋頂視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a heritage at risk.
2. Study how it is built.
3. Test joints by hand.
4. Give it a new role.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇一項瀕危遺產。
2. 研究它的構築方式。
3. 親手測試節點。
4. 賦予它新的角色。

pins.title: Realm of Light and Curves
pins.description:
A clay and timber model of a sacred space where coloured light filters through hand-made translucent films.

Architecture | Model | Sacred space | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 光與曲線之境
zh-Hant.description:
以黏土與木材打造的神聖空間模型，讓光線穿過手作半透明膜片染上色彩。

建築｜模型｜神聖空間｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final model of curved clay framework and coloured translucent panels.
由彎曲黏土骨架與彩色半透明面板組成的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was drawn to organic modernist architecture that seems to grow from nature, with curves, mosaics and stained glass. The project asks how a simple model can capture that sense of a sacred, dreamlike space.
captions: Hand sketch of a spired church.
Facade, tower and form sketches.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生深受彷彿從自然生長而出的有機現代建築吸引，著迷於其曲線、馬賽克與彩色玻璃。這個作品探問一個簡單的模型如何捕捉那種神聖而夢幻的空間感。
captions: 尖塔教堂手繪草圖。
立面、塔樓與形體草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sketches of towers, facades and twisting forms helped the student read how curves radiate with structural strength. Light filtering through coloured glass became the key quality to recreate.
captions: Wooden slat framework.
Clay shaped over the frame into organic curves.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 透過繪製塔樓、立面與扭轉形體，學生理解曲線如何帶著結構力量向外放射。光線穿過彩色玻璃的效果成為最需要重現的特質。
captions: 木條骨架。
以黏土包覆骨架塑出有機曲線。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Wooden slats formed the base frame, then clay was shaped over it into contorted, vine-like curves. Heat-pressed plastic bags made translucent films in different colours that lock sunlight inside the model.
captions: Coloured film test in the frame.
Tower close-up with coloured panels.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生先以木條構成基本骨架，再以黏土塑出扭曲、如藤蔓般的曲線。以熱壓塑膠袋製成不同顏色的半透明膜片，將陽光鎖在模型之中。
captions: 框架中的彩色膜片測試。
彩色面板塔體近景。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model joins towers, a terrace bridge and a vaulted arch, with plants growing along its edges. Light passing through the films casts shifting colours across the interior, so nature and the sacred feel joined in one space.
captions: Terrace and bridge.
Light through the coloured films.
Curved interior under the arch.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型結合塔體、平台橋與拱頂，邊緣長出植物。光線穿過膜片在室內投下變化的色彩，讓自然與神聖在同一空間中交融。
captions: 平台與橋。
光線穿過彩色膜片。
拱下的彎曲室內。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Sketch what moves you.
2. Name one quality.
3. Invent a cheap material.
4. Test it with light.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 描繪打動你的事物。
2. 指出一項特質。
3. 發明一種低成本材料。
4. 用光來測試。

pins.title: Sanctum - Renewal
pins.description:
A biophilic recovery centre model where terraced floors, hanging greenery and a woven timber shelter support healing.

Architecture | Model | Recovery centre | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 聖所・新生
zh-Hant.description:
以退台樓層、懸垂綠意與編織木構遮棚支持療癒的親生物復原中心模型。

建築｜模型｜復原中心｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final site model with the terraced tower, woven shelter and garden path.
最終基地模型，包含退台塔樓、編織遮棚與花園步道。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The brief is a centre that helps people recover from injury and other health challenges. The project asks how architecture can lower stress and give users calm, autonomy and a sense of belonging.
captions: Spiral concept sketch of stacked circular floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 設計任務是一座幫助人們從傷病與其他健康挑戰中復原的中心。這個作品探問建築如何降低壓力，並給予使用者平靜、自主與歸屬感。
captions: 層疊圓形樓層的螺旋概念草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student drew on biophilic principles such as large windows, hanging plants and wood finishes. Circular communal spaces with shortened terrace floors were sketched to connect users with nature and with each other.
captions: Making the curved walls.
Layered terrain in foam board.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生參考親生物設計原則，例如大面開窗、懸垂植物與木質飾面。草圖中以縮短的退台樓層構成圓形公共空間，讓使用者與自然及彼此相連。
captions: 製作彎曲牆面。
以泡棉板疊出的地形。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Foam board, wood and rattan were used to test stacked terraces, curved walls and a layered landscape. A swirling half-shelter of stacked wood was added so filtered sunlight casts soft patterns inside.
captions: Stacked terrace test.
Spiral stair seen from above.
Interior under the woven shelter.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以泡棉板、木材與藤條測試層疊退台、彎曲牆面與分層地景。再加入以木條堆疊的旋轉半遮棚，讓篩落的陽光在室內投下柔和光影。
captions: 層疊退台測試。
俯視螺旋樓梯。
編織遮棚下的室內。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model sets the tower among low curved pavilions, linked by a gravel garden path. Open terraces, rigid pillars and the woven shell balance openness with a feeling of safety.
captions: The woven shell around the tower.
Low curved pavilions.
The sheltered ground floor.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型將塔樓置於低矮的彎曲展館之間，以碎石花園步道相連。開放的退台、堅實的柱子與編織殼體，在開放與安全感之間取得平衡。
captions: 環繞塔樓的編織殼體。
低矮的彎曲展館。
有遮蔽的地面層。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from the user's needs.
2. Pick calming principles.
3. Test them in layers.
4. Shape light last.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從使用者需求出發。
2. 選定安定身心的原則。
3. 分層測試。
4. 最後塑造光線。

pins.title: The Lure of Layers
pins.description:
Gestures and water ripples from a classical painting translated into a layered timber structure over a gridded base.

Architecture | Model | Painting translation | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 層次之誘
zh-Hant.description:
將古典畫作中的姿態與水波轉譯為立於格狀基座上的層疊木構。

建築｜模型｜畫作轉譯｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final model of stained timber posts above a gridded base.
立於格狀基座上的染色木柱最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project starts from a classical painting of figures in water and the tension between bodies and nature in the scene. It asks how gesture, movement and visual seduction in an image can become architectural space.
captions: Angular lines from the figure composition.
Fluid curves from gestures, hair and ripples.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品從一幅描繪水中人物的古典畫作出發，關注畫面中身體與自然之間的張力。它探問圖像中的姿態、動作與視覺誘惑如何轉化為建築空間。
captions: 取自人物構圖的角狀線條。
取自姿態、髮絲與水波的流動曲線。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Through overlaid diagrams, the student extracted angular lines from the composition and fluid curves from gestures and ripples. These line systems set the rhythm, direction and edges of the space.
captions: Lines extruded into a layered digital structure.
Gridded plan of interlaced members.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生透過疊圖分析，從構圖中萃取角狀線條，並從姿態與水波中萃取流動曲線。這些線條系統決定了空間的節奏、方向與邊界。
captions: 線條擠出為層疊的數位結構。
交織構件的格狀平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The lines were modelled in 3D software as layers whose height and density follow the tension among the figures. The model was then built from laser-cut and hand-assembled wood, with a gridded lower base and a folded upper lattice.
captions: Assembling the timber frame.
Making the gridded base.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生在 3D 軟體中將線條建模為層次，其高度與密度對應人物之間的張力。模型再以雷射切割與手工組裝的木構件製作，下層為格狀基座，上層為折疊格架。
captions: 組裝木構框架。
製作格狀基座。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model suspends cement and wax forms within a dynamic timber frame, like water caught in motion. Hand-stained colours echo the contrast of water and skin, linking the drawn overlays to the built object.
captions: Water surface detail in cement and wax.
Cement forms held in the frame.
Elevation view.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型在動態的木構框架中懸掛水泥與蠟製形體，彷彿凝結的水流。手工染色呼應水與肌膚的對比，將疊圖分析與實體構築連結起來。
captions: 以水泥與蠟製作的水面細部。
嵌於框架中的水泥形體。
立面視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose an image.
2. Trace its lines.
3. Layer them in 3D.
4. Build with real materials.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇一張圖像。
2. 描出它的線條。
3. 在 3D 中分層。
4. 以真實材料構築。

pins.title: Human Doll
pins.description:
A board game about meeting face to face, translated into a stacked timber house whose rooms shift like game pieces.

Architecture | Game and model | Social space | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 人形
zh-Hant.description:
以促進面對面交流的桌遊為起點，轉化為房間如棋子般錯動的層疊木構住宅。

建築｜桌遊與模型｜社交空間｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final model of rooms stacked on columns and linked by stairs.
房間疊於柱上並以樓梯相連的最終模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to create a board game that brings people together for real, face-to-face connection. The project then asks how the game's shifting positions could shape a building.
captions: Classroom boards modelled in 3D software.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生希望設計一款讓人們真正面對面交流的桌遊。作品接著探問，遊戲中不斷變換的位置能如何塑造一棟建築。
captions: 以 3D 軟體建模的教室版圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Boards for classrooms, hallways, a cafeteria and stairs were modelled digitally and printed. Hand-drawn character cards and game pieces gave each player a role and set of advantages.
captions: Student, advantage and extra game pieces.
Digitally drawn character cards.
The game laid out in play.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 教室、走廊、餐廳與樓梯的版圖先以數位建模再列印。手繪角色卡與棋子讓每位玩家擁有角色與優勢。
captions: 學生、優勢與額外棋子。
數位繪製的角色卡。
遊戲進行中的桌面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Early card models tested simple house volumes with windows. A stacking method was then chosen so rooms could shift position, as pieces do on the board.
captions: Early cardboard house models.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 早期的紙板模型測試帶窗的簡單住宅量體。學生隨後選擇堆疊的方式，讓房間能像版圖上的棋子一樣變換位置。
captions: 早期紙板住宅模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model of wooden sticks and printed parts stacks rooms on slim columns, linked by open stairs and balconies. A traditional-style exterior contrasts with more western interiors, seen through clear ceilings.
captions: Cantilevered rooms.
Stair and balcony.
Spiral stair view.
Ground-floor room and window.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以木條與列印構件製作，將房間堆疊在細柱上，並以開放樓梯與陽台相連。傳統風格的外觀與較西式的室內形成對比，可透過透明天花窺見。
captions: 懸挑的房間。
樓梯與陽台。
螺旋樓梯視角。
地面層房間與窗。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Design the play first.
2. Map how players move.
3. Turn moves into rooms.
4. Stack and test.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先設計遊戲。
2. 描繪玩家的移動。
3. 將移動化為房間。
4. 堆疊並測試。

pins.title: Deconstructing Geometry
pins.description:
Triangles of striped PVC are broken apart and reassembled into a floating structure of tension and light.

Spatial design | Model | Deconstruction | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 解構幾何
zh-Hant.description:
以條紋 PVC 三角形拆解再重組，形成充滿張力與光影的懸浮構造。

空間設計｜模型｜解構｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final structure of striped triangles on a stick frame.
條紋三角形與木條骨架構成的最終結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was drawn to how deconstructivist architecture breaks order into fragments. The project asks whether simple triangles can be split apart and recombined into a new spatial order.
captions: Hand drawing of scattered triangles.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生著迷於解構主義建築將秩序拆成碎片的方式。作品探問，簡單的三角形能否被拆開再重組成新的空間秩序。
captions: 散落三角形的手繪。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Striped PVC sheets were tested for tension and balance against a timber stick frame. Light passing through the strips revealed how layering could make a solid surface feel semi-transparent.
captions: PVC strip tests.
Light through the strips.
Layered strips on the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生以條紋 PVC 片搭配木條骨架，測試張力與平衡。光線穿過條紋，顯示疊層能讓實體表面變得半透明。
captions: PVC 條片測試。
光線穿過條紋。
骨架上的疊層條片。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Triangular units were repeatedly taken apart and recombined into larger clusters. Each round tested how far fragmentation could go while the whole still held together.
captions: Regenerated triangle modules.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 三角單元被反覆拆解並重組成更大的群組。每一輪都在測試碎片化能推進多遠，而整體仍能成立。
captions: 重組後的三角模組。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model is an open cluster of striped triangles held by a visible stick frame. Its shifting density and shadows turn a basic shape into a dynamic, layered space.
captions: The model from above.
Close-up of the layered triangles.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型是由外露木條骨架支撐的開放條紋三角群。變化的密度與陰影，讓基本形狀轉化為動態且具層次的空間。
captions: 俯視模型。
層疊三角形近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick one basic shape.
2. Break it into parts.
3. Recombine and test.
4. Read the light.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個基本形。
2. 拆成碎片。
3. 重組並測試。
4. 觀察光影。

pins.title: Floating Channels
pins.description:
Stretchy fabric channels and floating foam balls flow through a rigid cubic frame of timber sticks.

Spatial design | Model | Structure and flow | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 漂浮通道
zh-Hant.description:
彈性布料通道與漂浮的泡棉球，穿流於木條構成的剛性立方框架之中。

空間設計｜模型｜結構與流動｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final model: fabric tunnels and foam balls inside a stick grid.
最終模型：木條網格中的布料通道與泡棉球。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The idea began with natural flows such as wind, water and roots that grow past boundaries. The project asks how soft systems can adapt and reshape themselves inside a rigid framework.
captions: Hand drawing of flows across a grid.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 構想源自風、水與樹根等會越過邊界自由生長的自然流動。作品探問，柔軟的系統如何在剛性框架內調適並重塑自身。
captions: 流動穿越網格的手繪。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A cubic frame of timber sticks was built first as the fixed order. Stretchy fabric was then pulled through it to test how far a channel could bend between levels.
captions: Fabric pulled into the frame.
Fixing the channels.
The bare cubic frame.
Frame taking shape on the cutting mat.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先以木條搭出立方框架，作為固定的秩序。再將彈性布料穿拉其中，測試通道在樓層之間能彎曲到什麼程度。
captions: 布料拉入框架。
固定通道。
尚未加入布料的立方框架。
切割墊上成形的框架。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Fabric tunnels were stretched to link different levels with tensioned, twisting surfaces. Foam balls were hung along the paths to suggest movement drifting through the grid.
captions: Tunnels with foam balls.
A holographic panel among the channels.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 布料通道被拉伸，以扭轉的張拉曲面連接不同樓層。泡棉球沿路徑懸掛，暗示穿越網格漂移的動態。
captions: 布料通道與泡棉球。
通道間的全像片。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished model balances solid frame and organic surface in one spatial system. Holographic film on some panels catches light and gives the space a vivid, shifting atmosphere.
captions: A level with coloured film.
Tensioned surfaces up close.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的模型在同一空間系統中平衡了實體框架與有機曲面。部分板面貼上全像膜捕捉光線，讓空間呈現鮮明而變幻的氛圍。
captions: 貼有彩色膜的樓層。
張拉曲面近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Set a rigid frame.
2. Add a soft material.
3. Let it flow across.
4. Add light.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 建立剛性框架。
2. 加入柔軟材料。
3. 讓它穿流其中。
4. 加入光。

pins.title: Bark Lattice
pins.description:
The rhythms of tree bark are translated into stacked timber and holographic strips that glow like a forest.

Spatial design | Model | Material texture | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 樹皮格構
zh-Hant.description:
將樹皮的紋理節奏轉譯為層疊的木條與全像紙條，如森林般閃耀。

空間設計｜模型｜材料紋理｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Stacked strips lit to glow like a forest at night.
層疊條片在燈光下如夜間森林般發亮。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student noticed how tree bark records growth in its cracks, fibres and folds. The project asks how that natural texture can become a clear building logic of lines and layers.
captions: Ink imprint of bark texture on fabric.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生注意到樹皮以裂紋、纖維與皺褶記錄生長。作品探問，這種自然紋理如何轉化為清晰的線與層的構築邏輯。
captions: 以墨拓印於布上的樹皮紋理。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Bark was wrapped in fabric and inked to capture its pattern as a print. Timber sticks and holographic strips were then gathered and sorted by length and thickness.
captions: Sticks sorted by length.
Strips merged into a colourful mass.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生以布包覆樹皮並上墨，將紋理拓印下來。接著收集木條與全像紙條，依長度與粗細分類。
captions: 依長度分類的木條。
合併成彩色量體的條片。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Hand drawings turned the bark into a vocabulary of line, bundle and layer. They also set the density and the break points for the linear construction.
captions: Hand drawing of bark rhythm.
Drawing of line density and breaks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 手繪將樹皮轉為線、束與層的語彙。這些圖也訂定了線性構築的密度與斷裂點。
captions: 樹皮節奏的手繪。
線條密度與斷裂的手繪。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final structure stacks varied stripes with slight offsets into tall, jungle-like clusters. Under coloured light the holographic strips shimmer and reveal the depth of each layer.
captions: Strip cluster.
Taller strip cluster.
Layered strip detail.
Light along the strips.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終構造以略微錯位的條片堆疊成高聳如叢林的群組。在彩色光線下，全像條片閃爍，顯現每一層的深度。
captions: 條片群組。
較高的條片群組。
層疊條片細部。
沿條片的光線。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Record a texture.
2. Draw its rhythm.
3. Sort your material.
4. Stack with offsets.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 記錄一種紋理。
2. 畫出它的節奏。
3. 分類材料。
4. 錯位堆疊。

pins.title: The Growing Pattern
pins.description:
Roots and branches traced into lines, then woven from painted sticks and acrylic platforms into ordered chaos.

Spatial design | Model | Order and chaos | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 生長紋理
zh-Hant.description:
將樹根與枝條描繪為線條，再以上色木條與壓克力平台編織成有序的混沌。

空間設計｜模型｜秩序與混沌｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final interwoven structure lit against black.
在黑色背景中打光的最終編織構造。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: On a field trip the student saw a hidden order beneath the apparent chaos of a jungle. The project asks how branching roots and vines can be read as a line, node and bundle logic.
captions: Study of branching angles.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生在一次田野考察中，看見叢林表面混亂之下隱藏的秩序。作品探問，枝狀的樹根與藤蔓如何被解讀為線、節點與束的邏輯。
captions: 分枝角度研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Growth patterns of roots and branches were traced to find their structural rhythm. The tracings were refined into simple two-dimensional line drawings that could guide the build.
captions: Tracing of root and branch patterns.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生描繪樹根與枝條的生長紋理，找出其結構節奏。描圖再被提煉為簡潔的二維線條圖，作為構築的依據。
captions: 樹根與枝條紋理描圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sticks of many sizes were interwoven, and acrylic paint marked a hidden order within the chaos. Laser-cut acrylic plates were added as hexagonal platforms with open voids above.
captions: Painted sticks.
Interwoven sticks.
Hexagonal acrylic platforms.
Dense and open zones.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 不同尺寸的木條相互編織，並以壓克力顏料在混沌中標示隱藏的秩序。雷射切割的壓克力板被加入成為六角形平台，上方留有開放的空隙。
captions: 上色木條。
交織的木條。
六角形壓克力平台。
密集與開放的區域。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Different stick densities create places to move through and places to pause. Under light the transparent platforms and coloured sticks add layers of depth and a playful rhythm.
captions: Coloured sticks in light.
Platform among the sticks.
Layered depth of the weave.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 不同的木條密度創造出可穿行與可停留的地方。在光線下，透明平台與彩色木條增添了層次深度與輕快的節奏。
captions: 光線中的彩色木條。
木條間的平台。
編織的層次深度。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe a natural system.
2. Trace its lines.
3. Weave by density.
4. Add places to pause.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察自然系統。
2. 描出它的線條。
3. 依密度編織。
4. 加入停留之處。

pins.title: Growth Rings
pins.description:
Tree-ring patterns become stacked PVC rings that merge building, trees and ground into one landscape.

Spatial design | Landscape model | Growth pattern | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 年輪
zh-Hant.description:
將年輪紋理轉化為層疊的 PVC 環，使建築、樹木與地面融為一片地景。

空間設計｜地景模型｜生長紋理｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The ring landscape model with trees, lit at night.
種有樹木的年輪地景模型夜間打光。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project responds to a self-replicating urban concept but shifts it toward organic growth like tree rings. It asks how cold urban motifs can become a living system shared by people, space and nature.
captions: Circular pattern painting.
Blue ring pattern.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品回應一個自我複製的城市構想，但將其轉向如年輪般的有機生長。它探問，冰冷的城市母題如何成為人、空間與自然共享的生命系統。
captions: 圓形紋理繪畫。
藍色年輪紋理。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Circular pattern paintings and hand drawings explored how rings overlap and link. These studies set the ring and strip units that the model would be built from.
captions: Hand drawing of linked rings.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 圓形紋理繪畫與手繪探討環與環之間如何重疊與連結。這些研究訂定了模型所用的環形與條狀單元。
captions: 相連圓環的手繪。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Templates were used to cut PVC sheet into rings and linear strips. The units were layered into three-dimensional pieces and then combined into a larger whole.
captions: Cut PVC rings in hand.
Assembled ring units.
Rings forming a continuous landscape.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以模板將 PVC 板切成圓環與線條。這些單元被疊合成立體構件，再組合成更大的整體。
captions: 手中的切割 PVC 環。
組合完成的環形單元。
環形構成連續地景。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Trees and grass powder are embedded among the rings so building and site blur together. The result is a seamless landscape where the built form reads as an extension of the ground.
captions: Ring terraces.
Trees among the rings.
View across the ring canopy.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 樹木與草粉嵌入環形之間，使建築與基地的界線變得模糊。成果是一片連續的地景，建築形體如同地面的延伸。
captions: 環形台地。
環形之間的樹木。
橫越環形頂蓋的視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a growth pattern.
2. Draw its units.
3. Cut and layer them.
4. Plant the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一種生長紋理。
2. 畫出它的單元。
3. 切割並疊合。
4. 種入基地。

pins.title: Kaleidoscopic Dreams
pins.description:
A simple block is twisted, mirrored and rotated in 3D software into a shimmering kaleidoscope form.

Digital design | 3D modelling | Form operations | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 萬花筒之夢
zh-Hant.description:
以 3D 軟體將簡單方塊扭轉、鏡射與旋轉，生成閃爍的萬花筒形體。

數位設計｜3D 建模｜形體操作｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final forms repeated into a kaleidoscope image.
最終形體重複構成的萬花筒影像。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: After a digital workshop the student set out to design an interactive system inspired by the kaleidoscope. The project asks how shapes and colours in constant flux can make us question what we see.
captions: Twist and mirror operations.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 參加數位工作坊後，學生著手設計一個受萬花筒啟發的互動系統。作品探問，持續變化的形狀與色彩如何讓人質疑自己所見。
captions: 扭轉與鏡射操作。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A single block was put through a chain of operations such as twist, mirror, rotate and scale. Each step was recorded so the logic of the form stayed readable.
captions: Mirror, rotate and scale steps.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生讓單一方塊經過扭轉、鏡射、旋轉與縮放等一連串操作。每一步都被記錄下來，讓形體的邏輯保持清晰可讀。
captions: 鏡射、旋轉與縮放步驟。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Mirrored and rotated copies were combined, then split with a boolean step to open the form. This produced a flower-like object with folded petals and deep pockets.
captions: From copies and boolean split to the final work.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 鏡射與旋轉的複本被組合，再以布林運算切開形體。如此產生一個花瓣摺疊、內有深陷凹處的花狀物件。
captions: 由複製、布林切割到最終作品。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final objects carry an iridescent finish that shifts with every view. Repeated into a kaleidoscope image, they invite open reflection on how stable perception really is.
captions: Final object, view one.
Final object, view two.
Final object, view three.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終物件帶有隨視角變化的虹彩表面。重複構成萬花筒影像後，它們引人反思感知究竟有多穩定。
captions: 最終物件，視角一。
最終物件，視角二。
最終物件，視角三。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start with one block.
2. Apply one operation.
3. Record every step.
4. Repeat and compare.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個方塊開始。
2. 套用一個操作。
3. 記錄每一步。
4. 重複並比較。

pins.title: Entangled Realms
pins.description:
A tree-shaped tower of stacked wooden sticks is wrapped in hand-shaped clay and ringed by yellow paper paths.

Model making | Mixed-media tower | Coexistence study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 糾纏之境
zh-Hant.description:
以木棒堆疊成樹形塔體，外覆手塑黏土，並以黃色瓦楞紙環道環繞。

模型製作｜複合材料塔體｜共存研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower with its yellow ring paths.
完成的塔體與黃色環道。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted a single model to hold both human order and the unruly growth of nature. The project asks how built frames and wild habitat might share one body.
captions: Sketch diagrams of the stacked form.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生希望以單一模型同時容納人類的秩序與自然的恣意生長。作品探問，人造框架與野性棲地如何共存於同一個形體。
captions: 堆疊形體的草圖分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A digital sketch first tested a stack of shrinking hexagonal layers shaped like a festive tree. The layers were then rebuilt as wooden sticks of graded lengths to make the frame.
captions: Making process from frame to clay.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先以數位草圖測試逐層縮小、形如節慶樹的六角形堆疊。之後再以長度漸變的木棒重新構築這些層，形成框架。
captions: 從框架到黏土的製作過程。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Clay was pressed between the sticks to form irregular pockets that stand for animal and plant habitat. The rigid frame and the soft clay begin to grip and depend on each other.
captions: Stick frame gripped by clay.
Side views of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生將黏土壓入木棒之間，形成代表動植物棲地的不規則空間。剛硬的框架與柔軟的黏土開始彼此咬合、相互依存。
captions: 被黏土包覆的木棒框架。
塔體側視。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Yellow corrugated paper rings now spiral around the tower as paths that link every level. The model reads as a shared home where people, animals and plants overlap.
captions: Front view of the finished model.
Ring path details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 黃色瓦楞紙環道螺旋環繞塔體，串連每一層。模型呈現出人、動物與植物交疊共居的家園。
captions: 完成模型正視。
環道細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Sketch one stacked form.
2. Build a rigid frame.
3. Add a soft material.
4. Link it with paths.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 草繪一個堆疊形體。
2. 搭建剛性框架。
3. 加入柔性材料。
4. 以路徑串連。

pins.title: Intertwining Surfaces
pins.description:
Bamboo sticks are bent across a wooden frame so that curved surfaces cross and open into one another.

Model making | Bamboo structure | Surface study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 交織曲面
zh-Hant.description:
以竹棒彎繞木構框架，讓曲面彼此交錯、開展。

模型製作｜竹構｜曲面研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished bamboo and wood frame model.
完成的竹木框架模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was drawn to tensile roofs where thin members carry wave-like skins. The project asks how stiff sticks alone can make surfaces that curve and cross.
captions: Early tests with rods, foam and fabric.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生受到以纖細構件撐起波浪表皮的張拉屋頂吸引。作品探問，僅靠硬直的棒材，能否做出彎曲並相互交錯的曲面。
captions: 以棒材、泡棉與布料進行的初步測試。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Early tests stretched fabric over rods set in foam, but the result stayed one solid form. Removing the fabric and keeping only sticks let separate parts start to connect.
captions: Curved surface details.
Woven stick structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 初期測試將布料撐在插入泡棉的棒材上，結果卻仍是單一實體。拿掉布料、只留棒材後，各個部分開始能彼此連結。
captions: 曲面細部。
編織棒材結構。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A sketch set out a wooden main frame with bamboo bent between its posts. Fixing the bamboo at regular but staggered points made the surfaces weave and meet.
captions: Sketch of the frame and bent surfaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以草圖規劃木構主框架，並在柱間彎繞竹棒。竹棒以規律而錯位的節點固定，使曲面交織相會。
captions: 框架與彎曲面的草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model rises as a cluster of towers wrapped in fine bamboo curves. Its openings and crossings come straight from the logic of bending and fixing.
captions: Tall view of the model.
Side views of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以細密竹曲線包覆的塔群拔地而起。其開口與交錯，都直接來自彎曲與固定的邏輯。
captions: 模型高處視角。
模型側視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study one precedent.
2. Test a soft skin.
3. Remove what blocks.
4. Bend and fix.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一個先例。
2. 測試柔性表皮。
3. 拿掉阻礙之物。
4. 彎曲並固定。

pins.title: Fossilized Architecture
pins.description:
Pale 3D-printed curves grow over a bed of stones while a red stick frame marks the human layer.

Model making | 3D-printed resin | Nature and structure | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 化石建築
zh-Hant.description:
淺色 3D 列印曲線在石床上蔓生，紅色木棒框架則標示人為的層次。

模型製作｜3D 列印樹脂｜自然與結構｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Resin curves, red frames and planting in the final model.
最終模型中的樹脂曲線、紅色框架與植栽。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student explored the tension between organic growth and human-made order. The project asks what a structure might look like once nature has slowly taken it back.
captions: Diagrams of the curve system.
Printed resin curve parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生探究有機生長與人造秩序之間的張力。作品探問，當自然慢慢收回一座結構時，它會呈現什麼樣貌。
captions: 曲線系統分析圖。
列印完成的樹脂曲線構件。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Line studies drawn from ecological networks were turned into a parametric curve system. The flowing pieces were printed in resin so they read like the remains of a living body.
captions: Hand sketch of the curve rings.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生將取自生態網絡的線條研究轉化為參數化曲線系統。流動的構件以樹脂列印，看起來如同生命體的遺骸。
captions: 曲線環的手繪草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The curves were set on cobblestones inside an acrylic box and planted with moss and small trees. A grid of red sticks was then added as roads and frames that hint at human use.
captions: Assembly in progress.
Planting and red frames.
The model inside its acrylic box.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生將曲線放在壓克力箱內的卵石上，並種上苔蘚與小樹。接著加入紅色木棒格網，作為暗示人類使用的道路與框架。
captions: 組裝進行中。
植栽與紅色框架。
置於壓克力箱中的模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The two layers press against and absorb each other across the whole landscape. The model imagines a place where people have left and the line between built and natural blurs.
captions: Curves rising over the stones.
Close-up views of frames and curves.
A curve among the trees.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 兩個層次在整片地景中相互擠壓、彼此吸納。模型想像一處人已離去、人造與自然界線逐漸模糊的場所。
captions: 在石床上升起的曲線。
框架與曲線的近景。
樹叢間的曲線。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Draw a natural network.
2. Model it as curves.
3. Add a human layer.
4. Let them overlap.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 描繪自然網絡。
2. 將其建模為曲線。
3. 加入人為層次。
4. 讓兩者交疊。

pins.title: Cliffside Beach House
pins.description:
Round rooms on thin red stilts step down a sandy hillside towards the sea, topped by a lookout tower.

Architecture | Hillside house | Site model | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 崖邊海灘屋
zh-Hant.description:
圓形房間立於細長紅色支柱上，沿沙質山坡向海層層下降，頂端設有瞭望塔。

建築設計｜山坡住宅｜基地模型｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The beach house stepping down the cliffside model.
沿崖邊模型層層下降的海灘屋。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Memories of buildings seen on travels led the student to imagine a house on a hill above a beach. The project asks how a home can feel both sheltered and open to the view.
captions: Early terrain render with the house.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 旅途中見過的建築記憶，讓學生想像一座位於海灘上方山坡的住宅。作品探問，一個家如何同時給人庇護感，又向景色敞開。
captions: 地形與住宅的初期渲染。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A digital terrain study set the house on the slope with a tower at its peak. The ground was then built up in layered sheets, sand and painted water.
captions: Terrain layers and sand being built up.
Sand and sea base of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生以數位地形研究，將住宅置於坡地並在頂端設置塔樓。之後以層疊板材、沙與彩繪水面堆出地面。
captions: 堆疊中的地形層與沙。
模型的沙灘與海面基座。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Hand-drawn plans link rounded rooms through narrow corridors and a shared stair. Curved windows were 3D-printed so the rooms glow softly like small lanterns.
captions: Floor plan, level one.
Floor plan, level two.
Floor plan, level three.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 手繪平面以狹長走道與共用樓梯串連圓形房間。弧形窗以 3D 列印製作，讓房間如小燈籠般柔和發光。
captions: 平面圖，第一層。
平面圖，第二層。
平面圖，第三層。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished model scatters timber rooms on red stilts across the hillside. Geometric shapes cross each other freely, yet every space has its own use.
captions: Houses on stilts above the beach.
Tower and room views.
Stair and garden details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的模型將木構房間散布在山坡的紅色支柱上。幾何形體自由交錯，但每個空間都有其用途。
captions: 海灘上方的高腳房屋。
塔樓與房間視角。
樓梯與花園細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Recall a memory.
2. Shape the terrain.
3. Plan the rooms.
4. Build the site model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 回想一段記憶。
2. 塑造地形。
3. 規劃房間。
4. 製作基地模型。

pins.title: Verdant Facade
pins.description:
A grid of timber sticks and black boxes becomes a small tower thick with climbing plants and flowers.

Model making | Vertical greening | Mixed-media tower | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 翠綠立面
zh-Hant.description:
木棒格架與黑色盒體構成小型塔體，攀爬植物與花朵在其間茂密生長。

模型製作｜垂直綠化｜複合材料塔體｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower with planting on every level.
每層皆有植栽的完成塔體。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Creepers growing over the walls near the student's home showed how plants cling to buildings without falling. The project asks whether a structure can be designed so greenery grows into it from the start.
captions: Sketch of the stick structure.
Sketches of planted towers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生家附近牆面上的爬藤，展現了植物如何攀附建築而不掉落。作品探問，能否從一開始就設計一座讓綠意自然長入的結構。
captions: 木棒結構草圖。
植栽塔體草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Studies of vertical greening showed plants held in neat but varied frames. The student chose a language of straight lines and rectangles taken from abstract painting and turned it into 3D.
captions: Building the base and frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究垂直綠化，發現植物被安置在整齊卻多變的框架中。學生選用取自抽象繪畫的直線與矩形語彙，並將其轉為立體。
captions: 基座與框架的製作過程。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A thick core stick was glued to a plastic base, then black sticks and plates were stacked around it. Wood rods and acrylic boxes added texture before plants were set into the frame.
captions: The model with its planting.
Close-up views of the levels.
View of the lower frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生先將較粗的核心木棒黏在塑膠底座上，再於周圍堆疊黑色棒材與板材。木棒與壓克力盒增添質感，最後才把植物安置進框架。
captions: 植栽後的模型。
各層近景。
下層框架視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Plants now spill over every level so the frame and the greenery read as one facade. A line drawing and a digital replica with more plants and animals extend the idea beyond the model.
captions: Line drawing of the tower.
Digital replica of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 植物溢滿每一層，讓框架與綠意成為一體的立面。一張線描圖與加入更多動植物的數位複製場景，將構想延伸到模型之外。
captions: 塔體線描圖。
模型的數位複製場景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe plants on walls.
2. Choose a line language.
3. Build the frame.
4. Plant it in.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察牆上的植物。
2. 選定線條語彙。
3. 搭建框架。
4. 植入綠意。

pins.title: A Spatial Narrative of Escape
pins.description:
Four escape tactics from a prison drama become four linked spaces around a spiral stair, later rebuilt as a game level.

Model making | Spatial narrative | Mixed-media maze | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 逃脫的空間敘事
zh-Hant.description:
一部越獄影集中的四種逃脫手法，化為環繞螺旋梯相連的四個空間，之後再重建成遊戲關卡。

模型製作｜空間敘事｜複合材料迷宮｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished escape model in PVC, sticks, wire net and clay.
以PVC、木棒、鐵絲網與黏土完成的逃脫模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student admired how a TV prison drama solves escape through careful planning rather than force. The project asks how a sequence of clever escape moves can be told as one continuous space.
captions: Sketch of the escape route through four parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生欣賞一部監獄影集以縝密計畫而非蠻力完成逃脫。作品探問，一連串巧妙的逃脫行動，如何被敘述成一個連續的空間。
captions: 貫穿四個部分的逃脫路線草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Four moves were studied: chiselling a wall, a tattooed map, corroded sewer bars and an elevator-shaft climb. Each move was reduced to a material action such as cutting, layering, dissolving or climbing.
captions: Shaping the wire net.
Stair pieces in progress.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究四個行動：鑿穿牆面、刺青地圖、腐蝕下水道鐵條與攀爬電梯井。每個行動都被轉譯為切割、層疊、溶解或攀爬等材料動作。
captions: 塑形鐵絲網。
製作中的樓梯構件。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A central spiral stair links four smaller spaces, with PVC window openings, a mapped surface and a criss-cross stick network. Hand drawings tested how stairs, arches and textures wind through the volume.
captions: Arches and stair in the model.
Drawing of the winding staircase.
Drawing of stairs and arches.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 中央螺旋梯串連四個較小的空間，包含PVC窗洞、地圖化的表面與交錯的木棒網絡。手繪圖測試樓梯、拱與紋理如何在量體中盤繞。
captions: 模型中的拱與樓梯。
盤繞樓梯手繪圖。
樓梯與拱的手繪圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model reads as a dense maze where every route ends in a breakthrough. The student then rebuilt it in a game engine as a playable final level of an escape game.
captions: Scenes from the game level.
Stick paths in the game level.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型成為一座密集的迷宮，每條路線都通往一次突破。學生之後在遊戲引擎中重建模型，成為逃脫遊戲中可遊玩的最終關卡。
captions: 遊戲關卡場景。
遊戲關卡中的木棒路徑。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a story.
2. Split it into moves.
3. Give each move a space.
4. Link them in one route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個故事。
2. 拆解成行動。
3. 為每個行動配置空間。
4. 以一條路線串連。

pins.title: Restyled Temple of Time
pins.description:
A stepped temple from a favourite video game is rebuilt in bamboo strips and ringed with hanging sticks of many heights.

Model making | Game-inspired architecture | Bamboo stick model | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重塑時之神殿
zh-Hant.description:
學生把喜愛的電玩中一座階梯式神殿，以竹條重新搭建，並以高低不一的垂掛木棒環繞。

模型製作｜遊戲啟發建築｜竹木棒模型｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished temple wrapped in hanging sticks.
被垂掛木棒包覆的完成神殿。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student loved a calm, monumental temple in a video game and wanted to build it without making a copy. The question was how to keep its stepped silhouette while making it feel open and light.
captions: Sketches of the front facade and the roof space.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生喜愛電玩中一座沉靜而宏偉的神殿，想將它做成模型卻不只是複製。問題在於如何保留階梯式輪廓，同時讓它顯得開放輕盈。
captions: 正立面與屋頂空間草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sketches broke the facade and roof into stacked layers that could be built in strips. The overall form was then redrawn as dense vertical lines, a step that set the language of the model.
captions: Translating the exterior into vertical lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生以草圖把立面與屋頂拆解為可用條材搭建的堆疊層次。整體造型再被重繪成密集的垂直線條，奠定模型的語彙。
captions: 將外觀轉譯為垂直線條。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Thin bamboo strips were laid layer by layer and glued into curved floors and frames. Vertical sticks of varied heights were then added around the edge to form a loose boundary.
captions: Building the layers.
Assembling the base frame.
Sketch of the interior structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以細竹條逐層鋪設，黏合成弧形樓板與框架。接著在外緣加上高低不一的垂直木棒，形成鬆散的邊界。
captions: 逐層搭建。
組裝底部框架。
室內結構素描。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: When lit, the sticks cast moving shadows across the stepped floors and give the temple depth. Small red figures show how the open interior can be walked through.
captions: Light falling into the interior.
Top view with scale figures.
Details of the hanging sticks.
The interior corridor.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在燈光下，木棒於階梯樓板上投下變化的光影，讓神殿更有深度。紅色小人偶顯示開放的室內如何被穿行。
captions: 灑入室內的光線。
附比例人偶的俯視。
垂掛木棒細部。
室內廊道。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a loved building.
2. Sketch its layers.
3. Translate into lines.
4. Build and light it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一座喜愛的建築。
2. 描繪它的層次。
3. 轉譯為線條。
4. 搭建並打光。

pins.title: Medieval Castle Isometric Studies
pins.description:
Gothic castle parts are modelled one by one and recombined into three coloured isometric castles.

Digital modelling | Isometric design | Gothic castle | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 中世紀城堡等角研究
zh-Hant.description:
哥德式城堡構件被逐一建模，再重組成三座上色的等角城堡。

數位建模｜等角設計｜哥德城堡｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: A tall castle rendered in pink light.
以粉色光線渲染的高聳城堡。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A castle in a favourite animated series caught the student's eye with its bold gothic forms and colours. The aim was to rebuild that spirit as new castles rather than copy a single scene.
captions: Tower, pier and window parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生被一部喜愛的動畫中城堡大膽的哥德造型與配色吸引。目標是將那份精神重建為新的城堡，而不是複製單一場景。
captions: 塔、柱墩與窗的構件。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student sketched typical parts such as towers, pointed windows, domes and spires. Each part was then modelled in Rhino as a reusable piece.
captions: Roof, dome and spire parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先描繪塔樓、尖拱窗、圓頂與尖塔等典型構件。再於Rhino中將每個構件建成可重複使用的元件。
captions: 屋頂、圓頂與尖塔構件。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The parts were combined into different castles with stairs, terraces and bridges between towers. Isometric views were exported and coloured with simple settings around them.
captions: Castle on a sandy ground.
Castle with arcades in orange light.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生把構件組合成不同的城堡，以樓梯、平台與橋樑連接各塔。等角視圖匯出後加上色彩與簡單的環境布景。
captions: 立於沙地的城堡。
橘光下帶拱廊的城堡。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Three castles show how one kit of parts can produce very different moods. Line elevations record the outlines of each design.
captions: Line elevations of the castles.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 三座城堡顯示同一套構件能營造截然不同的氛圍。線稿立面記錄了每個設計的輪廓。
captions: 城堡的線稿立面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a style you love.
2. Collect its parts.
3. Model each part.
4. Recombine and colour.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一種喜愛的風格。
2. 收集它的構件。
3. 逐一建模。
4. 重組並上色。

pins.title: Vertical Terrains
pins.description:
Terrain data from places the student loves is stacked into layered landscapes held up by white columns, forming a vertical forest.

Model making | Parametric terrain | Layered landscape | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 垂直地景
zh-Hant.description:
學生把喜愛之地的地形資料堆疊成多層地景，由白色柱體支撐，形成一座垂直森林。

模型製作｜參數化地形｜層疊地景｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Trees and columns between two terrain layers.
兩層地形之間的樹木與柱體。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Travel lets people feel landscapes and local culture in a way screens cannot. The project asks how landscapes from many places could be gathered into one compact, vertical forest.
captions: Height maps and landscape photos used as sources.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 旅行讓人以螢幕無法取代的方式感受地景與在地文化。作品探問，如何把多地的地景聚集成一座緊湊的垂直森林。
captions: 作為來源的高程圖與地景照片。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student collected elevation data of places visited or wished for and read it as height maps. A node script turned each map into a 3D terrain surface.
captions: Node script and generated terrain surfaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生收集曾造訪或嚮往之地的高程資料，並以高程圖讀取。透過節點程式，每張圖都被轉成立體地形曲面。
captions: 節點程式與生成的地形曲面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Two terrains were stacked and propped apart by tapered white columns. Layers of PVC plate were cut to the contours and the columns were 3D-printed.
captions: Axonometric of the stacked terrains.
Render of the space between the columns.
The contour model in progress.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 兩層地形上下堆疊，由漸縮的白色柱體撐開。學生依等高線切割PVC板層層疊合，柱體則以3D列印製作。
captions: 堆疊地形軸測圖。
柱間空間渲染。
製作中的等高線模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Moss and small trees cover both levels so the model reads as a forest climbing upward. Between the layers, the columns frame a shaded valley.
captions: Planted terrain details.
Views of the finished model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 苔蘚與小樹覆蓋上下兩層，讓模型讀起來像一座向上攀升的森林。層與層之間，柱體框出一處陰涼的山谷。
captions: 植栽地形細部。
完成模型各角度。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect terrain data.
2. Script the surfaces.
3. Stack and support them.
4. Plant the layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集地形資料。
2. 以程式生成曲面。
3. 堆疊並支撐。
4. 為各層植栽。

pins.title: The Fusion Cafe
pins.description:
Favourite details from many neighbourhood coffee shops are combined into one composite cafe model.

Model making | Interior design | Composite cafe | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 融合咖啡館
zh-Hant.description:
把社區裡多間咖啡店最喜愛的細節，組合成一座複合式咖啡館模型。

模型製作｜室內設計｜複合式咖啡館｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished composite cafe model.
完成的複合式咖啡館模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student visited many coffee shops in the community, from cafes in office towers to an old house in the old town, and found that each had its own charm. The project asks how favourite elements from different cafes can be combined into one place for both rest and work.
captions: Ink and watercolour drawing of a cafe interior.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生走訪社區中許多咖啡店，從辦公大樓裡的咖啡館到老城區的老屋，發現每一間都有自己的魅力。作品探問，如何把不同咖啡館中喜愛的元素，組合成一個兼顧休息與工作的空間。
captions: 咖啡館室內的鋼筆淡彩圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Favourite elements such as bold greens, spacious tables, comfortable chairs and bright lighting were recorded in watercolour. Patterns, brick, tiles and chair forms were collected as a small library of details.
captions: Sketches of plants, tiles, brick, chairs and furniture.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 鮮明的綠色、寬敞的桌子、舒適的椅子與明亮的燈光等喜愛元素，都以水彩記錄下來。花紋、磚牆、磁磚與椅子造型被整理成一個細節資料庫。
captions: 植物、磁磚、磚牆、椅子與家具的草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The composite cafe was modelled digitally, then scaled and translated into PVC components. The parts were finished with wallpaper and paint and assembled with furniture, glass, plants and an acrylic block mosaic.
captions: Interior views of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 複合式咖啡館先以數位模型建構，再依比例轉譯為PVC構件。構件貼上壁紙、上漆，並組裝家具、玻璃、植物與壓克力方塊馬賽克。
captions: 模型室內視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model joins a dark green cafe front, a tiled wall, a timber terrace and an open stair into one building. Seating, lighting and planting are arranged so visitors can both relax and work.
captions: Terrace and tiled facade of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型把深綠色的店面、磁磚牆、木露台與開放樓梯結合成一棟建築。座位、燈光與植栽的安排，讓來客既能放鬆也能工作。
captions: 模型的露台與磁磚立面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Visit real places.
2. Record what you love.
3. Combine the elements.
4. Build it as a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 走訪真實場所。
2. 記錄喜愛的元素。
3. 組合這些元素。
4. 做成模型。

pins.title: Living and Farming
pins.description:
A stacked complex where purifying, farming and living share one green tower.

Model making | Vertical farming | Mixed-media complex | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 生活與耕種
zh-Hant.description:
一座把淨化、耕種與居住疊在同一座綠色塔中的複合建築。

模型製作｜垂直農耕｜複合材料建築｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished living and farming complex.
完成的生活與耕種複合建築。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A classic study of rural society describes the deep attachment of Chinese people to the land. Many families still tend plants on balconies and rooftop gardens, so the project asks how farming and daily life can share one building.
captions: Diagrams of plant, soil and roots, and the three layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一部探討鄉土社會的經典著作，描述了華人與土地之間深厚的連結。許多家庭至今仍在陽台與屋頂花園種植，因此作品探問，耕種與日常生活如何共享一棟建築。
captions: 植物、土壤與根系，以及三個層次的圖解。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Plant structure, soil and roots were studied in diagrams. The building was then organised in three parts from bottom to top: purifying, farming and living.
captions: Pencil sketch of the stacked model.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生以圖解研究植物構造、土壤與根系。建築由下而上分為三個部分：淨化、耕種與居住。
captions: 堆疊模型的鉛筆素描。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: White living boxes were tested above timber planting decks. Sticks, fabric, clay, straw, yarn and acrylic were combined for structure, shade and water.
captions: Details of homes and planting decks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 白色的居住量體被安排在木構種植平台之上反覆測試。木棒、布料、黏土、吸管、毛線與壓克力被組合成結構、遮陽與水路。
captions: 住居與種植平台的細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model stacks a purifying base, planted terraces and white homes into one tower. Greenery spills over every level, making farming part of everyday life.
captions: Three views of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型把淨化基座、種植平台與白色住居堆疊成一座塔。綠意溢出每一層，讓耕種成為日常生活的一部分。
captions: 模型的三個視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a value.
2. Find it in daily life.
3. Stack the functions.
4. Test them in a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個價值出發。
2. 在日常生活中找到它。
3. 把機能堆疊起來。
4. 用模型測試。

pins.title: A Plant Stand That Breathes
pins.description:
Coconut fibre from food waste strengthens cement pots for a plant stand that breathes.

Material research | Product design | Bio-based concrete | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 會呼吸的植物架
zh-Hant.description:
以廚餘中的椰子纖維強化水泥花盆，做成一座會呼吸的植物架。

材料研究｜產品設計｜生質混凝土｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished plant stand.
完成的植物架。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Flower pots made of coconut fibre at home led the student to experiment with food waste. The aim was a breathing plant stand that can really be used to grow plants.
captions: From fresh coconut to chunks, fibre, fertiliser and powder.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 家中的椰纖花盆，啟發學生以廚餘進行實驗。目標是做出一座真的能種植物、會呼吸的植物架。
captions: 從新鮮椰子到碎塊、纖維、肥料與粉末。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Coconut was chopped, shredded into fibre, fermented into fertiliser and ground into powder. Shrimp shells, eggshells and other wastes were mixed with concrete in different amounts and compared.
captions: Test discs of concrete mixed with different food wastes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 椰子被切塊、撕成纖維、發酵成肥料，並磨成粉末。蝦殼、蛋殼等廚餘以不同比例混入混凝土並加以比較。
captions: 混入不同廚餘的混凝土試片。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Coconut fibre was chosen because it bridges micro-cracks in cement while its porous fibres carry water and air. Pots were cast and planted to test drainage, moisture and root health.
captions: Planted fibre-concrete pots.
A hanging pot in rope netting.
Small pots for air plants.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 選擇椰纖，是因為它能橋接水泥中的微裂縫，多孔的纖維又能輸送水分與空氣。學生灌製花盆並種上植物，測試排水、保濕與根系健康。
captions: 種上植物的纖維混凝土花盆。
以繩網懸吊的花盆。
放置空氣鳳梨的小花盆。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The stand combines timber shelves, branches and fibre-concrete pots, including a hanging pot. Leftover coconut shells can also be processed into nutrient-rich soil.
captions: The stand in daylight.
Details of shelves and disc pots.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 植物架結合木層架、樹枝與纖維混凝土花盆，還有一只懸吊花盆。剩下的椰殼也能再處理成養分豐富的土壤。
captions: 日光下的植物架。
層架與圓形花盆的細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Notice a waste.
2. Test it as a material.
3. Compare the results.
4. Make a useful object.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 留意一種廢料。
2. 把它當材料測試。
3. 比較結果。
4. 做成實用的物件。

pins.title: Cinderella
pins.description:
A favourite fairy-tale film becomes a tower that grows from paper arches into glowing blue petals.

Model making | Film-inspired narrative | Mixed-media tower | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 灰姑娘
zh-Hant.description:
一部喜愛的童話電影，化為一座從紙拱長成發光藍色花瓣的塔。

模型製作｜電影敘事｜複合材料塔｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower.
完成的塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student's favourite film is a live-action version of a classic fairy tale, with harmonious colours and pastoral, intricate details. The project asks how the heroine's growth, gentle yet resilient, can become a physical model.
captions: Annotated concept sketch.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生最喜愛的電影是一部經典童話的真人版，色彩和諧，田園氣息與精緻細節兼具。作品探問，女主角溫柔而堅韌的成長歷程，如何化為實體模型。
captions: 附註解的概念草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each stage of the story was mapped onto a part of a tower, from a closed white base to an open, blooming top. The signature blue, natural greenery and glowing details became the palette.
captions: Shaping plastic, cutting card and testing colour.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 故事的每個階段被對應到塔的不同部位，從封閉的白色基座到綻放的頂端。招牌藍色、自然綠意與發光細節構成材料色盤。
captions: 塑形塑膠片、切割卡紙與測試色彩。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Card arcades, bamboo weaving, organza, resin and heat-shaped plastic were tested layer by layer. An LED strip and UV light make the transparent pieces glow.
captions: The blue petals and the paper arcade.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 卡紙拱廊、竹編、歐根紗、樹脂與熱塑塑膠被逐層測試。LED燈條與紫外光讓透明構件發光。
captions: 藍色花瓣與紙拱廊。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The tower rises from paper arches into swirling blue petals, a bamboo ribbon and branches. Each layer stands for one stage of growth.
captions: Branches and petals over the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 塔從紙拱升起，轉為旋繞的藍色花瓣、竹帶與枝葉。每一層代表成長的一個階段。
captions: 基座上方的枝葉與花瓣。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a story you love.
2. Map its stages.
3. Give each stage a material.
4. Stack them in one form.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個喜愛的故事。
2. 拆出它的階段。
3. 為每個階段配置材料。
4. 堆疊成一個形體。

pins.title: Spinning Motion
pins.description:
A paper volume and a personal spinning gesture merge into a wearable model of sticks and paper.

Model making | Motion study | Stick and paper | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 旋轉的動作
zh-Hant.description:
紙量體與個人旋轉的動作結合，成為以木棒與紙製作的可穿戴模型。

模型製作｜動作研究｜木棒與紙｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The wearable stick-and-paper model.
木棒與紙的可穿戴模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project starts from a three-dimensional paper model built from a painting. The student asks how that volume can be joined with a personal movement, spinning with arms outstretched.
captions: The paper volume model.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品從一件依據畫作製作的立體紙模型出發。學生探問，這個量體如何與張開雙臂旋轉的個人動作結合。
captions: 紙量體模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The paper volume was photographed and rendered to read its rhythm of ribs and curves. Digital studies looked at it from several angles.
captions: Render of the volume.
Digital studies from several angles.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生拍攝並渲染紙量體，閱讀肋片與曲線的節奏。數位研究從多個角度觀察它。
captions: 量體渲染圖。
多角度數位研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The spinning motion was captured and frozen in a large hatched drawing. Its form was then abstracted and rebuilt as a light frame of sticks.
captions: Drawing of the frozen spinning motion.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 旋轉的動作被捕捉並凝結在一張大幅排線手繪中。接著將其形體抽象化，重建為輕盈的木棒框架。
captions: 凝結旋轉動作的手繪圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A new wearable model was assembled piece by piece from wooden sticks and paper. The finished frame follows the sweeping path of the spin.
captions: The stick frame in progress.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 學生以木棒與紙逐件組裝出新的可穿戴模型。完成的框架順著旋轉時掃過的軌跡延伸。
captions: 製作中的木棒框架。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a volume.
2. Add a body movement.
3. Freeze it in a drawing.
4. Build it to be worn.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一個量體出發。
2. 加入身體動作。
3. 以手繪凝結它。
4. 做成可穿戴的模型。

pins.title: A Scaffold of Growth
pins.description:
A cement-and-wire viewing tower grows a ligament of clay and wire around its spiral stair.

Model making | Bio-inspired structure | Cement and wire | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 生長的支架
zh-Hant.description:
一座水泥與鐵絲的觀景塔，沿著螺旋梯長出黏土與鐵絲的韌帶。

模型製作｜仿生結構｜水泥與鐵絲｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished viewing tower.
完成的觀景塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The work is inspired by how a torn knee ligament can be rebuilt, with a braided graft fixed by absorbable pins becoming a new ligament. The project asks how this process of repair and growth can shape a structure.
captions: Drawings of knee structures.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品的靈感來自膝關節韌帶的重建：以編織的移植物搭配可吸收的固定釘，長成新的韌帶。作品探問，這種修復與生長的過程，如何塑造一個結構。
captions: 膝關節結構手繪。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Knee structures were drawn with bones as support and muscles and ligaments as flexible protectors. Joint-like wire-and-cement pieces were then tested for strength and load-bearing.
captions: Concept sketch of the tower.
Cement and wire joint tests.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生描繪膝關節結構，以骨骼為支撐，肌肉與韌帶為柔性的保護。接著測試類似關節的鐵絲與水泥構件的強度與承重。
captions: 觀景塔概念草圖。
水泥與鐵絲的關節測試。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Most joint tests succeeded, though one wood-like tensile form did not. Several moulds of the cement tower failed under their own weight before the structure was reinforced.
captions: A wire ligament test.
The top of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 多數關節測試成功，只有一個仿木的張力形體失敗。水泥塔的數個模具在自重下失敗，之後才補強成功。
captions: 鐵絲韌帶測試。
塔頂。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A clay-and-wire ligament grows along the tower and wraps its spiral stair. Intentional cracks in the cement express damage, repair and growth.
captions: Spiral stair inside the strands.
Another view of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 黏土與鐵絲的韌帶沿著塔身生長，包覆螺旋梯。水泥上刻意留下的裂痕，表達損傷、修復與生長。
captions: 包覆在纖維中的螺旋梯。
觀景塔另一視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a living system.
2. Draw its parts.
3. Test the joints.
4. Grow it into a structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一個生命系統。
2. 描繪它的組成。
3. 測試接合。
4. 讓它長成結構。

pins.title: Oranges Pavilion
pins.description:
Mandarin pulp segments become the woven roofs of a bamboo pavilion in an orange grove.

Model making | Pavilion | Bamboo strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 橘子涼亭
zh-Hant.description:
橘子果肉的瓣形，化為果園中竹編涼亭的屋頂。

模型製作｜涼亭｜竹條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished pavilion model.
完成的涼亭模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student studied the cross-sections of more than twenty fruits and chose the mandarin orange. The project explores how nature and architecture relate through a pavilion set inside an orange grove.
captions: Cross-sections of different fruits.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究了二十多種水果的剖面，最後選擇橘子。作品透過一座位於橘子園中的涼亭，探索自然與建築的關係。
captions: 各種水果的剖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The pulp segments were drawn and then shaped digitally. The forms were scattered on a grid to test spacing and rhythm.
captions: Pulp segment forms on a grid.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生描繪果肉瓣形，再以數位方式塑形。這些形體被散佈在網格上，測試間距與節奏。
captions: 網格上的果肉瓣形。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The pulp forms were stretched into curved roofs over raised timber decks. A sketch placed the pavilion among the orange trees.
captions: Sketch of the pavilion in the grove.
Two views of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 果肉形體被拉伸成架高木平台上方的曲面屋頂。一張草圖把涼亭放進橘子樹之間。
captions: 果園中的涼亭草圖。
模型的兩個視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The bamboo-strip model shows woven shells floating above a walkway. The organic shapes form a harmonious space that blends with the grove.
captions: Roof shells and deck details.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 竹條模型呈現漂浮在步道上方的編織殼體。有機的形體構成一個與果園融為一體的和諧空間。
captions: 屋頂殼體與平台細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect natural samples.
2. Cut and compare them.
3. Pick one form.
4. Build it as a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集自然樣本。
2. 切開並比較。
3. 選定一個形體。
4. 以模型建造。

pins.title: Redesigning a Civic Plaza
pins.description:
Angled terraces, pools and planters reshape a downtown plaza for rest and market stalls.

San Francisco | Digital model | Public plaza | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 市民廣場再設計
zh-Hant.description:
以傾斜平台、水池與植栽重塑市中心廣場，容納休憩與市集攤位。

舊金山｜數位模型｜公共廣場｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Perspective of the redesigned plaza.
再設計後的廣場透視圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A high school design competition asked students to reimagine a downtown plaza in San Francisco. The plaza is surrounded by office buildings and hosts events such as free lessons and markets, so it needs places to rest and room for stalls.
captions: Diagram of green zones.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一項高中設計競賽，邀請學生重新想像舊金山市中心的一座廣場。廣場被辦公大樓包圍，並舉辦免費課程與市集等活動，因此需要休憩空間與攤位位置。
captions: 綠地分區圖解。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The site was studied through maps, photos and the directions people walk. Diagrams marked green zones and the main routes across the plaza.
captions: Diagram of walking routes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生透過地圖、照片與行人方向研究基地。圖解標示出綠地分區與穿越廣場的主要動線。
captions: 步行動線圖解。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The design took cues from the plaza's fountain and was oriented along pedestrian movement. Faceted planters, pools and seats were modelled as one landscape.
captions: Aerial render of the plaza.
Pools and planters.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計從廣場的噴泉取得靈感，並順著行人移動的方向配置。多面體的植栽、水池與座椅被塑造成一整片地景。
captions: 廣場鳥瞰渲染圖。
水池與植栽。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The digital model shows angled terraces wrapping pools and green islands. People can rest along the edges while open ground stays free for stalls.
captions: Terraces at one end.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 數位模型呈現傾斜平台環抱水池與綠島。人們可以在邊緣休憩，開放的地面則留給攤位使用。
captions: 一端的平台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the brief.
2. Watch how people move.
3. Shape the ground.
4. Leave room for events.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 閱讀題目。
2. 觀察人的移動。
3. 塑造地面。
4. 為活動留出空間。

pins.title: The Garden of Eternity
pins.description:
A mourning space that treats death as a milestone, with flower tombstones, roots and light.

Model making | Installation | Mourning space | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 永恆花園
zh-Hant.description:
一個把死亡視為里程碑的追思空間，以花朵墓碑、根系與光影構成。

模型製作｜裝置｜追思空間｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished garden model.
完成的花園模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Cemeteries hold people's thoughts about eternity, and every farewell shows how fleeting life is. The project designs a mourning space that treats death as a milestone in a continuing journey rather than an end.
captions: Early frame and roof models.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 墓園承載人們對永恆的思索，每一次告別都讓人感受生命的短暫。作品設計一個追思空間，把死亡視為持續旅程中的里程碑，而非終點。
captions: 初期的框架與屋頂模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Natural materials, light and shadow were chosen to show the cycle of life. Tombstones were made from flowers set in glue, to capture each bloom and pass hope to the next generation.
captions: Tombstones made of flowers.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生選用自然材料與光影，表現生命的循環。墓碑以花朵封入膠中製成，留住盛放的瞬間，並把希望傳給下一代。
captions: 以花朵製作的墓碑。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A grassy roof, a bamboo frame and twisting roots shelter small figures, coils and stairs inside. Model views test how light falls through the slatted walls.
captions: Figures among coils and stairs inside.
Roots and stairs in the interior.
Two views of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 草皮屋頂、竹構框架與蜿蜒的根系，庇護著室內的小人形、線圈與樓梯。模型視角測試光線如何穿過條狀牆面。
captions: 室內線圈與樓梯間的人形。
室內的根系與樓梯。
模型的兩個視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Two installations extend the garden: a rope bloom hung on a tree, and a corner of cyanotypes and netting about the threads that bind people together. Together they say that life continues in memory and that separation need not be feared.
captions: A rope bloom hung on a tree.
Looking up into the rope canopy.
Cyanotypes and netting on a red corner.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 兩件裝置延伸了花園：一朵懸掛在樹上的繩結花，以及一個以藍曬與網講述人與人之間牽絆的牆角。它們共同訴說生命延續在記憶裡，分離不必畏懼。
captions: 懸掛在樹上的繩結花。
仰望繩結頂篷。
紅色牆角上的藍曬與網。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Face a hard theme.
2. Find a hopeful view.
3. Choose living materials.
4. Let light tell the story.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 面對一個沉重主題。
2. 找到充滿希望的角度。
3. 選擇有生命的材料。
4. 讓光說故事。

pins.title: Passage in Planes
pins.description:
Folded and peeled paper planes turn a lakeside slope into a landscape of paths and shelters.

Model making | Landscape architecture | Paper and basswood | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 平面中的通道
zh-Hant.description:
折疊與剝離的紙平面，把湖畔坡地變成一片由路徑與遮蔽構成的地景。

模型製作｜地景建築｜紙與椴木｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished folded-plane model.
完成的折面模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project was made in a summer design studio, starting from a layered abstract painting chosen as a precedent. The student pulled out two actions from it, fragmentation and layering, to guide the design of a site on a lakeside slope.
captions: A composite line drawing of fragments.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品完成於一個暑期設計工作營，以一幅層疊的抽象畫作為先例。學生從中提取「碎片化」與「層疊」兩個動作，引導湖畔坡地基地的設計。
captions: 碎片化的複合線稿。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A language of cutting and folding surfaces was developed to express fragmentation. Basswood sticks were added to show movement and direction across the site.
captions: The digital model of the terrain.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生發展出一套切割與折疊表面的語彙，表達碎片化。椴木條則用來表現穿越基地的移動與方向。
captions: 地形的數位模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Folded and peeled planes respond to the natural topography and guide visitors across, around and through the terrain. Walkable roofs rise to viewpoints while the ground peels down at the centre into a quiet zone near the lake.
captions: Diagram of the circulation paths.
Side view of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 折疊與剝離的平面回應自然地形，引導訪客跨越、環繞並穿過地景。可行走的屋頂升向觀景點，中央的地面則向下剝離，形成靠近湖水的安靜區域。
captions: 動線圖解。
模型側視。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model avoids fixed entries and set programs, so circulation unfolds through each visitor's own choices. Basswood sticks mark sightlines and pauses among the angular planes.
captions: Close views of planes and sticks.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型避免固定的入口與既定機能，讓動線隨著每位訪客的選擇展開。椴木條在銳利的平面之間標示視線與停頓。
captions: 平面與木條的近看。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a precedent.
2. Pull out its actions.
3. Turn them into surfaces.
4. Let people choose their path.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個先例。
2. 提取它的動作。
3. 把動作化為表面。
4. 讓人自己選擇路徑。

pins.title: Continuum
pins.description:
Tori carved out of stacked cylinders form a tower wrapped by one continuous circular path.

Digital model | Rendering | Torque study | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 連續體
zh-Hant.description:
以圓環體切削堆疊的圓柱，形成一座被連續環形路徑包覆的塔。

數位模型｜渲染｜扭轉研究｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Render of the finished tower.
完成的塔樓渲染圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project was made in a summer design studio and explores the verb torque. The question was how a twisting action can carve spaces out of simple cylinders.
captions: Steps that generate the form.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品完成於一個暑期設計工作營，探索動詞「扭轉」。題目在問，扭轉的動作如何從簡單的圓柱中切削出空間。
captions: 形體生成步驟。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Tori were used to cut into stacked cylinders, step by step. Each step was checked in plan and in section.
captions: Section through the tower and ground.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生以圓環體逐步切入堆疊的圓柱。每一步都在平面與剖面中檢查。
captions: 塔樓與地面的剖面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Like a spiral gallery, the design replaces stairs with a continuous circular path that leads to the top. Openings were cut for views, and a carved ground plane connects to the main building.
captions: Unrolled rotation drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 如同螺旋展廊，設計以一條通往頂部的連續環形路徑取代樓梯。牆上切出觀景開口，切削的地面則連接主建築。
captions: 展開的旋轉投影圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model was rendered into composite, section and unrolled drawings and a short animation. The drawings show how one rotating move organises the whole tower.
captions: A second rotation drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型被渲染成複合圖、剖面圖、展開圖與一段短動畫。這些圖說明一個旋轉的動作如何組織整座塔。
captions: 另一張旋轉投影圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a verb.
2. Act it on a simple shape.
3. Draw every step.
4. Walk through the result.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個動詞。
2. 把它施加在簡單形體上。
3. 畫下每一步。
4. 走進成果之中。

pins.title: Misery House
pins.description:
A suspended frame of basswood splints and folded PVC explores how confinement tightens space.

Model making | Spatial narrative | PVC and basswood | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 苦難之屋
zh-Hant.description:
以椴木夾板與折疊PVC構成的懸吊框架，探索禁錮如何收緊空間。

模型製作｜空間敘事｜PVC與椴木｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished suspended frame.
完成的懸吊框架。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The work is inspired by a psychological thriller in which an obsessive fan holds a writer captive in a remote house. The student explored how psychological constraint can shape the tightness of a space.
captions: The diagram drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品的靈感來自一部心理驚悚故事：一位偏執的書迷把作家囚禁在偏遠的房子裡。學生探索心理上的束縛如何塑造空間的緊迫感。
captions: 圖解手繪。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A diagram of the tortures in the story was drawn and fed into a parametric script. The script turned the drawing into patterns of lines.
captions: The parametric script.
Patterns generated from the drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生把故事中的折磨畫成圖解，輸入參數化腳本。腳本把圖面轉化為線條圖樣。
captions: 參數化腳本。
由圖面生成的圖樣。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sections were cut from PVC board along the lines and folded. Basswood sticks joined the pieces like brittle splints, echoing the splints of a slow recovery.
captions: Cutting and folding the PVC pieces.
Spatial typology studies.
Folded PVC pieces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生沿著線條從PVC板切出片段並折疊。椴木條像脆弱的夾板般連接構件，呼應緩慢復原時的夾板。
captions: 切割與折疊PVC構件。
空間類型研究。
折疊的PVC構件。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The pieces were connected and hung with fishing line from a metal frame. The suspended mass gives a feeling of containment similar to the house in the story.
captions: The frame assembled and hung.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 構件連接後以釣魚線懸吊在金屬框架上。懸浮的量體帶來與故事中那棟房子相似的禁錮感。
captions: 組裝並懸吊的框架。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a story.
2. Draw its tension.
3. Translate it with code.
4. Build the feeling.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從故事出發。
2. 畫出它的張力。
3. 以程式轉譯。
4. 建構那種感受。

pins.title: Edge of Thaw
pins.description:
A gallery that collects glacier meltwater and purifies it in layered tanks people can watch.

Model making | Gallery | Resin and gypsum | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 融冰邊緣
zh-Hant.description:
一座收集冰川融水、以可觀看的層疊水槽淨化的展廊。

模型製作｜展廊｜樹脂與石膏｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished gallery model.
完成的展廊模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student grew interested in glacier melting caused by global warming. The project asks how a space could reuse the water collected after glaciers melt.
captions: Concept sketch of the gallery.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生關注全球暖化造成的冰川融化。作品探問，一個空間如何再利用冰川融化後收集的水。
captions: 展廊概念草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The idea was sketched by hand and then built as a digital model. Ice forms were shaped to drip into the space below.
captions: Digital model of the ice form.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先手繪構想，再建成數位模型。冰體形態被塑造成向下方空間滴落。
captions: 冰體形態的數位模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Stone, sand and filter media were tested in each acrylic tank to refine the purifying layers. Resin and gypsum were cast for the hanging ice.
captions: Material tests with stone and gypsum.
Filter layer and casting tests.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生在每個壓克力水槽中測試石頭、沙與過濾材料，調整淨化層。懸吊的冰體則以樹脂與石膏澆鑄。
captions: 石頭與石膏的材料測試。
過濾層與澆鑄測試。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A transparent gallery lets visitors watch the water being purified and learn about the harm of glacier melting. A tube beneath the tanks delivers clean water directly to people.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 透明的展廊讓訪客看見水被淨化的過程，認識冰川融化的危害。水槽下方的管線把乾淨的水直接送到人們手中。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a global issue.
2. Find a local action.
3. Test real materials.
4. Make the process visible.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個全球議題。
2. 找到在地行動。
3. 測試真實材料。
4. 讓過程被看見。

pins.title: The Inert World
pins.description:
A wire and found-object assemblage of a still central world circled by four rebellious planets.

Model making | Assemblage | Mixed media | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 惰性世界
zh-Hant.description:
以鐵絲與拾得物件組成的集合裝置：一個靜止的中心世界，被四顆反抗的星球環繞。

模型製作｜集合裝置｜複合媒材｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished assemblage.
完成的集合裝置。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The work starts from an animated science-fiction series whose hero believes life is meaningless yet keeps living, exploring other universes. The student asked how a space can express this quiet resistance.
captions: Stills from the animated series studied.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品從一部動畫科幻影集出發，主角相信生命毫無意義，卻仍持續活著、探索其他宇宙。學生探問，空間如何表達這種安靜的反抗。
captions: 研究的動畫影集畫面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Episodes of the series were studied and sketched into a map of worlds. Each world was given its own attitude towards rules and systems.
captions: Concept sketch of the worlds.
More stills from the series.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究影集的各集內容，畫成一張世界地圖。每個世界都被賦予面對規則與體系的不同態度。
captions: 世界的概念草圖。
更多影集畫面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A central middle planet represents a regulated, restrained world where people often feel powerless. Four planets around it each show a way to resist, break or face the systems that confine them.
captions: Building the wire worlds.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 中央的星球代表一個受規範、受約束、令人常感無力的世界。周圍四顆星球各自呈現抵抗、打破或面對束縛體系的方式。
captions: 製作鐵絲世界。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The inert world at the centre is defined by apathy rather than laws, a chaos disguised as order. The assemblage shows the many ways beings struggle for agency in a universe that offers none.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 中心的惰性世界由冷漠而非法則定義，是偽裝成秩序的混亂。集合裝置呈現眾生在毫無回應的宇宙中爭取自主的多種方式。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch closely.
2. Name the idea beneath.
3. Give it worlds.
4. Assemble them by hand.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 仔細觀看。
2. 說出背後的想法。
3. 賦予它世界。
4. 親手組裝。

pins.title: CoHabit
pins.description:
A climbing framework of sticks and tubes gives cats high, hidden places above shared human space.

Model making | Multispecies design | Basswood and straws | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 共棲
zh-Hant.description:
由木條與管子構成的攀爬框架，在人類共享空間上方，為貓提供高處與隱蔽處。

模型製作｜跨物種設計｜椴木與吸管｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished framework model.
完成的框架模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project began with the student's experience of caring for stray cats that came and went as they wished. The student asked whether architecture, usually built for humans, could also serve other creatures without forcing them to adapt.
captions: Studies of cat postures and behaviour.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品始於學生照顧流浪貓的經驗，這些貓來去自如。學生思考，通常為人而建的建築，能否也服務其他生物，而不強迫牠們適應。
captions: 貓的姿態與行為研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Feline behaviour was studied through a documentary and readings on animal ethics. The studies showed that cats love high places and secret, solitary spots.
captions: Early stick-grid sketch models.
A tall stick test.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生透過紀錄片與動物倫理的閱讀研究貓的行為。研究顯示貓喜歡高處與隱密、獨處的角落。
captions: 早期的木條網格草模。
高聳的木條測試。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Stick grids were tested as frames for climbing at different heights. Plastic straws became tubes that cats can use as hiding spots.
captions: A row of sketch models.
Detail of stick joints.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生測試木條網格作為不同高度的攀爬框架。塑膠吸管化為貓可以躲藏的管道。
captions: 一排草模。
木條接合細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The upper framework belongs to cats, while the ground level stays free for people to meet and relax. The aim is a shared space that does not force animals to fit human patterns.
captions: Close views of tubes and sticks.
The framework under light.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 上層框架屬於貓，地面層則留給人們相聚與休憩。目標是一個不強迫動物配合人類模式的共享空間。
captions: 管子與木條的近看。
光線下的框架。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Notice another user.
2. Study how it lives.
3. Design for both.
4. Let each keep its habits.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 留意另一種使用者。
2. 研究牠如何生活。
3. 為雙方設計。
4. 讓彼此保有習性。

pins.title: Coffee-ground Brick
pins.description:
Bricks of used coffee grounds and mud lead to an underground coffee hub in a downtown block.

Material research | Architecture | Coffee grounds | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 咖啡渣磚
zh-Hant.description:
以咖啡渣與泥土製成的磚，延伸為市中心地下的咖啡社區據點。

材料研究｜建築｜咖啡渣｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The full-scale brick wall in its timber frame.
木框中的足尺磚牆。

sections.heading: Problem
