sections.body: Having lived in a coffee-growing country where people built with corrugated sheets, the student wanted an ecofriendly, low-cost material for better construction. Used coffee grounds became the starting point.
captions: Mixing coffee grounds with mud.
Coffee grounds drying.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生曾住在一個咖啡產地，當地人以浪板搭建房屋，因此希望找到環保、低成本的材料改善建造。用過的咖啡渣成為起點。
captions: 把咖啡渣與泥土混合。
晾乾的咖啡渣。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Grounds collected from local coffee shops were dried for several days. They were then mixed with mud and water and pressed into moulds.
captions: Sieved coffee grounds.
Bricks in their moulds.
From grounds to bricks.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生向在地咖啡店收集咖啡渣，晾乾數天。接著與泥土和水混合，壓入模具。
captions: 過篩的咖啡渣。
模具中的磚。
從咖啡渣到磚。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The bricks were applied to a proposal for an underground coffee community in downtown San Francisco. Three levels hold a market tracing the bean-to-brew cycle, a gallery on coffee origins and a rooftop café with an open plaza.
captions: Digital models of the building.
Exploded diagram of the levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 磚被應用在舊金山市中心地下咖啡社區的提案中。三個樓層分別容納呈現從咖啡豆到沖煮全過程的市集、介紹咖啡產地的展廊，以及附開放廣場的屋頂咖啡館。
captions: 建築的數位模型。
樓層爆炸圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Many bricks were stacked in a full-scale timber frame with an opening at the top that acts as a window. The wall shows that waste from daily coffee can become a real building material.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 大量磚塊被堆疊進足尺木框中，頂部留有一個作為窗戶的開口。這面牆證明日常咖啡的廢料可以成為真正的建材。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a real need.
2. Collect a waste material.
3. Make and test units.
4. Build at full scale.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從真實需求出發。
2. 收集一種廢料。
3. 製作並測試單元。
4. 以足尺建造。

pins.title: Scraps to Soil
pins.description:
A kitchen-waste bin grows into a full composting system, first as a model and then as a working machine.

Model making | Product and system design | Concrete, wood and acrylic | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 從廚餘到土壤
zh-Hant.description:
一個廚餘桶發展成完整的堆肥系統，先做成模型，再做成可運轉的機器。

模型製作｜產品與系統設計｜混凝土、木材與壓克力｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The composting system model.
堆肥系統模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project began with the student's daily routine of taking out kitchen waste at home. A bin that filters out liquid waste came first, but a single object could not make a lasting impact.
captions: Sketch of the waste-to-soil cycle.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品起於學生在家倒廚餘的日常。最先設計的是能濾除液體的廚餘桶，但單一物件無法帶來長久的影響。
captions: 廚餘變土壤的循環草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The idea grew into a complete system in which a wheel feeds a grinder and turns waste into soil. Sketches mapped each step from kitchen to garden.
captions: Sketch of the wheel and grinder.
Sketches of the garden layout.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 構想發展成一套完整系統：水車帶動研磨機，把廚餘變成土壤。草圖標出從廚房到花園的每一步。
captions: 水車與研磨機草圖。
花園配置草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A concrete and wood model placed the grinder under an orange frame among garden beds. The student also sold the bins at an Earth Day sale.
captions: Garden beds around the system.
The orange frame over the grinder.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以混凝土與木材製作模型，把研磨機放在花圃之間的橘色框架下。學生也在一場地球日義賣中賣出了這些廚餘桶。
captions: 系統周圍的花圃。
研磨機上方的橘色框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A full-size machine with acrylic boards, a metal frame and a pipe nozzle system was then built. With local support, it was introduced to a village to address organic waste in rivers.
captions: Top of the built machine.
Bearing and frame detail.
A drawer of the waste bin.
The pipe nozzle detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 學生接著以壓克力板、金屬框架與管嘴系統打造出實尺寸的機器。在地方支持下，機器被引入一個村落，處理河流中的有機廢棄物。
captions: 實體機器的上部。
軸承與框架細節。
廚餘桶的抽屜。
管嘴細節。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a daily habit.
2. Grow it into a system.
3. Model the whole cycle.
4. Build it at full size.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從日常習慣出發。
2. 把它擴展成系統。
3. 以模型呈現完整循環。
4. 做成實際尺寸。

pins.title: The Daya Bay Boathouse
pins.description:
A sailing base rethought as a boathouse of light wooden rods and woven joints.

Model making | Architecture | Wooden rods and cardboard | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 大亞灣船屋
zh-Hant.description:
以輕巧木桿與交織接頭，重新構想一座帆船基地的船屋。

模型製作｜建築｜木桿與紙板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished boathouse model.
完成的船屋模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: As a sailor, the student noticed many functional shortcomings in the infrastructure of a sailing base. The project responds directly to the needs found on site.
captions: The existing boat racks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 身為帆船手，學生注意到帆船基地設施的許多功能不足。作品直接回應在現場發現的需求。
captions: 既有的船架。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Japanese and Hakka wooden joinery became the main references. The student studied how rods interlock without heavy connectors.
captions: Wooden joinery studied on site.
Sketches of roof and frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 日式與客家木構接合是主要參考。學生研究木桿如何不靠厚重五金而彼此咬合。
captions: 在基地觀察的木構接合。
屋頂與框架草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sketches tested trusses, roofs and openings made of thin rods. Blue gel wax, cardboard and wire mesh were combined to show water, decks and walls.
captions: Sketches of truss and joints.
Sketches of rods and openings.
Inside the deck levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 草圖測試以細桿構成的桁架、屋頂與開口。藍色凝膠蠟、紙板與鐵絲網組合起來，表現水面、甲板與牆面。
captions: 桁架與接頭草圖。
木桿與開口草圖。
甲板樓層內部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model shows a system of rods that emphasises lightness, exposure and structural elegance. Boats sit under the decks, ready to slide into the water.
captions: Front view of the boathouse.
Close views of the joints.
Side view of the rod frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型呈現一套強調輕盈、外露與結構美感的木桿系統。船隻停在甲板下方，隨時可以滑入水中。
captions: 船屋正面。
接頭近看。
木桿框架側視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Notice what is missing.
2. Study a craft tradition.
3. Sketch the joints.
4. Build light and visible.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 發現不足之處。
2. 研究工藝傳統。
3. 畫出接頭。
4. 做得輕盈而外露。

pins.title: Hometown Memory
pins.description:
A section model of a traditional Hakka home, with 3D-printed roof tiles and hand-built joinery.

Model making | Vernacular architecture | Wood, cement and resin | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 故鄉記憶
zh-Hant.description:
一座傳統客家民居的剖面模型，結合3D列印屋瓦與手作木構接合。

模型製作｜傳統建築｜木材、水泥與樹脂｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The section model of the home.
民居剖面模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Returning to the father's hometown, the student saw the mudbrick walls and green tiles of an old family house. Traditional Hakka building is fading with urbanisation, and the project sets out to study and record it.
captions: Perspective sketch of the roof frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 回到父親的故鄉，學生看見老家的泥磚牆與青瓦。客家傳統建築正隨著都市化逐漸消失，作品因此著手研究並記錄它。
captions: 屋頂框架透視草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Mortise and tenon joints from the ancestral home were photographed and studied closely. The student also researched how semi-cylindrical pan and cover tiles overlap in rows.
captions: Shaping the tiles by hand.
Layering rows of tiles.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生拍攝並仔細研究祖屋的榫卯接合。學生也研究半圓筒形的板瓦與筒瓦如何成排交疊。
captions: 手工整理屋瓦。
層疊排列屋瓦。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Tile panels were modelled in Rhino, 3D printed at home and layered like the real roof. The base was cast in concrete after dirt proved too weak to support the model.
captions: Testing the timber joints.
A finished roof panel.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 屋瓦板在Rhino中建模，在家以3D列印製作，並像真實屋頂般層疊。由於泥土不足以支撐模型，底座改以混凝土澆鑄。
captions: 測試木構接頭。
完成的屋頂板。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The section cut reveals the techniques used inside the home. Layered bricks in the courtyard show the flooring traditionally used in Hakka houses.
captions: The model from above.
The courtyard with brick paving.
Side view of the frame.
The roof frame from below.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 剖切面揭示民居內部使用的工法。庭院中層疊的磚塊呈現客家民居傳統的地坪做法。
captions: 模型俯視。
鋪磚的庭院。
框架側視。
由下看屋頂框架。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Visit a real place.
2. Record how it is built.
3. Rebuild the details.
4. Cut it open to explain.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 走訪真實場所。
2. 記錄它的構造。
3. 重建細部。
4. 剖開來說明。

pins.title: The Ghost Net
pins.description:
A tank model and tide experiments show how pollutants gather around man-made structures in the sea.

Model making | Environmental research | Sticks, sand and acrylic | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 幽靈漁網
zh-Hant.description:
以水槽模型與潮汐實驗，呈現污染物如何聚集在海中的人造結構周圍。

模型製作｜環境研究｜木條、沙與壓克力｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The vertical tank model.
直立的水槽模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: As a sailing coach, the student saw abandoned fishing nets tangled with wood, plastic and dead fish. Artificial structures often trap this waste in tidal areas and harm local ecosystems.
captions: The two experiment tanks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 身為帆船教練，學生看見廢棄漁網與木頭、塑膠和死魚纏在一起。人造結構常在潮間帶困住這些垃圾，傷害在地生態。
captions: 兩個實驗水槽。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Two tanks compared a shoreline with pillars against a natural one at low, normal and high tide. Debris stayed trapped around the pillars but washed away along the natural coast.
captions: Debris at low tide.
Debris at high tide.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 兩個水槽在低潮、平潮與高潮下，比較有樁柱的海岸與自然海岸。垃圾困在樁柱周圍，在自然海岸則被沖散。
captions: 低潮時的垃圾。
高潮時的垃圾。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The results led to a tall model that layers plastic, fishing line, hooks and structures. Each pollutant was placed where it would gather in the sea.
captions: Hooks caught on a stick.
A wire cage on the seabed.
A bottle trapped in netting.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 實驗結果引出一座高聳的模型，層疊塑膠、釣魚線、魚鉤與結構。每種污染物都被放在海中會聚集的位置。
captions: 卡在木條上的魚鉤。
海床上的鐵絲籠。
困在網中的瓶子。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model shows how pollutants intertwine and make marine contamination more complex. It makes the impact of human activity on the ocean visible at a glance.
captions: Stones and plants on the seabed.
Debris settled in the sand.
The shoreline of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型呈現污染物如何交織，讓海洋污染變得更複雜。它讓人類活動對海洋的影響一目了然。
captions: 海床上的石頭與植物。
沉積在沙中的垃圾。
模型的海岸線。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from what you see.
2. Run a simple test.
3. Read the results.
4. Build the evidence.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從親眼所見出發。
2. 做一個簡單實驗。
3. 解讀結果。
4. 把證據做出來。

pins.title: Daya Bay Eco-model
pins.description:
Resin, shells and coral fragments from a local beach show how a crowded shore harms the sea.

Model making | Environmental design | Resin, shells and coral | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 大亞灣生態模型
zh-Hant.description:
以樹脂、貝殼與在地海灘的珊瑚碎片，呈現擁擠的海岸如何傷害海洋。

模型製作｜環境設計｜樹脂、貝殼與珊瑚｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The model seen from above.
模型俯視。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Active in the bay, the student saw the local coral ecosystem decline at first hand. Oil and fertiliser spills have harmed the coral and the animals that depend on it.
captions: Concept sketch and materials.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生長期在海灣活動，親眼看見在地珊瑚生態衰退。油污與肥料外洩傷害了珊瑚以及依賴它的生物。
captions: 概念草圖與材料。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Coral skeletons and shells washed up on a local beach were collected as materials. Their meaning was compared with AB resin as an artificial material.
captions: The resin block from an angle.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生收集沖上在地海灘的珊瑚骨骼與貝殼作為材料。學生把它們的意義與作為人工材料的AB膠對照。
captions: 樹脂模型斜視。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Shells and fragments were layered in resin, with 3D-printed buildings packed along the shore. Pebbles and clay shaped the edge between city and sea.
captions: Buildings along the shore.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 貝殼與碎片層層封入樹脂，3D列印的建築密集排列在岸邊。卵石與黏土塑造出城市與海之間的邊界。
captions: 沿岸的建築。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model shows how rapid urbanisation leads to algae blooms and oil pollution. It is a visual example of how the ocean has been harmed.
captions: Layers of shells and resin.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型呈現快速都市化如何導致藻華與油污。它直觀呈現海洋受到的傷害。
captions: 貝殼與樹脂的層次。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect local materials.
2. Give each one a meaning.
3. Layer them in order.
4. Let the model speak.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集在地材料。
2. 賦予每種材料意義。
3. 依序層疊。
4. 讓模型自己說話。

pins.title: Algorithmic Modelling: Artificial Coral Reefs
pins.description:
Coral forms generated by script and 3D printed as shelters for fish and marine life.

Parametric design | 3D printing | Marine ecology | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 演算法建模：人工珊瑚礁
zh-Hant.description:
以腳本生成珊瑚形態並3D列印，作為魚類與海洋生物的庇護所。

參數化設計｜3D列印｜海洋生態｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The 3D-printed coral tower.
3D列印的珊瑚塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: As a local sailor, the student watched coral reefs degrade after an oil leak. Global warming and industry keep shrinking reefs around the world.
captions: Threats to coral reefs.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 身為在地帆船手，學生目睹珊瑚礁在一次油污外洩後退化。全球暖化與工業活動也持續讓世界各地的珊瑚礁縮小。
captions: 珊瑚礁面臨的威脅。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Artificial coral ecosystems that protect fish like real reefs became the chosen solution. A parametric script generated porous forms inspired by coral species.
captions: The parametric script.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生選擇以能像真實珊瑚礁般保護魚類的人工珊瑚生態系作為解方。參數化腳本生成受珊瑚物種啟發的多孔形態。
captions: 參數化腳本。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Print tests compared density and pore size. The pattern was then turned into modules that could be stacked.
captions: An early print test.
A denser print test.
Render of the porous pattern.
Renders of reef modules.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 列印測試比較密度與孔洞大小。圖樣接著被轉化為可堆疊的模組。
captions: 早期列印測試。
較密的列印測試。
多孔圖樣的渲染。
珊瑚礁模組的渲染。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A 3D-printed tower shows the final reef form. Concept views imagine fish and coral living inside it.
captions: Concept view of fish in the reef.
Concept view of coral growing.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 3D列印的塔呈現最終的礁體形態。概念圖想像魚群與珊瑚在其中生長。
captions: 魚群在礁體中的概念圖。
珊瑚生長的概念圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name the damage.
2. Learn from nature.
3. Let code generate form.
4. Test by printing.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 指出破壞。
2. 向自然學習。
3. 讓程式生成形態。
4. 以列印測試。

pins.title: Summer Studio: Movement Model
pins.description:
A pattern from artwork is extruded into frames and reshaped by the motion of swinging on monkey bars.

Model making | Digital modelling | Wooden rods, wire and paper | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 暑期工作營：動作模型
zh-Hant.description:
從藝術作品中提取的圖樣被擠出為框架，再依擺盪單槓的動作重新塑形。

模型製作｜數位建模｜木桿、鐵絲與紙｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final movement model.
完成的動作模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project was made in a summer design studio and starts from the idea that patterns shape how we see the world. The question was how patterns could connect with the way people move through a space.
captions: Pattern studies from the artwork.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品完成於一個暑期設計工作營，起點是圖樣影響我們觀看世界的方式。題目在問，圖樣如何與人在空間中的移動連結。
captions: 從藝術作品得出的圖樣研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Parts of a pattern in an artwork were marked and extruded into 3D. A sketch model was built both in Rhino and with physical materials.
captions: Digital model of the frames.
A second view of the digital model.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生在一件藝術作品的圖樣中標出局部並擠出為立體。草模同時在Rhino與實體材料中製作。
captions: 框架的數位模型。
數位模型的另一視角。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: An unconventional movement, swinging on monkey bars, was analysed frame by frame. Parts of the frames were removed so the model could follow the swing.
captions: Frames traced from the movement.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生逐格分析一個不尋常的動作：擺盪單槓。框架被局部移除，讓模型能跟隨擺盪。
captions: 從動作描出的框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model completes the swinging motion while keeping the look of the first pattern. It shows architecture as the design of human interaction with a set environment.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型完成擺盪的動作，同時保有最初圖樣的樣貌。它呈現建築作為人與既定環境互動的設計。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a pattern.
2. Extrude it into space.
3. Add a body movement.
4. Edit until both read.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找到一個圖樣。
2. 把它擠出成空間。
3. 加入身體動作。
4. 修改到兩者都清楚。

pins.title: Summer Studio: Folded Paper Pavilion
pins.description:
Symmetrical origami models grow into a timber pavilion that shades a campus walkway and lets light in.

Model making | Pavilion design | Paper and digital renders | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 暑期工作營：摺紙涼亭
zh-Hant.description:
對稱的摺紙模型發展成一座木構涼亭，為校園步道遮蔭並引入光線。

模型製作｜涼亭設計｜紙與數位渲染｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Render of the pavilion from above.
涼亭鳥瞰渲染。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project was made in a summer design studio and explores light in architectural design. The site needed shade for students and teachers moving in and out of a building.
captions: A folded dome model.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品完成於一個暑期設計工作營，探索建築設計中的光線。基地需要為進出建築的師生提供遮蔭。
captions: 摺紙穹頂模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Taking an origami precedent as a start, the student folded symmetrical paper models. Each fold was tested for how it lets light through.
captions: A folded star model.
A folded flower model.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生以一個摺紙先例為起點，摺出對稱的紙模型。學生並測試每道摺痕如何讓光穿透。
captions: 摺紙星形模型。
摺紙花形模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The folds were rebuilt as paper shells and then as a Rhino model. Openings were cut so natural light falls into the space below.
captions: A paper model of the shell.
A second view of the shell.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 摺痕先被重建為紙殼，再做成Rhino模型。殼體上切出開口，讓自然光灑落下方空間。
captions: 殼體的紙模型。
殼體的另一視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The timber pavilion makes a social space where people can feel at ease. Renders show it among the courtyard columns and brick walls.
captions: Render of the pavilion in the courtyard.
Render of people resting below.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 木構涼亭形成一個讓人自在交流的社交空間。渲染圖呈現它坐落在庭院柱列與磚牆之間。
captions: 庭院中的涼亭渲染。
人們在下方休息的渲染。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Fold before you draw.
2. Test light through folds.
3. Scale up the shell.
4. Place it where people meet.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先摺再畫。
2. 測試光穿過摺痕。
3. 放大殼體。
4. 放在人們相遇之處。

pins.title: The Layered Street
pins.description:
A narrow city street is rebuilt in three layers: an elevated walkway, a greener ground level and a driveway below.

Model making | Urban design | 3D print and laser cutting | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 分層街道
zh-Hant.description:
一條狹窄的城市街道被重建為三層：高架步道、更綠的地面層與地下車道。

模型製作｜都市設計｜3D列印與雷射切割｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The layered street model.
分層街道模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The street was a passage between the back walls of large buildings, with few shops and little sunlight. People walked through it, but few chose to stay.
captions: Section sketch along the street.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這條街夾在大型建築的背面之間，商店稀少，日照不足。人們只是穿過，很少有人願意停留。
captions: 沿街剖面草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied elevated parks and stepped pocket gardens as ways to layer a street. Sketches tested where people could pause, sit and find sunlight.
captions: Sketch of the elevated walkway.
Render of the stairs and planters.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究高架公園與階梯式口袋花園，作為讓街道分層的方法。草圖測試人們可以在哪裡停留、坐下並曬到太陽。
captions: 高架步道草圖。
階梯與植栽的渲染圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The ground level gained wider sidewalks, planted edges and street furniture, while cars moved to a driveway below. AI renders helped picture the mood of each layer.
captions: Sketch of the new ground level.
The street before and after.
AI render of the walkway.
AI render of the driveway entrance.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 地面層加寬人行道、加入植栽邊帶與街道家具，車輛則移到下方車道。AI渲染圖幫助想像每一層的氛圍。
captions: 新地面層草圖。
街道改造前後。
步道的AI渲染圖。
車道入口的AI渲染圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model was made with 3D printing and laser cutting at a length of 900 mm. A white walkway zigzags above the street and links its two ends.
captions: Stairs and a tree on the model.
The whole street model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以3D列印與雷射切割製成，長900毫米。白色步道在街道上方曲折延伸，連接街道兩端。
captions: 模型上的階梯與樹。
整條街道模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch how people use a street.
2. Split the street into layers.
3. Sketch each layer.
4. Build the whole length.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察人們如何使用街道。
2. 把街道分成數層。
3. 逐層繪製草圖。
4. 做出整條街的長度。

pins.title: The Gaze Chamber
pins.description:
A chamber and a floating stage turn a busy city plaza into a place to see and be seen.

Model making | Public space design | 3D print | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 凝視之室
zh-Hant.description:
一座廳室與一座漂浮舞台，把繁忙的城市廣場變成看與被看的場所。

模型製作｜公共空間設計｜3D列印｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The 3D-printed chamber model.
3D列印的廳室模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The plaza sits between transit, theatres and civic buildings, yet people mostly pass through it. The project asks how it could hold markets, shows and everyday meetings.
captions: Sightlines across the plaza.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座廣場位於交通、劇院與市政建築之間，人們卻大多只是路過。作品探問它如何容納市集、演出與日常相遇。
captions: 穿越廣場的視線分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied how vision and power are linked, and how sightlines can divide a space. Red lines in the plans extend the gaze between the chamber and the stage.
captions: Plan of the chamber.
Plan of the stage.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究視線與權力的關係，以及視線如何劃分空間。平面圖中的紅線延伸了廳室與舞台之間的凝視。
captions: 廳室平面圖。
舞台平面圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The chamber was carved into the plaza as a broken but continuous sequence of arches. Pauses, turns and framed views slow people down as they move through.
captions: Another view of the arches.
Arches and wooden ribs.
Open forms of the chamber.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 廳室以一連串斷開卻連續的拱形嵌入廣場。停頓、轉折與框景讓穿越的人放慢腳步。
captions: 拱形的另一個角度。
拱形與木肋。
廳室的開放形體。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A stage floats over a shallow pool and works as seating, a platform or a backdrop. The design does not try to be a landmark, but a frame where different people meet.
captions: Render of the chamber and stage.
The plaza off season.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 舞台漂浮在淺水池上，可作為座位、平台或布景。設計不求成為地標，而是成為不同人群相遇的框架。
captions: 廳室與舞台的渲染圖。
非活動季節的廣場。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map how people move.
2. Draw the lines of sight.
3. Shape pauses and turns.
4. Let the space change use.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 標出人的動線。
2. 畫出視線。
3. 塑造停頓與轉折。
4. 讓空間可以改變用途。

pins.title: House of Lines and Colour
pins.description:
Grid paintings are traced and turned into the planes, voids and colours of a house.

Model making | Architecture | Foam board, acrylic and laser cutting | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 線與色之屋
zh-Hant.description:
臨摹格狀繪畫，並把它們轉化為一棟房屋的平面、虛空與色彩。

模型製作｜建築｜泡棉板、壓克力與雷射切割｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished house model.
完成的房屋模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was drawn to grid paintings with layered depth and shifting lines and colours. The question was how such a flat composition could become a house.
captions: Traced drafts of lines and points.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生被層次豐富、線條與色彩不斷位移的格狀繪畫吸引。問題是如此平面的構圖如何成為一棟房屋。
captions: 線與點的臨摹草稿。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The paintings were traced to pull out proportions, solids and voids, lines and flows. These drafts became plans and sections of a house.
captions: Exploded diagram of the house.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生臨摹這些畫作，萃取比例、實與虛、線條與流動。這些草稿成為房屋的平面與剖面。
captions: 房屋爆炸圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Clear and coloured acrylic, perforated metal mesh, laser-cut wood and 3D-printed parts were layered. Each part was cut and assembled following CAD models.
captions: Views of the façade.
Stair and roof views.
Coloured acrylic panels.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生層疊透明與彩色壓克力、沖孔金屬網、雷射切割木材與3D列印零件。每個零件都依照CAD模型切割並組裝。
captions: 立面視角。
樓梯與屋頂視角。
彩色壓克力板。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The house reads as a reinterpreted painting in three dimensions. Windows, slats and coloured panels shift as the viewer walks around it.
captions: Side and top views.
Window boxes and roof.
Perforated mesh and roof slats.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這棟房屋就像一幅被立體重新詮釋的畫作。觀者繞行時，窗、條板與彩色面板隨之變化。
captions: 側面與頂部視角。
窗盒與屋頂。
沖孔網與屋頂條板。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Trace a work you admire.
2. Pull out its rules.
3. Turn rules into plans.
4. Build it in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 臨摹你欣賞的作品。
2. 萃取它的規則。
3. 把規則轉成平面。
4. 分層製作。

pins.title: Lunar Nexus
pins.description:
A habitat inside a lunar crater, with a glass dome, a glowing tower and six underground pods.

Model making | Speculative architecture | Cement, acrylic and 3D print | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 月球樞紐
zh-Hant.description:
一座位於月球坑洞內的棲地，有玻璃穹頂、發光高塔與六個地下艙。

模型製作｜思辨建築｜水泥、壓克力與3D列印｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The glowing habitat tower.
發光的棲地高塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Lunar craters and underground caves could shelter people from extreme heat, cold and radiation. The project imagines a self-sufficient base built from what the Moon offers.
captions: Sketch of the crater section.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 月球坑洞與地下洞穴可以讓人避開極端溫差與輻射。作品想像一座以月球自身資源建造的自給基地。
captions: 坑洞剖面草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied how lunar soil could make bricks, water and glass. Plan sketches linked homes, labs, energy rooms and gardens around a central core.
captions: Sketch of the floor plans.
The glass dome model.
Render of the structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究月壤如何製成磚、水與玻璃。平面草圖把住宅、實驗室、能源室與花園連結在中央核心周圍。
captions: 樓層平面草圖。
玻璃穹頂模型。
結構渲染圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The crater was cast in cement and fitted with six pods for living, farming, water, repair, storage and computing. Each pod was built and lit as its own small world.
captions: A pod on the crater edge.
Pods along the crater base.
Inside the agriculture pod.
Inside the computing pod.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 坑洞以水泥鑄造，並配置六個分別用於居住、農業、水循環、維修、儲存與運算的艙體。每個艙體都被製作並打光成一個小世界。
captions: 坑洞邊緣的艙體。
沿坑底排列的艙體。
農業艙內部。
運算艙內部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A glowing acrylic tower rises from the crater under a faceted glass dome. The model shows how a community could live and grow in a hostile place.
captions: The tower against the crater wall.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 發光的壓克力高塔在多面玻璃穹頂下自坑洞升起。模型呈現一個社群如何在嚴酷之地生活與成長。
captions: 坑壁旁的高塔。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick an extreme site.
2. List what people need.
3. Give each need a room.
4. Light the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個極端基地。
2. 列出人的需求。
3. 為每項需求安排空間。
4. 為模型打光。

pins.title: Auspicious Clouds
pins.description:
Traditional cloud patterns grow into a tall, folded tower of light and voids.

Model making | Architecture | 3D print | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 祥雲
zh-Hant.description:
傳統祥雲紋樣發展成一座高聳、摺疊的光與虛空之塔。

模型製作｜建築｜3D列印｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The 3D-printed cloud tower.
3D列印的祥雲塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Cloud patterns carry hopes of rising, harmony and shared memory, and they appear on screens and windows. The student remembered carved screens and paper-cut windows at a grandmother's house.
captions: Cloud patterns turned into forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 祥雲紋樣承載著步步高升、和諧與共同記憶的寓意，常見於屏風與窗花。學生想起外婆家的雕花屏風與剪紙窗花。
captions: 祥雲紋樣轉化為形體。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Digital studies turned flat cloud curls into stacked walls and voids. Each version tested how light and shadow pass between them.
captions: Stacked cloud forms.
Wall and void studies.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 數位研究把平面的雲紋捲曲轉化為堆疊的牆與虛空。每個版本都測試光影如何在其間穿行。
captions: 堆疊的雲形。
牆與虛空研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The forms were drawn and printed as thin, folded shells that open and close. Small figures show the scale of the spaces inside.
captions: Drawing of the folded forms.
Another side of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生把形體繪製並列印成可開可合的薄摺殼。小人模型標示出內部空間的尺度。
captions: 摺疊形體的繪圖。
塔的另一面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The tower looks like clouds drifting overhead and forms small sanctuaries of light. Each visitor finds a personal view, while the whole stays one continuous memory.
captions: Looking up between the folds.
Light through the folds.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 塔體宛如飄過頭頂的雲，形成一處處光的小聖所。每位訪客都能找到自己的視角，而整體仍是一段連續的記憶。
captions: 在摺面之間仰望。
穿過摺面的光。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a memory.
2. Study a pattern.
3. Turn lines into walls.
4. Test light between them.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從記憶出發。
2. 研究一個紋樣。
3. 把線轉成牆。
4. 測試其間的光。

pins.title: Traversing the Fifth Dimension
pins.description:
A film scene of an endless bookshelf in time becomes a grid of wooden sticks and mirrors.

Model making | Spatial design | Wooden sticks and mirrors | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 穿越第五維度
zh-Hant.description:
一個時間中無盡書架的電影場景，化為木條與鏡子構成的格網。

模型製作｜空間設計｜木條與鏡子｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The wooden stick grid.
木條格網。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In a science-fiction film, a space outside time lets a traveller look into a room at many moments. The student chose this bookshelf scene for its rich spatial quality.
captions: Film stills used as inspiration.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在一部科幻電影中，一個時間之外的空間讓旅人能在許多時刻窺看同一個房間。學生因這個書架場景豐富的空間感而選擇它。
captions: 作為靈感的電影劇照。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Scenes were sketched and then reduced to points, lines and planes. The grid became a way to show past, present and future at once.
captions: Sketch of the film scene.
Lines and planes from the scene.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先速寫場景，再把它簡化為點、線與面。格網成為同時呈現過去、現在與未來的方法。
captions: 電影場景速寫。
從場景萃取的線與面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Wooden sticks were glued into a regular frame, with each crossing marking a moment. Small figures were placed to show a parent and child across dimensions.
captions: Building the stick frame.
Figures for the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生把木條黏成規則的框架，每個交點代表一個時刻。小人物被放在不同維度中，代表一對親子。
captions: 搭建木條框架。
模型人物。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Mirrors repeat the grid endlessly, and threads hint at the pull of gravity. The centre of the maze stands for the point where space and time begin and end.
captions: Looking deep into the grid.
Drawing of a figure in the grid.
The model from above.
Mirrors and threads inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 鏡子讓格網無限重複，細線暗示重力的牽引。迷宮的中心象徵時空的起點與終點。
captions: 深入格網的視角。
格網中人物的素描。
模型俯視。
內部的鏡子與細線。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a scene you love.
2. Sketch it, then simplify.
3. Find its structure.
4. Build and reflect it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個喜愛的場景。
2. 先速寫再簡化。
3. 找出它的結構。
4. 做出來並加以反射。

pins.title: Infinite Loop: Memory Paths
pins.description:
Looping paper stairs inside a wooden frame show branching choices held in one structure.

Model making | Spatial design | PVC board and wooden strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 無限迴圈：記憶路徑
zh-Hant.description:
木框中迴繞的紙階梯，呈現收束在同一結構中的分岔選擇。

模型製作｜空間設計｜PVC板與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The stair tower model.
階梯塔模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was drawn to stories where different choices unfold as parallel paths. Each stair in the model stands for a possible memory or decision.
captions: Stair unit blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生著迷於不同選擇展開成平行路徑的故事。模型中的每段階梯都代表一段可能的記憶或抉擇。
captions: 階梯單元。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A stair unit was designed and repeated to test how paths can branch and loop. Stacked units began to form a tower.
captions: Units stacked into a tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生設計一個階梯單元並重複使用，測試路徑如何分岔與迴繞。堆疊的單元逐漸形成一座塔。
captions: 單元堆疊成塔。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A wooden frame was built first, and the looping stairs were attached to it. The frame stands for one self, while the stairs inside show unstable paths.
captions: The wooden frame.
Stairs added to the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生先搭建木框，再把迴繞的階梯固定上去。木框代表一個完整的自我，內部階梯則呈現不穩定的路徑。
captions: 木框架。
加上階梯的框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Stairs grow outward step by step like branching storylines. However far the paths go, they stay inside one frame, a picture of freedom within limits.
captions: The final model, upper part.
The final model from the side.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 階梯一步步向外生長，宛如分岔的故事線。無論路徑延伸多遠，都仍在同一框架內，象徵限制中的自由。
captions: 最終模型上段。
最終模型側面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Turn an idea into a unit.
2. Repeat and vary it.
3. Hold it in a frame.
4. Let it grow outward.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把想法變成單元。
2. 重複並變化。
3. 以框架承載。
4. 讓它向外生長。

pins.title: Living Cavities: Symbiotic Habitat
pins.description:
Coral skeletons and neural networks inspire a porous habitat of linked living spaces.

Digital modelling | Speculative architecture | Rhino and 3D print | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 生命孔洞：共生棲地
zh-Hant.description:
珊瑚骨骼與神經網絡啟發一座由相連生活空間構成的多孔棲地。

數位建模｜思辨建築｜Rhino與3D列印｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Render of the porous habitat.
多孔棲地的渲染圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Coral skeletons lose their link to the outside world, and the student saw them as frames for new life. Neural networks added the idea of connected flows.
captions: The branching network pattern.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 珊瑚骨骼失去了與外界的連結，學生把它們視為新生命的框架。神經網絡則帶來相互連結流動的概念。
captions: 分枝網絡圖樣。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Random points in a cube were turned into cells and then into a branching network. Contour lines cut the form into floor plates.
captions: From cells to branching networks.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生在立方體中產生隨機點，轉成細胞，再轉成分枝網絡。等高線把形體切出樓板。
captions: 從細胞到分枝網絡。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A sectional cut showed each cavity as a node for living, working or gathering. Studies marked which voids could hold rooms.
captions: Section with living spaces.
Studies of the cavities.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 剖切面把每個孔洞呈現為居住、工作或聚會的節點。研究圖標出哪些虛空可以容納房間。
captions: 含生活空間的剖面。
孔洞研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The porous habitat joins private rooms and public space in one network. It suggests a way for people and the environment to live together.
captions: Another view of the habitat.
Close views of the form.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 多孔棲地把私人房間與公共空間結合在同一個網絡中。它提出人與環境共存的一種方式。
captions: 棲地的另一個角度。
形體近看。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Borrow a form from nature.
2. Generate it with rules.
3. Cut it into floors.
4. Assign uses to voids.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 向自然借用形體。
2. 以規則生成。
3. 切出樓層。
4. 為虛空安排用途。

pins.title: Ski Trail
pins.description:
A spiral ski training base brings slopes, simulators and viewing halls into the city all year.

Model making | Architecture | PVC board and wooden strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 滑雪道
zh-Hant.description:
一座螺旋形滑雪訓練基地，把雪道、模擬器與觀賞廳全年帶進城市。

模型製作｜建築｜PVC板與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The ski training base model.
滑雪訓練基地模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student skis competitively and found it hard to keep training in the off season. The city has no proper place for year-round practice.
captions: Drafts of spiral and floor plans.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生參加滑雪競賽，發現淡季很難持續訓練。城市裡沒有適合全年練習的場所。
captions: 螺旋與樓層草稿。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Drafts tested spirals and rings for slopes, rental rooms, viewing halls and changing rooms. The spiral kept every part open to view.
captions: The first spiral model.
The spiral from the side.
Ramps around the spiral.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 草稿測試以螺旋與環形安排雪道、租借室、觀賞廳與更衣室。螺旋讓每個部分都保持可見。
captions: 第一個螺旋模型。
螺旋側面。
環繞螺旋的坡道。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A second model wrapped the floors in rings with an artificial slope on the roof and outer edges. Simulators inside allow technical training in any season.
captions: The second model with rings.
Perspective sketch of the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 第二個模型以環形包覆樓層，並在屋頂與外緣設置人工雪道。內部的模擬器讓任何季節都能進行技術訓練。
captions: 第二個環形模型。
基地透視草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Coaches and parents can watch training from many points around the base. Skiing becomes both practice and a show for the city.
captions: Trees in the central court.
Inside the rings.
Another side of the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 教練與家長可以從基地周圍許多位置觀看訓練。滑雪同時成為練習與城市的風景。
captions: 中庭的樹。
環形內部。
基地另一側。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from your own sport.
2. List what training needs.
3. Wrap it in one form.
4. Let others watch.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從自己的運動出發。
2. 列出訓練需求。
3. 收進一個形體。
4. 讓別人看得見。

pins.title: Cage of a Broken Friendship
pins.description:
A stage model of sticks, corroded blocks and wire tells how a friendship on a quiet island falls apart.

Model making | Stage design | Card paper and wooden sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 破碎友誼之籠
zh-Hant.description:
以木棒、侵蝕方塊與金屬線構成的舞台模型，講述寧靜島嶼上一段友誼的崩解。

模型製作｜舞台設計｜卡紙與木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished stage model.
完成的舞台模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to turn a story about two friends who drift apart on an island into space. The model had to show isolation, rupture and a final act of revenge.
captions: Shaping the water base.
Gluing the stick frames.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想把一段發生在島上、兩位朋友逐漸疏遠的故事轉化為空間。模型必須呈現孤立、斷裂與最後的報復。
captions: 製作水面底座。
黏合木棒框架。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The story was broken into six moments, from a quiet life to a last farewell by the sea. Each moment was linked to a material, such as sticks for the cage of daily life.
captions: The model lit from inside.
The frame growing upward.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 故事被拆成六個時刻，從平靜生活到海邊的最後告別。每個時刻都對應一種材料，例如以木棒代表日常生活的牢籠。
captions: 從內部打光的模型。
框架向上生長。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Corroded paper blocks show a friendship worn down over time, while tangled curves show an obsession. Aluminium wire shaped like flowing water marks a sister leaving the island.
captions: Burning part of the model.
Tangled curves at the top.
Corroded blocks over the water.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 侵蝕的紙方塊表現隨時間磨損的友誼，糾結的曲線則表現執念。像流水般的鋁線代表離開島嶼的妹妹。
captions: 燒灼模型的一部分。
頂部糾結的曲線。
水面上的侵蝕方塊。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Part of the model was burned on purpose, and the burn marks were kept. The final cage reads as a ruin of a relationship standing on the water.
captions: Front view of the cage.
Side view of the cage.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型的一部分被刻意燒灼，並保留燒痕。最終的籠體就像一段關係的廢墟立在水面上。
captions: 籠體正面。
籠體側面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Break a story into moments.
2. Give each moment a material.
3. Let the form tell the plot.
4. Keep the traces of making.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把故事拆成數個時刻。
2. 為每個時刻選一種材料。
3. 讓形體講述情節。
4. 保留製作的痕跡。

pins.title: Four Detectives in Paper
pins.description:
Four characters from a mystery game are turned into patterns and then into four paper models.

Model making | Spatial narrative | PVC board, card paper and wire | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 紙中的四位偵探
zh-Hant.description:
把推理遊戲中的四個角色轉化為圖案，再轉化為四座紙模型。

模型製作｜空間敘事｜PVC板、卡紙與金屬線｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The first character model.
第一個角色模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student loves story-driven role-playing games where four officers solve a series of crimes. The question was how a personality could become a space.
captions: Pattern of the first character.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生熱愛由劇情推動的角色扮演遊戲，故事中四位警員偵辦一連串案件。問題是一種性格如何成為一個空間。
captions: 第一個角色的圖案。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Keywords were pulled from each officer's personality and behaviour, such as nervous, rigorous or talkative. These words were drawn as flat black and white patterns.
captions: Pattern of the second character.
Pattern of the third character.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生從每位警員的性格與行為中萃取關鍵字，例如緊張、嚴謹或健談。這些詞被畫成黑白的平面圖案。
captions: 第二個角色的圖案。
第三個角色的圖案。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each pattern was folded, cut and stacked into a model on a square base. Curves, slats, rings and coloured film gave each character its own spatial language.
captions: From pattern to model.
The second model from above.
The third model from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每個圖案被摺疊、切割並堆疊成方形底座上的模型。曲線、條板、圓環與彩色薄膜賦予每個角色自己的空間語言。
captions: 從圖案到模型。
俯視第二個模型。
俯視第三個模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Four models now retell the story through space instead of words. Seen side by side, they show how different minds work on the same case.
captions: The second character model.
The third character model.
The fourth character model.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 四座模型以空間而非文字重述故事。並排觀看時，它們呈現不同的思維如何面對同一個案件。
captions: 第二個角色模型。
第三個角色模型。
第四個角色模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Describe a character in words.
2. Draw the words as patterns.
3. Fold patterns into space.
4. Compare the models.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 用文字描述角色。
2. 把文字畫成圖案。
3. 把圖案摺成空間。
4. 比較各個模型。

pins.title: A Settlement Growing from Ruins
pins.description:
Broken walls become the base of a settlement that keeps growing with scaffolds, ladders and bridges.

Model making | Speculative architecture | PVC board and sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 從廢墟生長的聚落
zh-Hant.description:
斷牆成為聚落的基座，鷹架、梯子與橋不斷向外生長。

模型製作｜思辨建築｜PVC板與木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The settlement model lit at night.
夜間打光的聚落模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project imagines a people forced to keep living before their wounds have healed. Instead of rebuilding a perfect building, it keeps the sense of fragments and temporary repair.
captions: Stacked hollow blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品想像一群在傷口尚未癒合前就必須繼續生活的人。它不重建完美的建築，而是保留碎片與臨時修補的感覺。
captions: 堆疊的中空方塊。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student first tested broken forms with stacked hollow PVC blocks. Tilting and leaning the blocks showed how ruins could still carry weight.
captions: Blocks turned and tilted.
A tower of broken frames.
Blocks leaning on each other.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先以堆疊的中空PVC方塊測試破碎形體。傾斜與倚靠的方塊顯示廢墟仍能承重。
captions: 旋轉傾斜的方塊。
破碎框架之塔。
互相倚靠的方塊。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Collapsed walls became the base, and scaffolds, platforms and bridges were added layer by layer. Mesh, ladders and tiny figures made the settlement feel lived in.
captions: Scaffolds around the ruin.
Lit windows at the top.
Mesh and repairs.
Tiny figures among the sticks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 倒塌的牆成為基座，鷹架、平台與橋被一層層加上。網片、梯子與小人物讓聚落顯得有人居住。
captions: 廢墟周圍的鷹架。
頂部亮燈的窗。
網片與修補。
木棒間的小人物。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The lit model shows a settlement that is repairing, living and defending at the same time. Red light and warm windows make the ruin feel both fragile and alive.
captions: The ruin in red light.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 打光後的模型呈現一座同時在修補、居住與防禦的聚落。紅光與溫暖的窗讓廢墟既脆弱又充滿生命。
captions: 紅光中的廢墟。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a broken form.
2. Test how it carries weight.
3. Add layers of repair.
4. Light it to tell a mood.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從破碎的形體開始。
2. 測試它如何承重。
3. 加上一層層修補。
4. 用光說出氛圍。

pins.title: Chromatic Narratives
pins.description:
Three small rooms in blue, red and warm white follow a girl from loneliness to fantasy and back.

Model making | Stage design | Plywood, clay and plastic tile | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 色彩敘事
zh-Hant.description:
藍、紅與暖白三個小房間，跟隨一個女孩從孤獨走入幻想再回到現實。

模型製作｜舞台設計｜夾板、黏土與塑膠磁磚｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The blue classroom model.
藍色教室模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project began with a drama the student created and performed at school. The story follows a girl who loses a close friend, escapes into fantasy and then returns to reality.
captions: Building the brick wall.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品源自學生在學校創作並演出的戲劇。故事跟隨一個女孩失去好友、逃入幻想，最後回到現實。
captions: 製作磚牆。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Key moments of the play were collaged into three scenes: a classroom, a bedroom and a hospital. Each scene was given its own colour of light.
captions: Desks in the classroom.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 戲中的關鍵時刻被拼貼成三個場景：教室、臥室與醫院。每個場景都被賦予自己的光色。
captions: 教室裡的課桌。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The classroom uses brick walls and square tiles to show rigid rules. The bedroom is wrapped in grey clay, like concrete closing in on a dream.
captions: The red bedroom model.
The bed in daylight.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 教室以磚牆與方形磁磚表現僵硬的規範。臥室被灰色黏土包覆，像混凝土包圍著一場夢。
captions: 紅色臥室模型。
日光下的床。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The hospital is finished in bright white clay to suggest letting go and starting again. Together the three rooms tell the whole story through colour and material.
captions: The white hospital model.
Beds in the hospital.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 醫院以明亮的白色黏土完成，暗示放下與重新開始。三個房間一起以色彩與材料講完整個故事。
captions: 白色醫院模型。
醫院裡的病床。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick key moments of a story.
2. Give each one a room.
3. Choose a colour and material.
4. Light the rooms in order.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 挑出故事的關鍵時刻。
2. 為每個時刻安排一個房間。
3. 選定色彩與材料。
4. 依序為房間打光。

pins.title: A Triptych Set for a Lakeside Drama
pins.description:
A stage split into three rooms, with a painted bird at the centre standing for lost dreams.

Model making | Stage design | Foam board, balsa and acrylic paint | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 湖畔戲劇的三聯舞台
zh-Hant.description:
一座分成三個房間的舞台，中央手繪的飛鳥象徵失落的夢想。

模型製作｜舞台設計｜泡棉板、輕木與壓克力顏料｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The three-part set model.
三聯舞台模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The play is about the clash between a stifling home and a restless wish to make art. The student wanted the set itself to split the characters' worlds apart.
captions: Structure and movement diagrams.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這齣戲講述窒息的家庭與不安的藝術渴望之間的衝突。學生希望舞台本身就把角色們的世界分開。
captions: 結構與動線圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Diagrams mapped a domestic zone on each side and a symbolic void in the middle. A material palette of wood, brick and white surfaces was set for each room.
captions: Plan and material palette.
Laying the wood strips.
Wall slats in progress.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 圖解在兩側配置家庭區，中央則是象徵性的虛空。學生為每個房間設定木、磚與白色表面的材料配置。
captions: 平面與材料配置。
鋪設木條。
製作中的牆面條板。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The living room uses vertical wooden slats like a cage, while the bedroom uses heavy exposed brick. The centre is not a literal lake but a highly textured painting of a bird.
captions: The set from the front.
The painted bird at the centre.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 客廳以垂直木條營造籠子般的感覺，臥室則用厚重的裸磚。中央不是真實的湖，而是一幅肌理豐富的飛鳥畫作。
captions: 舞台正面。
中央手繪的飛鳥。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The audience looks at both homes through the painted void at the centre. The set turns the play's emotional fracture into three separate rooms.
captions: The living room wing.
The bedroom wing.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 觀眾透過中央的繪畫虛空觀看兩側的家。舞台把戲中的情感裂痕轉化為三個分離的房間。
captions: 客廳側翼。
臥室側翼。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find the conflict in a play.
2. Split the stage to show it.
3. Give each part a material.
4. Keep a symbol at the centre.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出劇中的衝突。
2. 用分割舞台呈現它。
3. 為每部分選擇材料。
4. 在中央保留一個象徵。

pins.title: The Water Prison Stage
pins.description:
Curved stairs and arches rise around a round water prison inside a curtain of glowing acrylic.

Model making | Stage design | PVC board, acrylic and LED light | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 水牢舞台
zh-Hant.description:
弧形階梯與拱圈環繞圓形水牢，外圍是一圈發光的壓克力簾幕。

模型製作｜舞台設計｜PVC板、壓克力與LED燈｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The stage model in coloured light.
彩色光中的舞台模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student set out to design a semicircular stage for a tragic drama of desire. At its heart stands a round water prison, a symbol of confinement.
captions: Arches and the water prison.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生為一齣關於慾望的悲劇設計半圓形舞台。舞台中心是一座圓形水牢，象徵禁錮。
captions: 拱圈與水牢。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Curved stairs and arches were drawn to create a flowing route of entrances, escapes and gazes. The ground and the prison were shaped in clay in muted yellow-grey tones.
captions: Fixing the curved stair.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生繪製弧形階梯與拱圈，營造入口、逃離與凝視交織的流動路徑。地面與水牢以黏土塑形，呈現低調的黃灰色調。
captions: 固定弧形階梯。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Clear acrylic panels were set around the stage like a curtain. LED strips behind them refract changing colours across the panels.
captions: Fitting the LED strip.
The stage in red light.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 透明壓克力板像簾幕一樣圍繞舞台。後方的LED燈條讓變換的色彩折射在板面上。
captions: 安裝LED燈條。
紅光中的舞台。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: As the light shifts from red to blue, the same stage moves between moods. Simple geometric forms carry the tension of the story.
captions: The stage in blue light.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 當燈光從紅轉藍，同一個舞台在不同情緒之間轉換。簡單的幾何形體承載故事的張力。
captions: 藍光中的舞台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find the core symbol.
2. Build routes around it.
3. Wrap it in light.
4. Test moods with colour.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出核心象徵。
2. 圍繞它安排路徑。
3. 用光包覆它。
4. 用色彩測試情緒。

pins.title: A Twisted Bond in Two Castles
pins.description:
A hanging tower of paper castles and a twirling stair turns a film about two rival friends into space.

Model making | Spatial narrative | PVC board, window film, wire and mirror paper | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 雙城之間的糾結情誼
zh-Hant.description:
以紙城堡與迴旋階梯構成的懸吊塔，把一部關於兩位對立好友的電影轉化為空間。

模型製作｜空間敘事｜PVC板、窗膜、金屬線與鏡面紙｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The hanging castle tower.
懸吊的城堡之塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to turn the changing bond between two young women in a fantasy film into architecture. One is labelled a witch and the other a good girl, yet they stay friends.
captions: The film that inspired the work.
Stills of the bright castle.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想把一部奇幻電影中兩位年輕女性不斷變化的情誼轉化為建築。一人被貼上女巫的標籤，另一人被視為好女孩，但她們仍是朋友。
captions: 啟發作品的電影。
明亮城堡的劇照。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The story was split into four moments, from being loved by everyone to escaping the world. Each moment was linked to a bright castle, a dark castle or a prison.
captions: Stills of the turning point.
Storyline sketch of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 故事被拆成四個時刻，從受眾人喜愛到逃離世界。每個時刻都對應明亮的城堡、黑暗的城堡或牢籠。
captions: 轉折時刻的劇照。
塔的故事線草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The outer paper castles were built first, then the inside was filled with wire, mesh and coloured film. The structure stays the same from top to bottom while colours and materials change.
captions: Hand drawing of the tower.
Cutting the paper castles.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生先建造外層的紙城堡，再以金屬線、網片與彩色薄膜填滿內部。結構由上到下保持一致，色彩與材料則不斷變化。
captions: 塔的手繪圖。
切割紙城堡。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A twirling stair runs through the tower, tracing a journey from enemies to friends and apart again. Mirror paper against wire and gloss against grit show two personalities side by side.
captions: Stairs among the castles.
Coloured film at the top.
The dark lower castle.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 迴旋階梯貫穿整座塔，描繪從敵人到朋友再到分離的旅程。鏡面紙對比金屬線、光滑對比粗糙，呈現兩種並存的性格。
captions: 城堡間的階梯。
頂部的彩色薄膜。
下方的暗色城堡。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Split a story into moments.
2. Pair each moment with a space.
3. Keep one structure and vary materials.
4. Trace the plot with a route.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把故事拆成數個時刻。
2. 為每個時刻配一個空間。
3. 保持結構一致、變換材料。
4. 以動線描繪情節。

pins.title: Looms
pins.description:
The frames and rhythm of old weaving machines are taken apart and rebuilt as a tower of wooden sticks.

Model making | Structural form | Wooden sticks and string | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 織機
zh-Hant.description:
把古老織布機的框架與節奏拆解，再重組為一座木棒之塔。

模型製作｜結構造型｜木棒與棉線｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished stick tower.
完成的木棒塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project draws on old weaving looms and sewing machines. The question was how the rhythm of a machine could become an architectural form.
captions: Notes on how a loom works.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品取材自古老的織布機與縫紉機。問題是機械的節奏如何成為建築形體。
captions: 織機運作的筆記。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied how the treadles, beams and beater of a loom work together. Digital models and part drawings helped break the machine into frames and joints.
captions: Digital models of old looms.
Joint and part drawings.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究織機的踏板、經軸與筘如何協同運作。數位模型與構件圖幫助把機械拆解成框架與接頭。
captions: 古老織機的數位模型。
接頭與構件圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A first tower was built from straight sticks that spread out like threads from a central core. Square frames were then twisted around it to show motion.
captions: The first tower from above.
Sticks fanning out at the base.
The first tower in full.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 第一座塔以直木棒構成，像絲線一樣從中央核心向外展開。接著在周圍扭轉方形框架以表現運動。
captions: 俯視第一座塔。
底部向外展開的木棒。
第一座塔全貌。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the final tower, red string is woven between the sticks to tie the frames together. It merges the precision of a machine with the fluid feel of weaving.
captions: Red string wrapping the core.
The tower from the side.
Drawing of the string tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在最終的塔中，紅線穿梭於木棒之間，把框架連成一體。它融合了機械的精準與編織的流動感。
captions: 紅線纏繞核心。
塔的側面。
纏線之塔的手繪。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study how a machine moves.
2. Break it into frames and joints.
3. Rebuild the rhythm in sticks.
4. Weave the parts together.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究機械如何運動。
2. 拆解成框架與接頭。
3. 以木棒重建節奏。
4. 把構件編織在一起。

pins.title: Cycles of Nature
pins.description:
Branches, bark and resin build a layered model of how fallen trees slowly turn into soil.

Model making | Natural systems | Branches, bark, fibre optics and 3D resin | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 自然循環
zh-Hant.description:
以樹枝、樹皮與樹脂構成層疊模型，呈現倒下的樹木如何慢慢化為土壤。

模型製作｜自然系統｜樹枝、樹皮、光纖與3D樹脂｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The layered tree and soil model.
層疊的樹與土壤模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project looks at how fallen bark and leaves slowly become soil that feeds new trees. It treats decay and rebirth as one continuous cycle.
captions: Diagram of the soil layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 作品探討落下的樹皮與葉子如何慢慢化為滋養新樹的土壤。它把腐朽與重生視為一個連續的循環。
captions: 土壤分層圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student collected bark and made ink drawings that merge water flow with bark texture. Six material tests mixed branches, bark, powder and resin.
captions: Ink studies of bark and water.
Six material experiments.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生收集樹皮，並以墨跡畫融合水流與樹皮紋理。六組材料實驗混合了樹枝、樹皮、粉末與樹脂。
captions: 樹皮與水的墨跡研究。
六組材料實驗。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Layers of stone, mesh and soil were stacked inside a frame of branches. A pencil drawing tested how roots could pass through each layer.
captions: Stacking stones and mesh.
Pencil drawing of the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 石頭、網片與土壤被層層堆疊在樹枝框架中。一張鉛筆畫測試根系如何穿過每一層。
captions: 堆疊石頭與網片。
模型的鉛筆畫。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished model shows a tree rising from layers of soil and bedrock. Fibre optics make it glow green in the dark, like life returning.
captions: The model glowing in the dark.
Roots and branches up close.
Mesh layers up close.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的模型呈現一棵從土層與岩床中升起的樹。光纖讓它在黑暗中發出綠光，彷彿生命回歸。
captions: 在黑暗中發光的模型。
根與枝的近景。
網片層的近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe a natural process.
2. Test raw materials.
3. Stack the process in layers.
4. Use light to show change.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察一個自然過程。
2. 測試原始材料。
3. 把過程層層堆疊。
4. 用光呈現變化。

pins.title: Kinetics of Space
pins.description:
Speed, timing, angle and division in a squash game become four small studies and one large installation.

Model making | Installation | Mirror, foil, acrylic, springs and plywood | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 空間動力學
zh-Hant.description:
壁球比賽中的速度、時機、角度與分割，成為四件小研究與一座大型裝置。

模型製作｜裝置｜鏡面、錫箔、壓克力、彈簧與夾板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final installation.
最終的裝置。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student plays squash and finds it striking that the ball always returns from the wall. In a way, the court works as if it were twice its real size.
captions: Sketches of time, space and angle.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生打壁球，並著迷於球總會從牆面反彈回來。某種程度上，球場的運作就像是實際大小的兩倍。
captions: 時間、空間與角度的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Four ideas were drawn from the game: speed, timing, angle and division. Each became a small study model in a different material.
captions: Speed: hanging aluminium sheets.
Timing: metal springs.
Angle: red threads.
Division: mirror fragments.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生從比賽中提取四個概念：速度、時機、角度與分割。每個概念都成為一件不同材料的小研究模型。
captions: 速度：懸吊的鋁片。
時機：金屬彈簧。
角度：紅線。
分割：鏡面碎片。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The four studies were joined into one large model with a frame of chicken wire and wooden boards. Foil-wrapped foam balls and stretched fabric show the speed of the ball.
captions: The installation from above.
Stretched fabric and balls.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 四件研究被組合成一座以雞籠網與木板為框架的大型模型。錫箔包覆的泡棉球與拉伸的布料表現球速。
captions: 俯視裝置。
拉伸的布料與球。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Mirrors extend the space, while threads and plates capture direction and velocity. The installation turns the game into a system of geometry, time and movement.
captions: Mesh ramp and frames.
Mirrored drum and figures.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 鏡面延伸了空間，細線與板片捕捉方向與速度。裝置把比賽轉化為幾何、時間與運動的系統。
captions: 網片坡道與框架。
鏡面圓筒與人物。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from something you do.
2. Pull out a few key ideas.
3. Give each idea a material.
4. Join the studies into one.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從自己做的事出發。
2. 提取幾個關鍵概念。
3. 為每個概念選一種材料。
4. 把研究組合成一件作品。

pins.title: Soap City
pins.description:
A soap mountain melts through a forest of sticks into a city of staples below.

Model making | Urban narrative | Soap, steel, acrylic, staples and wooden strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 肥皂城市
zh-Hant.description:
一座肥皂山穿過木棒森林，融化成下方以釘書針構成的城市。

模型製作｜城市敘事｜肥皂、鋼材、壓克力、釘書針與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The soap city in its acrylic frame.
壓克力框中的肥皂城市。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The idea came while the student was using soap in the shower. Soap making changed from natural herbs to industrial chemicals as rural land turned into cities.
captions: Melting and casting soap.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個想法來自學生淋浴時使用肥皂。隨著鄉村變成城市，肥皂製作也從天然草本轉為工業化學品。
captions: 熔化與澆鑄肥皂。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sketches set out three layers: nature at the top, industry in the middle and the city at the bottom. Soap was melted, cast and cut to test how it could flow and harden.
captions: First sketch of the layers.
Drawing of melting soap.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 草圖安排了三層：上方是自然、中間是工業、下方是城市。學生熔化、澆鑄並切割肥皂，測試它如何流動與凝固。
captions: 分層的初步草圖。
融化肥皂的手繪。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A snowy soap mountain sits at the top, and melted soap drips through a dense grid of wooden sticks. At the bottom, piles of staples form towers and streets.
captions: Building the staple city.
Soap mountain up close.
Melting soap among sticks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 雪白的肥皂山位於頂端，融化的肥皂沿著密集的木棒格網滴落。底部則以成堆的釘書針形成高樓與街道。
captions: 製作釘書針城市。
肥皂山的近景。
木棒間融化的肥皂。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model hangs between two acrylic sheets held by steel rods. It reads as a story of natural land slowly becoming an urban grid.
captions: Front view of the model.
The model from above.
Side view of the layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型懸掛在以鋼桿固定的兩片壓克力板之間。它講述自然土地逐漸變成城市網格的故事。
captions: 模型正面。
俯視模型。
分層的側面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Notice an everyday object.
2. Trace its history.
3. Map the history in layers.
4. Let materials carry the change.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 留意一件日常物品。
2. 追溯它的歷史。
3. 把歷史分層呈現。
4. 讓材料承載變化。

pins.title: The Recycled City
pins.description:
Handmade paper from waste fabric, leaves and branches floats in layers on steel rods.

Model making | Material study | Recycled paper and steel rods | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 再生之城
zh-Hant.description:
以廢棄布料、落葉與樹枝製成的手工紙，層層漂浮在鋼桿上。

模型製作｜材料研究｜再生紙與鋼桿｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Paper sheets floating on rods.
漂浮在鋼桿上的紙片。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student saw paper as thin, easily torn and always keeping traces of what happened to it. The project asks how marks of damage can become signs of strength.
captions: Shredding the waste.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生認為紙很薄、容易撕破，並總會留下經歷的痕跡。作品探問損傷的痕跡如何成為堅韌的象徵。
captions: 撕碎廢料。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Old garments, rotting leaves and branches were collected and crushed in a blender. A step-by-step guide set out how fibre becomes pulp, then sheets.
captions: Steps of making paper.
Drying the new sheets.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生收集舊衣、腐葉與樹枝，並用果汁機打碎。一份逐步圖解說明纖維如何變成紙漿，再成為紙張。
captions: 造紙步驟圖。
晾乾新紙。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Two or three sheets were stitched together with red thread and hardened with glue. The stitches were left visible as marks that resist being erased.
captions: Stitching with red thread.
Stacking sheets on rods.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 兩到三張紙以紅線縫合，再以膠固化。縫線被刻意保留，成為抗拒被抹去的痕跡。
captions: 以紅線縫合。
把紙片疊上鋼桿。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each sheet was drilled and stacked on steel rods, with the gaps measured again and again. The floating layers read as a quiet city built from what others threw away.
captions: The model from above.
Layers seen from the side.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每張紙都被鑽孔並疊上鋼桿，間距經過反覆測量。漂浮的紙層像一座由他人丟棄之物築成的安靜城市。
captions: 俯視模型。
側看各層。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect waste around you.
2. Turn it into a new material.
3. Keep the marks of making.
4. Build space from the sheets.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集身邊的廢料。
2. 把它變成新材料。
3. 保留製作的痕跡。
4. 用紙片建構空間。

pins.title: A Field Chapel in Plaster and Burnt Timber
pins.description:
A plaster shell cast around burnt wooden strips studies a small chapel standing alone in a field.

Model making | Precedent study | Plaster and wooden strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 石膏與燒木的田野小教堂
zh-Hant.description:
以石膏包覆燒過的木條，研究一座獨立於田野中的小教堂。

模型製作｜案例研究｜石膏與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished plaster model.
完成的石膏模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student studied a small concrete chapel that stands alone in farm fields. Its outer shell was poured in thin layers, and its inner walls carry the marks of burnt wood.
captions: Burnt texture inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究一座獨立於農田中的混凝土小教堂。它的外殼以薄層澆灌，內牆則留有燒木的痕跡。
captions: 內部的燒灼紋理。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The question was how to rebuild that process at a small scale with simple materials. A core of wooden strips stood in for the timber frame used on site.
captions: The core of wooden strips.
Setting up the mould.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 問題是如何以簡單材料在小尺度上重現這個過程。木條核心代替了現場使用的木構架。
captions: 木條構成的核心。
架設模具。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Plaster was poured around the core in layers inside a sloped mould. After it set, the inner wood was burnt and cleaned to leave a dark, ribbed surface.
captions: Plaster poured in layers.
Taking the mould apart.
Burning the inner wood.
Cleaning the burnt surface.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 石膏在斜面模具中分層澆灌於核心周圍。凝固後，內部的木材被燒灼並清理，留下深色的肋紋表面。
captions: 分層澆灌石膏。
拆除模具。
燒灼內部木材。
清理燒灼面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model shows a pale, heavy shell around a dark, narrow void. Light falls through the opening at the top, much like the real chapel.
captions: The opening at the top.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型呈現淺色厚重的外殼包圍著深色狹長的空腔。光從頂部開口灑落，正如真實的小教堂。
captions: 頂部的開口。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a building you admire.
2. Study how it was made.
3. Rebuild the process at small scale.
4. Compare light and texture.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一座你欣賞的建築。
2. 研究它如何建造。
3. 以小尺度重現過程。
4. 比較光線與質感。

pins.title: Hive Commons
pins.description:
Hexagonal modules in three sizes turn a quiet city plaza into a lively, flexible public space.

Urban design | Public space | Laser cutting and 3D printing | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 蜂巢共享廣場
zh-Hant.description:
三種尺寸的六角形模組，把冷清的城市廣場變成熱鬧而靈活的公共空間。

城市設計｜公共空間｜雷射切割與3D列印｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The plaza with hexagon units.
設有六角單元的廣場。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is a quiet, underused plaza in San Francisco that feels unsafe at night. The aim was to make it welcoming for skaters, visitors, locals and families.
captions: Site analysis of activity.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是舊金山一處冷清、少被使用、夜間令人不安的廣場。目標是讓它對滑板族、遊客、居民與家庭都更友善。
captions: 活動的基地分析。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Site maps traced where people gather and the main routes across the plaza. These showed large empty areas that could take new activities.
captions: Main routes across the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 基地圖追蹤人群聚集之處與穿越廣場的主要動線。結果顯示有大片空地可以容納新活動。
captions: 穿越基地的主要動線。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Inspired by honeycombs, the student designed hexagon units in three sizes for benches, food trucks and small galleries. Coloured blocks on study models tested many ways to group them.
captions: Sketches of the units.
Plans of the three sizes.
Study model, first layout.
Study model, second layout.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 受蜂巢啟發，學生設計了三種尺寸的六角單元，用作座椅、餐車與小型展廊。研究模型上的彩色方塊測試了多種組合方式。
captions: 單元草圖。
三種尺寸的平面。
研究模型，第一種配置。
研究模型，第二種配置。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The units can be added or removed as events change, so the plaza keeps evolving. The final view shows a friendly space for both busy lunches and calm evening walks.
captions: Study model, third layout.
Study model, fourth layout.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 單元可隨活動增減，讓廣場持續變化。最終的透視呈現一個適合忙碌午餐與寧靜晚間散步的友善空間。
captions: 研究模型，第三種配置。
研究模型，第四種配置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch how a site is used.
2. Find what is missing.
3. Design one flexible unit.
4. Test many layouts.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察基地如何被使用。
2. 找出缺少的東西。
3. 設計一個靈活的單元。
4. 測試多種配置。

pins.title: A Tower of Two Cities
pins.description:
A cardboard and wire tower turns an animated series about two divided cities and two sisters into space.

Model making | Spatial narrative | Pencil, card paper and wooden sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 雙城之塔
zh-Hant.description:
以紙板與金屬線構成的塔，把一部關於兩座分裂城市與一對姊妹的動畫影集轉化為空間。

模型製作｜空間敘事｜鉛筆、卡紙與木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower model.
完成的塔模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student chose an animated series about two divided cities and the broken bond between two sisters. The aim was to show how inequality and conflict can shape a person's path.
captions: Poster art of the series.
Stills of the story, part one.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生選擇了一部關於兩座分裂城市與一對姊妹破裂情誼的動畫影集。目標是呈現不平等與衝突如何塑造一個人的道路。
captions: 影集的海報畫面。
故事劇照之一。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Key scenes were collected and lined up as a storyline from the crowded lower city to the final flare. Each scene was then given a layer in a sketch of the tower.
captions: Storyline sketch of the tower.
Stills of the story, part two.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生收集關鍵場景，從擁擠的下城到最後的信號火光排成一條故事線。每個場景都在塔的草圖中對應一個層次。
captions: 塔的故事線草圖。
故事劇照之二。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Cardboard houses form the base and a bar sits at the centre, with silver cards and blue wire for an explosion. Above them, black sticks form a prison and wire wrapped in mesh shows a restless mind.
captions: Building the model by hand.
Houses at the base.
Drawing of the crowded houses.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 紙板房屋構成底座，中央是一間酒館，銀色卡片與藍色金屬線代表爆炸。上方的黑色木棒形成牢籠，包覆網布的金屬線呈現不安的心境。
captions: 親手製作模型。
底部的房屋。
擁擠房屋的手繪。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished tower reads from bottom to top as one journey through the story. Blue straws at the very top stand for a flare, a promise to find each other again.
captions: Wire and straws at the top.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的塔由下而上讀起來就是穿越故事的一段旅程。最頂端的藍色吸管象徵信號火光，也是再次找到彼此的承諾。
captions: 頂部的金屬線與吸管。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a story that moves you.
2. Line up its key scenes.
3. Give each scene a layer.
4. Read the model as a journey.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個打動你的故事。
2. 排出它的關鍵場景。
3. 為每個場景安排一個層次。
4. 把模型當作一段旅程來閱讀。

pins.title: Shade Pavilion for a Seaside Plaza
pins.description:
A light wooden pavilion gives shade, seats and a place for events on a windy, sunny plaza by the sea.

Model making | Public space | Pencil, card paper and wooden sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 海濱廣場遮陽亭
zh-Hant.description:
一座輕巧的木構亭為海邊多風、日曬強烈的廣場提供遮陽、座位與活動空間。

模型製作｜公共空間｜鉛筆、卡紙與木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The pavilion on the plaza.
廣場上的亭子。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The plaza by the sea has few obstructions, so summer sun is strong and winter wind is harsh. Outdoor seats are also scarce, and the space stays empty when no events are held.
captions: Site map around the plaza.
Problems found on site.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這座海邊廣場幾乎沒有遮蔽，夏天日曬強烈，冬天風勢猛烈。戶外座位也很少，沒有活動時空間便閒置。
captions: 廣場周邊的基地圖。
基地上發現的問題。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student mapped the park, food places, offices and the ferry terminal around the plaza. Simple sketches then tested three needs: shade, rest and activity.
captions: Shade, rest and activity ideas.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生繪出廣場周邊的公園、餐飲、辦公與渡輪碼頭。接著以簡單草圖測試三種需求：遮陽、休憩與活動。
captions: 遮陽、休憩與活動的構想。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A ring of wooden sticks holds a fabric roof that dips between the posts. Double seats along the edge let people face in or out.
captions: Model from above.
The roof frame.
Model from the side.
Looking up inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一圈木棒撐起在柱間下垂的布質屋頂。邊緣的雙向座椅讓人可以面向內或外。
captions: 俯視模型。
屋頂框架。
模型側面。
由內部向上看。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Renders place the temporary pavilion on the plaza as a spot for meals, rest and small events. It brings life to an empty space while keeping people out of the strong sun.
captions: Aerial view of the site.
Sitting under the canopy.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 渲染圖將這座臨時亭子置於廣場上，作為用餐、休息與小型活動的場所。它為閒置空間帶來活力，也讓人避開強烈日曬。
captions: 基地鳥瞰。
坐在頂篷下。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Visit the site in different seasons.
2. List what is missing.
3. Sketch one idea per need.
4. Test the frame in a model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 在不同季節觀察基地。
2. 列出缺少的東西。
3. 每個需求畫一個構想。
4. 用模型測試結構。

pins.title: Tree-Architecture Symbiosis
pins.description:
Thousands of wooden strips grow like a tree around metal platforms, so nature and building become one.

Model making | Nature and structure | Wooden sticks, wooden board, paint and steel frames | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 樹與建築的共生
zh-Hant.description:
成千上萬的木條像樹一樣圍繞金屬平台生長，讓自然與建築合而為一。

模型製作｜自然與結構｜木棒、木板、顏料與鋼框｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tree model.
完成的樹模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Much building begins by clearing forests, and modern buildings often feel cold and over-refined. The student asked how a building could grow with a tree instead of replacing it.
captions: Sketches of tree houses.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 許多建造始於砍伐森林，現代建築也常顯得冰冷、過度精緻。學生思考建築如何能與樹一起生長，而不是取代它。
captions: 樹屋草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Tree houses seen on trips abroad showed how small rooms can sit high in branches. Sketches tested posts, roofs and ladders that lean on a trunk.
captions: The trunk taking shape.
Strips graded thick to thin.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 在國外旅行看到的樹屋，展示了小房間如何高掛在枝幹間。草圖測試了倚靠樹幹的支柱、屋頂與梯子。
captions: 逐漸成形的樹幹。
由粗到細的木條。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Wooden strips were graded from thick to thin to follow the taper of a real tree. Silver-painted frames and platforms were then tied in with ladders and weathered with acrylic.
captions: Branches being layered.
Platforms among the branches.
Silver frames in the crown.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 木條由粗到細分級，以呼應真實樹木的漸細形態。接著以梯子連接漆成銀色的框架與平台，並用壓克力顏料做出風化效果。
captions: 層層疊加的枝幹。
枝幹間的平台。
樹冠中的銀色框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: In the final model, branches and rusted steel frames merge into one form linked by free paths. It suggests a future where people, trees and buildings live as partners.
captions: Ladders between platforms.
Frames at the top.
Steel and wood together.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在最終模型中，枝幹與生鏽鋼框融為一體，並以自由的路徑串連。它描繪出人、樹與建築成為夥伴的未來。
captions: 平台之間的梯子。
頂部的框架。
鋼與木結合。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a doubt about building.
2. Study how a tree grows.
3. Grade materials by size.
4. Let structure and nature merge.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從對建造的疑問出發。
2. 研究樹如何生長。
3. 依尺寸分級材料。
4. 讓結構與自然融合。

pins.title: Tokyo Light Topography
pins.description:
A night satellite image of Tokyo Bay becomes a mountain of wooden triangles, taller where the city glows brighter.

Model making | Data to form | Pencil, card paper and wooden sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 東京光之地形
zh-Hant.description:
一張東京灣夜間衛星影像化為木棒三角形構成的山，城市越亮的地方就越高。

模型製作｜數據轉化造型｜鉛筆、卡紙與木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished light mountain.
完成的光之山。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to turn abstract city data into a physical form. A night satellite image of Tokyo Bay shows where people live and work most densely.
captions: Night satellite image of the bay.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想把抽象的城市數據轉化為實體造型。東京灣的夜間衛星影像顯示人們居住與工作最密集的地方。
captions: 海灣的夜間衛星影像。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The image was split into a grid and each cell was given a grey value. Each value became a height, so brightness turns directly into elevation.
captions: Brightness mapped to triangles.
A strip of triangles.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 影像被切成網格，每一格都給予灰階值。每個數值轉為高度，讓亮度直接變成海拔。
captions: 亮度轉換為三角形。
一條三角形帶。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Triangles of wooden sticks were joined into a frame that rises over the brightest areas. Coloured and shiny films were tested to catch light inside the frame.
captions: Material tests for colour.
Sketch of the peak.
Joining the sticks.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 木棒三角形接合成框架，在最亮的區域升起。學生也測試了彩色與亮面薄膜，讓框架內部捕捉光線。
captions: 色彩材料測試。
山峰草圖。
接合木棒。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model reads as an urban mountain range made of light. It is a study in data, material logic and the shape of a city.
captions: Stairs on the side.
The peak from another side.
The spreading base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型讀起來像一座由光構成的城市山脈。它是一項關於數據、材料邏輯與城市形態的研究。
captions: 側面的階梯。
另一側的山峰。
向外展開的底部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a data image.
2. Turn values into heights.
3. Build with one repeated unit.
4. Check the form against the data.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇一張數據影像。
2. 把數值轉為高度。
3. 以單一重複單元建造。
4. 對照數據檢查造型。

pins.title: Night Market and Housing
pins.description:
An empty parking lot becomes a night market with homes, wrapped in a facade of hundreds of thin wooden strips.

Model making | Housing | Wooden board, wooden strips and PLA | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 夜市與住宅
zh-Hant.description:
一塊閒置停車場化為結合住宅的夜市，外牆包覆數百根細木條。

模型製作｜住宅設計｜木板、木條與PLA｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The house with its strip facade.
帶木條外牆的住宅。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The site is a wasteful parking lot in a busy city district. The student proposed turning it into a night market and public community, keeping a free parking section.
captions: Hand-drawn site plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基地是繁忙城區中一塊浪費的停車場。學生提議將其改造為夜市與公共社區，並保留一區免費停車。
captions: 手繪基地配置圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: To get sizes right, the student studied how human figures scale against furniture and rooms. Each drawn figure became a gauge for real bodies and movement.
captions: Studies of the human scale.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 為了掌握尺寸，學生研究人體與家具、房間之間的比例。每個繪製的人形都成為衡量真實身體與動作的尺規。
captions: 人體尺度研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In a later step, one corner became homes for couples, singles and families. All parts were drawn to scale, laser-cut from wood and joined, with window frames painted black.
captions: Laser-cut wooden parts.
Black window frames.
