Assembling the floors.
Facade strips going on.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在後續階段，一角被規劃為情侶、單身者與家庭的住宅。所有構件依比例繪製、以雷射切割木材並接合，窗框漆成黑色。
captions: 雷射切割的木構件。
黑色窗框。
組裝樓層。
安裝外牆木條。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The frame is wrapped in hundreds of hand-cut basswood strips that give a rhythmic, tactile facade. White 3D-printed furniture shows how the rooms are lived in.
captions: Dining room inside.
Hall and stairs.
The model from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 框架外包覆數百根手工切割的椴木條，形成富有節奏與觸感的外牆。白色3D列印家具呈現房間的使用方式。
captions: 室內的餐廳。
走廊與樓梯。
俯視模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a wasted site.
2. Learn the human scale.
3. Cut parts to exact sizes.
4. Give the facade a texture.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出被浪費的基地。
2. 學習人體尺度。
3. 依精確尺寸切割構件。
4. 為外牆賦予質感。

pins.title: Frozen Harbour
pins.description:
A snowy harbour map from a video game is broken into flat shapes, then rebuilt with straws, sticks and shiny paper.

Model making | Game space | Wood sticks, plastic, straws, corrugated paper and laser paper | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 冰封港灣
zh-Hant.description:
把電子遊戲中的雪地港灣地圖拆成平面造型，再以吸管、木棒與亮面紙重建。

模型製作｜遊戲空間｜木棒、塑膠片、吸管、瓦楞紙與雷射紙｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Among the iceberg towers.
冰山塔之間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student took a snowy harbour map from a video game as the starting point. The aim was to take its spaces apart and rebuild them by hand.
captions: Views of the game map.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生以一款電子遊戲中的雪地港灣地圖作為起點。目標是拆解它的空間，再親手重建。
captions: 遊戲地圖畫面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Elements such as the curved dome, lanes, cranes and containers were sketched one by one. They were then arranged into a composition of pure flat shapes.
captions: Sketches of map elements.
The map as flat shapes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 圓頂、通道、吊車與貨櫃等元素被逐一描繪。接著它們被排列成純粹的平面幾何構成。
captions: 地圖元素草圖。
轉為平面造型的地圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The flat design was translated into 3D through a careful choice of materials. White and blue straws stand for water, and silver and brown strips frame the crane.
captions: Straw towers on the base.
Drawing of the composition.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面設計透過精選的材料轉化為立體。白色與藍色吸管代表水，銀色與棕色木條構成吊車的骨架。
captions: 底座上的吸管塔。
構成的手繪。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Icebergs became white sticks and holographic paper that catch cold light. Orange and green cubes clad in corrugated card recall the harbour's metal containers.
captions: Corrugated containers.
Holographic paper in the crane.
The model from the side.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 冰山化為白色木棒與雷射紙，捕捉冷冽光線。包覆瓦楞紙的橘色與綠色方塊讓人想起港灣的金屬貨櫃。
captions: 瓦楞紙貨櫃。
吊車中的雷射紙。
模型側面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a space you know well.
2. Break it into elements.
3. Flatten them into shapes.
4. Rebuild them with materials.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個你熟悉的空間。
2. 把它拆成元素。
3. 將元素轉為平面造型。
4. 用材料重新建造。

pins.title: Parametric Morphogenesis
pins.description:
One free curve is copied, scaled and rotated in a script until it grows into a flowing tower.

Digital design | Parametric form | 3D modelling and visual scripting | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 參數化形態生成
zh-Hant.description:
一條自由曲線經程式複製、縮放與旋轉，逐步長成流動的塔。

數位設計｜參數化造型｜3D建模與視覺化程式｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The final flowing tower.
最終的流動之塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project asks how a single simple line can grow into a complex 3D structure. It is a first step into designing with rules instead of drawing every shape by hand.
captions: The starting curve.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個專案探討一條簡單的線如何長成複雜的立體結構。這是以規則設計、而非手繪每個造型的第一步。
captions: 起始曲線。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student tested three basic moves on the curve: array, scale and rotate. Each move changed how the copies stacked into layers.
captions: Array, scale and rotate.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生在曲線上測試三種基本操作：陣列、縮放與旋轉。每種操作都改變了複本堆疊成層的方式。
captions: 陣列、縮放與旋轉。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A visual script links the steps, so changing one value updates the whole form. Loft, extrude and contour with pipe turned the layers into surfaces and lines.
captions: The visual script.
Loft, extrude and contour.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 視覺化程式串連各個步驟，改動一個數值就能更新整個造型。放樣、擠出與等高線加管線把層次轉為曲面與線條。
captions: 視覺化程式。
放樣、擠出與等高線。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final tower flares at the base and splits into two peaks at the top. Its contour lines show form, structure and visual complexity under one set of rules.
captions: The form from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的塔在底部展開，頂端分成兩座峰。它的等高線在同一組規則下呈現造型、結構與視覺的複雜度。
captions: 俯視造型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one line.
2. Try one operation at a time.
3. Link the steps in a script.
4. Compare versions side by side.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一條線開始。
2. 一次嘗試一種操作。
3. 用程式串連步驟。
4. 並排比較各個版本。

pins.title: Stones & Habitats
pins.description:
Beach stones are studied one by one, then rebuilt into a coastal landscape where people and nature share the shore.

Model making | Landscape and ecology | Wax, wooden sticks, stones, plaster cloth, clay and plants | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 石與棲地
zh-Hant.description:
逐一研究海灘上的石頭，再重組成人與自然共享海岸的濱海地景。

模型製作｜地景與生態｜蠟、木棒、石頭、石膏布、黏土與植物｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished coastal model.
完成的海岸模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student asked how stones on a beach could become new natural habitats. The aim was to design a shore that supports both people and wildlife.
captions: Collected stones with notes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生思考海灘上的石頭如何成為新的自然棲地。目標是設計一處同時支持人與野生生物的海岸。
captions: 附筆記的收集石頭。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Stones were collected and logged by size, hardness, roughness and porosity. Sketches then explored how stones, terrain and waves move and trade materials along the coast.
captions: Hand-drawn section studies.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生收集石頭，並記錄其大小、硬度、粗糙度與孔隙。草圖接著探討石頭、地形與海浪如何沿著海岸移動與交換物質。
captions: 手繪剖面研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: 3D studies combined stones with water, plants, paths and structures. The terrain was then shaped with clay and plaster cloth, and stones, wire and boards were arranged on top.
captions: Drawing of a coastal habitat.
Shaping terrain by hand.
Placing stones and boards.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 立體研究把石頭與水、植物、步道與構造物結合。接著以黏土與石膏布塑造地形，並在上方安排石頭、金屬線與木板。
captions: 海岸棲地的繪圖。
親手塑造地形。
擺放石頭與木板。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model mixes rock caves, planted terraces and steps that lead down to the water. Small figures show how people can rest and walk while the stones keep giving shelter to life.
captions: Light inside a stone cave.
A wall of stacked rocks.
Terraces with plants.
Steps down to the water.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型融合岩洞、植栽平台與通往水邊的階梯。小人偶呈現人們如何休憩與散步，而石頭持續為生物提供庇護。
captions: 石洞中的光。
堆疊的岩壁。
種有植物的平台。
通往水邊的階梯。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect real samples.
2. Record their qualities.
3. Sketch how they meet the site.
4. Build the terrain by hand.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集真實樣本。
2. 記錄它們的特性。
3. 描繪它們如何與基地相遇。
4. 親手建造地形。

pins.title: Geometry in Flux
pins.description:
Pure concrete geometry meets free-flowing metal curves in one model joined by corridors.

Model making | Form and structure | Plywood, steel wire, concrete, iron mesh and metal-effect film | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 流動中的幾何
zh-Hant.description:
純粹的混凝土幾何與自由流動的金屬曲線，在一座以廊道相連的模型中相遇。

模型製作｜造型與結構｜夾板、鋼線、混凝土、鐵網與金屬質感膜｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished concrete and metal model.
完成的混凝土與金屬模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wondered what happens when strict concrete geometry and free metal curves meet. The aim was to merge two opposite design languages without simply placing them side by side.
captions: Shapes pulled from solid geometry.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生好奇嚴謹的混凝土幾何與自由的金屬曲線相遇時會發生什麼。目標是融合兩種對立的設計語言，而非只是把它們並置。
captions: 從實體幾何中提取的形狀。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Two precedents were studied, one for its solid cut-out forms and one for its flowing metal skins. Sketches pulled out basic shapes and simplified the curves into layers.
captions: Sketch of layered metal curves.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究兩個先例，一個著重實體挖孔造型，一個著重流動的金屬表皮。草圖提取基本形狀，並把曲線簡化成層次。
captions: 層疊金屬曲線的草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A watercolour tested how corridors could tie the solid pieces to the flowing parts. Concrete rings were then cast and joined with plywood, wire and metal film.
captions: Watercolour of the fused idea.
Cast concrete rings drying.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 水彩畫測試廊道如何把實體部分與流動部分串連。接著澆鑄混凝土環，並以夾板、金屬線與金屬膜結合。
captions: 融合構想的水彩畫。
正在乾燥的混凝土環。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model sets a pierced concrete drum on timber stilts beside a ring-topped tower. Corridors and curved metal roofs link them into one walkable piece.
captions: Inside the linking corridor.
Side view with timber struts.
The concrete drum on stilts.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型把穿孔的混凝土圓筒架在木支柱上，旁邊是頂部有圓環的塔。廊道與彎曲的金屬屋頂把它們連成一個可穿行的整體。
captions: 連接廊道的內部。
帶木支柱的側面。
架高的混凝土圓筒。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick two opposite ideas.
2. Extract their basic shapes.
3. Find a linking element.
4. Test it in real materials.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇兩個相反的概念。
2. 提取它們的基本形狀。
3. 找出連結的元素。
4. 以真實材料測試。

pins.title: Movement & Form
pins.description:
The paths of two dancers become a tower of wooden strips and red and blue rods.

Model making | Movement and space | Wooden sticks and plastic rods | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 動態與形體
zh-Hant.description:
兩位舞者的軌跡，化為一座由木條與紅藍塑膠棒構成的塔。

模型製作｜動態與空間｜木棒與塑膠棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished dance model.
完成的舞蹈模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student asked how the movement of dancing bodies could become a 3D space. The goal was a sculptural model that feels like a fluid dance space.
captions: Sketches of dancers in motion.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生思考舞動身體的動作如何成為立體空間。目標是一座讓人感受到流動舞蹈空間的雕塑模型。
captions: 舞者動態的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Figure sketches marked joints and turns as dots and arcs. One path was then pulled out on its own to study its shape.
captions: A single motion path.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 人物草圖把關節與轉身標記成點與弧線。接著單獨抽出一條軌跡，研究它的形狀。
captions: 單一動作軌跡。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Single trajectories were built in 3D software, then combined, rotated and stretched into one drawing. Wooden strips set the frame and red and blue rods traced the two dancers.
captions: Drawing of combined trajectories.
Setting sticks on a grid.
Building the frame by hand.
Red rods trace the paths.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 單一軌跡先在3D軟體中建立，再組合、旋轉與拉伸成一張圖。木條定出框架，紅藍棒材描繪兩位舞者。
captions: 組合軌跡的繪圖。
在格線上立起木棒。
親手搭建框架。
紅色棒材描出軌跡。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model merges structure and motion into one expressive form with foil nodes at the joints. The fabric base records the dancers' shadows and extended paths.
captions: Upper part of the model.
Foil nodes and blue rods.
Shadows drawn on the fabric base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以關節處的鋁箔節點，把結構與動態融為一個有表現力的形體。布面底座記錄舞者的影子與延伸的軌跡。
captions: 模型上半部。
鋁箔節點與藍色棒材。
畫在布面底座上的影子。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch real movement.
2. Sketch it as lines.
3. Combine paths digitally.
4. Build the paths by hand.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察真實的動作。
2. 以線條速寫。
3. 以數位方式組合軌跡。
4. 親手建造軌跡。

pins.title: Dog Hill
pins.description:
A soft hill with caves and holes gives dogs and people a shared place to play.

Model making | Landscape and habitat | Clay, pebbles, grass powder and artificial plants | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 狗狗山丘
zh-Hant.description:
一座有洞穴與孔洞的柔和山丘，讓狗與人有共享的遊憩場所。

模型製作｜地景與棲地｜黏土、卵石、草粉與人造植物｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Close-up of the hill with a figure and dog.
人偶與狗在山丘旁的近景。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted a landscape where dogs and their owners can share space. The question was how terrain itself could invite play, rest and hiding.
captions: Watercolour of the hill idea.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想打造一處讓狗與飼主共享的地景。問題是地形本身如何引發遊戲、休息與躲藏。
captions: 山丘構想的水彩畫。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student mapped how dogs move, sniff and stop along a route. These notes became a plan of paths and resting spots.
captions: Map of dog routes and stops.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生描繪狗沿路移動、嗅聞與停留的方式。這些筆記成為步道與休息點的平面。
captions: 狗狗路線與停留點的地圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Soft mounds were modelled in 3D to test sizes and openings. The forms were then built as hollow clay shells and given a rough stone texture.
captions: 3D study of the mounds.
Shaping the hollow clay shell.
The shell with a rough texture.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以3D建立柔和的土丘，測試尺度與開口。接著把造型做成中空黏土殼，並加上粗糙的石材質感。
captions: 土丘的3D研究。
塑造中空的黏土殼。
帶粗糙質感的外殼。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final hill is full of caves and holes framed by grass, flowers and trees. Small figures of a person and a dog show how the hill is shared.
captions: Side view of the hill.
Caves along the hill.
Flowers and pebbles at the base.
Top view of the whole site.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的山丘布滿洞穴與孔洞，四周是草地、花與樹。人與狗的小人偶呈現山丘如何被共享。
captions: 山丘側面。
沿著山丘的洞穴。
底部的花與卵石。
整個基地的俯視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe the user, even an animal.
2. Map their habits.
3. Model soft forms digitally.
4. Build and texture by hand.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察使用者，即使是動物。
2. 描繪牠們的習慣。
3. 以數位建立柔和形體。
4. 親手建造並加上質感。

pins.title: Silk Road
pins.description:
The lightness of silk is turned into a floating frame of woven curves.

Model making | Culture and material | PLA, acrylic, hot-melt glue and silk | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 絲路
zh-Hant.description:
把絲的輕盈轉化為一座由編織曲線構成的漂浮框架。

模型製作｜文化與材料｜PLA、壓克力、熱熔膠與絲｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished silk thread structure.
完成的絲線結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was moved by the ancient trade route and the silk carried along it. The question was how the lightness and weave of silk could become architecture.
captions: Crumpled silk concept studies.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生被古老的貿易路線與沿途運送的絲綢所觸動。問題是絲的輕盈與編織如何成為建築。
captions: 揉皺的絲質概念研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Crumpled silk was photographed to study folds and light. Line sketches then traced how threads loop and overlap.
captions: Sketch of looping thread lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生拍攝揉皺的絲，研究皺褶與光線。線條草圖接著描繪絲線如何環繞與重疊。
captions: 環繞線條的草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Printed frames were tested with silk fibres and hot-melt glue. A sequence of digital steps grew a single loop into a layered curve frame.
captions: Testing silk and printed frames.
Frame with silk fibres.
Steps from loop to layered form.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以絲纖維與熱熔膠測試列印框架。一連串數位步驟把單一環形發展成層狀曲線框架。
captions: 測試絲與列印框架。
帶絲纖維的框架。
從環形到層狀造型的步驟。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final work is a flowing curve frame that seems to float like a silk thread. It links craft, material and space as a dialogue between cultures.
captions: Close-ups of woven curves.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終作品是一座彷彿絲線般漂浮的流動曲線框架。它把工藝、材料與空間連結成一場文化之間的對話。
captions: 編織曲線的近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a personal journey.
2. Study one material closely.
3. Translate it into lines.
4. Build a light frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從個人的旅程出發。
2. 仔細研究一種材料。
3. 把它轉化為線條。
4. 建造輕盈的框架。

pins.title: Civic Stage: Performing Arts Complex
pins.description:
A parking lot becomes an arts complex of stacked blocks and a spherical theatre.

Digital design | Urban architecture | 3D modelling, rendering and watercolour | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市舞台：表演藝術綜合體
zh-Hant.description:
一座停車場化身為由堆疊量體與球形劇場組成的藝術綜合體。

數位設計｜城市建築｜3D建模、算圖與水彩｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Aerial render of the complex.
綜合體的鳥瞰算圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project turns a city parking lot into a complex for the arts, culture and learning. It asks how one building can bring students, artists and the public together.
captions: Land-use map of the area.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個專案把城市停車場改造成藝術、文化與學習的綜合體。它探討一座建築如何讓學生、藝術家與大眾聚在一起。
captions: 地區的土地使用圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied land use, routes and street life around the site. Simple block moves such as shifting, lifting and cutting were then tested.
captions: Massing steps from block to cluster.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究基地周邊的土地使用、動線與街道生活。接著測試平移、抬升與切割等簡單的量體操作。
captions: 從方塊到群組的量體步驟。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Four programmes were given their own blocks and colours: an academy, a civic hall, an innovation hub and a theatre. They were stacked so their edges overlap and open onto shared spaces.
captions: Colour-coded programme diagram.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 四種機能各自分配量體與顏色：學院、市民空間、創新中心與劇場。它們互相堆疊，讓邊緣重疊並通往共享空間。
captions: 以顏色標示的機能圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Renders show a raised performance deck and a spherical theatre forming a strong public landmark. A watercolour adds daylight and people to show an open, walkable arts campus.
captions: Front view of the arrival deck.
Street view with the theatre sphere.
Watercolour of the public plaza.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 算圖呈現抬高的表演平台與球形劇場構成鮮明的公共地標。水彩畫加入日光與人群，表現開放、適合步行的藝術園區。
captions: 入口平台的正面。
有球形劇場的街景。
公共廣場的水彩畫。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the site first.
2. Test simple block moves.
3. Give each use its own volume.
4. Show it in render and paint.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 先閱讀基地。
2. 測試簡單的量體操作。
3. 為每種用途分配量體。
4. 以算圖與繪畫呈現。

pins.title: Emerging Eco-Architecture
pins.description:
Square wooden frames climb a rocky slope like a structure growing out of the land.

Model making | Architecture and nature | Wooden strips, white board and gravel | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 浮現的生態建築
zh-Hant.description:
方形木框沿著岩坡攀升，彷彿從大地長出的結構。

模型製作｜建築與自然｜木條、白板與碎石｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished frame structure on gravel.
碎石上完成的框架結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was struck by recent natural disasters and saw them as a sign of nature under stress. The question was whether architecture could help restore balance between people and land.
captions: Watercolour of the frame idea.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生被近年的天然災害所觸動，視之為自然承受壓力的訊號。問題是建築能否幫助恢復人與土地之間的平衡。
captions: 框架構想的水彩畫。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Two precedents were studied for how they blend with landscape and use repeated modules. Sketches turned these ideas into crossing frames.
captions: Sketch of crossing frames.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究兩個先例如何融入地景並運用重複模組。草圖把這些概念轉化為交錯的框架。
captions: 交錯框架的草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Small cube frames were made as concept modules. They were then stacked along a slope so the structure seems to rise from the rock.
captions: Small cube frame modules.
Frames stacked on the slope.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生製作小型立方框架作為概念模組。接著沿坡堆疊，使結構彷彿從岩石中升起。
captions: 小型立方框架模組。
沿坡堆疊的框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model uses square frames as structure and slopes to create porosity. Flat platforms woven between them act as public spaces that grow from the rocky ground.
captions: Frames meeting the gravel.
Close-up of the joints.
Side view on the white base.
End view with platforms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以方形框架為結構，並以坡度創造孔隙。穿插其間的平台成為從岩地長出的公共空間。
captions: 框架與碎石相接。
接點的近景。
白色底座上的側面。
帶平台的端景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a real concern.
2. Study how others answer it.
3. Design one repeatable module.
4. Grow it across the site.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從真實的關注出發。
2. 研究他人如何回應。
3. 設計一個可重複的模組。
4. 讓它在基地上生長。

pins.title: Streamlined High-rise
pins.description:
A stack of distorted ellipses grows into a porous, layered tower through a visual script.

Digital design | Parametric tower | Visual scripting and 3D modelling | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 流線高層建築
zh-Hant.description:
一疊變形的橢圓透過視覺化程式長成多孔、層疊的塔。

數位設計｜參數化高塔｜視覺化程式與3D建模｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished layered tower.
完成的層疊高塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project explores how rules can shape a high-rise instead of drawing it by hand. It asks whether simple geometry can produce an organic, flowing tower skin.
captions: Ellipse array, mapping and random scale.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個專案探討如何以規則而非手繪來塑造高樓。它思考簡單的幾何能否產生有機、流動的塔樓表皮。
captions: 橢圓陣列、映射與隨機縮放。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A single ellipse was arrayed upward, then distorted with mapping and random scaling. Surfaces and colours were added to preview the stack.
captions: Surfaces and colour preview.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 單一橢圓向上陣列，再以映射與隨機縮放加以變形。學生加上曲面與顏色來預覽堆疊效果。
captions: 曲面與顏色預覽。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A visual script links every step so one change updates the whole tower. The curves were rebuilt, lofted, subdivided into a mesh and merged into two layers.
captions: The visual script.
Rebuild, loft, mesh and merge.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 視覺化程式串連每個步驟，改動一處就更新整座塔。曲線經過重建、放樣、細分成網格，再合併成兩層。
captions: 視覺化程式。
重建、放樣、網格與合併。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final tower reads like layers of rock built up over time. It shows how a clear digital workflow can lead to expressive yet buildable facades.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的塔看起來像長年堆積的岩層。它展示清楚的數位流程如何帶來有表現力又可建造的立面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one curve.
2. Change one rule at a time.
3. Link steps in a script.
4. Merge the best layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一條曲線開始。
2. 一次改變一條規則。
3. 以程式串連步驟。
4. 合併最佳的層次。

pins.title: Material Regeneration
pins.description:
Plastic bags, bamboo chopsticks and old mesh are knotted into a new woven surface.

Model making | Material reuse | Plastic bags, bamboo chopsticks, iron mesh and hemp rope | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 材料再生
zh-Hant.description:
塑膠袋、竹筷與舊網片被打結編織成全新的表面。

模型製作｜材料再利用｜塑膠袋、竹筷、鐵網與麻繩｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished woven panel.
完成的編織板。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Everyday waste such as plastic bags and old mesh is usually thrown away after one use. The project asks how these overlooked materials could gain a second life as a new building surface.
captions: Tying chopsticks into a grid.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 塑膠袋與舊網片等日常廢棄物通常用過一次就被丟棄。這個專案思考這些被忽略的材料，如何以新的建築表面重獲第二次生命。
captions: 把竹筷綁成格網。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student collected common household waste and tested how it could be tied, wrapped and woven. Bamboo chopsticks became a light frame that could hold softer materials.
captions: Knotting the joints by hand.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生收集常見的家庭廢棄物，測試如何綁、包與編織它們。竹筷成為能承載柔軟材料的輕巧框架。
captions: 親手打結固定節點。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Plastic bags were stretched and knotted across the chopstick grid in several layers. Mesh strips and rope were woven in to add strength and texture.
captions: Plastic bags stretched over the frame.
Mesh strips woven in.
A tied joint up close.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 塑膠袋被拉開並分層綁在竹筷格網上。網條與麻繩被編入其中，增加強度與質感。
captions: 塑膠袋包覆在框架上。
編入的網狀條帶。
綁好的節點特寫。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final panel is a light, translucent skin that shows waste in a new form. It also works as a teaching piece that invites neighbours to rethink what they throw away.
captions: Top view of the surface.
Side view showing depth.
A folded corner.
Close-up of the woven skin.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的板材是輕盈、半透明的表皮，以新形式呈現廢棄物。它也是一件教材，邀請鄰里重新思考自己丟掉的東西。
captions: 表面的俯視。
呈現厚度的側面。
折起的轉角。
編織表皮的特寫。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect everyday waste.
2. Test how each piece joins.
3. Build a simple frame.
4. Layer and weave the skin.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集日常廢棄物。
2. 測試每種材料如何接合。
3. 搭出簡單的框架。
4. 分層編織表皮。

pins.title: Urban Rain Garden
pins.description:
A terrain model shows rainwater cleaned in four steps as it flows to a pond.

Model making | Landscape and water | Foam, clay, sand, stone, wax and model plants | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市雨水花園
zh-Hant.description:
一座地形模型呈現雨水流向水池時經過的四道淨化步驟。

模型製作｜地景與水｜泡棉、黏土、沙、石頭、蠟與模型植物｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished rain garden model.
完成的雨水花園模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Cities face heavier storms and flooding as the climate changes. The student asked how a garden could hold, clean and reuse rainwater while staying pleasant for people.
captions: Terraced wetland on a site visit.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 氣候變遷讓城市面對更強的暴雨與淹水。學生思考一座花園如何留住、淨化並再利用雨水，同時讓人感到舒適。
captions: 實地考察時的階梯式濕地。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A site visit to a terraced park wetland showed how stepped pools slow water down. The student sketched the flow from street runoff through filters to a retention pool.
captions: A planted pool beside the city.
Hand sketch of the water path.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 實地走訪一座階梯式公園濕地，看見層層水池如何減緩水流。學生畫出雨水從街道逕流、經過過濾到滯留池的路徑。
captions: 城市旁的植栽水池。
水流路徑的手繪草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The landform was carved from foam, then covered with clay and sand for texture. Stones of different sizes, wax water and white tubes showed each cleaning stage.
captions: Cutting the foam base.
Covering the landform with clay.
Adding stone layers.
Planting and wax water.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 地形以泡棉雕出，再覆上黏土與沙增加質感。不同大小的石頭、蠟製水面與白色管線呈現每一道淨化階段。
captions: 切割泡棉底座。
以黏土覆蓋地形。
加入石材層。
種植與蠟製水面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model reads as a section of sedimentation, plant filter, gravel filter and pond. It shows how a park can work like a sponge while also offering a green place to rest.
captions: The four purification stages.
Detail of the gravel and pond.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型以剖面呈現沉澱、植物過濾、礫石過濾與水池。它展示公園如何像海綿一樣運作，同時提供可休憩的綠地。
captions: 四個淨化階段。
礫石與水池細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Visit a real water site.
2. Draw the water path.
3. Build the landform in layers.
4. Label each stage clearly.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 走訪真實的水環境。
2. 畫出水流路徑。
3. 分層建造地形。
4. 清楚標示每個階段。

pins.title: Shared Kitchen
pins.description:
Stackable kitchen modules grow from a single dining unit into a community hub.

Model making | Community space | PLA frames, wooden sticks, resin prints and laser cutting | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 共享廚房
zh-Hant.description:
可堆疊的廚房模組，從單一用餐單元長成社區據點。

模型製作｜社區空間｜PLA框架、木棒、樹脂列印與雷射切割｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished stacked kitchen.
完成的堆疊廚房。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Cooking and eating together is one of the easiest ways for neighbours to meet. The project asks how a kitchen could become a flexible social space for communities of any size.
captions: Front view of the modules.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一起煮飯吃飯是鄰居相遇最自然的方式之一。這個專案思考廚房如何成為適合不同規模社區的彈性社交空間。
captions: 模組的正面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student treated everyday activities as social moments and studied how dining, teaching and workshops could share one space. A single module was sized for a small neighbourhood meal.
captions: Inside one module.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生把日常活動視為社交時刻，研究用餐、教學與工作坊如何共用空間。單一模組的尺度適合小型鄰里聚餐。
captions: 單一模組內部。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Black frames were printed and filled with timber floors, slatted screens and white furniture. Modules were stacked and shifted to test larger kitchens and movable units.
captions: A shared dining floor.
Modules seen from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生列印黑色框架，再放入木地板、格柵屏風與白色家具。模組被堆疊與錯位，測試更大的廚房與可移動單元。
captions: 共享用餐樓層。
從上方看模組。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model stacks modules into a stepped community kitchen with stairs and terraces. It shows a building that can grow or shrink with the people who use it.
captions: Stairs and screens in a module.
A stacked corner.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型把模組堆成有樓梯與平台的階梯式社區廚房。它展示一座能隨使用者增減而成長或縮小的建築。
captions: 模組中的樓梯與屏風。
堆疊的轉角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a daily activity.
2. Design one module.
3. Stack and shift modules.
4. Add people and furniture.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從日常活動出發。
2. 設計一個模組。
3. 堆疊與錯位模組。
4. 加入人物與家具。

pins.title: Living Layers, Watching Streets
pins.description:
Shifting floor plates let residents on every level keep an eye on the street.

Model making | Housing and safety | PVC sheets and red figures | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 層層生活，守望街道
zh-Hant.description:
錯動的樓板讓每一層的住戶都能看顧街道。

模型製作｜住宅與安全｜PVC板與紅色人偶｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished staggered towers.
完成的錯層塔樓。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Streets feel safer when people living nearby can see them. The project asks how a housing block could keep that link to the street across several floors.
captions: Front view of the floor plates.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 當附近居民看得見街道時，街道會更讓人安心。這個專案思考一棟住宅如何在好幾層樓之間維持與街道的連結。
captions: 樓板的正面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student started from a well-known urban idea that residents watching from home keep streets safe. That effect fades above a few storeys, so height and openness became the key questions.
captions: Red figures mark the watchers.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生從一個知名的城市觀念出發：居民在家中看著街道，就能讓街道更安全。這種效果在幾層樓以上會減弱，所以高度與開放性成為關鍵。
captions: 紅色人偶標示觀察者。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Thin PVC plates were staggered and held by short vertical partitions. Red figures were placed at edges and terraces to test where people could look out.
captions: A figure at the floor edge.
An open terrace.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 薄PVC樓板被錯開排列，以短隔牆支撐。紅色人偶放在邊緣與平台上，測試人們能從哪裡往外看。
captions: 樓板邊緣的人偶。
開放的平台。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final towers turn every level into a lookout while keeping private corners. They show how small choices in floor layout can shape a sense of safety.
captions: Upper floors and partitions.
Looking along a slab edge.
Close side view.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的塔樓讓每一層都成為瞭望點，同時保留私密角落。它們展示樓層配置上的小選擇如何影響安全感。
captions: 上層樓板與隔牆。
沿著樓板邊緣看去。
近距離側面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a city idea.
2. Turn it into a section.
3. Stagger the floors.
4. Test sightlines with figures.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從城市觀念出發。
2. 把它轉成剖面。
3. 錯開樓板。
4. 用人偶測試視線。

pins.title: Passive Facade
pins.description:
Layered timber strips shade, cool and quiet the rooms behind them.

Model making | Facade and climate | Wooden sticks and laser-cut panels | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 被動式立面
zh-Hant.description:
層疊的木條為後方的房間遮陽、降溫並隔音。

模型製作｜立面與氣候｜木棒與雷射切割板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished facade model.
完成的立面模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Large glass walls let in too much sun and noise, so buildings rely on air conditioning. The project asks whether a facade itself could control light, heat and sound.
captions: Laser-cut strips being assembled.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 大面玻璃牆引入過多陽光與噪音，使建築依賴空調。這個專案思考立面本身能否調節光線、熱與聲音。
captions: 組裝雷射切割木條。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied how layered surfaces filter sunlight and scatter sound waves. Cutting diagrams were drawn in software for every floor and strip.
captions: The staggered strip texture.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究層疊表面如何過濾陽光並分散聲波。每一層樓與每根木條都以軟體繪製切割圖。
captions: 錯落的木條紋理。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Thin strips were laser-cut, assembled in a staggered sequence and lightly sanded. Light tests showed soft patterns falling across the floors.
captions: Filtered light on the floor.
A shaded interior.
Side view of the facade.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 細木條經雷射切割，依錯落順序組裝並輕輕打磨。光線測試呈現灑落在樓板上的柔和圖案。
captions: 灑在地板上的過濾光線。
被遮蔭的室內。
立面的側面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model shows a rough, deep facade that shades rooms and breaks up noise. It treats beauty and comfort as one goal rather than two.
captions: Shadow patterns inside.
Light through the gaps.
Looking out through the strips.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型呈現粗糙而有深度的立面，為室內遮陽並打散噪音。它把美感與舒適視為同一個目標。
captions: 室內的光影圖案。
穿過縫隙的光線。
透過木條往外看。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name the climate problem.
2. Draw the facade layers.
3. Cut and assemble strips.
4. Test with real light.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 說出氣候問題。
2. 畫出立面層次。
3. 切割並組裝木條。
4. 以真實光線測試。

pins.title: Big Bang Constellation
pins.description:
Star patterns become stick-and-plaster forms that merge into one expanding cluster.

Model making | Form from data | Wooden sticks, plaster mix, hot glue and board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 大爆炸星座
zh-Hant.description:
星座圖形化為木棒與石膏造型，再融合成一個不斷擴張的星團。

模型製作｜從資料到造型｜木棒、石膏、熱熔膠與板材｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished constellation cluster.
完成的星座星團。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Star signs look flat in the sky, but the stars are really far apart in space. The student asked what these patterns would look like as real 3D forms.
captions: First 3D constellation studies.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 星座在天空中看起來是平的，但星星在宇宙中其實相距遙遠。學生思考這些圖形若成為真實的立體造型會是什麼樣子。
captions: 最初的立體星座研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The twelve star signs were mapped and each one was modelled digitally. The forms were then placed back on the chart to check their links.
captions: A chart of the star signs.
Digital forms placed on the chart.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生整理十二星座，並逐一以數位方式建模。接著把造型放回星圖上，檢查它們之間的關係。
captions: 星座圖表。
放在星圖上的數位造型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Signs were combined in groups to invent new constellations built from sticks and plaster panels. The stages were then merged, with card used to suggest the shielding of an expanding universe.
captions: Four combined constellations.
Merging the stages step by step.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 星座被分組組合，以木棒與石膏板創造新的星座。各階段再被融合，並用紙板暗示不斷擴張的宇宙所產生的遮蔽。
captions: 四個組合後的星座。
逐步融合各階段。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final cluster grows outward like a living structure of triangles and struts. Its regular geometry means it could keep extending in any direction.
captions: Upper part of the cluster.
A figure inside the frame.
Lower part of the cluster.
Looking up through the sticks.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的星團像一座由三角形與支桿組成的生命體向外生長。規則的幾何讓它能朝任何方向持續延伸。
captions: 星團上半部。
框架中的人偶。
星團下半部。
從木棒間往上看。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a pattern you love.
2. Turn 2D points into 3D.
3. Combine and test groups.
4. Let the form keep growing.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇喜愛的圖形。
2. 把平面的點轉成立體。
3. 組合並測試群組。
4. 讓造型持續生長。

pins.title: Wonders of the World Stacks
pins.description:
Memories of three trips are stacked into one tower of brick, coloured houses and a white facade.

Model making | Travel and culture | Gypsum, tiny shells, bricks, wooden sticks, acrylic rods, PVC and cellophane | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 世界奇觀堆疊
zh-Hant.description:
三段旅行的記憶堆疊成一座由磚、彩色小屋與白色立面組成的塔。

模型製作｜旅行與文化｜石膏、小貝殼、磚、木棒、壓克力棒、PVC與玻璃紙｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished stacked tower.
完成的堆疊塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Travel leaves strong memories of places, food and buildings. The student asked how three very different trips could live together in one structure.
captions: Concept sketch of the stack.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 旅行留下對地方、食物與建築的深刻記憶。學生思考三段截然不同的旅行如何共存於一個結構中。
captions: 堆疊的概念草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Thailand, Macau and Hokkaido were each reduced to a few strong symbols. A watercolour tested how temples, a church facade and snowy hills could stack.
captions: Watercolour of the three places.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 泰國、澳門與北海道各自被濃縮成幾個鮮明的符號。水彩畫測試寺廟、教堂立面與雪山如何堆疊。
captions: 三個地方的水彩畫。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The base was formed from gypsum and tiny shells, then ringed with miniature brick walls. Coloured houses on wooden sticks and a cut PVC facade were added above.
captions: Shaping the base by hand.
Tiny brick walls.
Cutting the white facade.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 底座以石膏與小貝殼塑成，再圍上迷你磚牆。上方加入以木棒支撐的彩色小屋與切割的PVC立面。
captions: 親手塑造底座。
迷你磚牆。
切割白色立面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final tower reads from calm stone at the bottom to busy streets and a white facade at the top. Each layer uses materials that match the mood of each place.
captions: The facade from the side.
Facade and acrylic rods.
Coloured street-food houses.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的塔由底部沉穩的石材，往上到熱鬧的街道與白色立面。每一層都使用符合當地氛圍的材料。
captions: 立面側面。
立面與壓克力棒。
彩色的街頭小吃屋。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. List your strongest memories.
2. Pick one symbol per place.
3. Match a material to each.
4. Stack them in order.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 列出最深刻的記憶。
2. 每個地方選一個符號。
3. 為每個符號配一種材料。
4. 依序堆疊。

pins.title: Tiny Forest
pins.description:
Rice terraces inspire stepped hexagon platforms where plants and city can share space.

Model making | Landscape and planting | Straws, PVC boards, model trees and glue | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 微型森林
zh-Hant.description:
以梯田為靈感，讓植物與城市共享空間的階梯式六角平台。

模型製作｜地景與植栽｜吸管、PVC板、模型樹與膠｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished terrace forest.
完成的梯田森林。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Dense cities leave little room for plants, yet greenery helps both people and wildlife. The student asked how buildings could make space for nature in layers.
captions: Rice terraces that inspired it.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 高密度城市留給植物的空間很少，但綠意對人與野生動物都有益。學生思考建築如何分層為自然騰出空間。
captions: 啟發設計的梯田。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A hike through mountain rice terraces showed how stepped fields hold water and soil. The student also collected and painted rooftop-garden plants to see which could live at each height.
captions: Plan of green platforms.
Watercolour of a rooftop garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一次梯田健行讓學生看見階梯式田地如何保住水與土壤。學生也收集並描繪屋頂花園的植物，觀察哪些能在不同高度生長。
captions: 綠色平台的平面圖。
屋頂花園的水彩畫。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: PVC boards were cut into hexagons so their edges could interlock without bending. Straw columns lifted each layer and a terrace sketch guided the overall shape.
captions: Cutting hexagon plates.
Straws for the columns.
Sketch of the terraced hills.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: PVC板被切成六角形，讓邊緣能互相咬合而不必彎折。吸管柱撐起每一層，梯田速寫則引導整體造型。
captions: 切割六角形板。
作為柱子的吸管。
梯田山丘的速寫。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model stacks green platforms like terraces, each planted with different model trees. It suggests a city where buildings and plants grow together.
captions: Top view of the platforms.
Side view with planting.
Layers of platforms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型像梯田般堆疊綠色平台，每一層種上不同的模型樹。它描繪一座建築與植物共同生長的城市。
captions: 平台俯視。
帶植栽的側面。
層層平台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a landscape you admire.
2. Study its structure.
3. Choose one repeating unit.
4. Plant each layer.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找到欣賞的地景。
2. 研究它的結構。
3. 選定一個重複單元。
4. 為每一層種植。

pins.title: Rhythms in Structure
pins.description:
A lively piano piece becomes a burst of black sticks, coloured film and cotton balls.

Model making | Music and form | Sticks, spray paint, cellophane, cotton balls and iridescent board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 結構中的節奏
zh-Hant.description:
一首輕快的鋼琴曲化為黑色木棒、彩色玻璃紙與棉球的迸發。

模型製作｜音樂與造型｜木棒、噴漆、玻璃紙、棉球與炫彩板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished music sculpture.
完成的音樂雕塑。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student had composed a short piano piece in a lively style for a music class. The question was how to turn rhythm and melody into a space you can see.
captions: Drawing of the bass line.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生在音樂課上創作了一段輕快風格的鋼琴曲。問題在於如何把節奏與旋律變成看得見的空間。
captions: 低音聲部的繪圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The steady left-hand bass and the playful right-hand melody were drawn as two kinds of lines. Bold arcs showed the bass, while loose curves and dots showed the melody.
captions: Drawing of the melody.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 穩定的左手低音與俏皮的右手旋律被畫成兩種線條。粗弧線代表低音，鬆散的曲線與圓點代表旋律。
captions: 旋律的繪圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Black-sprayed sticks were tied in a tent shape to hold the bass, and white sticks twisted around them for the melody. Cellophane strips and cotton balls added colour and drum-like beats.
captions: Cut cellophane strips.
Layering coloured film.
First concept model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 噴黑的木棒被綁成帳篷形狀代表低音，白色木棒環繞其間代表旋律。玻璃紙條與棉球加入色彩與鼓點般的節拍。
captions: 剪好的玻璃紙條。
疊上彩色薄膜。
最初的概念模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final sculpture glows under light and reflects off an iridescent base. It turns a three-minute tune into one bright, frozen moment.
captions: Light through the film.
Reflections on the base.
Blue glow close-up.
Side view of the burst.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的雕塑在光線下發亮，並映照在炫彩底座上。它把三分鐘的樂曲凝結成一個明亮的瞬間。
captions: 穿透薄膜的光線。
底座上的倒影。
藍色光芒特寫。
迸發造型的側面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Listen and pick two voices.
2. Draw each as a line type.
3. Match lines to materials.
4. Light it like a stage.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 聆聽並選出兩個聲部。
2. 把每個聲部畫成一種線條。
3. 為線條配上材料。
4. 像舞台一樣打光。

pins.title: Visualization of Personality
pins.description:
Drawings of four personality types grow into one model of clay, sticks and white boards.

Model making | Psychology and form | Wooden sticks, plastic clay, wire and PVC board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 個性的視覺化
zh-Hant.description:
四種個性類型的繪畫，發展成一座由黏土、木棒與白板構成的模型。

模型製作｜心理與造型｜木棒、塑形黏土、鐵線與PVC板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished personality model.
完成的個性模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Every person has a different mix of traits, but these are hard to see. The project asks how colour, shape and space could express a personality.
captions: Warm circles for an open type.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 每個人都有不同的特質組合，卻很難被看見。這個專案思考色彩、形狀與空間如何表達個性。
captions: 代表開朗類型的暖色圓。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied personality theories and drew one composition for each of four types. Warm circles, sharp blocks, closed forms and mixed patterns each told a different story.
captions: Blocks and lines for a logical type.
A closed shape for a guarded type.
Mixed patterns for a complex type.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究個性理論，並為四種類型各畫一幅構圖。暖色圓、銳利方塊、封閉形與混合圖案各自訴說不同的故事。
captions: 代表理性類型的方塊與線條。
代表內斂類型的封閉形狀。
代表複雜類型的混合圖案。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Two hand drawings were picked and turned into 3D studies. Clay, wooden sticks, wire and PVC boards were then combined into one piece.
captions: Hand drawing chosen to develop.
Building with sticks and boards.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生挑選兩幅手繪轉化成立體研究。接著把黏土、木棒、鐵線與PVC板組合成一件作品。
captions: 選定發展的手繪。
以木棒與板材搭建。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model mixes open grids with closed boxes to show the many sides of one person. Light and shadow make each angle feel like a different mood.
captions: Model seen from above.
Grid of boards and sticks.
Layers at an angle.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型混合開放的格網與封閉的盒體，呈現一個人的多重面向。光影讓每個角度都像不同的情緒。
captions: 從上方看模型。
板材與木棒的格網。
斜看層次。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a trait to show.
2. Draw it as shapes.
3. Choose the strongest drawing.
4. Build it in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇要表現的特質。
2. 以形狀畫出來。
3. 挑選最有力的圖。
4. 分層搭建。

pins.title: Chilling Refuge: Penguin Habitat
pins.description:
A ring of stacked stones and a light acrylic frame form a shared home for penguins.

Model making | Animal habitat | Stone, wood strips, jelly wax, acrylic strips and foamboard | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 寒冷避風港：企鵝棲地
zh-Hant.description:
堆疊的石塊與輕巧的壓克力框架，圍成企鵝共享的家。

模型製作｜動物棲地｜石塊、木條、果凍蠟、壓克力條與珍珠板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished stone habitat.
完成的石塊棲地。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Penguins kept on hard concrete can fall ill because the ground does not suit them. The student asked how a man-made habitat could feel natural and still support their social life.
captions: Penguins living among stones.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 企鵝若住在堅硬的混凝土上容易生病，因為地面不適合牠們。學生思考人工棲地如何既自然又能支持牠們的群居生活。
captions: 生活在石塊間的企鵝。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Some penguins build nests from stones, so stacked rock became the main material. A round, inward-facing house type was studied because it lets neighbours meet in a shared centre.
captions: Concept drawings of the habitat.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 有些企鵝會用石頭築巢，因此堆疊的石塊成為主要材料。學生也研究一種向內圍合的圓形住屋，因為它讓鄰居能在共享的中心相遇。
captions: 棲地概念圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Stones were glued into a ring of nests around a pool made from jelly wax. A thin acrylic frame was then raised over the ring to suggest shelter without blocking light.
captions: Building the ring and stone nests.
Drawing of the frame over the stones.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生把石塊黏成一圈巢穴，圍繞著以果凍蠟做成的水池。接著在環上架起細壓克力框架，暗示遮蔽又不擋住光線。
captions: 搭建環形與石巢。
石塊上方框架的圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model joins rough natural stone with a light, regular frame. Small penguin figures show how the ring creates a shared, protected home.
captions: Three views of the model.
Close view of the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型結合粗糙的天然石塊與輕巧規則的框架。小企鵝模型顯示環形如何創造一個共享且受保護的家。
captions: 模型的三個視角。
框架近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study how the animal lives.
2. Choose a natural material.
3. Shape a shared space.
4. Add a light shelter.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究動物如何生活。
2. 選擇天然材料。
3. 塑造共享空間。
4. 加上輕巧的遮蔽。

pins.title: Spatial Deconstruction of Chinese Gardens
pins.description:
Fragments of classical garden plans are reassembled into a new winding water garden.

Model making | Garden space | PVC board, stone clay, wooden sticks and landscape materials | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 中國園林的空間解構
zh-Hant.description:
古典園林平面的片段被重新組合成一座蜿蜒的新水景園。

模型製作｜園林空間｜PVC板、石粉黏土、木棒與造景材料｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished water garden from above.
從上方看完成的水景園。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Classical gardens hide and reveal views as people walk, which makes them feel larger than they are. The project asks how this effect could be taken apart and rebuilt in a new layout.
captions: A classical garden pavilion.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 古典園林隨著行走藏景與露景，讓空間感覺比實際更大。這個專案思考如何拆解這種效果，再在新的配置中重建。
captions: 古典園林的亭子。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied gardens from Yangzhou and Suzhou and the idea that scenery changes with every step. Pieces of their plans were cut out and reassembled into one new plan.
captions: Plan fragments reassembled.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究揚州與蘇州的園林，以及「移步換景」的概念。接著把它們的平面片段剪下，重新組合成一張新的平面。
captions: 重新組合的平面片段。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The new plan was refined in pencil and then built with PVC board, stone clay and wooden sticks. Halls were framed in sticks so their outlines stay light against the water.
captions: Drawing and building the model.
Stick frames of the halls.
Frames in low light.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 新平面先以鉛筆修整，再用PVC板、石粉黏土與木棒製作。廳堂以木棒搭出框架，使輪廓在水面前保持輕盈。
captions: 繪圖與製作模型。
廳堂的木棒框架。
低光下的框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model winds paths and bridges around a bright blue pond. Each turn opens a new view, just as in the gardens that inspired it.
captions: Pavilions beside the water.
The pond and its edges.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型讓小徑與橋繞著亮藍色的水池蜿蜒。每一次轉折都開啟新的景色，正如啟發它的園林。
captions: 水邊的亭子。
水池與岸線。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a classic space.
2. Cut it into fragments.
3. Reassemble a new plan.
4. Build and test the views.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究經典空間。
2. 把它切成片段。
3. 重組新的平面。
4. 製作並檢驗景觀。

pins.title: Flowing Sleeves: Dance to Space Design
pins.description:
Silk hung in lattice frames captures the soft lines of a traditional sleeve dance.

Model making | Movement to space | Wood strips, cloth, yarn, fishing line and a wooden doll | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 流動水袖：從舞蹈到空間設計
zh-Hant.description:
懸掛在格柵框架中的絲布，捕捉傳統水袖舞的柔和線條。

模型製作｜從動作到空間｜木條、布料、紗線、釣魚線與木偶｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Fabric spaces inside the frames.
框架中的布料空間。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A sleeve dance creates soft lines in the air that vanish a moment later. The student asked how those passing movements could be turned into lasting space.
captions: Stills of a sleeve dance from a period drama.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 水袖舞在空中畫出柔和的線條，轉瞬即逝。學生思考如何把這些短暫的動作轉化為持久的空間。
captions: 古裝劇中的水袖舞劇照。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Scenes from a period drama were studied and the sleeve paths were traced as coloured lines. Traditional cracked-ice window patterns gave a frame for holding these lines.
captions: Drawings of the dance lines.
A cracked-ice window pattern.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究古裝劇中的片段，把水袖的軌跡描成彩色線條。傳統冰裂紋窗格則提供承載這些線條的框架。
captions: 舞蹈線條的繪圖。
冰裂紋窗格。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Three wooden frames of different sizes were filled with thin strips and fishing line. Silk was then hung and pulled in different ways, and each change was photographed frame by frame.
captions: Pattern turned into a frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以木條製作三個不同大小的框架，並加入細條與釣魚線。接著以不同方式懸掛與拉動絲布，逐格拍攝每一次變化。
captions: 窗格化為框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final frames hold layers of pink and white fabric like a dancer frozen mid-turn. Together they show one movement unfolding through space and time.
captions: Frame-by-frame record of pulling the fabric.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的框架容納層層粉白布料，像舞者在旋轉中定格。它們一起呈現一個動作在時空中展開。
captions: 逐格記錄拉動布料。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch a movement closely.
2. Trace its lines.
3. Build a frame to hold them.
4. Record the changes.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 仔細觀察一個動作。
2. 描出它的線條。
3. 製作承載的框架。
4. 記錄變化過程。

pins.title: Tranquil Retreat House
pins.description:
A small timber house keeps only the essentials and frames the forest through one low window.

Model making | Small house | Wooden board, laser cutting, PVC board and clay | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 寧靜隱居小屋
zh-Hant.description:
一座小木屋只保留必需品，並以一扇與視線同高的窗框住森林。

模型製作｜小住宅｜木板、雷射切割、PVC板與黏土｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished house from above.
從上方看完成的小屋。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Stress and conflict can make city life feel overwhelming. The student wanted a small place in the forest that helps a person slow down and think.
captions: Concept sketch of the house.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 壓力與衝突會讓城市生活令人喘不過氣。學生想要一個森林中的小地方，幫助人放慢腳步思考。
captions: 小屋的概念草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The house was kept small, with only essential furniture and functions. A window set at eye height became the key idea, turning the view outside into a calm daily ritual.
captions: Furniture and windows inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 小屋保持小巧，只有必要的家具與功能。與視線同高的窗成為關鍵概念，讓看向窗外成為平靜的日常儀式。
captions: 室內的家具與窗。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The form was modelled digitally, turned into flat drawings and laser cut from wood. Walls, furniture and framed clear windows were then glued together piece by piece.
captions: Cutting and gluing the walls.
Rooms taking shape.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 造型先以數位建模，再轉成平面圖並以雷射切割木板。接著逐片黏合牆面、家具與嵌有透明片的窗框。
captions: 切割與黏合牆面。
房間逐漸成形。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model shows a quiet timber shelter that glows warmly at night. Its simple rooms keep the focus on light, wood and the view.
captions: Model lit at night.
Timber walls from the side.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型呈現一座在夜裡透出暖光的安靜木屋。簡單的房間讓焦點留在光、木材與景色上。
captions: 夜間打光的模型。
側看木牆。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name the feeling you need.
2. Keep only the essentials.
3. Frame one key view.
4. Build and light the model.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 說出你需要的感受。
2. 只保留必需品。
3. 框出一個關鍵景色。
4. 製作並為模型打光。

pins.title: Volleyball Motion Trajectory
pins.description:
Frames of a volleyball swing become rows of paper fins under a triangulated stick canopy.

Model making | Motion to form | PVC board, paper and wood sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 排球動作軌跡視覺化
zh-Hant.description:
排球揮擊的連續畫格化為一排排紙鰭，上方覆蓋三角化的木棒棚架。

模型製作｜從動作到造型｜PVC板、紙與木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished model from above.
從上方看完成的模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A volleyball move lasts only a second, so its shape is hard to see. The student asked how her own playing motion could be turned into a lasting space.
captions: The motion traced as a 3D band.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一個排球動作只持續一秒，形狀很難被看見。學生思考如何把自己打球的動作轉化成持久的空間。
captions: 把動作描成立體帶狀。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A video of one strong move was split into single frames to find the key angles. These were traced as a band and rebuilt digitally as rows of thin fins.
captions: Digital model of the fin field.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生把一段動作最清楚的影片拆成單格，找出關鍵角度。這些角度被描成帶狀，再以數位方式重建為一排排薄鰭片。
captions: 鰭片陣列的數位模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Paper fins were cut, folded and tested under side light to read the motion. A canopy of triangles was then drawn and built in sticks to sit above them.
captions: Fin studies lit from the side.
Folding and cutting the fins.
First stick frame over the fins.
Line drawings of the canopy.
Coloured canopy study.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 紙鰭片經過切割、摺疊，並在側光下測試動作的表現。接著繪製三角形棚架，以木棒搭建在鰭片上方。
captions: 側光下的鰭片研究。
摺疊與切割鰭片。
鰭片上方的第一版木棒框架。
棚架的線稿。
上色的棚架研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model sets a wave of white fins under a varied stick canopy. Each strut length changes with the motion, so the roof reads like a frozen swing.
captions: Canopy and fins from the side.
A corner of the canopy.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型讓一波白色鰭片位於變化豐富的木棒棚架下。每根支桿的長度隨動作改變，使屋頂像一次定格的揮擊。
captions: 側看棚架與鰭片。
棚架的一角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Film one movement.
2. Split it into frames.
3. Trace the key angles.
4. Build the path in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 拍下一個動作。
2. 拆成單格畫面。
3. 描出關鍵角度。
4. 分層搭建軌跡。

pins.title: The Fragile Arctic: Revolving Ice
pins.description:
Clear and black layers stack into a tower that shows sea ice thinning as it warms.

Model making | Climate change | Paper, vegetation, wood sticks and transparent bars | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 脆弱的北極：旋轉的冰
zh-Hant.description:
透明與黑色層板堆疊成塔，呈現海冰在暖化中變薄。

模型製作｜氣候變遷｜紙、植栽、木棒與透明條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished ice tower.
完成的冰之塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Rising temperatures are melting Arctic sea ice faster every year. Many animals lose the ice they need for resting, hunting and raising their young.
captions: Animals that rely on sea ice.
Watercolour of the ice landscape.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 氣溫上升使北極海冰逐年加速融化。許多動物因此失去休息、覓食與繁殖所需的冰面。
captions: 依賴海冰的動物。
冰原的水彩畫。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student ran a test comparing how fast ice melts in room-temperature and heated water. The results showed how a small rise in heat speeds up the loss of ice.
captions: Ice blocks for the melting test.
Measuring water temperature.
Ice samples after melting.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生進行實驗，比較冰在室溫水與加熱水中的融化速度。結果顯示熱度的小幅上升就會加快冰的流失。
captions: 融冰實驗的冰塊。
測量水溫。
融化後的冰樣本。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A tall tower was sketched with clear planks and white platforms to stand for ice and human space. Black parts were added at the base to show the warming creeping upward.
captions: First sketch of the tower.
Building with clear bars.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生畫出一座高塔，以透明板與白色平台代表冰與人的空間。底部加入黑色構件，表現暖化逐漸向上蔓延。
captions: 塔的初步草圖。
以透明條搭建。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final tower grows thinner and darker toward the bottom, like ice melting away. It turns test results into a clear image that invites people to learn and act.
captions: Details with small figures.
Drawing of the final tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的塔越往下越細、越暗，像冰正在融化。它把實驗結果轉化成清楚的畫面，邀請人們了解並採取行動。
captions: 放有小人偶的細部。
最終塔的繪圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a real problem.
2. Test it with an experiment.
3. Give each finding a material.
4. Build the change in form.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇一個真實問題。
2. 以實驗驗證。
3. 為每個發現選擇材料。
4. 用造型表現變化。

pins.title: Interpretation of Music as a Sculpture
pins.description:
Two trials turn the calm of playing the flute into waves of cut straws.

Model making | Music to space | Plastic straws, hot glue, plastic board and spray paint | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 音樂的雕塑詮釋
zh-Hant.description:
兩次嘗試把吹奏長笛的平靜轉化為由剪裁吸管組成的波浪。

模型製作｜從音樂到空間｜塑膠吸管、熱熔膠、塑膠板與噴漆｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished straw waves.
完成的吸管波浪。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Playing the flute gives the student a calm, familiar feeling. The project asks how that feeling could be shown as a sculpture and a space.
captions: Drawing of a flute and birds.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 吹奏長笛給學生平靜而熟悉的感受。這個專案思考如何把這種感受呈現為雕塑與空間。
captions: 長笛與鳥的繪圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A first trial used tubes, arches and coloured flags around a flute form. It looked more like a busy playground than calm music, so the student chose to start again.
captions: The first trial with arches and flags.
Sketches for the first trial.
Watercolour of the first trial.
Close views of the first trial.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 第一次嘗試在長笛造型周圍使用管子、拱與彩色旗子。它看起來更像熱鬧的遊樂場而非平靜的音樂，因此學生決定重新開始。
captions: 第一次嘗試的拱與旗。
第一次嘗試的草圖。
第一次嘗試的水彩。
第一次嘗試的近景。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The second trial went abstract, using hundreds of cut paper and plastic straws. Flowing lines were sketched and then built as separate waves that were pieced together.
captions: Drawing of the straw forms.
Sketching the flowing lines.
Cutting and gluing straws.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 第二次嘗試轉向抽象，使用數百根剪裁的紙吸管與塑膠吸管。學生先描繪流動線條，再做成一段段波浪拼合起來。
captions: 吸管造型的繪圖。
描繪流動的線條。
剪裁並黏合吸管。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final sculpture rises in grey and black waves like notes in the air. Small figures turn it into an urban space shaped by music.
captions: Small figures among the waves.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的雕塑以灰黑色的波浪升起，像空中的音符。小人偶讓它成為由音樂塑造的城市空間。
captions: 波浪間的小人偶。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name the feeling.
2. Test a first model.
3. Be ready to start again.
4. Refine one material.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 說出那種感受。
2. 測試第一個模型。
3. 勇於重新開始。
4. 精煉一種材料。

pins.title: Three-Dimensional Modular System Study
pins.description:
A precedent study of stacked modular boxes grows into an open cardboard tower.

Model making | Precedent model study | Wood sticks, white cardboard and glue | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 立體模組系統研究
zh-Hant.description:
一項堆疊模組盒體的先例研究，長成一座開放的紙板塔。

模型製作｜先例模型研究｜木棒、白紙板與膠｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished modular tower.
完成的模組塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A famous 1960s housing idea stacked boxes in three dimensions to solve crowded space. The student wanted to test how far such a modular system could grow.
captions: Cardboard and sticks ready to build.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一個著名的1960年代住宅構想，以立體堆疊盒體解決擁擠的空間。學生想測試這樣的模組系統能長到多遠。
captions: 準備好的紙板與木棒。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Several small modular models were made first to understand how the units link. They were then combined and extended upward and sideways.
captions: A small modular test.
Units combined and extended.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先做幾個小型模組模型，了解單元如何相連。接著把它們組合，並向上與向旁延伸。
captions: 小型模組測試。
組合並延伸的單元。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: As the model grew, continuous voids appeared that let light in from many angles. Some spaces were then enclosed to add a sense of boundary, and stick frames marked open rooms.
captions: Voids and platforms up close.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 模型長大時出現連續的虛空間，讓光從多個角度進入。學生接著封閉部分空間以增加邊界感，並用木棒框架標示開放房間。
captions: 近看虛空間與平台。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final tower mixes closed white boxes, open frames and platforms of many sizes. A detailed hand drawing was used to study its light, shadow and connections.
captions: Hand drawing of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終的塔混合封閉的白色盒體、開放框架與各種尺度的平台。學生以細緻的手繪研究它的光影與連結。
captions: 塔的手繪。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a precedent system.
2. Build small units first.
3. Let the system grow.
4. Draw it to understand it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一個先例系統。
2. 先做小單元。
3. 讓系統成長。
4. 以手繪理解它。

pins.title: City in Window
pins.description:
Broken reflections in city windows are rebuilt as a tower of stick frames and planes.

Model making | City impressions | PVC board and wood sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 窗中城市
zh-Hant.description:
城市窗戶中破碎的倒影，被重建成一座木棒框架與平面組成的塔。

模型製作｜城市印象｜PVC板與木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished fragment tower.
完成的碎片之塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Windows in the city reflect buildings in bent and broken pieces. The student found these reflections more interesting than the city seen directly.
captions: Sketches of building windows.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 城市中的窗戶以彎曲破碎的片段映照建築。學生發現這些倒影比直接看到的城市更有趣。
captions: 建築窗戶的速寫。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Photos of windows were traced, cut and collaged into new patterns. The lines were then simplified into points, lines and surfaces.
captions: Collage and traced lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生描下窗戶的照片，再剪裁拼貼成新的圖案。接著把線條簡化為點、線與面。
captions: 拼貼與描出的線條。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The patterns were imagined in 3D and built with wood strips and PVC boards. Three phases moved from single fragments to overlapping layers and then to tower forms.
captions: Early stick and board models.
Phase one: single fragments.
Phase two: overlapping layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 這些圖案被想像成立體，以木條與PVC板製作。三個階段從單一碎片走向重疊層次，再發展成塔的造型。
captions: 早期的木棒與板材模型。
第一階段：單一碎片。
第二階段：重疊層次。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model stacks striped frames and pale planes into an irregular tower. Its overlapping shadows rebuild the broken city seen in a window.
captions: Phase three: tower studies.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型把條紋框架與淺色平面堆疊成不規則的塔。重疊的陰影重建了窗中那座破碎的城市。
captions: 第三階段：塔的研究。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect everyday views.
2. Trace and collage them.
3. Simplify to lines and planes.
4. Build in phases.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集日常景象。
2. 描摹並拼貼。
3. 簡化為線與面。
4. 分階段製作。

pins.title: The Sharpness of Language
pins.description:
Clay mouths sit in a mirror cube surrounded by sharp paper shards of words.

Model making | Concept installation | Mirrors, clay, plastic sticks, magazine paper and plastic sheets | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 語言的鋒利
zh-Hant.description:
黏土嘴巴坐在鏡面立方中，四周環繞著尖銳的文字紙片。

模型製作｜概念裝置｜鏡子、黏土、塑膠棒、雜誌紙與塑膠片｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Mouths inside the mirror cube.
鏡面立方中的嘴巴。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Online, a few harsh words can hurt more than a physical weapon. The student wanted to show how one person cannot escape the pressure of public opinion.
captions: First sketch of the idea.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在網路上，少數尖銳的言語可能比實體武器更傷人。學生想表現一個人如何難以逃離輿論的壓力。
captions: 概念的初步草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The idea grew into a person wishing for many mouths to answer words coming from every side. A mouth was chosen as the main form and sculpted in clay with careful colour and texture.
captions: Sculpting a clay mouth.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 概念發展成一個人渴望擁有許多張嘴，回應來自四面八方的言語。學生選擇嘴巴作為主要造型，以黏土細緻塑造顏色與質感。
captions: 雕塑黏土嘴巴。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Headlines in many languages were cut into sharp triangles and fixed on clear sheets and rods. Three mirrors were then joined into a cube to multiply the mouths and shards.
captions: Fixing the shards in place.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 多種語言的標題被剪成尖銳的三角形，固定在透明片與塑膠棒上。接著把三面鏡子組成立方，讓嘴巴與紙片不斷倍增。
captions: 固定紙片。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Inside the cube, the mouths seem endless and the shards point in from all sides. The small piece makes an invisible pressure feel physical and close.
captions: Shards seen from above.
The cube from a corner.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在立方內，嘴巴彷彿無窮無盡，紙片從四面指向中心。這件小作品讓看不見的壓力變得具體而貼近。
captions: 從上方看紙片。
從一角看立方。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose an invisible feeling.
2. Find one body symbol.
3. Add contrasting materials.
4. Use mirrors to multiply.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇一種看不見的感受。
2. 找出一個身體符號。
3. 加入對比的材料。
4. 用鏡子使其倍增。

pins.title: Harmonic Home
pins.description:
A house shaped by the treble clef wraps a sloping roof garden for a musical family.

Model making | House design | 3D print (PLA), wooden board, clay and Rhino | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 和諧之家
zh-Hant.description:
一座以高音譜號為形的住宅，包覆著為音樂家庭設計的傾斜屋頂花園。

模型製作｜住宅設計｜3D列印（PLA）、木板、黏土與Rhino｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished house and roof garden.
完成的住宅與屋頂花園。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A home can be more than rooms; it can connect the people who live in it. The student wanted a house that expresses music and the bond between family members.
captions: Sketches of the clef-shaped plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 家不只是房間，也能連結住在其中的人。學生希望設計一座表現音樂與家人情感連結的住宅。
captions: 高音譜號平面的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The treble clef gave the flowing plan, and a note shape gave the triangular structure. A lush garden was added to stand for the growth of the family.
captions: Digital renders of the house.
Watercolour of the exterior.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 高音譜號帶來流動的平面，音符的形狀則形成三角形結構。學生加入茂盛的花園，象徵家庭的成長。
captions: 住宅的數位渲染。
外觀水彩。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The design was modelled and tested digitally, then the complex roof was 3D printed. Walls and clear windows were laser cut, and furniture and planting were added by hand.
captions: The bright living space.
Rooms seen without the roof.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 設計先以數位建模與模擬，再以3D列印製作複雜的屋頂。牆面與透明窗經雷射切割，家具與植栽則以手工加入。
captions: 明亮的起居空間。
移除屋頂後的房間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model rises from a glass frame to a green roof walk. Its open plan and shared garden invite the family to meet and talk.
captions: The garden path from above.
Figures in the garden.
The glass frame facade.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型從玻璃框架升起，延伸到綠色的屋頂步道。開放平面與共享花園邀請家人相聚交流。
captions: 從上方看花園小徑。
花園中的人偶。
玻璃框架立面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a symbol to follow.
2. Turn it into a plan.
3. Test it digitally.
4. Build with mixed methods.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找到要追隨的符號。
2. 把它轉化為平面。
3. 以數位方式測試。
4. 以多種方法製作。

pins.title: House of Wishes
pins.description:
A two-storey timber house by the sea gives children calm rooms for learning and rest.

Model making | Care-centred housing | Wooden board and spray paint | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 願望之家
zh-Hant.description:
一座海邊的雙層木構住宅，為孩子提供安靜的學習與休息空間。

模型製作｜以照護為核心的住宅｜木板與噴漆｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished house cut open in section.
剖開的完成住宅模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Children who need a quiet setting often learn in crowded, worn-out rooms. The student asked what a calm, purpose-built house for them could look like.
captions: Laser-cut wall parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 需要安靜環境的孩子，常在擁擠老舊的房間裡學習。學生思考一座為他們量身打造的安靜住宅會是什麼樣子。
captions: 雷射切割的牆板。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A seaside site was chosen because the steady sound of waves helps focus. The rooms were sorted into learning, sleeping and relaxing zones on two floors.
captions: Plan diagrams of the rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生選擇海邊基地，因為規律的海浪聲有助專注。房間被分為學習、睡眠與放鬆三區，配置在兩層樓中。
captions: 房間的平面配置圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The layout was modelled digitally at 1:50 and cut from wooden board. Walls were glued cleanly and small furniture was made to test the scale.
captions: Assembling the walls.
The frame during assembly.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面以 1:50 比例數位建模，再從木板切割。牆面以乾淨的膠合方式組裝，並製作小家具來檢驗尺度。
captions: 組裝牆面。
組裝中的框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model opens in section to show a tall stair hall and bright rooms. Large glass walls and a deep roof keep the house light but sheltered.
captions: The living room interior.
Rooms seen from above.
The double-height stair hall.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以剖面打開，展現高聳的樓梯廳與明亮的房間。大片玻璃牆與深遠的屋簷，使住宅明亮又有遮蔽。
captions: 客廳室內。
從上方看各房間。
挑高的樓梯廳。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Define the users' needs.
2. Zone the rooms.
3. Model at a fixed scale.
4. Add furniture to check size.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 定義使用者的需求。
2. 劃分房間區域。
3. 以固定比例建模。
4. 加入家具檢查尺寸。

pins.title: Extension of Motions
pins.description:
Violin bowing paths become clay caves wrapped in a net of wooden sticks.

Model making | Motion to form | Air-dry clay, wood sticks and wire | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 動作的延伸
zh-Hant.description:
拉小提琴的運弓軌跡化為黏土洞穴，外覆木棒網架。

模型製作｜從動作到造型｜風乾黏土、木棒與鐵絲｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished clay and stick model.
完成的黏土與木棒模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Playing the violin is a chain of quick arm movements that leave no trace. The student wanted to see the space her own bowing motions create.
captions: Bowing paths traced as lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 拉小提琴是一連串快速、不留痕跡的手臂動作。學生想看見自己的運弓動作所創造出的空間。
captions: 把運弓路徑描成線條。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A video of her playing was broken down frame by frame to study each angle. The paths were layered in sketches to find where they meet.
captions: Clay shaped over the wire paths.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生把自己演奏的影片逐格拆解，研究每個角度。這些路徑在草圖中層層疊合，找出彼此交會之處。
captions: 黏土包覆鐵絲路徑成形。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Wires twisted into a foam base were wrapped in clay to form half-closed caves. Wooden sticks then stretched the hollows outward like a skeleton.
captions: Cave-like clay spaces.
First sticks over the clay.
Extending the stick net.
Perspective drawing of the space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 插在泡棉底座上的鐵絲被黏土包覆，形成半封閉的洞穴。接著以木棒把空洞向外延伸，如同骨架。
captions: 洞穴般的黏土空間。
黏土上的第一批木棒。
延伸木棒網架。
空間的透視圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model joins solid white caves with an open stick net. Light falling through the net casts shadows that echo the moving bow.
captions: Light through the stick net.
The model from the side.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型結合白色實心洞穴與開放的木棒網架。穿過網架的光影，呼應移動中的琴弓。
captions: 穿過木棒網架的光線。
模型側視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Record a movement.
2. Layer the paths in sketches.
3. Shape the solids.
4. Extend with a light frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 記錄一個動作。
2. 在草圖中疊合路徑。
3. 塑造實體量體。
4. 以輕巧框架延伸。

pins.title: Three-Dimensional Violin Sound Waves
pins.description:
Sketched sound waves from a violin piece are rebuilt as triangles of sticks and board.

Model making | Sound to form | Wood sticks and PVC board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 小提琴聲波的立體呈現
zh-Hant.description:
把小提琴樂曲的聲波草圖，重建為木棒與板材的三角形結構。

模型製作｜從聲音到造型｜木棒與PVC板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished sound-wave model.
完成的聲波模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Sound waves from an instrument are invisible, yet they have shape and rhythm. The student wondered whether the waves of her violin were curved or sharp.
captions: Sketch of the sound waves.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 樂器的聲波看不見，卻有形狀與節奏。學生好奇自己小提琴的聲波是彎曲的還是尖銳的。
captions: 聲波草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She recorded a favourite piece and sketched its waves, linking their key points. The waves repeated with small changes, which suggested a triangular system.
captions: Waves redrawn as triangles.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她錄下喜愛的曲子並描繪聲波，把關鍵點連接起來。聲波重複中帶有細微變化，啟發了三角形的系統。
captions: 把聲波重繪為三角形。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: PVC board was cut into triangles of many sizes to stand for each wave form. Sticks were glued into a frame, then added where the music grew more complex.
captions: Starting the stick frame.
Adding PVC triangles.
A corner of the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: PVC板被切成大小不一的三角形，代表各種波形。木棒先黏成框架，再在樂曲更複雜之處加密。
captions: 開始搭建木棒框架。
加入PVC三角板。
框架的一角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model rises in sharp peaks of sticks over white panels. Denser areas mark the busiest moments of the piece.
captions: Dense sticks show busy passages.
The whole model on its base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以尖銳的木棒峰頂聳立在白色板面上。較密集的區域標示出曲中最繁複的時刻。
captions: 密集木棒呈現繁複的樂段。
底座上的完整模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Record a sound.
2. Map its wave points.
3. Choose one geometry.
4. Vary density with intensity.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 錄下一段聲音。
2. 標出波形節點。
3. 選定一種幾何。
4. 依強度改變密度。

pins.title: Blooming with the Bamboo
pins.description:
Layered petals of a chrysanthemum become arching bamboo strips around an open centre.

Model making | Nature to structure | Bamboo strips and wood sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 與竹共綻
zh-Hant.description:
菊花層層的花瓣化為環繞開放中心的拱形竹條。

模型製作｜從自然到結構｜竹條與木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished bamboo flower.
完成的竹製花朵。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A chrysanthemum packs many layers of petals into a small, ordered space. The student asked how that hidden complexity could be built at a larger scale.
captions: Study of the flower's petals.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 菊花在小小空間裡容納了層層有序的花瓣。學生思考如何以更大尺度建構這種隱藏的複雜性。
captions: 花瓣的觀察研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She drew the flower's main shape, structure and petal directions step by step. Bamboo strips alone were chosen to show its curves clearly.
captions: The first radiating stick frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她逐步描繪花的主要形狀、結構與花瓣方向。只選用竹條，以清楚呈現花的曲線。
captions: 第一版放射狀木棒框架。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A radiating stick frame was built first and repeated for the centre. Bamboo strips were then bent into arching petals in an oval outer ring.
captions: Testing bamboo curves.
The frame from the side.
Adding the petal layers.
Digital model of the petals.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 先搭建放射狀木棒框架，並在中心重複這套結構。接著把竹條彎成拱形花瓣，形成橢圓外環。
captions: 測試竹條曲線。
框架側視。
加上花瓣層。
花瓣的數位模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model blooms in layers of curved strips that viewers can look through. Repetition in the centre and outer ring keeps the flower's order.
captions: The flower seen from above.
The inner petal layers.
A low view through the petals.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型以層層彎曲竹條綻放，觀者可穿透觀看內部。中心與外環的重複保留了花的秩序。
captions: 從上方看花朵。
內層花瓣。
低角度穿看花瓣。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe a natural form.
2. Draw its structure.
3. Pick one material.
4. Repeat to build layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察一個自然形態。
2. 畫出它的結構。
3. 選定一種材料。
4. 以重複建立層次。

pins.title: Exploring Chinese Calligraphy
pins.description:
Free-flowing cursive strokes are rebuilt as curling bands of woven bamboo.

Model making | Calligraphy to space | Bamboo, wire and hot glue | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 探索中國書法
zh-Hant.description:
草書流動的筆畫，被重建為捲曲的編織竹帶。

模型製作｜從書法到空間｜竹、鐵絲與熱熔膠｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished woven bamboo model, lit at night.
夜間點燈的完成竹編模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Cursive script moves freely and uses empty space boldly, but it lives flat on paper. The student asked what space its strokes would hold in three dimensions.
captions: Abstract sketch of the strokes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 草書自由流動、大膽運用留白，卻只存在於平面紙上。學生思考這些筆畫在三維中會包覆出怎樣的空間。
captions: 筆畫的抽象草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She studied a classic cursive work and traced its strokes as abstract sketches. The sketches were turned into a 2D design that reads like layered terraces.
captions: Strokes turned into a layered terrace design.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她研究一件經典草書作品，把筆畫描成抽象草圖。草圖再轉化為宛如層疊梯田的平面設計。
captions: 筆畫轉化為層疊梯田的平面設計。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Bamboo was chosen for its flexibility and sharp edges, which match the speed of the brush. Strips were woven into a hexagonal mesh and bent into twisting bands.
captions: The hexagonal weave pattern.
A curved band of weave.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 選用竹子，是因為它的柔韌與銳利呼應筆勢的速度。竹條被編成六角網格，再彎成扭轉的竹帶。
captions: 六角形編織紋理。
一段彎曲的編織帶。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model curls and crosses like a line of cursive written in the air. Small lights inside cast the woven pattern across the space.
captions: Bands crossing in space.
Light through the weave.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型捲曲交錯，如同寫在空中的一行草書。內部的小燈把編織紋理投射到四周。
captions: 在空間中交錯的竹帶。
穿過編織的光線。
