sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a written form.
2. Sketch its strokes.
3. Translate to a plan.
4. Choose a material that matches.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選定一種書寫形式。
2. 描繪它的筆畫。
3. 轉化為平面。
4. 選擇相應的材料。

pins.title: Harmony in Nature
pins.description:
A classical garden model joins pavilions, rockery, water and planting in one balanced scene.

Model making | Classical garden design | Paper, wood sticks, model trees and stone | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 自然的和諧
zh-Hant.description:
一座古典園林模型，把亭台、假山、水景與植栽融為和諧的一景。

模型製作｜古典園林設計｜紙、木棒、模型樹與石材｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Pavilion and arched bridge over the water.
水上的亭子與拱橋。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Classical gardens now sit among high-rise towers, almost as borrowed scenery for the city. The student asked whether their techniques can still live in modern design.
captions: Diagrams of classical garden elements.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 古典園林如今座落在高樓之間，幾乎成為城市的借景。學生思考這些造園手法能否在現代設計中延續。
captions: 古典園林元素的分析圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She sketched windows, pavilions and plans to study framing, borrowing and screening views. She also looked at how plants change with water depth and humidity.
captions: The front elevation of the garden.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她描繪花窗、亭台與平面，研究框景、借景與障景等手法。她也觀察植物如何隨水深與濕度變化。
captions: 園林正立面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Paper and wood sticks formed walls, roofs and a bridge, while stone built up the rockery. Model trees were placed by height and density around the water.
captions: Rockery and pavilion from the side.
Garden walls and buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以紙與木棒製作牆垣、屋頂與橋，石材堆疊出假山。模型樹依高度與密度環繞水景配置。
captions: 假山與亭子側視。
園林的牆垣與建築。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final garden balances solid rockery against open water and light planting. Each view through a gate or over the bridge reveals a new framed scene.
captions: The whole garden from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終園林以厚重假山對比開闊水面與輕盈植栽。穿過門洞或越過橋時，每一處都展開新的框景。
captions: 從上方看整座園林。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a traditional type.
2. Sketch its key techniques.
3. Layer solid, water and plants.
4. Test the views at eye level.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一種傳統類型。
2. 描繪它的關鍵手法。
3. 層疊山石、水與植栽。
4. 以視線高度檢驗景觀。

pins.title: The Echo of Lights
pins.description:
Clear coloured acrylic panels catch a spotlight and scatter it into moving colour.

Model making | Light and reflection | Acrylic board, PVC board and spotlight | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 光的回響
zh-Hant.description:
透明彩色壓克力板承接聚光燈，把光散射成流動的色彩。

模型製作｜光與反射｜壓克力板、PVC板與聚光燈｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Panels spread out from the light source.
從光源向外擴散的壓克力板。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Coloured glass windows turn sunlight into a painting made of light. The student asked how a simple panel could guide light into a moving visual effect.
captions: Coloured rays from the panels.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 彩色玻璃窗把陽光化為一幅由光構成的畫。學生思考簡單的板片如何引導光線，產生流動的視覺效果。
captions: 壓克力板折射出的彩色光線。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She held acrylic panels under a spotlight to test angles, heights and combinations. Each setup bent and scattered the light in a different way.
captions: Testing a single panel.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她把壓克力板置於聚光燈下，測試角度、高度與組合。每種配置都以不同方式折射與散射光線。
captions: 測試單片壓克力板。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Laser-cut panels were glued to the wall, densest near the light for rich reflections. Further out they spread apart so their shadows stretched longer.
captions: A dense cluster of panels.
Light bursting from the spotlight.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 雷射切割的板片黏在牆上，靠近光源處最密集，反射最豐富。越往外越分散，陰影也越拉越長。
captions: 密集的壓克力板群。
從聚光燈迸發的光芒。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final piece fans out from the light like a spray of colour. To her surprise, the panels cast two sets of shadows across the wall.
captions: Long double shadows on the wall.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終作品如一道彩色噴泉從光源展開。出乎她意料，板片在牆上投下了兩組陰影。
captions: 牆上拉長的雙重陰影。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a light effect.
2. Test materials by hand.
3. Vary density from the source.
4. Record surprises.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一種光的效果出發。
2. 親手測試材料。
3. 由光源向外改變密度。
4. 記錄意外的發現。

pins.title: Tower of Descending Feasts
pins.description:
A three-part clay tower, inspired by a film, shows food and greed flowing from the top down.

Model making | Film to form | Clay, wire, wood sticks and acrylic paint | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 層層下降的盛宴之塔
zh-Hant.description:
受一部電影啟發的三段式黏土高塔，呈現食物與貪婪由上而下流動。

模型製作｜從電影到造型｜黏土、鐵絲、木棒與壓克力顏料｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower with its domed top.
頂部為圓頂的完成高塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A film about a vertical prison uses a descending food platform as a metaphor for inequality. The student wanted to turn its message about greed and survival into a model.
captions: Annotated sketch of the three levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一部關於垂直監獄的電影，以下降的食物平台比喻不平等。學生想把它關於貪婪與生存的訊息轉化為模型。
captions: 標註三個階層的概念草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She rewatched the film and picked out greed, waste and revolt as its key themes. Stills of feasts and leftovers guided the mood of each level.
captions: Film still of a crowded feast.
Film still of scattered leftovers.
Film still of the food platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她重看電影，歸納出貪婪、浪費與反抗三個主題。盛宴與殘羹的畫面引導了各層的氛圍。
captions: 電影中擁擠盛宴的畫面。
電影中散落殘餘的畫面。
電影中食物平台的畫面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The tower was split into three sections for three social classes. Clay over wire formed spikes, warped outlines and hanging strips around the frame.
captions: Tangled middle level.
Spikes and strands at the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 高塔分為三段，代表三個社會階層。鐵絲外包黏土，在框架周圍形成尖刺、扭曲輪廓與垂掛條帶。
captions: 糾纏的中段。
底部的尖刺與垂絲。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The white tower rises from a ruined base to a calm dome at the top. Bright clay food stands out at first glance and thins out further down.
captions: The dome and fallen food.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 白色高塔從殘破的底部升至頂端寧靜的圓頂。鮮豔的黏土食物一眼可見，越往下越稀少。
captions: 圓頂與掉落的食物。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find the core metaphor.
2. Name the themes.
3. Give each level a form.
4. Use colour for focus.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找出核心隱喻。
2. 命名主題。
3. 為每一層賦予造型。
4. 以色彩引導焦點。

pins.title: Observation Deck: Haven
pins.description:
A hillside observation deck rebuilds the stacked timber joinery of an ancient pagoda with sticks.

Model making | Traditional structure | Wood sticks, popsicle sticks and clay | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 觀景台：避風港
zh-Hant.description:
一座山坡觀景台，以木棒重建古塔層層堆疊的木構榫卯。

模型製作｜傳統結構｜木棒、冰棒棍與黏土｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished deck on its clay hill.
黏土山丘上的完成觀景台。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Traditional timber structures are admired but rarely used in new buildings. The student asked how an ancient wooden frame could serve a modern hillside deck.
captions: Drawing of the layered timber frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 傳統木構備受讚賞，卻很少用在新建築中。學生思考古老的木構架如何服務一座現代山坡觀景台。
captions: 層疊木構架的圖說。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He studied a historic wooden pagoda and found that each level nests a smaller ring inside a larger one. This socket-like layering explains its great stability.
captions: Plan and joint drawings.
Digital model of the ring frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他研究一座歷史木塔，發現每一層都在大環中嵌入小環。這種如套筒般的層疊，正是它穩固的原因。
captions: 平面與節點圖。
環形構架的數位模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Stick joints that imitate mortise and tenon form the base, and sticks pave the floors. A two-layer platform came first, then a roof of popsicle-stick rafters.
captions: Digital study of the roof.
Assembling the stick rings.
The two-layer platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 模仿榫卯的木棒節點構成基座，地板則以木棒鋪成。先完成雙層平台，再加上冰棒棍椽條的屋頂。
captions: 屋頂的數位研究。
組裝木棒環圈。
雙層平台。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The deck sits on a clay hill with corridors and small platforms on both sides. Plain, straight rafters blend old craft with modern simplicity.
captions: Roof rafters and side corridors.
Rafters from below.
A side corridor and platform.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 觀景台座落在黏土山丘上，兩側有廊道與小平台。簡潔筆直的椽條，融合傳統工藝與現代簡約。
captions: 屋頂椽條與兩側廊道。
從下方看椽條。
側邊廊道與平台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a historic structure.
2. Find its key principle.
3. Rebuild it in sticks.
4. Fit it to a new site.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一座歷史結構。
2. 找出它的關鍵原理。
3. 以木棒重建。
4. 讓它適應新基地。

pins.title: Sounds of Nature
pins.description:
Nets of shredded paper recall the sound of leaves and form a light resting shelter.

Model making | Sound and memory | Recycled paper and straws | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 自然之聲
zh-Hant.description:
碎紙編成的網，喚起樹葉的聲音，形成輕盈的休憩棚架。

模型製作｜聲音與記憶｜回收紙與吸管｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished shelter and its shadows.
完成的棚架與陰影。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Familiar sounds can bring back a place long after we have left it. The student asked whether a space could be built from the sound of a memory.
captions: Shredded paper strips.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 熟悉的聲音能在多年後喚回一個地方。學生思考能否以一段記憶中的聲音建構空間。
captions: 碎紙條。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The rustle of shredded paper reminded him of wind in the trees of a childhood garden. He first tried pairing the shreds with straws to suggest trees.
captions: Strips joined into a net.
Early tests with straws.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 碎紙的沙沙聲讓他想起童年庭園裡風吹過樹葉。他先嘗試把碎紙與吸管結合，暗示樹木。
captions: 紙條連接成網。
以吸管做的早期測試。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The straws did not capture the mood, so the shreds were joined in pairs to form nets. The nets were pressed into the base like trunks meeting the ground.
captions: Layered nets from above.
The low profile of the nets.
Shadows cast by the nets.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 吸管無法傳達氛圍，於是改把碎紙兩兩相連成網。網被壓入底座，如同樹幹扎入地面。
captions: 從上方看層疊的網。
網的低矮輪廓。
網投下的陰影。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The nets were kept apart so their shadows overlap in a staggered pattern. The result is a light public shelter whose shadows sway like leaves.
captions: Nets pressed into the base.
The canopy on its legs.
Legs like tree trunks.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 網片彼此分開，使陰影錯落交疊。最終成為一座輕盈的公共棚架，陰影如樹葉般搖曳。
captions: 壓入底座的網。
支腳上的頂棚。
如樹幹般的支腳。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a sense.
2. Find a matching material.
3. Drop what does not work.
4. Use light and shadow.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一種感官出發。
2. 找到相應的材料。
3. 捨棄行不通的嘗試。
4. 運用光與影。

pins.title: Puzzle of Liminal Space
pins.description:
Five overlooked in-between spaces, from a pool to a long hallway, are stacked into one puzzle.

Model making | Liminal space | Wood board, resin, 3D print and LED | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 過渡空間的拼圖
zh-Hant.description:
五種常被忽略的過渡空間，從泳池到長廊，被堆疊成一個拼圖。

模型製作｜過渡空間｜木板、樹脂、3D列印與LED｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished stacked model.
完成的堆疊模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Hallways and stairwells are passed every day yet hardly noticed. The student wanted to bring these quiet, uncanny in-between spaces into focus.
captions: Collage of in-between spaces.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 走廊與樓梯間每天經過，卻很少被注意。學生想讓這些安靜又詭異的過渡空間成為焦點。
captions: 過渡空間的拼貼。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He gathered images of empty halls and drew from places that felt oddly familiar. Collages and sketches set out five spaces to connect.
captions: Early sketches.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他蒐集空曠大廳的影像，並從似曾相識的場所取材。拼貼與草圖定出五個要連接的空間。
captions: 早期草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The structure was modelled digitally, unrolled for laser cutting and 3D printed where curved. A tapered hallway with a warm light at the end exaggerates its length.
captions: Laser-cut parts.
Walls with inset windows.
The tapered hallway shell.
The first stacked test.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 結構先數位建模，展開後雷射切割，曲面部分則以3D列印製作。漸縮的走廊盡頭點上暖光，誇大了它的深度。
captions: 雷射切割零件。
內凹窗洞的牆面。
漸縮的走廊外殼。
第一次堆疊測試。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A pool with a spiral stair, a grey window block, a hallway, shelves and a playground lock together. Stairs and slides join them into one puzzle.
captions: Digital model of the stack.
The upper boxes.
Spiral stair and grey block.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 有旋轉樓梯的泳池、灰色窗格量體、長廊、書架與遊樂場相互咬合。樓梯與滑梯把它們串成一個拼圖。
captions: 堆疊的數位模型。
上方的盒體。
旋轉樓梯與灰色量體。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect a mood.
2. List the spaces.
3. Model, unroll and cut.
4. Link them with circulation.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 蒐集一種氛圍。
2. 列出空間。
3. 建模、展開與切割。
4. 以動線串聯。

pins.title: Tower Pointing Towards Brutalism
pins.description:
Bold concrete forms are recombined into a grey tower that rises with spikes pointing upward.

Model making | Retro-futurism | 3D print and grey plaster | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 指向粗獷主義之塔
zh-Hant.description:
厚重的混凝土造型被重組為一座向上尖刺聳立的灰色高塔。

模型製作｜復古未來主義｜3D列印與灰色石膏｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished grey tower.
完成的灰色高塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Retro-futurist art shows huge, hopeful towers, but real buildings in that heavy style are rarely tall. The student set out to build the tower those images promise.
captions: Digital model of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 復古未來主義藝術描繪巨大而充滿希望的高塔，但這種厚重風格的真實建築很少是高樓。學生決定建造那些影像所許諾的高塔。
captions: 高塔的數位模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He studied dozens of heavy concrete buildings known for raw surfaces and one colour. Single modules were taken from them and reshaped.
captions: A zigzag module.
A sloping wing module.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他研究數十棟以粗糙表面與單一色調著稱的混凝土建築。從中擷取單一模組並重新塑形。
captions: 鋸齒狀的模組。
斜翼模組。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A first collage spread the parts outward to express strength but missed the idea of hope. The parts were regrouped so that they all climb and point upward.
captions: Sketch of the stacked forms.
Plaster texture close up.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 第一版拼貼讓構件向外擴張以表達力量，卻缺少希望的意涵。構件因此重組，全部向上攀升並指向天空。
captions: 堆疊造型的草圖。
石膏質感特寫。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The 3D-printed tower was coated in grey plaster to mimic raw concrete. Sanded sharp edges keep both its strength and its fine details.
captions: A cantilevered disc.
The tower from the front.
The tower from the back.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 3D列印的高塔塗上灰色石膏，模仿清水混凝土。打磨後的銳利邊角同時保留力量感與細節。
captions: 懸挑圓盤。
高塔正面。
高塔背面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick two styles to merge.
2. Extract modules.
3. Arrange for a message.
4. Finish to match the material.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇兩種風格融合。
2. 擷取模組。
3. 依訊息排列。
4. 以表面處理呼應材質。

pins.title: Boundless Spatial Memory
pins.description:
A familiar route through a home becomes a stick model with enlarged memory anchors.

Model making | Memory and space | Wood sticks, 3D print, resin and cotton | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 無邊的空間記憶
zh-Hant.description:
一條熟悉的居家路線，化為放大記憶錨點的木棒模型。

模型製作｜記憶與空間｜木棒、3D列印、樹脂與棉花｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished route model.
完成的路線模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A memory technique stores ideas along a familiar route of rooms. The student asked how the spaces we pass every day shape the way we think.
captions: Rough plan of the route.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 有一種記憶法把知識存放在熟悉的房間路線上。學生思考每天經過的空間如何塑造我們的思考方式。
captions: 路線的草圖平面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He chose four areas along a route at home that he used to memorise study notes. The features he relied on were enlarged and exaggerated.
captions: Early stick frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他選了家中一條路線上的四個區域，那是他用來記憶課業的地方。他依賴的空間特徵被放大並誇張化。
captions: 早期木棒框架。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Sticks were glued along the plan, with stairs dropping below it to vary the levels. 3D-printed objects, gears, resin and cotton became anchors for each memory.
captions: The route with its memory anchors.
Side view of the route.
The route from above.
A coloured memory piece.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 木棒依平面黏合，樓梯向下延伸以改變高程。3D列印物件、齒輪、樹脂與棉花，成為每段記憶的錨點。
captions: 帶有記憶錨點的路線。
路線側視。
從上方看路線。
彩色的記憶構件。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model reads as a journey from room to room, each marked by a strange object. Together they tell the story of how memory lives in space.
captions: A wall of laser-cut gears.
A room filled with cotton clouds.
A coloured resin floor.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型讀起來像一段穿越房間的旅程，每處都有奇特物件標記。它們共同講述記憶如何寄存在空間中。
captions: 雷射切割齒輪牆。
充滿棉花雲的房間。
彩色樹脂地板。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Map a familiar route.
2. Mark the key features.
3. Exaggerate them.
4. Add objects as anchors.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 描繪一條熟悉的路線。
2. 標出關鍵特徵。
3. 加以誇張。
4. 加入物件作為錨點。

pins.title: Vase of the City
pins.description:
A 3D-printed planter borrows the lattice facades of city towers to help newcomers feel at home.

Model making | Parametric product | 3D print (PLA) | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 城市之瓶
zh-Hant.description:
一個3D列印花器借用城市高樓的格柵立面，讓新移居者感到歸屬。

模型製作｜參數化產品｜3D列印（PLA）｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The vase planted with succulents.
種上多肉植物的花瓶。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Many people who move to a fast-growing city struggle to feel they belong there. The student wanted an everyday object that ties them to the city around them.
captions: A lattice facade in the city.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 許多移居快速發展城市的人，難以產生歸屬感。學生想做一件日常物品，把他們與周遭的城市連結起來。
captions: 城市中的格柵立面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He toured the city photographing building exteriors and traced their patterns on paper. The patterns were compared to find the best one for a vase.
captions: Facade patterns sketched.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他走訪城市拍攝建築外觀，並把圖案描在紙上。比較各種圖案，找出最適合花瓶的一種。
captions: 立面圖案草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Because many identical vases were needed, he fully adopted 3D modelling and printing. A parametric script generated the lattice shell, and square pillars like rebar hold the inner pot.
captions: Digital model of the vase.
The first print.
The parametric script.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 因為需要大量相同的花瓶，他全面採用3D建模與列印。參數化程式生成格柵外殼，如鋼筋般的方柱支撐內盆。
captions: 花瓶的數位模型。
第一次列印。
參數化程式。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The white lattice vase holds plants while echoing the towers outside. Planting it turns a reminder of the city into a small act of care.
captions: Vases by a city window.
The vase from the side.
The vase from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 白色格柵花瓶容納植物，同時呼應窗外的高樓。種植它，讓城市的印記成為一份小小的照顧。
captions: 城市窗邊的花瓶。
花瓶側視。
從上方看花瓶。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Define the user.
2. Collect local patterns.
3. Script the form.
4. Test it in real use.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 定義使用者。
2. 蒐集在地圖案。
3. 以程式生成造型。
4. 在實際使用中測試。

pins.title: Cats and Humans: A Vertical Apartment
pins.description:
An apartment where cats climb a tangle of jump paths while people live in a simple timber frame.

Model making | Animal movement | PVC board, wood and hot melt glue | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 貓與人：垂直公寓
zh-Hant.description:
一座公寓裡，貓在交錯的跳躍路徑間攀爬，人則住在簡潔的木構框架中。

模型製作｜動物行為｜PVC板、木材與熱熔膠｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished apartment model.
完成的公寓模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Homes are stacked in flat floors joined by stairs, but cats move by climbing and leaping. The student asked whether one apartment could suit both ways of moving.
captions: Video frames of a cat jumping.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 住宅以樓梯連接一層層平坦樓板，但貓靠攀爬與跳躍移動。學生思考一間公寓能否同時適合兩種移動方式。
captions: 貓跳躍的影片截圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He filmed a cat hunting and traced each jump and landing frame by frame. Each pose was simplified into straight lines that suggest a path.
captions: Sketches of jump paths.
Jump paths modelled digitally.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他拍攝貓捕獵的影片，逐格描繪每次跳躍與落地。每個姿態被簡化為暗示路徑的直線。
captions: 跳躍路徑草圖。
數位建模的跳躍路徑。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each path was modelled as a small space sized to a cat and the pieces were combined. The human part was kept to a plain square timber frame.
captions: The timber frame with cat paths.
Ledges at cat scale.
The simple level for people.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每條路徑都被建模成符合貓尺寸的小空間，再組合在一起。人的部分則保持為簡單方正的木構框架。
captions: 帶有貓路徑的木構框架。
貓尺度的平台。
給人使用的簡潔樓層。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Cat paths weave through the frame above a calm living floor for people. A pencil drawing and photos look up through the busy vertical world.
captions: Pencil drawing of the interior.
Looking up through the paths.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 貓的路徑穿梭在框架中，下方是安靜的人居樓層。鉛筆圖與照片向上望穿這個熱鬧的垂直世界。
captions: 室內的鉛筆圖。
向上望穿路徑。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe a movement.
2. Trace it frame by frame.
3. Turn paths into spaces.
4. Combine with a calm base.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察一種動作。
2. 逐格描繪。
3. 把路徑轉為空間。
4. 與安靜的基座結合。

pins.title: Coconut for Arch
pins.description:
Coconut fibre bound with glue is cast into a light, cave-like arch.

Material study | Natural fibre | Coconut fibre, white glue and water | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 椰子之拱
zh-Hant.description:
以膠水黏合的椰子纖維，鑄成輕盈如洞穴的拱。

材料研究｜天然纖維｜椰子纖維、白膠與水｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished coconut arch.
完成的椰子拱。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A coconut can drift across an ocean, yet its hard shell alone sinks. The student wanted to know what makes it float and whether that could become a building material.
captions: Coconuts on the tree.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 椰子能漂洋過海，但單獨的硬殼卻會下沉。學生想知道它浮起的原因，以及能否成為建築材料。
captions: 樹上的椰子。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He found that the outer fibre layer is full of tiny air pockets that give buoyancy. Fibre, tea leaf residue and coconut jelly were tested as mixes.
captions: Raw coconut fibre.
Three material tests.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他發現外層纖維充滿細小氣室，提供浮力。他測試了纖維、茶渣與椰果等混合配方。
captions: 椰子纖維原料。
三種材料測試。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Fibre coated with glue and water was dried on round objects to copy the husk. Tunnels carved into foam made a mould like an ant nest.
captions: Tunnels carved into a foam mould.
Fibre sheets dried on round forms.
Legs of the cast arch.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 塗上膠水的纖維在圓形物上乾燥，模仿椰殼外層。在泡棉中刻出的通道則形成如蟻巢般的模具。
captions: 在泡棉模具中刻出的通道。
在圓形模上乾燥的纖維片。
鑄造拱的支腳。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The cast is strong yet light, with arches and hollows like a cave. Scale figures show how natural material can shape a sheltering space.
captions: Fibre texture with scale figures.
Sitting under the arch.
The space beneath the arch.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 鑄件堅固而輕盈，拱與空洞宛如洞穴。比例人偶展示天然材料如何塑造庇護空間。
captions: 纖維質感與比例人偶。
坐在拱下。
拱下的空間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask why a material works.
2. Test mixes.
3. Make a mould.
4. Cast and read the space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 追問材料為何有效。
2. 測試配方。
3. 製作模具。
4. 鑄造並解讀空間。

pins.title: Cat Shelter
pins.description:
A resin tree shelter copies a cat's pupil and ear to shade, listen and glow.

Model making | Biomimicry | Resin, steel bars, optical fibre and wood | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 貓的庇護所
zh-Hant.description:
一座樹脂樹形庇護所，模仿貓的瞳孔與耳朵來遮陽、聆聽與發光。

模型製作｜仿生設計｜樹脂、鋼條、光纖與木板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The shelter glowing in the dark.
在黑暗中發光的庇護所。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Cats like hidden spots where they can still watch the world. The student designed a shelter that answers a cat's sharp senses.
captions: How a cat's pupil changes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 貓喜歡隱蔽又能觀察外界的地方。學生設計一座回應貓敏銳感官的庇護所。
captions: 貓瞳孔的變化。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A cat's pupil widens and narrows with light, and its ears gather faint sounds. These two senses became the rules for the roof and the lights.
captions: Digital model of the shelter.
Drawing of the shading device.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 貓的瞳孔隨光線放大縮小，耳朵能收集細微聲音。這兩種感官成為屋頂與燈光的設計規則。
captions: 庇護所的數位模型。
遮光裝置圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A light sensor and filtered rainwater on the roof shade the inside in strong sun and drain away in dim light. Branches of steel and optical fibre grow inside a clear resin shell.
captions: The clear resin shell.
The water roof and a cat figure.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂的光感測器與過濾雨水，在強光時遮蔭，光線不足時排走。鋼條與光纖的枝幹在透明樹脂殼內生長。
captions: 透明樹脂外殼。
水屋頂與貓偶。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Cats can rest on the branches while sound sensors change the light colour to warn of danger. The shelter glows like a tree at night.
captions: Cats resting on the branches.
Glowing green.
Light colours that signal danger.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 貓可在枝幹上休息，聲音感測器會改變燈光顏色以提示危險。庇護所在夜裡如一棵發光的樹。
captions: 在枝幹上休息的貓。
發出綠光。
提示危險的燈光顏色。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study the user's senses.
2. Turn senses into rules.
3. Build a working prototype.
4. Test it in light and dark.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究使用者的感官。
2. 把感官轉成規則。
3. 製作可運作的原型。
4. 在明暗中測試。

pins.title: Reinventing a Family House
pins.description:
An old family house is redesigned around a shared courtyard learned from round earthen houses.

Model making | Vernacular housing | Laser-cut wood board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 重塑家族老屋
zh-Hant.description:
一座家族老屋以圓形土樓的共享中庭為靈感重新設計。

模型製作｜傳統民居｜雷射切割木板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished house model.
完成的住宅模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was asked to rebuild an old family villa in a historic town. He wanted to bring back the joy of the old house with a modern layout.
captions: Plans of the original house.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生受託重建歷史小鎮中的一棟家族老宅。他想以現代格局找回老屋的歡樂。
captions: 原有住宅平面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He studied the town's round earthen houses, where many families share a central courtyard behind thick walls. Their flexible routes and shared ground became key ideas.
captions: Study of a round earthen house.
Sketches of the new plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他研究鎮上的圓形土樓，許多家庭在厚牆後共享中央庭院。靈活的動線與共享地面成為關鍵概念。
captions: 圓形土樓研究。
新平面草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Many tracing-paper sketches over the old plans were merged into one design and modelled digitally. Walls were laser cut and assembled piece by piece.
captions: Original and new house compared.
Laser-cut parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在舊平面上以描圖紙畫下大量草圖，合併為一個設計並數位建模。牆面以雷射切割，再逐片組裝。
captions: 新舊住宅比較。
雷射切割零件。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Curved wings wrap a patterned courtyard with stairs and open frames. The house blends a shared vernacular layout with a light modern structure.
captions: Looking down into the courtyard.
The curved wing.
The house from above.
The courtyard floor.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 弧形翼樓環抱帶有圖案的中庭，配有樓梯與開放框架。住宅融合了共享的傳統格局與輕盈的現代結構。
captions: 俯視中庭。
弧形翼樓。
從上方看住宅。
中庭地面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Survey the existing house.
2. Study a local type.
3. Sketch over the plans.
4. Cut and assemble.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 調查現有住宅。
2. 研究在地類型。
3. 在平面上疊圖草繪。
4. 切割與組裝。

pins.title: Different Tone: Rich and Varied Space
pins.description:
The rising and falling tones of a recited poem are turned into blocks that stack into a tower.

Model making | Sound and language | Wood, clear acrylic and PVC board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 不同的聲調：豐富多變的空間
zh-Hant.description:
朗誦詩句時起伏的聲調，被轉化為層層堆疊成塔的量體。

模型製作｜聲音與語言｜木材、透明壓克力與PVC板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tone tower.
完成的聲調之塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Two Chinese dialects share the same characters yet sound very different, one with four tones and one with nine. The student wanted to make that difference visible as space.
captions: Tone lines in one dialect.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 兩種漢語方言共用同樣的文字，聽起來卻差異很大，一種有四個聲調，另一種有九個。學生想把這種差異化為可見的空間。
captions: 一種方言的聲調線條。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He recorded a classical poem read in both dialects and studied the spectrograms. Each syllable's tone was traced as a simple line symbol.
captions: Tone lines in Mandarin.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他錄下以兩種方言朗誦的一首古詩，並研究聲譜圖。每個音節的聲調都被描成簡單的線條符號。
captions: 國語的聲調線條。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The tone lines were drawn digitally and given thickness to become blocks. Following the order of the poem, the blocks were combined and stretched where the reading is most emphatic.
captions: Tone lines given thickness.
Three digital massing studies.
Render of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 聲調線條以數位方式繪製並賦予厚度成為量體。依照詩句的順序組合量體，並在朗誦最強調之處加以拉伸。
captions: 賦予厚度的聲調線條。
三個數位量體研究。
塔的渲染圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Wood and acrylic panels rise into a dense tower full of narrow gaps and platforms. Scale figures show how the rhythm of speech becomes a varied, climbable space.
captions: A scale figure among the panels.
Side view of the stacked panels.
The tower from a distance.
Close-ups of the lower levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 木板與壓克力板升起成為一座密集的塔，充滿窄縫與平台。比例人偶顯示說話的節奏如何成為豐富可攀的空間。
captions: 板片間的比例人偶。
堆疊板片的側視。
遠看塔身。
下層的近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Record a sound.
2. Trace it as lines.
3. Give lines thickness.
4. Stack in sequence.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 錄下一段聲音。
2. 描成線條。
3. 賦予線條厚度。
4. 依序堆疊。

pins.title: Hive in the Sand
pins.description:
Folding honeycomb paper grows into a sphere, shelters and towers imagined for the desert.

Material study | Honeycomb structure | Honeycomb paper and marker sketches | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 沙中蜂巢
zh-Hant.description:
可伸縮的蜂巢紙長成球體、庇護所與塔，構想於沙漠之中。

材料研究｜蜂巢結構｜蜂巢紙與麥克筆草圖｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished honeycomb sphere.
完成的蜂巢球體。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Honeycomb paper is used as packing, yet it can stretch, fold and stand on its own. The student asked whether this humble material could suggest new structures for harsh places.
captions: The base sphere.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 蜂巢紙常用於包裝，卻能伸展、折疊並自行站立。學生思考這種平凡材料能否為嚴酷環境帶來新的結構。
captions: 球體基底。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He studied how geometric patterns are fitted to different shapes in traditional ornament. The same method guided how cones and fans were spread across a sphere.
captions: The first cones added.
The surface filling up.
Radial pattern detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他研究傳統紋樣如何將幾何圖案配合不同形狀。同樣的方法引導他把錐體與扇形分布在球面上。
captions: 加上第一批錐體。
逐漸填滿的表面。
放射狀圖案細部。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Wrapping the paper around sticks made small towers of hexagon cells. Sketches imagined prefabricated units that people could combine into homes in the dunes.
captions: Paper wrapped around sticks.
Sketch of a desert facility.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 把紙纏繞在棍上，形成由六角格構成的小塔。草圖構想人們可組合成沙丘住宅的預製單元。
captions: 纏繞在棍上的紙。
沙漠設施草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The sphere, animal shelter and curved wall show one material taking many forms. Marker drawings picture a city that grows with the desert rather than against it.
captions: A desert animal shelter.
A curved honeycomb wall.
Marker drawing of the structures.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 球體、動物庇護所與弧牆展現一種材料的多種形態。麥克筆圖描繪一座與沙漠共生而非對抗的城市。
captions: 沙漠動物庇護所。
弧形蜂巢牆。
結構的麥克筆圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a flexible material.
2. Study a pattern method.
3. Test small forms.
4. Imagine a site.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找到有彈性的材料。
2. 研究圖案方法。
3. 測試小型形態。
4. 想像一處場地。

pins.title: Flowing Reed Pavilion
pins.description:
A summer group workshop bends steel wire and reeds into a flowing outdoor pavilion.

Group workshop | Pavilion build | Steel wire, reeds and digital modelling | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 流動蘆葦亭
zh-Hant.description:
一場暑期團體工作坊，將鋼絲與蘆葦彎折成流動的戶外涼亭。

團體工作坊｜涼亭搭建｜鋼絲、蘆葦與數位建模｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished reed pavilion.
完成的蘆葦涼亭。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The workshop asked how a light pavilion could be made from simple, sustainable materials. The form had to come from what wire and reeds can naturally do.
captions: Sketches of bending and twisting wire.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 工作坊探討如何以簡單、永續的材料做出輕盈的涼亭。形態必須來自鋼絲與蘆葦本身能做到的事。
captions: 鋼絲彎折與扭轉的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student first sketched ways a wire can bend and twist into loops. Small models tested these curves with reed covering on the ground.
captions: A small wire and reed model.
A second model study.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先草繪鋼絲彎折、扭轉成環的方式。小模型則在地面上測試這些曲線與蘆葦覆面。
captions: 小型鋼絲蘆葦模型。
第二個模型研究。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The chosen form was refined digitally and then built as a team on site. Scaffolding, welding, lighting and reed weaving were done step by step.
captions: A third model study.
Reed-wrapped columns on site.
A woven reed panel.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 選定的形態以數位方式修整，再由團隊在現場搭建。鷹架、焊接、燈光與蘆葦編織逐步完成。
captions: 第三個模型研究。
現場以蘆葦包覆的柱子。
編織的蘆葦板。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A long woven ribbon sweeps over curved legs and seats on the lawn. The build taught form, structure and construction as one connected process.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一條長長的編織帶越過草地上的弧形支腳與座椅。這次搭建把形態、結構與施工當作一個相連的過程來學習。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Sketch the material's moves.
2. Test in small models.
3. Refine digitally.
4. Build as a team.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 草繪材料的動作。
2. 以小模型測試。
3. 數位修整。
4. 團隊搭建。

pins.title: Wilderness & Urbanization
pins.description:
Sounds recorded on a hike from city to forest become a landscape where towers meet wild growth.

Model making | Sound and landscape | Paper, glue and digital modelling | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 荒野與城市化
zh-Hant.description:
從城市走向山林的健行錄音，化為高樓與野生植物交會的地景。

模型製作｜聲音與地景｜紙、膠與數位建模｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished city and wilderness model.
完成的城市與荒野模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: As cities expand, wild land is pushed further away. The student asked how natural landscape could be kept alive inside a growing city.
captions: Hiking route traced over a map.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 城市擴張時，荒野被推得越來越遠。學生思考如何在成長中的城市裡保留自然地景。
captions: 描在地圖上的健行路線。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: On a hike away from the city he recorded both traffic and forest sounds. The two recordings were turned into wave patterns with clear contrast.
captions: City and nature sounds as waves.
Paper layers set in a frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 在離開城市的健行中，他錄下車流與森林的聲音。兩段錄音被轉成對比鮮明的波形圖案。
captions: 城市與自然聲音的波形。
放在框架中的紙層。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The waves were cut into paper strips and layered as rolling ground. Towers were modelled digitally to rise from the loud city parts.
captions: Strips of paper being placed.
The layered ground from above.
Digital model of the towers.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 波形被裁成紙條，層疊成起伏的地面。高樓以數位方式建模，從聲音嘈雜的城市段落升起。
captions: 正在放置的紙條。
從上方看層疊地面。
高樓的數位模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: White towers and wild trees share one contoured ground. The model asks the viewer to hear the tension between city and nature.
captions: Aerial view of the model.
Ground-level contours and towers.
Side view with trees.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 白色高樓與野生樹木共享同一片等高地面。模型邀請觀者聽見城市與自然之間的張力。
captions: 模型鳥瞰。
地面等高線與高樓。
帶有樹木的側視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Record a journey.
2. Turn sound into lines.
3. Layer lines as ground.
4. Place the city on it.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 記錄一段旅程。
2. 把聲音化為線條。
3. 把線條層疊成地面。
4. 在上面放置城市。

pins.title: Growing Spires
pins.description:
A tree is broken into lines, curves and spheres, then rebuilt as a dense timber stick tower hung with chains.

Model making | Composition | Wood sticks, timber frame and chains | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 生長的尖塔
zh-Hant.description:
把一棵樹拆解為線、曲線與球體，再以密集的木條重建成垂掛鐵鍊的塔。

模型製作｜構成｜木條、木框與鐵鍊｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower with chains.
完成的掛鍊之塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A famous basilica has been growing spire by spire for over a century. The student wondered whether a tower could grow in the same impulsive yet harmonious way.
captions: Cut timber sticks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座著名的大教堂一百多年來一座座尖塔地生長。學生思考一座塔能否以同樣隨性卻和諧的方式生長。
captions: 裁好的木條。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Inspired by abstract painting, he broke a tree into vertical trunk lines, horizontal branches, curved canopy and round fruit. These simple parts became his building rules.
captions: The stick mass from above.
The stick city in its frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 受抽象繪畫啟發，他把樹拆解為垂直樹幹、水平枝條、弧形樹冠與圓形果實。這些簡單元素成為他的建構規則。
captions: 從上方看木條量體。
框架中的木條之城。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Curves for the canopy were placed first and extended upward into a volume. A central trunk then grew freely while spheres balanced the straight lines.
captions: An early stage of the tower.
Upper and lower clusters.
Angled view of the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 代表樹冠的曲線先被放置，再向上延伸成量體。接著中央樹幹自由生長，球體則平衡直線。
captions: 塔的早期階段。
上下兩組木條群。
框架的斜角視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Thousands of sticks rise like spires inside a timber frame. Hanging chains add a soft canopy over the hard, upright city.
captions: Detail of stick heights.
Chains hanging over the sticks.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 上千根木條如尖塔般在木框中升起。垂掛的鐵鍊為堅硬直立的城市加上柔軟的頂蓋。
captions: 木條高度的細部。
垂掛在木條上的鐵鍊。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Break a form into elements.
2. Set simple rules.
3. Let it grow.
4. Add a contrasting layer.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 把形體拆解為元素。
2. 訂下簡單規則。
3. 讓它生長。
4. 加上對比的層次。

pins.title: Exploring a New Architectural Language Through Facade and Form
pins.description:
Sketches of favourite facades become unit blocks that stack into an expressive timber tower.

Model making | Facade study | Wood boards, wood sticks, paper and PVC board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 以立面與形體探索新建築語言
zh-Hant.description:
喜愛的立面草圖化為單元量體，堆疊成富表現力的木構塔。

模型製作｜立面研究｜木板、木條、紙與PVC板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished facade tower.
完成的立面之塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Walking through the city, the student saw each building as a piece in a huge exhibition. He wanted to invent a new language by mixing their forms and facade materials.
captions: Pencil sketches of facades.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 走在城市中，學生把每棟建築看成巨大展覽中的一件作品。他想混合它們的形體與立面材料，創造新的語言。
captions: 立面的鉛筆草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He collected six facades he liked and summarised each in pencil. Each sketch then became a unit block built with a different method.
captions: Unit block models.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他收集六個喜愛的立面，以鉛筆提煉其特徵。每張草圖再以不同手法做成一個單元量體。
captions: 單元量體模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The blocks were stacked and tested in several combinations. White legs lift the tower while sticks and boards build up its layers.
captions: An early stacking test.
A second stacking study.
Detail of the upper floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 量體以多種組合堆疊測試。白色支腳托起塔身，木條與木板則堆出層次。
captions: 早期的堆疊測試。
第二個堆疊研究。
上層的細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The tower mixes slats, frames and solid panels into one rich surface. A crown of sticks reaches upward like scaffolding.
captions: The tower in full.
The stick crown.
Layers of boards.
Looking down on the crown.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 塔身把格柵、框架與實板混合為豐富的表面。木條頂冠像鷹架般向上伸展。
captions: 塔的全貌。
木條頂冠。
層層木板。
俯視頂冠。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Collect facades.
2. Sketch their features.
3. Build unit blocks.
4. Stack and combine.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 收集立面。
2. 草繪其特徵。
3. 製作單元量體。
4. 堆疊與組合。

pins.title: Curled Shell Pavilion
pins.description:
A summer workshop project grows curling digital shells into a sculptural pavilion.

Summer workshop | Digital form | Digital modelling and rendering | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 捲曲殼體涼亭
zh-Hant.description:
一個暑期工作坊作品，把捲曲的數位殼體發展成雕塑般的涼亭。

暑期工作坊｜數位形體｜數位建模與渲染｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Render of the curled shell pavilion.
捲曲殼體涼亭的渲染圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The workshop asked students to make a space from a single continuous digital form. The student wanted a shell that curls into rooms rather than walls.
captions: Plan lines of the first form.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 工作坊要求學生以單一連續的數位形體創造空間。學生想做出捲曲成房間而非牆面的殼體。
captions: 初始形體的平面線條。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He started from simple crossing tubes drawn in plan. Bending and twisting them in the software revealed many curling surfaces.
captions: Wireframe of the curled shells.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他從平面上簡單交叉的管狀體開始。在軟體中彎曲扭轉後，出現許多捲曲的曲面。
captions: 捲曲殼體的線框。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A section with a human figure checked the height and openings. Three render studies compared different curls and densities.
captions: Section with a scale figure.
First render study.
Second render study.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 帶有人物的剖面檢查了高度與開口。三個渲染研究比較了不同的捲曲與密度。
captions: 帶有比例人物的剖面。
第一個渲染研究。
第二個渲染研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final shells overlap into a cave-like pavilion lit from above. The project shows how one digital gesture can become a complex space.
captions: Third render study.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終殼體交疊成一座由上方採光的洞穴般涼亭。作品展示一個數位手勢如何成為複雜空間。
captions: 第三個渲染研究。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a simple line.
2. Bend and twist it.
3. Check with a section.
4. Compare renders.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從簡單線條開始。
2. 彎曲與扭轉。
3. 以剖面檢查。
4. 比較渲染圖。

pins.title: Between Solid and Void
pins.description:
The eight trigrams of an ancient classic are built as stick frames filled with plaster blocks.

Model making | Traditional cosmology | Plaster, wood sticks and cardboard | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 虛實之間
zh-Hant.description:
把古代經典中的八卦，以木條框架填入石膏塊建構出來。

模型製作｜傳統宇宙觀｜石膏、木條與紙板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished trigram model.
完成的八卦模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In traditional thought, solid and void suggest how people relate to their surroundings. The student wanted to give this idea a physical form at different scales.
captions: Diagram of the eight trigrams.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在傳統思想中，虛與實暗示人與環境的關係。學生想在不同尺度上把這個概念化為實體。
captions: 八卦圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He studied how the eight trigrams each describe a relationship between people and environment. Lines of the trigrams were read as solid and broken bars.
captions: A frame with one plaster block.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他研究八卦如何各自描述人與環境的關係。卦象中的線被解讀為實線與斷線。
captions: 帶有一塊石膏的框架。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Stick frames like building parts first made empty spaces without clear edges. Solid plaster blocks were added to give each trigram its form and field.
captions: Plaster pieces added to a frame.
Trigram studies, first row.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 像建築構件的木條框架最初只形成沒有清楚邊界的空間。加入實心石膏塊後，每一卦才有了形與場。
captions: 加入框架的石膏塊。
八卦研究第一排。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Eight small models were combined into one arrangement of frames and blocks. Together they show solid and void working as a pair.
captions: Trigram studies, second row.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 八個小模型組合成框架與石塊的整體配置。它們共同展現虛與實相互依存。
captions: 八卦研究第二排。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read an old system.
2. Assign forms to symbols.
3. Add solids to frames.
4. Combine the set.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀古老的系統。
2. 為符號賦予形式。
3. 在框架中加入實體。
4. 組合成整體。

pins.title: Floating Mangrove Pavilion
pins.description:
A curving, translucent building floats on wire legs above a mangrove forest.

Model making | Building and nature | Wire, frosted plastic sheet, bamboo strip and sand | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 漂浮紅樹林涼亭
zh-Hant.description:
一座彎曲半透明的建築，以鋼絲支柱漂浮在紅樹林之上。

模型製作｜建築與自然｜鋼絲、霧面塑膠片、竹條與沙｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished pavilion over the mangroves.
紅樹林上完成的涼亭。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A mangrove forest stands on soft mud, floods with seawater and shelters rare birds. The student asked how a building could sit there without harming it.
captions: Digital study of the form.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 紅樹林生長在軟泥上，會被海水淹沒，也是稀有鳥類的棲地。學生思考建築如何在此存在而不造成傷害。
captions: 形體的數位研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He decided to lift the building so its main structure never touches the forest floor. Digital studies tested curved slats that stay open to birds.
captions: Digital study of the slats.
Wire roots on the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他決定把建築抬高，讓主結構不接觸林地。數位研究測試了對鳥類保持開放的弧形格柵。
captions: 格柵的數位研究。
底座上的鋼絲根系。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Thin wire pillars rise like roots to hold a light canopy. Frosted sheets were tested so sunlight can still reach the trees.
captions: Testing frosted sheets.
The wire canopy.
The wire frame in dark light.
Sketch of mangrove roots.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 細鋼絲柱如根系般升起，托住輕盈的頂蓋。霧面片材經過測試，讓陽光仍能照到樹木。
captions: 測試霧面片材。
鋼絲頂蓋。
暗光下的鋼絲框架。
紅樹林根系草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Curving translucent sheets float above model trees and sand. The open roof lets birds fly through while light falls on the forest.
captions: Walking under the curved roof.
The curved edge and figures.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 彎曲的半透明片材漂浮在模型樹與沙地之上。開放的屋頂讓鳥自由穿越，光線灑落林間。
captions: 走在弧形屋頂下。
弧形邊緣與人偶。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Read the site's limits.
2. Lift off the ground.
3. Test light materials.
4. Keep it open.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 解讀場地限制。
2. 離地抬升。
3. 測試輕質材料。
4. 保持開放。

pins.title: Site of Solid and Steel
pins.description:
Columns that vanish into a building's foundation inspire a cantilevered plaster form pierced by steel rods.

Model making | Structure and material | Whiteform, PVC board, metal rods, plaster and clear plastic | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 實體與鋼筋之境
zh-Hant.description:
終將隱沒於建築基礎中的柱子，啟發了一個被鋼條穿透的懸挑石膏形體。

模型製作｜結構與材料｜白色泡綿板、PVC板、金屬條、石膏與透明塑膠｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The cantilevered plaster and steel model.
懸挑的石膏與鋼條模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Foundation columns are built and then hidden for ever inside a building. The student wanted to make this unseen rebar moment visible as architecture.
captions: An early solid block study.
A round form bound with wire.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 基礎柱子在建造後便永遠隱沒於建築之中。學生想把這段看不見的鋼筋時刻轉化為可見的建築。
captions: 早期的實體量塊研究。
以鐵絲綁紮的圓形量體。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She first sculpted solid forms on a grid and found them heavy and bound by gravity. Wire and rods were tried as ways to loosen the mass.
captions: Rods rising from the blocks.
Linked forms with rods.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她先在格網上雕塑實體量體，發現它們沉重且受制於重力。接著嘗試以鐵絲與鋼條鬆動量體。
captions: 從量塊中升起的鋼條。
以鋼條串聯的量體。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Thin sheets were pierced with rods to test how steel can hold a surface. Clear plastic molds then helped turn heavy plaster into a curved cantilever.
captions: Rods pierce a thin sheet.
A curved sheet with rods.
Grid sheet tests.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以鋼條穿透薄片，測試鋼材如何撐起表面。透明塑膠模具則幫助把厚重石膏轉化為彎曲的懸挑。
captions: 鋼條穿透薄片。
帶鋼條的彎曲薄片。
格線薄片測試。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A white plaster wave floats over its base while a cloud of rods rises above it. Solid and steel finally share one light structure.
captions: Front view of the frame.
Side view of the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 白色石膏波浪漂浮在基座上方，一片鋼條之雲在其上升起。實體與鋼材終於共構成一個輕盈的結構。
captions: 骨架正視。
骨架側視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a hidden moment.
2. Test heavy forms.
3. Add a contrasting material.
4. Let it lift.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找到被隱藏的時刻。
2. 測試厚重的形體。
3. 加入對比的材料。
4. 讓它浮起。

pins.title: Ascending Realms
pins.description:
A layered sandbox game world becomes a vertical tower of white blocks, timber stairs and decks.

Model making | Vertical space | Wood slices, wood battens and 3D printing | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 攀升之境
zh-Hant.description:
層層堆疊的沙盒遊戲世界，化為由白色量塊、木梯與平台組成的垂直塔樓。

模型製作｜垂直空間｜木片、木條與3D列印｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished vertical tower.
完成的垂直塔樓。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Sandbox games let players build freely across many stacked layers. The student asked how that playful, layered world could become a real piece of architecture.
captions: A collage of game world scenes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 沙盒遊戲讓玩家在多層堆疊的世界中自由建造。學生思考這個充滿玩心的分層世界如何成為真實的建築。
captions: 遊戲世界場景拼貼。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She made a collage of game scenes to study their vertical and modular spaces. The collage was then rebuilt as a precise digital block model.
captions: Digital block models.
Preparing the 3D print.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她拼貼遊戲場景，研究其垂直與模組化的空間。拼貼再被重建為精確的數位量塊模型。
captions: 數位量塊模型。
準備3D列印。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The blocks were 3D printed and assembled into a stack. Wood battens and stairs were added to brace the tower and link its levels like tunnels.
captions: Small block studies.
Timber stairs on the blocks.
An angled view of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 量塊經3D列印後組裝成堆疊。再加入木條與樓梯，強化塔身，並像隧道般串連各層。
captions: 小型量塊研究。
量塊上的木梯。
塔樓的斜角視角。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: White masses and timber decks climb together into a busy vertical town. Viewers are invited to trace routes from level to level.
captions: The model in full.
Looking down on the decks.
Detail of the timber decks.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 白色量體與木平台一同攀升，成為熱鬧的垂直小鎮。觀者被邀請追尋一層又一層的路徑。
captions: 模型全貌。
俯視各層平台。
木平台的細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a familiar world.
2. Collage its spaces.
3. Model it as blocks.
4. Link the levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究熟悉的世界。
2. 拼貼其空間。
3. 以量塊建模。
4. 串連各層。

pins.title: Ethereal Bamboo Pavilion
pins.description:
Woven bamboo and wood strips form a hollow two-level pavilion that lets light and air pass through.

Model making | Bamboo structure | Bamboo weaving and wood strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 輕盈竹亭
zh-Hant.description:
編織的竹材與木條構成中空的雙層涼亭，讓光與空氣自由穿透。

模型製作｜竹構造｜竹編與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The woven bamboo pavilion.
編織竹亭。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Bamboo is light, flexible and deeply tied to Asian building traditions. The student wanted a pavilion that feels open and at one with nature.
captions: Bamboo weave patterns.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 竹材輕盈、柔韌，並與亞洲建築傳統緊密相連。學生想做一座開放、與自然融為一體的涼亭。
captions: 竹編圖樣。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She studied traditional pagoda forms and many bamboo weaving patterns. Small star-shaped units tested how thin poles can lock together.
captions: Star-shaped bamboo units.
Early spiky frames.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她研究傳統塔樓形式與多種竹編圖樣。小型星形單元測試細竹如何相互扣合。
captions: 星形竹構單元。
早期的尖刺骨架。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Poles of different thickness were woven and braided into the outer walls. Two floors were linked by an open triangular stair and braced with wood strips.
captions: The deck and its bracing.
The model under light.
Front view of the pavilion.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 不同粗細的竹竿被編織成外牆。兩層樓以開放的三角樓梯相連，並以木條斜撐加固。
captions: 平台與其斜撐。
光線下的模型。
涼亭正視。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The hollow pavilion curls upward like a woven cloud. Light passes through its rhythmic net and casts soft patterns below.
captions: The woven roof.
The triangular stair inside.
Side view of the roof.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 中空的涼亭如編織的雲般向上捲起。光線穿過富節奏的網格，在下方投出柔和的圖案。
captions: 編織屋頂。
內部的三角樓梯。
屋頂側視。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study weave patterns.
2. Test small units.
3. Weave the walls.
4. Brace the structure.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究編織圖樣。
2. 測試小單元。
3. 編織牆面。
4. 加固結構。

pins.title: Modern Serenity
pins.description:
A detached house in wood plank and strip balances shared living spaces with quiet private rooms.

Model making | House design | Wood plank and wood strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 現代寧靜
zh-Hant.description:
以木板與木條製作的獨棟住宅，在共享起居空間與安靜的私密房間之間取得平衡。

模型製作｜住宅設計｜木板與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished timber house.
完成的木構住宅。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A home should bring people together while still giving each person a quiet place. The student set out to design a detached house with that balance.
captions: Phase 1 block model.
Stacked foam blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 住宅應讓人們相聚，也要給每個人安靜的角落。學生著手設計一棟兼顧這種平衡的獨棟住宅。
captions: 第一階段量塊模型。
堆疊的泡綿量塊。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Foam block models tested several room arrangements. Plan sketches then fixed an open living and kitchen space with a guest room downstairs.
captions: Plan sketches of both floors.
Room layout in blocks.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 泡綿量塊模型測試多種房間配置。平面草圖再確定開放的客廳與廚房，以及一樓的客房。
captions: 兩層樓的平面草圖。
以量塊排列房間。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A second concept model framed the rooms in timber. Large clear windows were added to bring natural light deep inside.
captions: The second concept model.
The house from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 第二個概念模型以木構框出房間。加入大面透明窗戶，把自然光引入深處。
captions: 第二個概念模型。
從上方看住宅。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final house uses wood boards and battens for warm, textured walls. A central stair leads up to a private floor of bedrooms.
captions: Front elevation of the model.
An interior view.
The house in full light.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終住宅以木板與木條構成溫暖而有質感的牆面。中央樓梯通往私密的臥室樓層。
captions: 模型正立面。
室內視角。
光線下的住宅全貌。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Define the daily life.
2. Test layouts with blocks.
3. Sketch the plan.
4. Frame it in timber.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 定義日常生活。
2. 以量塊測試配置。
3. 草繪平面。
4. 以木構建構。

pins.title: Shaped by Time
pins.description:
A plaster sea cliff with projected future scenes shows how coastlines erode into stacks and new habitats.

Model making | Landscape and time | Foam, plants, stones, glue, plaster cloth and sand | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 時間之形
zh-Hant.description:
一座投影未來場景的石膏海崖，呈現海岸如何侵蝕成岩柱並形成新的棲地。

模型製作｜地景與時間｜泡綿、植物、石頭、膠、石膏布與沙｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The eroding cliff model.
侵蝕中的海崖模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Weathering is slow and almost invisible, yet it reshapes every coast. The student wanted a model that makes this passing of time visible.
captions: Reference photo of sea stacks.
A sketch of the cliff receding.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 風化緩慢而幾乎不可見，卻重塑每一片海岸。學生想做一個讓時間流逝變得可見的模型。
captions: 海蝕柱參考照片。
海崖後退的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: She studied a famous coastal rock formation and how waves cut cliffs into stacks. Sketches traced the edge moving back over thousands of years.
captions: Cliff silhouette study.
A lower worn coastline.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她研究一處著名的海岸岩層，以及海浪如何把海崖切成岩柱。草圖描繪了數千年間崖邊的後退。
captions: 海崖剪影研究。
被磨低的海岸線。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Foam, plaster cloth, stones and sand built up the layered cliff. A projector then cast rising seas and new stacks onto its surface.
captions: Future scenes projected on the model.
Rock stacks in the water.
A boulder lit by projection.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 泡綿、石膏布、石頭與沙堆出層狀海崖。再以投影機把上升的海面與新的岩柱投射在表面上。
captions: 投影在模型上的未來場景。
水中的岩柱。
被投影照亮的巨石。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The model is not static but changes with each projected scene. Worn rocks become homes for sea life as the beach slips under water.
captions: Side view of the cliff.
Rocks along the shore.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 模型不是靜態的，而是隨每段投影改變。當沙灘沒入水中，被磨蝕的岩石成為海洋生物的家。
captions: 海崖側視。
岸邊的岩石。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Observe a slow change.
2. Sketch it over time.
3. Build layered material.
4. Project the future.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察緩慢的變化。
2. 描繪其隨時間的過程。
3. 以材料層層堆疊。
4. 投影未來。

pins.title: Kingdom's Legacy
pins.description:
Ancient ruins from a fantasy video game are reinterpreted as a 3D printed temple tower.

Model making | Game-inspired form | 3D printing (PLA) and plaster | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 王國遺產
zh-Hant.description:
奇幻電玩中的古老遺跡，被重新詮釋為一座3D列印的神殿塔樓。

模型製作｜遊戲啟發的形體｜3D列印（PLA）與石膏｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The 3D printed temple tower.
3D列印的神殿塔樓。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Video game worlds often hold ruins that feel as sacred as real temples. The student asked how these imagined forms could be read again in a modern context.
captions: A still of the game's ruins.
Columns of the game ruins.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 電玩世界中常有如真實神殿般神聖的遺跡。學生思考這些想像的形體如何在當代語境中被重新閱讀。
captions: 遊戲遺跡畫面。
遊戲遺跡的柱列。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Screenshots of the ruins were compared with ancient temple geometry. Their arches and heavy columns were redrawn as plans and elevations.
captions: Elevation of the digital model.
Plan of the column ring.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 遺跡截圖被拿來與古代神殿的幾何比較。拱與厚重的柱子被重新繪成平面與立面。
captions: 數位模型立面。
柱環平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The screenshots were turned into a detailed digital model. Ten columns were 3D printed and coated in plaster to match the base.
captions: The digital temple model.
Inside the arched hall.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 截圖被轉化為精細的數位模型。十根柱子以3D列印製作，再塗上石膏與基座一致。
captions: 數位神殿模型。
拱形大廳內部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The white tower blends sacred temple geometry with game-world fantasy. Scale figures show it as a space between real and imagined landscapes.
captions: Columns and scale figures.
The upper level.
The tower in full.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 白色塔樓融合神殿的神聖幾何與遊戲世界的奇想。比例人顯示它是介於真實與想像地景之間的空間。
captions: 柱列與比例人。
上層。
塔樓全貌。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a world you love.
2. Capture key views.
3. Model the geometry.
4. Build it physically.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個你喜愛的世界。
2. 擷取關鍵視角。
3. 建構其幾何。
4. 實體製作。

pins.title: Tactical Pathways
pins.description:
Maps from a team shooter game are mixed into one white board tower full of routes to the top.

Model making | Game-inspired space | PVC boards | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 戰術路徑
zh-Hant.description:
把團隊射擊遊戲中的多張地圖混合成一座白色板材塔，布滿通往頂端的路徑。

模型製作｜遊戲啟發的空間｜PVC板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished board tower.
完成的板材塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Game maps are designed around routes, cover and a final goal. The student wondered how those rules could shape a piece of architecture.
captions: A still from the game.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 遊戲地圖圍繞路線、掩體與最終目標而設計。學生思考這些規則能如何塑造建築。
captions: 遊戲畫面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He studied several maps, from a control tower to a big garage door. Each element was sketched as a wall, roof, stair or window.
captions: Early walls and stairs.
The ring route taking shape.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他研究數張地圖，從控制塔到巨大的車庫門。每個元素都被草繪為牆、屋頂、樓梯或窗。
captions: 早期的牆與樓梯。
成形中的環形路線。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Boards were cut and glued into open rooms linked by many pathways. Every space was left open so light could pass right through.
captions: The model with red figures.
Looking down on the rooms.
The curved route.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 板材被裁切黏合成開放的房間，以多條路徑相連。每個空間都保持開放，讓光可以穿透。
captions: 放有紅色人偶的模型。
俯視各房間。
彎曲的路線。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Visitors can climb from the bottom to the top by many different routes. Ink drawings show the tower as a dense, playful maze.
captions: A stair yard inside.
An ink drawing of the levels.
A hatched drawing of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 訪客可沿多條不同路線從底部攀到頂端。墨線圖呈現這座塔如密集而充滿趣味的迷宮。
captions: 內部的樓梯廣場。
各層的墨線圖。
塔的排線圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a game's rules.
2. Pick key elements.
3. Link them with routes.
4. Draw the result.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究遊戲規則。
2. 挑選關鍵元素。
3. 以路徑串連。
4. 繪製成果。

pins.title: Squash Sport
pins.description:
The sharp angles of a squash ball's bounce become a cluster of folded board pyramids and sticks.

Model making | Movement study | PVC boards, paper board and wood sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 壁球運動
zh-Hant.description:
壁球反彈的銳利角度，化為一簇摺板角錐與木條。

模型製作｜運動研究｜PVC板、紙板與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The folded board cluster.
摺板群組。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In squash, a ball hit with skill bounces at only a few sharp angles. The student asked whether that path could be turned into a shape.
captions: Bounce paths drawn in small boxes.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在壁球中，有技巧的擊球只會以少數幾種銳角反彈。學生思考這條路徑能否轉化為一個形體。
captions: 在小盒中繪出的反彈路徑。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He traced the ball's path inside small model courts. The strong first bounce and the weak second one gave him a set of angles.
captions: A first folded study.
A row of pyramids.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他在小型球場模型中描繪球的路徑。強勁的第一次反彈與微弱的第二次反彈給了他一組角度。
captions: 第一個摺板研究。
一排角錐。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The angles were folded into board pyramids and joined with wood sticks. More pyramids were added until the cluster felt like a moving ball.
captions: Pyramids pierced by sticks.
A close view of the angles.
A striped version of the form.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 這些角度被摺成板材角錐，以木條相連。他持續加入角錐，直到群組有如運動中的球。
captions: 被木條穿透的角錐。
角度的近景。
條紋版本的形體。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final piece bursts outward with sharp points and long sticks. Drawings and a planted collage test it as a future structure.
captions: A low view of the cluster.
An ink drawing of the angles.
A collage with planting.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終作品以尖角與長木條向外迸發。墨線圖與植栽拼貼測試它成為未來構築物的可能。
captions: 群組的低角度視角。
角度的墨線圖。
加入植栽的拼貼。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch a movement.
2. Trace its path.
3. Fold the angles.
4. Cluster the parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察一個動作。
2. 描繪其路徑。
3. 摺出角度。
4. 組合各部分。

pins.title: Walled Street Dream
pins.description:
Dense old shopfronts seen on a trip are stacked into a glowing walled-city model with two light paths.

Model making | Street memory | PVC boards, paper, wire and small lights | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 圍城街道之夢
zh-Hant.description:
旅途中看到的密集老店面，被堆疊成一座發光的圍城模型，並有兩條燈光路徑。

模型製作｜街道記憶｜PVC板、紙、電線與小燈｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The glowing stacked shopfronts.
發光的堆疊店面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Walking down a narrow street, the student saw old structures stacked tightly on each other. The scene later came back in a dream of being chased through a walled city.
captions: A dense city from above.
Narrow old buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 走在狹窄的街道上，學生看見老建築緊密地互相堆疊。這個場景後來出現在他被追逐穿越圍城的夢中。
captions: 從上方看密集城市。
狹窄的老建築。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: He sketched shopfronts from reference photos onto paper. Each sketch was stuck to a board as a small facade.
captions: Early shopfront boards.
An ink drawing of the stack.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 他依參考照片在紙上草繪店面。每張草圖都貼在板材上，成為一個小立面。
captions: 早期的店面板。
堆疊的墨線圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The facades were glued together at different heights to build a walled-city feeling. Two paths were outlined with tiny lights and wire.
captions: The upper levels lit up.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 立面以不同高度黏合，營造圍城的感覺。兩條路徑以小燈與電線勾勒。
captions: 點亮的上層。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: One light path is the dreamer and the other is the chaser climbing behind. The model turns a street memory into a glowing vertical story.
captions: A wall of drawn signs.
Figures along the light path.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一條燈光路徑是做夢者，另一條是在後方攀爬的追逐者。模型把街道記憶化為發光的垂直故事。
captions: 手繪招牌牆。
燈光路徑上的人偶。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Recall a place.
2. Sketch its facades.
3. Stack them up.
4. Light a story path.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 回想一個地方。
2. 草繪其立面。
3. 把它們堆疊起來。
4. 點亮故事路徑。

pins.title: Rooted Lattice Tower
pins.description:
A summer workshop project grows vines and tree roots into an organic 3D printed lattice tower.

Summer workshop | Organic structure | Foam board, museum board and 3D printing | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 根系晶格塔
zh-Hant.description:
一個暑期工作坊作品，把藤蔓與樹根發展成有機的3D列印晶格塔。

暑期工作坊｜有機結構｜泡綿板、博物館板與3D列印｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The 3D printed lattice tower.
3D列印的晶格塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A steel frame under a bench made the student imagine a more organic and random structure. He wanted to stand inside a building that feels like vines.
captions: Basic forms used as a start.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 長椅下的鋼構讓學生想像一種更有機、更隨機的結構。他想站在一棟宛如藤蔓的建築之中。
captions: 作為起點的基本形體。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Vines, tree roots and a twisting lattice tower all fed his idea. Basic shapes were tested in a parametric script inside a rectangular limit.
captions: Digital lattice iterations.
The parametric script.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 藤蔓、樹根與扭轉的晶格塔都啟發了他。基本形體在矩形限制內以參數化腳本測試。
captions: 數位晶格迭代。
參數化腳本。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The digital lattice was refined until it felt both irregular and stable. Ink drawings tested stairs and decks threading through it.
captions: An ink drawing of the tower.
A sketch of the root form.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 數位晶格被不斷調整，直到既不規則又穩定。墨線圖測試穿越其中的樓梯與平台。
captions: 塔的墨線圖。
根系形體草圖。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The printed tower rises like a cluster of white roots with stairs wrapping round it. Red figures show how people could move through its hollows.
captions: Stairs wrap the lattice.
A hollow in the lattice.
An arch at the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 列印出的塔如一簇白色根系升起，樓梯環繞其外。紅色人偶顯示人們如何穿行於孔洞之間。
captions: 環繞晶格的樓梯。
晶格中的孔洞。
基部的拱。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a natural pattern.
2. Script the growth.
3. Set a boundary.
4. Print and test.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找到自然圖樣。
2. 以腳本生成。
3. 設定邊界。
4. 列印與測試。

pins.title: Silent Canopy
pins.description:
Tank experiments and a concrete-and-wire model show mangroves buried beneath a growing city.

Model making | Ecology study | Wood sticks, wire, cement, rocks and plants | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 寂靜樹冠
zh-Hant.description:
以水箱實驗與混凝土鐵絲模型，呈現被擴張城市掩埋的紅樹林。

模型製作｜生態研究｜木條、鐵絲、水泥、石頭與植物｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The mangroves under concrete.
混凝土下的紅樹林。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Fast city growth and land reclamation have destroyed large areas of coastal mangroves. The student wanted to show this hidden loss.
captions: A watercolour of mangrove roots.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 快速的城市擴張與填海工程摧毀了大片海岸紅樹林。學生想呈現這種隱藏的失落。
captions: 紅樹林根系水彩。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student drew mangrove species, their food chain and how they sit across tidal zones. Tank tests with plants, sand and salt water showed roots acting as a natural sea wall.
captions: Sketches of mangrove species.
The habitat food chain.
Mangroves across tidal zones.
A tide test in a tank.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她描繪紅樹林物種、食物鏈及其在潮間帶的分布。以植物、沙與鹽水進行的水箱實驗，顯示根系如天然海堤。
captions: 紅樹林物種草圖。
棲地食物鏈。
不同潮間帶的紅樹林。
水箱中的潮汐實驗。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A sketch split the scene into reclaimed land above and living habitat below. A first model used withered red saplings to show the damage.
captions: The layered concept sketch.
A first model with red sap.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一張草圖把場景分為上方的填海土地與下方的棲地。第一個模型以枯萎的紅色幼苗表現破壞。
captions: 分層概念草圖。
帶紅色汁液的第一個模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model buries plants and rocks under cement slabs, pillars and wire. Small figures walk above, unaware of the roots below.
captions: The buried level from the side.
Concrete pillars over roots.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型把植物與石頭埋在水泥板、柱子與鐵絲之下。小人偶在上方行走，對下方的根系渾然不覺。
captions: 側看被掩埋的層。
根系上方的混凝土柱。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study the ecosystem.
2. Test it in a tank.
3. Layer above and below.
4. Build the contrast.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究生態系統。
2. 在水箱中測試。
3. 分出上下層。
4. 做出對比。

pins.title: Light, Shadow, Colour
pins.description:
Twisting stick cubes filled with nylon line, colour film and small lights become a large lightbox.

Model making | Light study | Wood sticks, nylon line, laser paper and mini spotlights | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 光、影、色
zh-Hant.description:
填滿尼龍線、彩色膠片與小燈的扭轉木條立方體，組成一座大型燈箱。

模型製作｜光線研究｜木條、尼龍線、鐳射紙與迷你聚光燈｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The lightbox switched on.
點亮的燈箱。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Light, shadow and colour change how a space feels. The student wanted to show that lighting can build space, not just brighten it.
captions: The twisting stick frames.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 光、影與色彩改變空間的感受。學生想證明照明能構築空間，而不只是讓它變亮。
captions: 扭轉的木條框架。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student built square stick frames and tested wire mesh, colour film and mirror paper inside them. Small spotlights were wired in series for better control.
captions: Small lights used in series.
A first rotated cube.
A cube with mesh and film.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她製作方形木條框架，並在其中測試鐵絲網、彩色膠片與鏡面紙。小聚光燈以串聯方式接線，以便控制。
captions: 串聯使用的小燈。
第一個旋轉立方體。
加入網片與膠片的立方體。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The cubes were rotated and stacked, with nylon lines forming curved surfaces between them. Each layer was tested for the shadows it cast.
captions: Nylon lines across a cube.
Colour film inside the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 立方體被旋轉並堆疊，尼龍線在其間形成曲面。每一層都測試它投下的影子。
captions: 橫越立方體的尼龍線。
框架內的彩色膠片。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Inside a paper box, the lights throw red and blue lines across every surface. The lightbox shows how light alone can reshape a room.
captions: Red beams across the frames.
A blue glow inside.
The stack in red and blue.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在紙盒中，燈光把紅藍線條投射到每個表面。燈箱展現光本身如何重塑一個空間。
captions: 橫越框架的紅色光束。
內部的藍色光暈。
紅藍光中的堆疊。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick light materials.
2. Frame them in cubes.
3. Rotate and stack.
4. Test in the dark.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 挑選透光材料。
2. 以立方體框住。
3. 旋轉並堆疊。
4. 在暗處測試。

pins.title: Sonic Refraction
pins.description:
Threads stretched between pins trace how sound bounces around a shoebox-shaped hall.

Model making | Acoustic study | Cotton thread, 3D print, PVC board, pins and wood sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 聲音折射
zh-Hant.description:
在釘子之間拉緊的線，描繪聲音如何在鞋盒形大廳中反彈。

模型製作｜聲學研究｜棉線、3D列印、PVC板、釘子與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The hall model with its roof grid.
帶屋頂格柵的大廳模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student plays guitar and wondered how music could shape architecture. Sound moves through a room in paths we cannot see.
captions: Sketches of sound paths.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生彈吉他，思考音樂如何塑造建築。聲音以我們看不見的路徑在房間中移動。
captions: 聲音路徑草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied a famous shoebox-shaped concert hall, where walls and ceilings spread sound evenly. Sketches traced how sound bends and reflects.
captions: The digital model plan.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 她研究一座著名的鞋盒形音樂廳，其牆與天花板讓聲音均勻擴散。草圖描繪聲音如何彎折與反射。
captions: 數位模型平面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A hall was modelled digitally and printed in parts. Pins marked reflection points, and threads joined them to show each sound path.
captions: First threads across the hall.
Printed wall parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 大廳以數位建模並分件列印。釘子標示反射點，線把它們連接以呈現每條聲音路徑。
captions: 橫越大廳的第一批線。
列印的牆體構件。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Under strong light, the threads and roof grid cast a web of shadows. The model makes the movement of sound visible.
captions: Light falling on the threads.
Threads above the floor.
A view down the hall.
Figures among the threads.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在強光下，線與屋頂格柵投下一片影子網。模型讓聲音的移動變得可見。
captions: 落在線上的光。
地面上方的線。
沿大廳望去。
線網中的人偶。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a sense.
2. Study a precedent.
3. Mark the paths.
4. Make it visible.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選擇一種感官。
2. 研究案例。
3. 標示路徑。
4. 讓它可見。

pins.title: Rhythm of the Court
pins.description:
Sticks, shoelaces and a hanging chain net turn the rhythm of a basketball game into a model.

Model making | Sport study | Wood sticks, spray paint, shoelaces and iron chain | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 球場的節奏
zh-Hant.description:
木條、鞋帶與懸掛的鐵鍊網，把籃球比賽的節奏化為一座模型。

模型製作｜運動研究｜木條、噴漆、鞋帶與鐵鍊｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The chain net over the court.
球場上方的鐵鍊網。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Basketball is full of rhythm: passes, jumps and shots. The student wanted to turn that rhythm into a space.
captions: A sketch of movement on court.
A sketch of the rising form.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 籃球充滿節奏：傳球、跳躍與投籃。學生想把這種節奏轉化為空間。
captions: 球場動態草圖。
上升形體的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sketches mapped the elements of the game and how players move. Loose drawings tested a form that rises from the floor.
captions: The stick base from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 草圖整理比賽的元素與球員的移動方式。隨意的線稿測試一個從地面升起的形體。
captions: 從上方看木條基座。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Painted sticks became the court floor. Upright sticks wrapped in yellow, blue and grey laces stood for two teams and the referees, and cantilevered sticks traced passes.
captions: Coloured sticks for two teams.
Posts tied with laces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 上漆的木條成為球場地板。纏上黃、藍、灰鞋帶的直立木條代表兩隊與裁判，懸挑木條則描繪傳球軌跡。
captions: 代表兩隊的彩色木條。
綁上鞋帶的柱子。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A chain from a street hoop was split and draped over the top, with a ball hung in the middle. The model captures the energy of a game in motion.
captions: The ball caught in the chains.
Figures under the net.
A high view of the net.
Players among the posts.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 取自街頭籃框的鐵鍊被拆開並披掛在頂部，中央懸掛一顆球。模型捕捉比賽進行中的能量。
captions: 卡在鍊中的球。
網下的人偶。
網的高處視角。
柱間的球員。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. List the elements.
2. Give each a material.
3. Trace the movement.
4. Build the energy.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 列出元素。
2. 為每個元素選材料。
3. 描繪動態。
4. 建構能量。

pins.title: Cube Rotate
pins.description:
A summer workshop project rotates, stacks and splits boxes into a carved white volume.

Summer workshop | Form study | 3D modelling and 3D printed model | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 旋轉立方
zh-Hant.description:
一個暑期工作坊作品，把方塊旋轉、堆疊並切分成一個雕刻般的白色量體。

暑期工作坊｜形體研究｜3D建模與3D列印模型｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The printed model with a figure.
放有人偶的列印模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The workshop asked students to pick a volume and a verb that would shape it. The student chose a cube and the verb rotate.
captions: Aggregation, step one.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 工作坊要求學生選擇一個量體與一個塑造它的動詞。學生選了立方體與「旋轉」。
captions: 聚合步驟一。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A rectangle was copied, rotated and stacked again and again. The steps were tested in a series of animation frames.
captions: Aggregation, step two.
Aggregation, step three.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一個矩形被反覆複製、旋轉與堆疊。各步驟以一系列動畫畫格測試。
captions: 聚合步驟二。
聚合步驟三。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A boolean cut split the stacked boxes into halves, and the same commands were repeated with small changes. Drawings explained the rotation and the surfaces.
captions: A render of the whole form.
The rotation drawing.
Surface logic in lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以布林運算把堆疊的方塊切成兩半，並以細微調整重複相同指令。圖面說明旋轉與表面。
captions: 整體形體的算圖。
旋轉圖。
以線條表現的表面邏輯。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The printed model is a carved white mass with stairs and terraces inside. An unrolled elevation and a section show how it works as a space.
captions: A close view of the model.
The unrolled elevations.
A section with stairs.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 列印模型是一個內含樓梯與平台的白色雕刻量體。展開立面與剖面呈現它如何成為空間。
captions: 模型近景。
展開立面。
帶樓梯的剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a volume.
2. Pick a verb.
3. Repeat the action.
4. Draw the result.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個量體。
2. 選一個動詞。
3. 重複動作。
4. 繪製成果。

pins.title: Music Reflection Space
pins.description:
A guitar is taken apart and rebuilt with mirror paper and white balls into a tall reflective box.

Model making | Music and space | Guitar parts, paper, fishing line and white balls | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 音樂反射空間
zh-Hant.description:
一把吉他被拆解，並以鏡面紙與白球重組成一座高大的反射盒。

模型製作｜音樂與空間｜吉他零件、紙、釣魚線與白球｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The guitar inside the reflective box.
反射盒中的吉他。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to show music as a space, not only a sound. A guitar became the starting point.
captions: A drawing of a guitar and music.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想把音樂呈現為空間，而不只是聲音。一把吉他成為起點。
captions: 吉他與音樂的手繪。

sections.heading: Research
