sections.body: The guitar was taken apart piece by piece, and every stage was recorded. The neck, pegs and joints were studied closely.
captions: Taking the guitar apart.
The parts laid out.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 吉他被逐件拆解，每個階段都被記錄。琴頸、弦鈕與接合處都被仔細研究。
captions: 拆解吉他。
攤開的零件。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The parts were put back together with mirror paper and white balls hung on fishing line. The reflections stand for the echo of music.
captions: Mirror shards and balls.
Shards at the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 零件與鏡面紙、以釣魚線懸掛的白球重新組合。反射代表音樂的回響。
captions: 鏡面碎片與白球。
底部的碎片。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The tall box holds the broken guitar among bright shards and floating balls. It reads like a song frozen in space.
captions: The neck among the shards.
Balls floating by the body.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 高大的盒子把拆開的吉他置於明亮碎片與漂浮白球之間。它如同凝結在空間中的一首歌。
captions: 碎片中的琴頸。
漂浮於琴身旁的白球。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick an object.
2. Take it apart.
3. Add new materials.
4. Rebuild the feeling.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個物件。
2. 把它拆開。
3. 加入新材料。
4. 重建感受。

pins.title: Dissipating Forms of Time
pins.description:
Bent iron and steel wire, hung in a wooden frame, capture a passing moment as a hovering form.

Model making | Installation | Wooden frame, iron wire, clay, steel wire and fishing line | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 消散的時間形態
zh-Hant.description:
彎折的鐵絲與鋼絲懸掛於木框中，以懸浮的形體捕捉流逝的瞬間。

模型製作｜裝置｜木框、鐵絲、黏土、鋼絲與釣魚線｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The wire form in light and shadow.
光影中的鐵絲形體。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Paintings record moments, but they felt too flat to hold changing emotions. The student wanted a three-dimensional piece that could hold a feeling.
captions: The first wire in the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 繪畫能記錄瞬間，但對承載變化的情緒來說太平面。學生想做一件能承載感受的立體作品。
captions: 框中的第一批鐵絲。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A wooden frame was sized to fit a face. Thin black wire was woven into a flat plane fixed at both ends.
captions: A front view in progress.
A side view in progress.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 木框依臉部尺寸製作。細黑鐵絲被編成固定兩端的平面。
captions: 製作中的正面。
製作中的側面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The wire was pressed into shape with a little clay, and curly steel wire was added on top. The piece was then hung from the frame with fishing line.
captions: Wire work on the bench.
The form hung by fishing line.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 鐵絲被壓塑成形並加入少量黏土，頂部加上捲曲的鋼絲。作品再以釣魚線懸掛於框中。
captions: 工作台上的鐵絲作業。
以釣魚線懸掛的形體。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Under a single light, loose strands seem to blow away from the form. The installation shows a moment slowly fading.
captions: The finished profile.
The installation in the dark.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在單一光源下，鬆散的線條彷彿從形體飄散。裝置呈現一個逐漸消逝的瞬間。
captions: 完成的側影。
暗處中的裝置。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name a feeling.
2. Set a frame.
3. Shape the material.
4. Light the moment.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 說出一種感受。
2. 設定框架。
3. 塑造材料。
4. 照亮瞬間。

pins.title: Bagua
pins.description:
Eight plaster walls carved with the eight trigrams form an octagon crossed by a web of sticks.

Model making | Traditional culture | PVC board, plaster, wooden sticks, wooden board and spray paint | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 八卦
zh-Hant.description:
刻有八卦卦象的八面石膏牆圍成八角形，再由交錯的木條網貫穿。

模型製作｜傳統文化｜PVC板、石膏、木條、木板與噴漆｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The octagon seen from above.
從上方看八角形。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was drawn to an old classic of Chinese culture that reads fortune through eight trigrams. The aim was to turn the flat bagua diagram into a space.
captions: The eight trigrams in two diagrams.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生對一部以八個卦象推演吉凶的中國古典著作深感興趣。目標是把平面的八卦圖轉化為空間。
captions: 兩張八卦圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each trigram was linked to a meaning such as sky, soil, mountain, water or wind. These notes guided the pattern on every wall.
captions: Notes on what each trigram means.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每個卦象都對應一種意義，例如天、地、山、水或風。這些筆記決定了每面牆的圖樣。
captions: 每個卦象意義的筆記。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The trigrams were cut into boards and filled with plaster, then eight walls were stood up as an octagon. Sticks were driven through the open parts of the walls.
captions: Plaster walls with trigram openings.
Walls on the workbench.
The stick web from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 卦象被切割於板材上並灌入石膏，八面牆再立成八角形。木條穿過牆面的開口處。
captions: 帶卦象開口的石膏牆。
工作台上的牆面。
從上方看木條網。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished model is a dense web of sticks inside eight patterned walls. Small figures and strong shadows show how the space would feel.
captions: Inside the octagon.
Figures among the sticks and walls.
An eye-level view.
Shadows across the floor.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的模型是在八面圖樣牆內的密集木條網。小人偶與強烈的陰影呈現空間的感受。
captions: 八角形內部。
木條與牆面間的人偶。
視平線視角。
地面上的陰影。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a symbol.
2. Learn its meaning.
3. Turn it into walls.
4. Weave the space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個符號。
2. 理解它的意義。
3. 把它化為牆。
4. 編織空間。

pins.title: Parallel Worlds in a Box
pins.description:
3D-pen lines, mirror and laser acrylic sheets turn three wooden boxes into glowing parallel worlds.

Model making | Film and space | Wooden sticks, PLA, 3D printing pen and laser acrylic sheet | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 盒中的平行世界
zh-Hant.description:
3D筆線條、鏡面與雷射壓克力板，讓三個木盒化為發光的平行世界。

模型製作｜電影與空間｜木條、PLA、3D列印筆與雷射壓克力板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The large box lit up.
點亮的大盒子。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to show parallel universes as a real object. An animated superhero film about many worlds became the starting point.
captions: Stills from the animated film.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想把平行宇宙呈現為真實的物件。一部描寫多重世界的動畫英雄電影成為起點。
captions: 動畫電影的畫面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Wire and plastic thread were tested first, but they were too soft or too stiff. A 3D printing pen gave lines that were both free and strong.
captions: Sketches of the line cubes.
Sketches of curved line panels.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 最先測試了鐵絲與塑膠線，但它們不是太軟就是太硬。3D列印筆畫出的線條既自由又堅韌。
captions: 線條方盒草圖。
曲線面板草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Curved lines filled the inside of wooden boxes. Laser acrylic sheets on four sides and a mirror below reflect the colours of the lines.
captions: The first test cube.
A simple web inside a cube.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 曲線填滿木盒內部。四面的雷射壓克力板與底部的鏡子反射出線條的色彩。
captions: 第一個測試方盒。
方盒內的簡單蛛網。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Three boxes tell the story: one bright, one red and black, and one large box for the hero's whole journey. Small cut-out pictures of the characters sit inside.
captions: The bright green and yellow box.
The red and black box.
Lines and cut-outs inside.
Coloured lines up close.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 三個盒子講述故事：一個明亮、一個紅黑，以及一個代表主角完整旅程的大盒子。盒內放有角色的小剪影圖片。
captions: 明亮的綠黃盒子。
紅黑盒子。
內部的線條與剪影。
彩色線條近景。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Watch closely.
2. Find the images.
3. Test the materials.
4. Build the worlds.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 仔細觀看。
2. 找出畫面。
3. 測試材料。
4. 建構世界。

pins.title: Vertical Ascent
pins.description:
A tall tower wrapped in DNA spirals and ramps tells a film story of reaching for space against the odds.

Model making | Film and space | Plastic, AB glue, wooden sticks, wire, spray paint, PLA and PVC board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 垂直攀升
zh-Hant.description:
一座纏繞DNA螺旋與坡道的高塔，講述一個逆境中追尋太空夢的電影故事。

模型製作｜電影與空間｜塑膠、AB膠、木條、鐵絲、噴漆、PLA與PVC板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower.
完成的高塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The model is based on a science-fiction film where genes decide a person's job. Its hero, born with weaker genes, still works his way to space, and the student wanted to build that persistence.
captions: A drawing of the tower idea.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 模型取材自一部由基因決定職業的科幻電影。主角天生基因較弱，仍努力走向太空，學生想把這份堅持建構出來。
captions: 高塔構想手繪。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The sketches set out four levels: a race, a workplace, a climb through challenges and the final launch. Each level marks a key moment of the story.
captions: A sketch of the four levels.
A tall sketch of the ascent.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 草圖規劃四個層次：一場競賽、一個工作場所、穿越挑戰的攀爬，以及最終的升空。每一層代表故事的關鍵時刻。
captions: 四個層次的草圖。
攀升的長形草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A green base was cast with tinted AB glue, and a 3D-printed pillar and platform held wooden sticks. Silver-painted plastic, wire and red forms added the upward movement.
captions: The top level for higher goals.
A DNA spiral beside the frame.
The working space.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以調色AB膠澆鑄綠色基座，3D列印的柱子與平台固定木條。銀色噴漆的塑膠、鐵絲與紅色形體加強向上的動勢。
captions: 代表更高目標的頂層。
框架旁的DNA螺旋。
工作空間。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The tower rises through DNA spirals, ramps and stairs to a sharp tip. It reads as a vertical path toward a dream.
captions: Red shapes for genetic material.
Ramps for climbing.
The spiral stairs at the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 高塔穿過DNA螺旋、坡道與樓梯，直升至尖頂。它如同一條通往夢想的垂直路徑。
captions: 代表遺傳物質的紅色形體。
攀爬用的坡道。
底部的螺旋梯。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a story.
2. Find key moments.
3. Stack them as levels.
4. Build the climb.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個故事。
2. 找出關鍵時刻。
3. 把它們疊成層次。
4. 建構攀升。

pins.title: Transcoding Traditional Chinese Architecture
pins.description:
Mortise and tenon logic is rebuilt in wooden sticks and bamboo weaving as a new courtyard pavilion.

Model making | Traditional architecture | Wooden sticks and bamboo weaving | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 轉譯中國傳統建築
zh-Hant.description:
以木條與竹編重構榫卯邏輯，形成一座新的庭院亭子。

模型製作｜傳統建築｜木條與竹編｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished pavilion and roof.
完成的亭子與屋頂。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to bring traditional Chinese timber building into a modern design. The goal was a courtyard that honours the past and fits today's life.
captions: Joint pieces cut from sticks.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想把中國傳統木構建築帶入現代設計。目標是一座既尊重傳統又適合當代生活的庭院。
captions: 以木條切出的接頭。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A historic pavilion was studied through a digital model and books. Its double eaves, carved beams and mortise and tenon joints were the key lessons.
captions: The first frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生透過數位模型與書籍研究一座歷史亭閣。重簷、雕樑與榫卯接合是主要的學習重點。
captions: 第一個框架。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Simple joints were made from combined wooden sticks, then built up into a full frame. The logic of the joints shaped a new pavilion.
captions: Layers of brackets.
The frame from an angle.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以組合木條做出簡單接頭，再逐步建成完整框架。接頭的邏輯塑造出一座新的亭子。
captions: 層層斗栱。
斜角的框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Bamboo weaving finished the sweeping roof. Light falls through the layered sticks onto the courtyard below.
captions: The eaves from the front.
A roof corner.
Under the roof.
Figures in the courtyard.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 竹編完成了舒展的屋頂。光線穿過層疊的木條灑落在下方庭院。
captions: 正面的屋簷。
屋頂轉角。
屋頂之下。
庭院中的人偶。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study a building.
2. Learn its joints.
3. Rebuild the logic.
4. Make it new.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究一座建築。
2. 理解它的接頭。
3. 重建邏輯。
4. 使它煥然一新。

pins.title: Hexagonal Corridor Structure
pins.description:
Mirror paper and PVC hexagons stack along a model riverbank into walkways and waterfront platforms.

Model making | Landscape and structure | Mirror paper, PVC board, stone clay, AB glue and grass powder | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 六角形廊道結構
zh-Hant.description:
鏡面紙與PVC六角形沿著模型河岸堆疊，形成步道與親水平台。

模型製作｜地景與結構｜鏡面紙、PVC板、石粉黏土、AB膠與草粉｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The hexagons on both banks.
兩岸的六角形結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project began with a test of how materials bend. Mirror paper curved easily, while PVC board stayed firm, and the student wanted to use both.
captions: Sketches of the hexagon system.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個作品起於一次材料彎曲的測試。鏡面紙容易彎曲，PVC板則保持堅挺，學生想同時運用兩者。
captions: 六角形系統草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: After many trials, a hexagon was chosen for its regular shape and easy joins. Sketches showed how units could link into walkways and supports.
captions: Early unit tests.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 經過多次嘗試，六角形因規則的形狀與易於接合而被選用。草圖呈現單元如何連成步道與支撐。
captions: 早期單元測試。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A riverbank was modelled with stone clay, grass powder and stones, and the river was poured with tinted AB glue. Hexagon units were stacked on both banks.
captions: The riverbank terrain begins.
Clusters of units.
Units by the poured water.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以石粉黏土、草粉與石頭塑造河岸，並以調色AB膠澆灌河道。六角形單元堆疊於兩岸。
captions: 河岸地形起步。
單元群組。
澆灌水面旁的單元。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The stacked units form corridors and platforms for rest and meeting by the water. The model shows a structure that grows with the landscape.
captions: The waterfront in low light.
Figures on the walkway.
Hexagons from above.
Layered platforms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 堆疊的單元形成可在水邊休憩與相聚的廊道與平台。模型呈現一個隨地景生長的結構。
captions: 低光中的水岸。
步道上的人偶。
從上方看六角形。
層疊的平台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Test materials.
2. Pick a unit.
3. Shape the ground.
4. Stack with purpose.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 測試材料。
2. 選定單元。
3. 塑造地形。
4. 有目的地堆疊。

pins.title: Pineapple Bio-geometry
pins.description:
The fibres inside a pineapple cake inspire a growing web of wood sticks that casts patterned shadows.

Model making | Bio-inspired structure | Tracing paper, wood sticks, pencil, hot glue and cardboard | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 鳳梨生物幾何
zh-Hant.description:
鳳梨酥內部的纖維啟發一張不斷生長的木條網，投下帶有圖案的陰影。

模型製作｜仿生結構｜描圖紙、木條、鉛筆、熱熔膠與紙板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The canopy under a low light.
低光下的頂篷。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Breaking open a pineapple cake, the student saw a web of fibres inside. The aim was to turn that inner structure into a space.
captions: Fibres inside the pastry.
The pastry broken open.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 剝開一塊鳳梨酥時，學生看見內部交織的纖維。目標是把這種內部結構轉化為空間。
captions: 糕點內部的纖維。
剝開的糕點。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Sketches studied the fibres, and thin wood strips were cut to copy them. The pieces were stacked into a first concept model.
captions: Early sketches.
A drawing of the stick web.
Cutting thin wood strips.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 草圖研究纖維，並切割細木條模仿它們。這些木條被堆疊成第一個概念模型。
captions: 早期草圖。
木條網手繪。
切割細木條。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: As the model grew, the gaps between sticks became spaces to explore, so corridor-like paths were added. The form spread into a cantilevered umbrella shape.
captions: The model growing outward.
Shadows traced on the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 隨著模型生長，木條間的縫隙成為可探索的空間，於是加入如廊道般的路徑。形體延展成懸挑的傘狀。
captions: 向外生長的模型。
描繪在底座上的陰影。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Under light, the web casts rich patterns, which were traced in pencil on the base. The model reads as an organism that can keep on growing.
captions: A drawing with figures.
A view from inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在光線下，木條網投下豐富的圖案，並以鉛筆描繪在底座上。模型如同一個可以持續生長的有機體。
captions: 帶人偶的圖面。
內部視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Look inside things.
2. Copy the structure.
3. Let it grow.
4. Trace the light.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察事物內部。
2. 模仿結構。
3. 讓它生長。
4. 描繪光影。

pins.title: House
pins.description:
Two crossing rectangles and a round core create a house with a sense of horizontal movement.

Model making | House design | Cardboard, hot glue and wooden sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 住宅
zh-Hant.description:
兩個交錯的矩形與一個圓形核心，構成一座帶有水平移動感的住宅。

模型製作｜住宅設計｜紙板、熱熔膠與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished house model.
完成的住宅模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted a house that gives a sense of moving sideways. The question was how a plan could show that motion.
captions: A first plan sketch.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想設計一座帶有橫向移動感的住宅。問題在於平面如何表現這種動態。
captions: 第一張平面草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Reference houses led to one idea: two rectangles crossing each other to make a space in the middle. Plans tested a round core at the crossing.
captions: The crossing plan.
A loose form sketch.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 參考案例引出一個想法：兩個矩形彼此交錯，在中間創造空間。平面圖在交錯處測試一個圓形核心。
captions: 交錯的平面圖。
形體速寫。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Card panels and sticks were cut and glued to test the crossing walls and roofs. The pieces slid past each other like moving plates.
captions: Card panels in process.
An early frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 切割並黏合紙板與木條，測試交錯的牆與屋頂。各部件像移動的板片般彼此錯開。
captions: 製作中的紙板面。
早期的框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model sets long white volumes across each other around a round core. Open frames let the space flow from end to end.
captions: A corner of the house.
The round core from above.
Inside the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型讓長形白色量體圍繞圓形核心交錯。開放的框架讓空間由一端流向另一端。
captions: 住宅的轉角。
從上方看圓形核心。
框架內部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Name a movement.
2. Draw it in plan.
3. Cut and test.
4. Let space flow.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 說出一種動態。
2. 在平面上畫出。
3. 切割並測試。
4. 讓空間流動。

pins.title: Drowned Legacy: The Inevitable Tide
pins.description:
A coastal model shows houses from different eras slowly taken by rising seas until only stone shelters remain.

Model making | Climate and architecture | Wooden sticks, steel, stones, sand, cement, plants and acrylic rods | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 淹沒的遺產：無法避免的潮水
zh-Hant.description:
一座海岸模型呈現不同時代的房屋被上升的海水逐步吞沒，最後只剩石造庇護所。

模型製作｜氣候與建築｜木條、鋼材、石頭、沙、水泥、植物與壓克力棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Frames and walls in the water.
水中的框架與牆。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Rising sea levels threaten homes along every coast. The student asked what would be left of our buildings if the water kept coming.
captions: Four eras along one coast.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 上升的海平面威脅著每一段海岸上的家。學生思考，若海水持續上漲，我們的建築會留下什麼。
captions: 同一海岸上的四個時代。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A drawing set four houses from different eras side by side, each built of glass, cement, steel, wood or stone. Only the stone house stays above the water.
captions: Testing stone, sand and cement.
The stone shelter above the sea.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一張圖面將不同時代的四座房屋並排，分別以玻璃、水泥、鋼材、木材或石頭建成。只有石屋留在水面之上。
captions: 測試石頭、沙與水泥。
海面上的石造庇護所。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The model was built in layers of sand, stone and cement with clear rods as water. It was shot in three stages as the tide rises.
captions: Three stages of the rising tide.
Flood.
Floating.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 模型以沙、石頭與水泥分層建造，並以透明棒表現水。它依海水上升分三個階段拍攝。
captions: 海水上升的三個階段。
淹水。
漂浮。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Sunken walls and frames turn into reefs where sea life can settle. The work suggests a future where people and the ocean share the same structures.
captions: Habitat under water.
A desolate building.
Timber frames as a reef.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 沉沒的牆與框架轉變為海洋生物可棲息的礁體。作品提出人與海洋共享同一結構的未來。
captions: 水下棲地。
荒廢的建築。
成為礁體的木構架。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a threat.
2. Compare materials.
3. Stage the change.
4. Find new life.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選定一個威脅。
2. 比較材料。
3. 分階段呈現變化。
4. 找到新的生命。

pins.title: Green Charging Park
pins.description:
An old fuel station becomes a car charging park under a terraced garden whose plants help make power.

Architectural design | Adaptive reuse | Hand sketches and 3D modelling | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 綠色充電公園
zh-Hant.description:
一座舊加油站轉變為充電公園，上方的階梯花園以植物協助發電。

建築設計｜再利用｜手繪草圖與3D建模｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The terraced rooftop garden.
階梯式屋頂花園。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Fuel stations are being left empty as more people drive electric cars. Nearby residents also lack parking and easy access for seniors and wheelchair users.
captions: Sketch of the garden zones.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 隨著更多人駕駛電動車，加油站逐漸閒置。附近居民也缺少停車位，長者與輪椅使用者出入不便。
captions: 花園分區草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student studied how bacteria around plant roots release a small electric current. Sketches tested a stepped garden that could sit above a charging floor.
captions: Sketch of stairs and grass.
Sketch of the tree columns.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生研究植物根部周圍的細菌如何釋放微小電流。草圖測試一座可架在充電層上方的階梯花園。
captions: 樓梯與草地草圖。
樹狀柱草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Tree-shaped columns hold round planters over the parking and charging level. Ramps and a side elevator give everyone a way up to the garden.
captions: The long section.
Plants power the night lights.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 樹狀柱在停車與充電層上方撐起圓形種植台。坡道與側邊電梯讓每個人都能登上花園。
captions: 長向剖面。
植物為夜間照明供電。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The roof becomes a green public park while the ground floor charges cars. Power from the plants lights the garden at night.
captions: Terraces and ramps.
The side elevator.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 屋頂成為綠色公共公園，地面層則為車輛充電。植物產生的電力在夜間點亮花園。
captions: 階梯平台與坡道。
側邊電梯。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find an empty site.
2. Study a new energy.
3. Stack the uses.
4. Design for all.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找到閒置基地。
2. 研究新能源。
3. 堆疊不同用途。
4. 為所有人設計。

pins.title: Puzzle-piece Calm Space
pins.description:
Eight rooms shaped like puzzle pieces connect by ramps into a calm, semi-open place for autistic children.

Model making | Space for children | Wooden board, PVC board, laser cutting and 3D modelling | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 拼圖形的安心空間
zh-Hant.description:
八個拼圖形的房間以坡道相連，為自閉症兒童打造一處安心的半開放空間。

模型製作｜兒童空間｜木板、PVC板、雷射切割與3D建模｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Ramps cross the open front.
坡道穿越開放的正面。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Autistic children often feel anxious in places that are crowded or new. The student wanted a space where they could move and rest safely.
captions: Mapping the children's needs.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 自閉症兒童在擁擠或陌生的環境中常感到焦慮。學生想打造一個讓他們能安心活動與休息的空間。
captions: 整理孩子們的需求。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Mind maps listed the activities and feelings the space should hold. The puzzle piece became the idea, as each piece looks incomplete alone but fits into a whole.
captions: Rooms linked by ramps.
From pieces to a whole.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 心智圖列出空間應容納的活動與感受。拼圖成為核心概念，因為每一片單獨看似不完整，卻能拼成整體。
captions: 以坡道相連的房間。
由片段組成整體。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Eight boxes of different sizes hold rooms for rest, play and meals. The form was modelled in 3D and then laser cut from board.
captions: The digital model.
The puzzle outline.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 八個大小不同的盒子容納休息、遊戲與用餐的房間。形體先以3D建模，再以板材雷射切割。
captions: 數位模型。
拼圖的輪廓。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Ramps and balconies let children move freely between floors at their own pace. The model shows a calm place built with care and patience.
captions: Balconies on the corner.
A hall of ramps.
A quiet room.
Ramps from below.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 坡道與陽台讓孩子能依自己的步調在樓層間自由移動。模型呈現一個以關懷與耐心打造的安心場所。
captions: 轉角的陽台。
坡道大廳。
安靜的房間。
從下方看坡道。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Listen to users.
2. Find a symbol.
3. Vary the rooms.
4. Connect gently.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 傾聽使用者。
2. 找到一個象徵。
3. 變化房間。
4. 溫和地連接。

pins.title: The Illusion of Choices
pins.description:
A wooden box wrapped in coloured yarn hides mirror shards, so looking inside shows only the viewer's own reflection.

Installation | Thought and perception | Pencil, card paper, wooden sticks, wool and glass | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 選擇的錯覺
zh-Hant.description:
一個纏繞彩色毛線的木箱內藏鏡面碎片，往內看時只會看見觀者自己的倒影。

裝置｜思想與感知｜鉛筆、卡紙、木條、毛線與玻璃｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The yarn web from above.
從上方看毛線網。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wondered how people tell the real from the unreal. A box became the test, looking solid outside but holding a different world inside.
captions: Sketches of the four faces.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生思考人們如何分辨真實與虛幻。一個木箱成為實驗，外表看似實在，內部卻藏著另一個世界。
captions: 四個面的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each of the four faces was matched to a different school of thought about truth. Sketches tried patterns of yarn, from order to tangle.
captions: Sketches of the box.
A sketch of looking inside.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 四個面各自對應一種關於真理的思想流派。草圖嘗試從有序到糾結的不同毛線圖案。
captions: 木箱草圖。
往內看的草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A painted wooden frame was wrapped in blue, black, natural and green yarn. Strands run from the inside to each face and never fold back.
captions: The blue yarn face.
Two faces meet.
Hanging strands.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 塗色的木框纏上藍色、黑色、原色與綠色毛線。線束由內部連向各個面，且不會折返。
captions: 藍色毛線面。
兩個面相接。
垂掛的線束。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Mirror shards inside the box show viewers only themselves. The work suggests that every choice is a path with no way back.
captions: The dark yarn face.
Natural and black yarn.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 箱內的鏡面碎片只讓觀者看見自己。作品暗示每個選擇都是一條無法回頭的路。
captions: 深色毛線面。
原色與黑色毛線。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask a big question.
2. Give each side a role.
3. Wrap and test.
4. Let viewers join.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 提出一個大問題。
2. 賦予每一面角色。
3. 纏繞並測試。
4. 讓觀者參與。

pins.title: The Source of Purity
pins.description:
Three clay and foam cubes move from a pure blue block to a polluted, broken one and then to signs of rebirth.

Model making | Ocean and environment | Ultra-light clay, foam adhesive, foam board, acrylic, cotton, stone, leaves, sand and hay | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 純淨之源
zh-Hant.description:
三個黏土與泡沫方塊，從純淨的藍色方塊走向受污染的破碎方塊，再到重生的跡象。

模型製作｜海洋與環境｜超輕黏土、泡沫膠、泡沫板、壓克力、棉花、碎石、落葉、沙與乾草｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The three cubes together.
三個方塊並置。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Plastic and oil keep harming the ocean. The student wanted a simple form to show how clean water is lost and might return.
captions: The pure blue cube.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 塑膠與油污持續傷害海洋。學生想用一個簡單的形體，表現乾淨的水如何失去又可能回來。
captions: 純淨的藍色方塊。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A perfect blue cube was chosen to stand for clean sea and sky. Each later cube would be more scrambled, like a puzzle cube being turned.
captions: Half order, half pollution.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 以完美的藍色方塊代表乾淨的海洋與天空。之後的每個方塊都更加打亂，如同被轉動的方塊玩具。
captions: 一半秩序，一半污染。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Ultra-light clay and blue foam adhesive formed the cubes, and foam board built the polluted zone. Stones, leaves, sand and hay were added as details.
captions: The fully scrambled cube.
The clay surface.
Foam waves.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以超輕黏土與藍色泡沫膠塑造方塊，並以泡沫板建構污染區。碎石、落葉、沙與乾草作為細節加入。
captions: 完全打亂的方塊。
黏土表面。
泡沫浪花。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The last cube is fully scrambled yet full of life, with foam waves and driftwood. The series shows that nature can heal if people act.
captions: Green blocks and stones.
Cotton like falling water.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最後的方塊完全打亂卻充滿生機，帶有泡沫浪花與漂流木。這個系列表現只要人們行動，自然就能修復。
captions: 綠色方塊與石頭。
如落水般的棉花。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a pure form.
2. Break it in steps.
3. Use real textures.
4. End with hope.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從純粹的形體開始。
2. 分步驟打破它。
3. 運用真實質感。
4. 以希望作結。

pins.title: Two Sides Tower
pins.description:
A tall mixed-material model grows in six parts, each one telling a stage of a story about two rivals.

Model making | Narrative structure | PVC board, wooden and bamboo sticks, tin foil, clay, iron wire, foam and acrylic strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 雙面之塔
zh-Hant.description:
一座高聳的複合材料模型分六個部分生長，每個部分講述兩個對手故事中的一個階段。

模型製作｜敘事結構｜PVC板、木條與竹籤、錫箔、黏土、鐵絲、泡沫塊與壓克力條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower.
完成的塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to turn the plot of a crime film into a building. Two rivals, one on each side of the law, had to share one structure.
captions: A colour sketch of the six parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想把一部犯罪電影的情節轉化為建築。分處法律兩端的兩個對手，必須共享同一個結構。
captions: 六個部分的彩色草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A colour sketch divided the story into six stages from bottom to top. Each stage was given its own material and form.
captions: Folded paper and toothpicks.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一張彩色草圖將故事由下而上分成六個階段。每個階段都被賦予各自的材料與形態。
captions: 摺紙與牙籤。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Stick platforms and stairs form the base, with a crumpled foil mass beside them. Above them rise folded paper, foam supports, clay and a cage of wire houses.
captions: The wire cage.
Clay flowing upward.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 木條平台與樓梯構成基座，旁邊是揉皺的錫箔量體。其上依序升起摺紙、泡沫支撐、黏土與鐵絲房屋組成的籠子。
captions: 鐵絲籠。
向上流動的黏土。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The tower reads as one climb through the whole story. A detailed pen drawing records every part of it.
captions: The model from above.
A pen drawing of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這座塔讀起來就像一次貫穿整個故事的攀升。一張細膩的鋼筆畫記錄了它的每個部分。
captions: 從上方看模型。
塔的鋼筆畫。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Break the story down.
2. Give each part a material.
3. Stack in order.
4. Draw what you built.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 拆解故事。
2. 為每個部分配置材料。
3. 依序堆疊。
4. 畫出你所建造的。

pins.title: Tower of Echoes
pins.description:
Roofs, door frames and a spire from familiar buildings are echoed in a white card tower wrapped by red paths.

Model making | Tower design | PVC board, wooden sticks and cardboard | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 回聲之塔
zh-Hant.description:
熟悉建築中的屋頂、門框與尖塔，在一座被紅色路徑環繞的白色紙板塔中迴響。

模型製作｜塔樓設計｜PVC板、木條與紙板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished tower.
完成的塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student took photos of the old brick buildings around them every day. The aim was to sample their parts and build a new tower from them.
captions: A stipple drawing of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生每天拍攝身邊的老磚造建築。目標是取樣它們的構件，建造一座新的塔。
captions: 塔的點描畫。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Triangular roofs, square door frames and window frames were picked out from the photos. A tall spire with doors on four sides became the top.
captions: Building the base.
Adding the levels.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 從照片中挑出三角形屋頂、方形門框與窗框。一座四面開門的高聳尖塔成為頂部。
captions: 建造基座。
加上樓層。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Card walls were cut and glued with great care, since each cut decided whether the parts above could stand. Red strips wind through the levels as paths.
captions: The tower on black.
Arched doors.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 紙板牆面經過仔細切割與黏合，因為每一刀都決定上方構件能否站穩。紅色紙條作為路徑在各層間蜿蜒。
captions: 黑底上的塔。
拱門。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The white tower climbs past arches, gables and ramps to a pointed spire. Small red figures show how people would move through it.
captions: Red ramps through the walls.
Gable walls and figures.
A small gabled room.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 白色的塔經過拱門、山牆與坡道，升至尖頂。紅色小人偶呈現人們如何在其中移動。
captions: 穿越牆面的紅色坡道。
山牆與人偶。
小型山牆空間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Photograph your world.
2. Pick the key parts.
3. Cut with care.
4. Add a path.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 拍下你的世界。
2. 挑出關鍵構件。
3. 仔細切割。
4. 加入一條路徑。

pins.title: Steel Unity
pins.description:
Triangles of card braced by wooden sticks form an angular structure that can also be worn on the shoulder.

Model making | Wearable structure | PVC board and wooden sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 鋼之聯結
zh-Hant.description:
以木條支撐的紙板三角形，組成一個稜角分明、也能披在肩上的結構。

模型製作｜可穿戴結構｜PVC板與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished structure.
完成的結構。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The steel frame of a tall tower caught the student's eye with its intricate yet orderly pattern. The question was how to turn that frame into a small object.
captions: Drawings of a steel frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一座高塔的鋼構框架以其複雜卻有序的圖案吸引了學生。問題在於如何把這個框架轉化為小型物件。
captions: 鋼構框架圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Drawings traced how the frame repeats in triangles. Single card triangles were tested with sticks as braces.
captions: Triangle units.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 圖面描繪框架如何以三角形重複。以木條作為支撐，測試單一的紙板三角形。
captions: 三角形單元。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Many triangles of different shapes were cut and joined into one angular form. Line and shaded drawings helped keep the whole piece cohesive.
captions: A line drawing of the form.
A shaded drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 切割許多不同形狀的三角形，並接合成一個稜角分明的形體。線稿與明暗素描幫助整件作品保持一致。
captions: 形體線稿。
明暗素描。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished structure sits on a table or rests on the shoulder like armour. Its sticks and triangles echo the tower frame at a human scale.
captions: One way to arrange it.
A second view.
A third view.
Sticks inside the triangles.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的結構可放在桌上，也能像盔甲般披在肩上。它的木條與三角形以人的尺度呼應塔的框架。
captions: 一種擺放方式。
第二個視角。
第三個視角。
三角形內的木條。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Look at structure.
2. Find the unit.
3. Repeat and vary.
4. Try it at body scale.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 觀察結構。
2. 找到單元。
3. 重複與變化。
4. 以身體尺度嘗試。

pins.title: Open Windows Community
pins.description:
Houses with oversized openings are cut into cross sections and grown into a small open community of white walls and wooden frames.

Model making | Housing and community | PVC board, wooden strips and cubes, cotton, iron wire | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 開窗社區
zh-Hant.description:
帶有超大開口的住宅被切成剖面，並生長為一個由白牆與木框組成的小型開放社區。

模型製作｜住宅與社區｜PVC板、木條與木塊、棉花、鐵絲｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The whole community model.
整個社區模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was struck by a house whose doors and windows blur into large openings. Such openness pushes against old ideas that kept women inside the home, and the student wrote a poem about their hidden feelings.
captions: A study of light through the openings.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生被一棟門與窗模糊成大型開口的住宅所震撼。這種開放性對抗了將女性束縛於家中的舊觀念，學生為她們隱藏的情感寫了一首詩。
captions: 光線穿過開口的研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Eight sketches turned the house into cross sections with openings of different sizes. From them the student made up four house types.
captions: Sketches of the cross sections.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 八張草圖把住宅轉化為開口大小不一的剖面。學生從中發展出四種住宅類型。
captions: 剖面草圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Each type was built in white board and photographed from three sides. Public facilities in wooden frames and blocks were then added, following the pattern of the sections.
captions: One house type from three sides.
A second house type.
Wooden frames between walls.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 每種類型都以白色板材製作，並從三個面拍攝。接著依循剖面的圖案，加入以木框與木塊構成的公共設施。
captions: 一種住宅類型的三個面。
第二種住宅類型。
牆之間的木框。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The houses open onto stairs, frames and cotton trees shared by everyone. The community turns private homes outward.
captions: A stair of wooden blocks.
Frames seen from above.
A cotton tree in a courtyard.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 住宅向所有人共享的樓梯、木框與棉花樹敞開。這個社區讓私人住宅轉向外部。
captions: 木塊組成的樓梯。
從上方看木框。
庭院中的棉花樹。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Find a house that moves you.
2. Cut it into sections.
3. Make types.
4. Share the space between.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 找到打動你的住宅。
2. 把它切成剖面。
3. 發展類型。
4. 共享其間的空間。

pins.title: Hidden Fears of a Night Street
pins.description:
Fears felt on a dark walk are mapped and built into thirteen wire-tangled stick frames hidden behind calm walls.

Model making | Urban perception | PVC board, wooden strips and cubes, cotton, iron wire | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 夜街裡隱藏的恐懼
zh-Hant.description:
一次黑暗步行中感受到的恐懼被繪製成圖，並建造成十三個纏滿鐵絲、藏在平靜牆面後的木條框架。

模型製作｜城市感知｜PVC板、木條與木塊、棉花、鐵絲｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Three buildings from the final model.
最終模型中的三棟建築。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: On a trip, the student had to walk alone through a rough district at night with a dead phone. Darkness, laughter and noise leaked from the buildings, and the question became how a building can hide its chaos.
captions: Maps of the scary factors.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 旅途中，學生在手機沒電的情況下，必須在夜裡獨自穿越一個混亂的街區。黑暗、笑聲與噪音從建築中滲出，問題於是成為：建築如何隱藏它的混亂。
captions: 令人害怕的因素地圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student drew the route and marked what was frightening: passing trains, lines of sight, areas of darkness and levels of sound. Each factor became its own map.
captions: Twisted wire bundles.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生畫出走過的路線，並標出令人恐懼的事物：經過的列車、視線方向、黑暗區域與聲音大小。每個因素都成為一張獨立的地圖。
captions: 扭轉的鐵絲束。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Wires and pillars were stuck to thirteen stick structures and left messy on purpose. Small wire patterns stand for incidents, and pillars show how the events connect.
captions: The thirteen structures.
Wire tangled in a frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 鐵絲與柱子被黏在十三個木條結構上，並刻意保持凌亂。小型鐵絲圖案代表事件，柱子則呈現事件之間的關聯。
captions: 十三個結構。
纏繞在框架中的鐵絲。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The structures were joined into buildings that are messy inside but calm outside. Pale walls cover the tangle, just as the street hid its danger.
captions: Inside the messy walls.
A sketch of the buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這些結構被組合成內部雜亂、外部平靜的建築。淺色牆面掩蓋了糾結，正如那條街隱藏了它的危險。
captions: 雜亂牆面之內。
建築的草圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a feeling.
2. Map what causes it.
3. Build the mess.
4. Decide what to hide.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一種感受出發。
2. 繪製造成它的原因。
3. 建造那份混亂。
4. 決定要隱藏什麼。

pins.title: Scenery along the Road
pins.description:
Layered wooden strips rise from a carved board like a canyon that changes shape with every angle.

Model making | Landscape form | Wooden board and wooden strips | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 沿途風景
zh-Hant.description:
層層木條從雕刻的木板上升起，宛如一座隨每個角度改變形態的峽谷。

模型製作｜地景形態｜木板與木條｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished model in light.
光線中的完成模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A canyon seen on a trip looked different from every angle. The student wanted a hand-made model that keeps this change and ties it to human life.
captions: A triangulated drawing of the scene.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 旅途中看到的峽谷從每個角度看都不一樣。學生想做一個保留這種變化、並連結人類生活的手工模型。
captions: 場景的三角網格圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A photo was traced into a triangulated mesh. The mesh showed where surfaces fold and where they open.
captions: The layered base.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一張照片被描繪成三角網格。網格呈現出表面在哪裡折起、在哪裡打開。
captions: 層疊的基座。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Thin wooden strips were layered on a board to make the ground. Bundles of strips were then set at angles to rise above it.
captions: Strips seen from above.
Strips rising from the base.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 細木條層層鋪在木板上構成地面。接著將成束的木條以不同角度架設，升起於其上。
captions: 從上方看木條。
從基座升起的木條。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished model looks like a canyon from one side and a tangle of paths from another. Light through the strips casts changing shadows.
captions: A low view.
Light and shadow inside.
The model on black.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的模型從一側看像峽谷，從另一側看則是交錯的路徑。穿過木條的光線投下變化的陰影。
captions: 低角度視角。
內部的光與影。
黑底上的模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Look from many angles.
2. Trace the form.
3. Layer the ground.
4. Test it in light.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從多個角度觀看。
2. 描繪形態。
3. 層疊地面。
4. 在光線中測試。

pins.title: Optical Exploration
pins.description:
A hand-made cardboard camera is paired with a stick tower built to be seen through its lens.

Model making | Optics and architecture | Cardboard, wood, tape, optical lens | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 光學探索
zh-Hant.description:
一台手工紙板相機，搭配一座為了透過其鏡頭觀看而建造的木條塔。

模型製作｜光學與建築｜紙板、木材、膠帶、光學鏡頭｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The camera and the tower.
相機與塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to learn how a camera forms an image. The plan was to build both a simple camera and a building for it to capture.
captions: A concept drawing of the tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想了解相機如何成像。計畫是同時建造一台簡易相機，以及一棟供它拍攝的建築。
captions: 塔的概念圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Cardboard formed the frame, and tape sealed off all light except at the lens. Wax paper was tested as the screen and gave the clearest image.
captions: The camera box and lens.
A sketch of the lens.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 紙板構成框架，膠帶封住鏡頭以外的所有光線。蠟紙被測試作為成像屏，呈現出最清晰的影像。
captions: 相機盒與鏡頭。
鏡頭素描。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The tower was built only from wooden strips. The size of the box set the focal length, and the lens position set where the image lands.
captions: The tower behind the camera.
The tower from the side.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 塔僅以木條建造。盒子的尺寸決定焦距，鏡頭的位置決定影像落在何處。
captions: 相機後方的塔。
從側面看塔。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Looking into the camera, one sees the tower appear on the wax paper. The project taught the student about lenses, focal length and building by hand.
captions: The tower alone.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 從相機看進去，可以看到塔出現在蠟紙上。這個專案讓學生學到鏡頭、焦距與手工建造。
captions: 單獨的塔。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Ask how it works.
2. Build the tool.
3. Build what it sees.
4. Adjust and look again.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 問它如何運作。
2. 建造工具。
3. 建造它看見的東西。
4. 調整後再看一次。

pins.title: Fragments of Hope
pins.description:
Wavy lines drawn by many young hands are joined into one painting, then cut into a wooden puzzle given back as a gift.

Painting and puzzle design | Volunteer-inspired | Tracing paper, wooden board, marker | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 希望的碎片
zh-Hant.description:
許多孩子畫下的波浪線條被組合成一幅畫，再切割成一副木製拼圖，作為禮物送回給他們。

繪畫與拼圖設計｜志工經驗啟發｜描圖紙、木板、麥克筆｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The shared painting.
共同完成的畫作。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: While volunteering in weekend art classes, the student saw that many children found it hard to hold a brush steadily. Their drawings were mostly curved, wavy lines, and few could finish a picture alone.
captions: Colours filling the lines.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在週末美術課擔任志工時，學生發現許多孩子難以穩定地握筆。他們的畫多半是彎曲的波浪線，很少有人能獨自完成一幅畫。
captions: 填滿線條的色彩。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student collected the colourful lines drawn by ten children and looked for links between them. The lines met and formed small shapes, which the children then filled with colour.
captions: A small face on a piece.
Shapes and eyes.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生收集了十個孩子畫下的彩色線條，並尋找它們之間的關聯。線條相交形成小形狀，孩子們再為它們填上顏色。
captions: 拼圖上的小臉。
形狀與眼睛。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The painting was scanned and set into a 3D puzzle model. Each piece was given its own small face, then cut from wood with a laser.
captions: The cut pieces in a box.
Loose pieces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 畫作經掃描後放入3D拼圖模型。每一片都被賦予一張獨特的小臉，再以雷射從木板切出。
captions: 盒中切好的拼圖。
散落的拼圖片。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The puzzle went back to the children as a gift to put together. Each piece stands for one child, and the whole picture appears only when they join.
captions: The puzzle half done.
The finished puzzle.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這副拼圖作為禮物送回孩子手中，讓他們一起拼。每一片代表一個孩子，只有拼在一起時，完整的畫面才會出現。
captions: 拼到一半的拼圖。
完成的拼圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Notice what is hard.
2. Start from their marks.
3. Join many into one.
4. Give it back.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 留意困難之處。
2. 從他們的筆觸出發。
3. 把許多匯聚為一。
4. 把成果還給他們。

pins.title: Twisted Chessboard
pins.description:
A ceramic chessboard warps like cloth, and glazed pieces of very different shapes stand on its coloured squares.

Ceramics | Object design | Ceramic clay, underglaze, transparent glaze, glass glaze | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 扭曲的棋盤
zh-Hant.description:
一個陶瓷棋盤如布料般扭曲，形態迥異的上釉棋子立於彩色方格之上。

陶藝｜物件設計｜陶土、釉下彩、透明釉、玻璃釉｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished chessboard.
完成的棋盤。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to make a chessboard where the board itself is part of the play. A twisted surface would make every square feel uneven.
captions: A colour study of the warped grid.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想做一個讓棋盤本身也參與遊戲的棋盤。扭曲的表面會讓每個方格都顯得不平均。
captions: 扭曲格網的色彩研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Drawings tested how a square grid bends and how many colours it could hold. Two kinds of pieces were planned: one large sculpted figure and many simple, formless ones.
captions: A sketch of the board and pieces.
The carved relief grid.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 圖面測試了方格網如何彎曲、能容納多少色彩。規劃了兩種棋子：一個大型雕塑人物，以及許多簡單、無具體形態的棋子。
captions: 棋盤與棋子的草圖。
雕刻的浮雕格網。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A relief board was carved in ceramic clay, then the pieces were shaped. After air-drying, underglaze added layered colour.
captions: Painting the underglaze.
Coloured squares.
Simple pieces.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 以陶土雕出浮雕棋盤，再塑造棋子。風乾後以釉下彩加上層次豐富的色彩。
captions: 上釉下彩。
彩色方格。
簡單的棋子。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Glass glaze makes the sculpted piece shine, and a clear glaze seals the whole set. The contrast between the pieces makes the game feel uneven from the start.
captions: The sculpted piece.
The set before the final glaze.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 玻璃釉讓雕塑棋子閃閃發亮，透明釉則封住整組作品。棋子之間的對比，讓遊戲從一開始就顯得不平等。
captions: 雕塑的棋子。
上最後一層釉之前的棋組。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Question the board.
2. Bend the grid.
3. Contrast the pieces.
4. Let glaze carry meaning.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 質疑棋盤本身。
2. 彎曲格網。
3. 對比棋子。
4. 讓釉色承載意義。

pins.title: A Garden for an Individual
pins.description:
A photo collage of a window turns into striped walls and terrain, shaping a quiet garden walked in sequence.

Summer architecture studio | Garden design | Rhino model, picture collage | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 一個人的花園
zh-Hant.description:
一張窗戶的照片拼貼轉化為條紋牆與地形，塑造出一座依序漫步的寧靜花園。

暑期建築工作營｜花園設計｜Rhino模型、圖像拼貼｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The garden in isometric view.
花園的等角視圖。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The task was to design a garden for one person from a single image. The student began with a photo grid of the window beside the study desk.
captions: The first collage from window photos.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 題目是從一張圖像出發，為一個人設計花園。學生從書桌旁窗戶的照片格網開始。
captions: 由窗戶照片做成的第一張拼貼。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A perspective collage of the photos was redrawn to stress the contrast of bright and dark. The white and dark lines kept strict right angles to each other.
captions: Light and dark lines in the collage.
Wall iterations.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 照片的透視拼貼被重新繪製，以強調明暗對比。白色與深色線條彼此保持嚴格的直角關係。
captions: 拼貼中的明暗線條。
牆體的反覆推演。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Many versions of wall and terrain led to the idea of striations across the landscape. Bands carved from the wall tops let sunlight fall into the spaces below.
captions: Striped pieces.
Wall and terrain combined.
Light in two sections.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 多次牆與地形的版本，發展出橫越地景的條紋概念。從牆頂刻出的帶狀開口，讓陽光灑入下方空間。
captions: 條紋構件。
牆與地形的結合。
兩個剖面中的光線。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: After the final review, some strips were raised or lowered to form stairs. A visitor now moves through the garden in a clear order of light and shade.
captions: Views along the walking sequence.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 期末評圖後，部分條帶被升高或降低以形成階梯。訪客如今能依明暗的清楚順序穿越花園。
captions: 沿著行走序列的視角。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one image.
2. Draw the contrast.
3. Turn lines into walls.
4. Shape a sequence.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一張圖像開始。
2. 畫出對比。
3. 把線條變成牆。
4. 塑造行走序列。

pins.title: Golf Motion in Space
pins.description:
The turning body of a golf swing is traced, frozen into a solid form and cut from stacked acrylic sheets.

Motion study | Sculpture | Rhino model, physical model, acrylic board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 空間中的高爾夫揮桿
zh-Hant.description:
高爾夫揮桿中轉動的身體被描繪下來，凝固成實體形態，再以層疊的壓克力板切割而成。

動作研究｜雕塑｜Rhino模型、實體模型、壓克力板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The acrylic model stands on its own.
壓克力模型能自行站立。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A golf swing turns the shoulders, waist and hips and folds the arms one after another. The student wanted to show how these linked motions could describe space.
captions: Traced lines of the swing.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 高爾夫揮桿依序轉動肩、腰、髖，並彎曲手臂。學生想呈現這些連續動作如何描述空間。
captions: 揮桿的描線。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Tracing the swing showed that the triangle between head, shoulder and wrist stays almost fixed while the body spins. Those points were taken out and reduced to simple diagrams.
captions: Points of the swing in order.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 描繪揮桿後發現，身體旋轉時頭、肩與手腕之間的三角關係幾乎不變。這些點被抽取出來，簡化為簡單的圖解。
captions: 依序排列的揮桿點位。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: In Rhino the diagrams grew from points to lines and then to a solid body. The body was sliced into contours and each slice was cut from acrylic.
captions: An early digital body.
The solid body before cutting.
Sharp edges from the side.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 在Rhino中，圖解從點發展為線，再成為實體。實體被切成等高輪廓，每一片都以壓克力切出。
captions: 早期的數位形體。
切割前的實體形體。
側面的銳利邊緣。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished model can stand on the ground by itself, like a statue or even a chair. Changing light throws striped shadows that move across it.
captions: Stripes of light through the layers.
An arch under the form.
Lines of shadow.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的模型能自行立於地面，像一座雕像，甚至像一張椅子。變化的光線投下在其上移動的條紋陰影。
captions: 穿過層板的光紋。
形體下方的拱。
陰影的線條。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick a motion you know.
2. Trace it.
3. Find what stays still.
4. Build from slices.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個你熟悉的動作。
2. 把它描繪下來。
3. 找出不動的部分。
4. 以切片建構。

pins.title: Spiral of Choices
pins.description:
Five turning points of a story about chasing dreams become platforms on a spiral tower that climbs from bottom to top.

Model making | Narrative space | Plastic board, coloured aluminium wire, acrylic, reflective sheets | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 選擇的螺旋
zh-Hant.description:
一個追夢故事的五個轉折點，化為一座由下而上攀升的螺旋塔上的平台。

模型製作｜敘事空間｜塑膠板、彩色鋁線、壓克力、反光片｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The spiral stair in blue light.
藍光中的螺旋梯。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A favourite musical film made the student think about growth, choices and chasing dreams. The project asks how those themes could be read in space.
captions: The whole tower.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一部喜愛的音樂電影讓學生思考成長、選擇與追夢。這個專題探問這些主題如何在空間中被閱讀。
captions: 整座塔。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Five key moments were picked, from a hopeful start to a final parting on separate paths. For each one, a body motion or a turn of the plot was drawn as a spatial part.
captions: The lattice base.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生挑選了五個關鍵時刻，從充滿希望的開始到各自走上不同道路的分別。每一個時刻的肢體動作或情節轉折，都被畫成一個空間構件。
captions: 格狀基座。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The parts were stacked from bottom to top in the order of the story. Each was built on its own and then joined into one tower.
captions: Upper platforms.
Layered floors.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 這些構件依故事順序由下往上堆疊。每一個先單獨製作，再組合成一座塔。
captions: 上層平台。
層疊的樓板。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Stairs, rings and round platforms climb through blue light toward the top. The tower shows that each choice brings some loss, yet every step adds to growth.
captions: The tower from above.
Round stepping platforms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 階梯、圓環與圓形平台在藍光中向上攀升。這座塔表達每個選擇都伴隨失去，但每一步都促成成長。
captions: 從上方看塔。
圓形踏台。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Choose a story that matters.
2. Pick key moments.
3. Give each a form.
4. Stack them in order.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 選一個對你重要的故事。
2. 挑出關鍵時刻。
3. 為每個時刻賦形。
4. 依序堆疊。

pins.title: Imaginary Space
pins.description:
Traced pieces of curved, circular and flat buildings are collaged into one drawing and then built as a bursting white model.

Model making | Collage and form | PVC board, wooden sticks, wooden plate | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 想像的空間
zh-Hant.description:
描下的曲面、圓形與平面建築片段被拼貼成一張圖，再建成一座迸發的白色模型。

模型製作｜拼貼與形態｜PVC板、木棒、木板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished model.
完成的模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student was drawn to buildings known for curved fronts, round forms and calm flat walls. The aim was to join these very different languages in one imaginary space.
captions: A curved study.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生被以曲面立面、圓形量體與平靜平牆聞名的建築所吸引。目標是把這些迥異的語彙結合在一個想像的空間中。
captions: 曲面研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Pictures of the buildings were traced on tracing paper and cut into pieces. The pieces were stretched and collaged into one composite drawing.
captions: The composite line drawing.
The layered tracing collage.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 建築的圖片被描在描圖紙上並剪成碎片。這些碎片被延展、拼貼成一張組合圖。
captions: 組合的線描。
層疊的描圖拼貼。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Elements were lifted from the drawing to make the model. The work focused on fusing curved, circular and flat surfaces together.
captions: An early model.
The model from the front.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生從圖中提取元素來製作模型。重點在於把曲面、圓形與平面融合在一起。
captions: 早期模型。
模型正面。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: White walls curl around round rooms while sticks burst out on every side. The model reads as a single new place built from many borrowed parts.
captions: Sticks bursting out.
Shadows on the side.
A narrow view.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 白牆環繞圓形空間捲曲，木棒向四面八方迸出。模型看起來是由許多借來的片段組成的一個全新場所。
captions: 迸出的木棒。
側面的陰影。
窄角視圖。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Study works you admire.
2. Trace and cut.
3. Collage into one.
4. Build the fusion.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 研究你欣賞的作品。
2. 描繪並剪下。
3. 拼貼成一體。
4. 建構融合。

pins.title: The Ground I Run Upon
pins.description:
Ground textures noticed on daily runs are drawn as patterns and rebuilt as small models of foam, cotton, sand and sticks.

Model making | Material study | Foam board, cotton, plaster, sand, pebbles, wooden sticks, iron wire | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 我奔跑的地面
zh-Hant.description:
日常跑步時注意到的地面紋理被畫成圖案，再以泡棉、棉花、沙與木棒重建為小模型。

模型製作｜材料研究｜泡棉板、棉花、石膏、沙、卵石、木棒、鐵絲｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The set of texture models.
整組紋理模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student runs around the neighbourhood and slows down when a view catches the eye. At that pace, the texture of the ground beneath becomes very clear.
captions: Patterns traced from the ground.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生常在住家附近跑步，看到吸引目光的景色就會放慢腳步。在這樣的速度下，腳下地面的紋理變得格外清晰。
captions: 從地面描下的圖案。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Some ground was hard and some was soft, and each was made of different materials. The student photographed the ground and traced a pattern from each texture.
captions: Foam and wire.
Pebbles set in foam.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 有些地面堅硬、有些柔軟，各自由不同材料組成。學生拍下地面，並從每種紋理描出圖案。
captions: 泡棉與鐵絲。
嵌入泡棉的卵石。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Materials that felt close to each texture were chosen, though not the same as on the ground. Each model was also lifted upward so it could be read as a space.
captions: A stick frame over the ground.
Cotton on a plaster block.
A folded sail.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生選擇感覺接近各種紋理的材料，雖然與地面上的並不相同。每個模型也被向上發展，讓它能被讀成一個空間。
captions: 地面上的木棒框架。
石膏塊上的棉花。
摺起的帆。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The pieces turn ordinary ground into shelters, sails and gardens. Working with so many materials broadened the student's sense of texture and making.
captions: A timber shelter.
Wire and cotton from above.
The models side by side.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 這些作品把平凡的地面變成棚架、帆與花園。運用這麼多材料，拓展了學生對紋理與製作的感受。
captions: 木構棚架。
從上方看鐵絲與棉花。
並排的模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Notice the ground.
2. Trace its pattern.
3. Match a material.
4. Lift it into space.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 留意地面。
2. 描下它的圖案。
3. 找到相應的材料。
4. 把它提升為空間。

pins.title: Fragments House
pins.description:
Drawings of one given image are broken into fragments and rebuilt, step by step, into a long house by a lake.

Summer architecture studio | House design | Foam board, museum board, Photoshop, Rhino, Illustrator | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 碎片之屋
zh-Hant.description:
一張指定圖像的多次繪製被拆解成碎片，再一步步重組成一座湖畔的長形住宅。

暑期建築工作營｜住宅設計｜泡棉板、博物館紙板、Photoshop、Rhino、Illustrator｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The house from above.
從上方看住宅。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Every student received the same image and had six weeks to turn it into architecture. The student set out to find forms and line weights hidden in that one picture.
captions: Studies of the given image.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 每位學生都拿到同一張圖像，並有六週把它轉化為建築。學生著手尋找藏在這張圖中的形態與線條粗細。
captions: 對指定圖像的研究。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Many drawings of the image were made by hand and then layered digitally. The work kept moving from flat drawings to models and back again.
captions: Stick fragments.
Plane fragments.
Denser fragment models.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先手繪多張圖像研究，再以數位方式層疊。過程不斷在平面圖與模型之間來回轉換。
captions: 線狀碎片模型。
面狀碎片模型。
更密集的碎片模型。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Small fragments from the scale models were joined into one overall form. The form became a house by a hillside lake for two scientists.
captions: A layered elevation drawing.
Two axonometric views.
Scale models of the house.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 比例模型中的小碎片被組合成一個整體形態。這個形態成為山坡湖畔一座供兩位科學家居住的住宅。
captions: 層疊的立面圖。
兩張軸測圖。
住宅的比例模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Long slabs and walls slide past each other and reach out over the water. The course also taught the student to cut cleaner and manage time better.
captions: The roof in plan.
A section toward the lake.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 長形樓板與牆體彼此錯動，向水面伸出。這門課也讓學生學會切得更俐落、更善於管理時間。
captions: 屋頂平面。
朝向湖面的剖面。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from one image.
2. Draw it many times.
3. Break it into fragments.
4. Rebuild a place.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從一張圖像出發。
2. 反覆繪製。
3. 拆解成碎片。
4. 重建一個場所。

pins.title: Cell Bridge
pins.description:
A frame of cell-like openings rises over a small sunken stage, letting light fall onto the performers below.

Summer architecture studio | Performance space | Polystyrene foam board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 細胞之橋
zh-Hant.description:
一座由細胞狀開口組成的框架升起於小型下沉舞台之上，讓光線灑落在下方的表演者身上。

暑期建築工作營｜表演空間｜聚苯乙烯泡棉板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The cell frame model.
細胞框架模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The earlier course project turned a parking space under an elevated park into a stage for a small band. Rows of benches circled a round platform sunk below the pavement.
captions: A section of the sunken stage.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 先前的課程專題把高架公園下方的一個停車位改造成小型樂團的舞台。一排排長椅環繞著一個低於路面的圓形平台。
captions: 下沉舞台的剖面。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: For the next step, the student looked at how living cells move and change shape. The idea was a frame that could feel alive and also bring in daylight.
captions: A sketch of the frame.
A curve template.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 下一步，學生研究活細胞如何移動與變形。構想是一個看起來有生命、同時能引入日光的框架。
captions: 框架草圖。
曲線模板。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Cells with rounded openings were cut from foam board and joined at their edges. Layers of cells were stacked into a long, bridge-like frame over the stage.
captions: One cut cell.
The first assembly.
The long frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 帶有圓角開口的細胞單元以泡棉板切出，並在邊緣相接。一層層細胞單元被堆疊成跨越舞台的長形橋狀框架。
captions: 一個切好的細胞單元。
初步組裝。
長形框架。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Light passes through the openings and moves across the stage below. The frame gives the small performance space a lively, organic roof.
captions: Cells stacked in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 光線穿過開口，在下方舞台上移動。這個框架為小小的表演空間撐起一片生動而有機的屋頂。
captions: 層層堆疊的細胞單元。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Revisit a past project.
2. Borrow from nature.
3. Repeat one unit.
4. Let light in.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 重新檢視過去的專題。
2. 向自然借鏡。
3. 重複一個單元。
4. 讓光進來。

pins.title: Rhythm of Notes
pins.description:
Notes, clefs and beats of a piano piece are turned into shapes, laid out as a diagram and built up in thin sticks and blue sheets.

Model making | Music and form | Coloured plastic sheets, wooden sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 音符的節奏
zh-Hant.description:
一首鋼琴曲中的音符、譜號與節拍被轉化為形狀，排成圖解，再以細木棒與藍色片材堆疊而成。

模型製作｜音樂與形態｜彩色塑膠片、木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished stick model.
完成的木棒模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Every piece of music is built from meter, dynamics, rhythm, harmony and scales. The student wanted to show the movement and energy these parts create together.
captions: Musical symbols turned into forms.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 每一首樂曲都由拍子、力度、節奏、和聲與音階構成。學生想呈現這些部分共同創造的動態與活力。
captions: 轉化為形態的音樂符號。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each element, from single notes to clefs, was given its own shape. The shapes were then placed along a chosen piano piece to show how they move and meet.
captions: Diagrams of each part.
The full diagram.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 從單一音符到譜號，每個元素都被賦予專屬的形狀。這些形狀再依一首選定的鋼琴曲排列，呈現它們如何移動與交會。
captions: 各部分的圖解。
完整圖解。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The flat diagram was raised into a model with thin wooden sticks. Open common areas sit beside smaller, more closed and private corners.
captions: The model from above.
A corner of sticks.
Blue light through the sheets.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 平面圖解被以細木棒提升為立體模型。開放的公共區域旁，是較小、較封閉而私密的角落。
captions: 從上方看模型。
木棒的轉角。
穿過片材的藍光。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Small triangles stand for movement in the music and cast lively shadows. Light slips through the gaps into the empty spaces between the sticks.
captions: Inside at night.
A low view.
Tall sticks and gaps.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 小三角形代表音樂中的律動，並投下生動的陰影。光線從縫隙滲入木棒之間的空隙。
captions: 夜間的內部。
低角度視圖。
高聳的木棒與縫隙。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. List the parts of music.
2. Give each a shape.
3. Map them in time.
4. Raise the map.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 列出音樂的組成。
2. 為每一項賦形。
3. 依時間排列。
4. 把圖面立體化。

pins.title: Piano Key Tower
pins.description:
Notes from piano scores are drawn as black and white boxes, then stacked into an uneven tower of white layers.

Model making | Music and vertical city | Foam board, museum board, Photoshop, Rhino, Illustrator | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 琴鍵之塔
zh-Hant.description:
鋼琴樂譜中的音符被畫成黑白方塊，再堆疊成一座參差不齊的白色層疊高塔。

模型製作｜音樂與垂直城市｜泡棉板、博物館紙板、Photoshop、Rhino、Illustrator｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The tower set into a skyline.
置入天際線中的塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student has played piano since early childhood and loves classical pieces. The project asks how the black and white keys could become a building.
captions: Keys as simple bars.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生從小就彈鋼琴，熱愛古典樂曲。這個專題探問黑白琴鍵如何成為一棟建築。
captions: 化為簡單條塊的琴鍵。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Short passages of favourite pieces were chosen and each note was redrawn as a box. Filled boxes stand for the black keys.
captions: Notes filled as boxes on the score.
The notes as a 3D block diagram.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生挑選喜愛樂曲中的短樂段，把每個音符重畫成方塊。填黑的方塊代表黑鍵。
captions: 在樂譜上填成方塊的音符。
音符化成的立體方塊圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The idea of building upward instead of outward guided the next step. Board layers, each with its own uneven design, were built one by one and stacked.
captions: First paper blocks.
A cluster of boxes.
The tall layered model.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 向上而非向外發展的概念引導了下一步。每一層都有獨特而不規則設計的板材層被逐一製作並堆疊起來。
captions: 最初的紙方塊。
一組方塊。
高聳的層疊模型。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Each block could hold homes, sports, dining, balconies or green rooms. The tower can change or grow taller as needs change.
captions: A sketch looking up the tower.
Detail of the layers.
Rooms in the stack.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 每個方塊都能容納住宅、運動、餐飲、陽台或綠色空間。這座塔可以隨需求改變或繼續長高。
captions: 仰望塔身的草圖。
層板細部。
堆疊中的房間。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from what you play.
2. Turn notes into boxes.
3. Stack upward.
4. Let every layer differ.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從你演奏的音樂開始。
2. 把音符化為方塊。
3. 向上堆疊。
4. 讓每一層都不同。

pins.title: Trombone Metropolis
pins.description:
A trombone is taken apart into tubes on paper, and the parts become an industrial city built from recycled nails and bike parts.

Model making | Industrial city | Recycled nails, screws, bicycle parts | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 長號都市
zh-Hant.description:
一把長號在紙上被拆解成管件，這些部件化為一座以回收螺絲與單車零件建成的工業城市。

模型製作｜工業城市｜回收鐵釘、螺絲、單車零件｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The metal city model.
金屬城市模型。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The trombone, a long-time interest of the student, is made of many linked tubes. The project asks whether those parts could become blocks for building a city.
captions: Sketches of the instrument.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 長號是學生長久以來的興趣，由許多相連的管子組成。這個專題探問這些部件能否成為建造城市的積木。
captions: 樂器草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: The student sketched the whole instrument and then focused on the slide braces and mouthpiece. In Photoshop the drawings were cut into small pieces.
captions: Parts rearranged into buildings.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生先畫下整把樂器，再聚焦於滑管支架與吹嘴。這些圖在Photoshop中被切成小片段。
captions: 重組成建築的部件。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Only the broken-down parts were used to draw new buildings and structures. The scale model then swapped tubes for recycled nails and bicycle parts.
captions: A city drawn from tubes.
The model from the left.
The model from the right.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生只用拆解後的部件來繪製新的建築與結構。比例模型再以回收鐵釘與單車零件取代管件。
captions: 以管件繪成的城市。
模型左側。
模型右側。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Long parts act as pipes and thick nails act as beams, like the inside of a factory. Small figures show that people can still live and meet in this metal skyline.
captions: Towers of screws.
Gears and stairs in detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 長形零件像管線，粗鐵釘像樑，宛如工廠內部。小人偶表示人們仍能在這片金屬天際線中生活與相遇。
captions: 螺絲構成的塔。
齒輪與樓梯細部。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Take something apart.
2. Draw its pieces.
3. Rebuild something new.
4. Find real parts.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 拆解一件物品。
2. 畫下它的零件。
3. 重組成新事物。
4. 找到真實的材料。

pins.title: Crossing Lines
pins.description:
A collage of a busy street crossing and line drawings of film scenes are folded together into one layered paper city.

Model making | Collage city | Photoshop, Illustrator, Procreate, paper | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 交錯之線
zh-Hant.description:
繁忙路口的拼貼與電影場景的線稿被摺疊結合，成為一座層層疊疊的紙上城市。

模型製作｜拼貼城市｜Photoshop、Illustrator、Procreate、紙材｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The finished paper city.
完成的紙上城市。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student wanted to join a favourite street scene and a favourite science fiction film in one work. The question was how two very different worlds could share one city.
captions: Buildings traced as lines.
Film scenes as line sketches.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生想把最喜愛的街景與最喜愛的科幻電影結合在同一件作品中。問題在於兩個截然不同的世界如何共享一座城市。
captions: 描成線條的建築。
化為線稿的電影場景。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Buildings were cut from photos of a busy crossing and rebuilt as a noisy collage. Scenes from the film were sketched only as line segments on a black ground.
captions: The hatched collage drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生從繁忙路口的照片中剪下建築，重組成一幅喧鬧的拼貼。電影場景則只以線段的形式畫在黑色底上。
captions: 排線拼貼圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The two layers were printed and folded into standing frames. Early studies tested how the frames could lean and lock together.
captions: A first study model.
Letter-like frames.
A study on the mat.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 兩個圖層被列印出來並摺成立起的框架。早期研究測試這些框架如何傾斜並互相扣合。
captions: 最初的研究模型。
如字母般的框架。
切割墊上的研究。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The final model reads like a dragon of buildings winding across the table. Photo surfaces and white line frames sit side by side, so both worlds stay visible.
captions: The model on black.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型宛如一條由建築組成、蜿蜒於桌面的巨龍。照片表面與白色線框並置，讓兩個世界都清晰可見。
captions: 黑底上的模型。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Pick two worlds you love.
2. Collect their shapes.
3. Fold drawings into space.
4. Let the layers meet.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 挑選兩個你喜愛的世界。
2. 收集它們的形狀。
3. 把圖摺成空間。
4. 讓圖層相遇。

pins.title: Independent Ecosystem Research
pins.description:
A woven bamboo tower carries plants from four climates, from tropical at the base to boreal at the top.

Model making | Ecosystem and climate | Bamboo, wood, mosses, plants, branches | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 獨立生態系統研究
zh-Hant.description:
一座竹編塔承載四種氣候的植物，從底部的熱帶到頂端的寒帶。

模型製作｜生態與氣候｜竹、木、苔蘚、植物、樹枝｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The woven tower with moss and branches.
覆滿苔蘚與樹枝的編織塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: Climate change and fast-growing cities are putting pressure on many plants and animals. The student asked what a stable home for living things might look like in a changing world.
captions: The concept sketch.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 氣候變遷與快速擴張的城市正對許多動植物造成壓力。學生思考在變動的世界裡，生物穩定的家園會是什麼模樣。
captions: 概念草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Plants were grouped into four climate types, from tropical to subtropical, temperate and boreal. A sketch placed them in layers from bottom to top.
captions: Plants sorted by climate.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 學生把植物分為熱帶、亞熱帶、溫帶與寒帶四種氣候類型。一張草圖將它們由下而上分層排列。
captions: 依氣候分層的植物。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Bamboo weaving was chosen as the main structure because it is gentle on the environment and strong enough. Woven shells were shaped to hold soil, moss and branches.
captions: The weave up close.
A curving woven shell.
Inside the woven frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生選擇竹編作為主要結構，因為它對環境友善且足夠堅韌。編織外殼被塑造成能承載土壤、苔蘚與樹枝的形狀。
captions: 編織近看。
彎曲的編織外殼。
編織框架內部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished tower changes its plants as it rises, like a small climate map. It expresses a calm and stable world where living things can stay.
captions: The final showcase.
Moss behind the weave.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的塔隨高度變換植物，就像一張小型氣候地圖。它表達出一個讓生物得以安居的平靜而穩定的世界。
captions: 最終展示。
編織後方的苔蘚。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Start from a real concern.
2. Sort what you find.
3. Choose a kind material.
4. Build it in layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 從真實的關懷出發。
2. 整理你的發現。
3. 選擇友善的材料。
4. 分層建構。

pins.title: Library Renovation
pins.description:
A web of wooden sticks holds coloured translucent panes, testing a new ceiling that paints the floor with light.

Model making | Ceiling renovation | Coloured plastic sheets, wooden sticks | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 圖書館改造
zh-Hant.description:
木棒編成的網架承托彩色半透明板，試驗一片能以光彩繪地面的新天花板。

模型製作｜天花板改造｜彩色塑膠片、木棒｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: Coloured light beneath the web.
網架下的彩色光影。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The student set out to rethink the ceiling of a library at school. The aim was a ceiling that changes how light enters and colours the room.
captions: The bare stick frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 學生著手重新構想學校圖書館的天花板。目標是讓天花板改變光線進入的方式，並為空間染上色彩。
captions: 未覆板的木棒框架。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Coloured glass windows in old churches were the main inspiration. The student studied how tinted glass turns plain daylight into patches of colour.
captions: The frame from above.
The web seen from above.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 古老教堂中的彩色玻璃窗是主要靈感來源。學生研究有色玻璃如何把平凡的日光化為一片片色彩。
captions: 從上方看框架。
從上方看網架。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A spider-web structure of wooden sticks was built to hold translucent coloured sheets as panes. Each pane was set at a different angle to test the shadows it casts.
captions: The frame from the side.
Panes up close.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生以木棒建構蜘蛛網般的結構，承托作為窗板的半透明彩色片。每片彩板以不同角度安裝，以測試它投下的陰影。
captions: 網架側面。
彩板近看。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Under a strong light, the model throws coloured shapes across the floor and walls. Small figures show how a reader would sit and walk within the shifting colour.
captions: A figure in the coloured shadow.
Colour falling on the floor.
A pool of blue light.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 在強光下，模型把彩色形狀投射到地面與牆上。小人形呈現讀者如何在變幻的色彩中坐下與走動。
captions: 彩色陰影中的人形。
灑落地面的色彩。
一片藍色光影。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Look up at a ceiling.
2. Borrow a light idea.
3. Build a web.
4. Test the shadows.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 抬頭看天花板。
2. 借用一個光的概念。
3. 搭建一張網。
4. 測試陰影。

pins.title: Machinery City
pins.description:
Toy bricks, gears and a small programmed controller come together as a moving city of arms, bridges and lifts.

Model making | Programming design | Toy bricks, gears, sensors, controller board | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 機械城市
zh-Hant.description:
玩具積木、齒輪與小型程式控制器組合成一座擁有手臂、橋梁與升降機的會動城市。

模型製作｜程式設計｜玩具積木、齒輪、感測器、控制板｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The moving city on black.
黑底上的會動城市。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project asks how a city could move like a machine. The student imagined parts that lift, swing and connect on their own.
captions: The first machine sketch.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個專題探問城市能否像機器一樣運作。學生想像能自行抬升、擺動與連接的部件。
captions: 最初的機械草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A hand sketch mapped out arms, shafts and gears before building began. Each motion was broken down into a simple mechanism.
captions: A gear-driven arm.
A lever in the frame.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 動手搭建前，學生先以手繪草圖規劃手臂、轉軸與齒輪。每個動作都被拆解成簡單的機構。
captions: 齒輪驅動的手臂。
框架中的槓桿。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The mechanisms were built from toy bricks and linked to a controller board and sensors. The student then wrote programs to set each part in motion.
captions: An arm lifting up.
The drive under the frame.
Gears and beams in detail.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 這些機構以玩具積木搭建，並連接控制板與感測器。學生接著編寫程式讓每個部件動起來。
captions: 抬起的手臂。
框架下的傳動。
齒輪與樑的細部。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The finished model behaves like a small working city with a lifting bridge of beams. It joins design, mechanics and coding in one piece.
captions: Wires and a sensor.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 完成的模型像一座小型運轉中的城市，擁有一道由樑組成的升降橋。它在同一件作品中結合了設計、機械與程式。
captions: 線路與感測器。

sections.heading: How I Teach This Method
sections.body:
1. Imagine a moving city.
2. Sketch each motion.
3. Build simple mechanisms.
4. Program them to move.

zh-Hant.heading: 我如何教這套方法
zh-Hant.body:
1. 想像一座會動的城市。
2. 畫下每個動作。
3. 搭建簡單機構。
4. 寫程式讓它動起來。

pins.title: The Multiverse
pins.description:
A five-layer tower of stairs, small worlds and coloured glass turns the feelings of a film story into space.

Model making | Story and space | Salt, acrylics, cotton, spray paint, iron wire | Student Project | Design Director: Yu Chun Tsai (full-cycle supervision)

zh-Hant.title: 多重宇宙
zh-Hant.description:
一座由樓梯、小世界與彩色玻璃組成的五層塔，把電影故事中的情感轉化為空間。

模型製作｜故事與空間｜鹽、壓克力、棉花、噴漆、鐵絲｜學生作品｜設計總監 Yu Chun Tsai，全程指導

captions: The tower crowned with coloured glass.
頂端覆著彩色玻璃的塔。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: A film about travelling through many universes inspired the student to look at the feelings inside the story. These include facing the dark side of oneself, a mother's strong hold on her child and the spirit of a team.
captions: A labelled sketch of the layers.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 一部關於穿越多重宇宙的電影，啟發學生審視故事中的情感。其中包括面對自我的黑暗面、母親對孩子的強烈執著，以及團隊精神。
captions: 標示各層的草圖。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each feeling was given its own layer, so the model grew into a five-layer body. Sketches set out how stairs would link one layer to the next.
captions: A sketch of the stair layers.
A spiral stair.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每一種情感都有自己的一層，使模型發展成五層的實體。草圖規劃了樓梯如何連接各層。
captions: 樓梯層的草圖。
螺旋樓梯。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A foundation floor with stairs came first, then a prism frame of wooden strips on the second floor. Five small spaces on the third floor stand for different times and places, filled with clay and bionic trees.
captions: Dried bionic trees.
Small worlds on the third floor.
Glass panes at the top.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 學生先做出帶樓梯的基礎樓層，再在二樓以木條搭建稜柱框架。三樓的五個小空間代表不同的時間與空間，並填入黏土與仿生樹。
captions: 乾燥的仿生樹。
三樓的小世界。
頂部的玻璃窗。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A grand staircase climbs to a stained glass building set on a turning wheel at the top. Small figures give the scale of a real person against the tower.
captions: The full model from the front.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
